title: Some Dialects Are More Equal Than Others: Non-Prestigious Arabic Dialectal Bias in LLMs
summary: Previous work on Egyptian Arabic in NLP has focused largely on the prestigious Cairene Egyptian Arabic (CEA) dialect, resulting in a lack of representation for the less prestigious Sa'idi Egyptian Arabic (SEA) dialect both in LLM and resource development. Does this lack of representation influence an LLM's view of the acceptability of SEA (upstream), and does an upstream bias against SEA lead to worse performance (downstream)? We investigate the upstream effect of SEA dialectal features on LLM preferences in a Targeted Syntactic Evaluation (TSE) task which reveals a significant bias against SEA across multiple LLMs. We then analyze the effect of these same features on downstream model performance on MMLU benchmarks and show that models experience a degradation in performance when presented with SEA. This work highlights the need for further exploration on how sub-dialectal variation impacts language technologies.

AI.tldr: 该研究考察少于标准地位的上埃及阿拉伯语（SEA）方言在LLM中的代表性缺失，通过目标句法评估（TSE）验证上游偏见，并通过MMLU基准验证下游性能下降。
AI.motivation: 既有埃及阿拉伯语NLP研究主要聚焦于地位较高的开罗埃及阿拉伯语（CEA），导致地位较低的上埃及阿拉伯语（SEA）在LLM和语言资源开发中代表性不足。作者关注这种代表性缺失是否会影响LLM对SEA可接受度的判断（上游），以及上游对SEA的偏见是否会导致下游任务性能变差。
AI.method: 采用目标句法评估（TSE）任务，考察SEA方言特征对多个LLM偏好的上游影响；随后分析相同方言特征在下游MMLU基准上对模型性能的影响。
AI.result: TSE任务显示多个LLM对SEA存在显著偏见；在下游MMLU基准上，当输入为SEA时模型性能出现退化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作凸显了对次方言变体（sub-dialectal variation）如何影响语言技术进行进一步研究的必要性。

title: Open-Jev Judgments on CallScreenBench: Calibrated One-Pass Scam Screening with a Small Language Model
summary: Screening a phone call for fraud needs a trustworthy probability after every caller turn, in milliseconds. Jev-style typed decisions promise exactly that: declared options go in, one calibrated probability per option comes out of a single forward pass, with no generated text. We test an open implementation of this readout, JevLite, on scam-call screening: Qwen3-4B is LoRA-tuned so that the temperature-scaled softmax over two answer-label logits is P(scam). On 41 held-out CallScreenBench scenarios (577 per-turn decisions) a three-seed ensemble reaches AUROC .974 with calibration error .052, non-inferior to an LLM judge (MiniMax-M3) at a pre-registered .02 margin, with no false alarms on legitimate calls, decisions 1.14 turns earlier under the same hang-up rule, and 64.5 ms per decision on one consumer GPU, 4.9x lower than the same backbone fine-tuned to generate its answer. The gain is in the readout and calibration, not accuracy: a fine-tuned ModernBERT encoder is not significantly worse, the recipe was selected with test-set exposure, and all callers are synthetic. We claim no architectural novelty; the contribution is the application and an evaluation reporting calibration, false alarms and decision timing alongside AUROC.

AI.tldr:
在诈骗电话筛查任务上，对 Qwen3-4B 进行 LoRA 微调，使两个答案标签 logits 经温度缩放 softmax 得到 P(scam)；三随机种子集成在 41 个留存场景（577 个逐轮决策）上达到 AUROC .974、校准误差 .052，单决策 64.5 ms（单张消费级 GPU），比同骨干生成式方案快 4.9 倍。</tldr>
<parameter name="motivation">诈骗电话筛查需要在每个来电者轮次后于毫秒级给出可信概率，而生成式 LLM 判官既慢又难以直接给出校准概率；因此需要一种单次前向、无文本生成、逐选项输出校准概率的读出方式。
AI.motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable
AI.method: 测试 JevLite 这一"类型化决策"读出的开源实现：将 Qwen3-4B 做 LoRA 微调，对两个答案标签 logit 做温度缩放 softmax 得到 P(scam)；与 MiniMax-M3 判官在预注册的 .02 非劣性边界下对比，并以微调 ModernBERT 编码器作对照。
AI.result: 三随机种子集成：AUROC .974，校准误差 .052，在预注册 .02 边界下非劣于 MiniMax-M3；合法通话零误报；相同挂断规则下决策提前 1.14 轮；单决策 64.5 ms（单张消费级 GPU），比同骨干生成式微调低 4.9 倍延迟；微调 ModernBERT 编码器性能无显著劣势。
AI.conclusion: 增益来自读出与校准而非准确率；配方选择过程中接触过测试集，且所有来电者均为合成数据；作者不主张架构新颖性，贡献在于该应用以及同时报告校准、误报与决策时机的评测方式。

title: Colon3R: Cross-Domain 3D Reconstruction from Monocular Colonoscopic Video
summary: Monocular colonoscopic 3D reconstruction is important for surgical robotic colonoscopy, but remains challenging due to weak texture, specular reflections, limited view overlap, and non-rigid tissue motion. Conventional multi-view 3D reconstruction methods rely on stable correspondences and approximate rigidity, which are often violated in colonoscopy. Existing endoscopic methods often rely on domain-specific supervision, whereas there are not enough in-vivo labeled data available to adapt geometry foundation models to clinical colonoscopy. We present Colon3R, a cross-domain semi-supervised framework built on pretrained VGGT that transfers coupled camera, depth, and pointmap geometry from labeled phantom and simulated data to unlabeled in-vivo colonoscopy without requiring target-domain geometric annotations. Unlike source-only fine-tuning, which learns only from phantom and simulated data, Colon3R directly exploits unlabeled in-vivo video through teacher-derived cross-view supervision. Our proposed hierarchical quasi-rigid reliability selects reliable supervision at the sequence, directed-pair, and pixel levels, while source-preserving adaptation retains the learned coupled geometry during target-domain adaptation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior overall performance over state-of-the-art approaches in depth, pointmap, and camera pose estimation. Qualitative comparisons on real in-vivo colonoscopy further show substantially more complete and geometrically consistent reconstructions than competing methods under clinical domain shift. The code will be public available after the paper is accepted.

AI.tldr: Colon3R是一个基于预训练VGGT的跨域半监督框架，将已标注的体模与仿真数据中的相机、深度和点云图几何迁移至无标注的在体结肠镜数据，通过分层准刚性可靠性筛选与源域保持自适应，在深度、点云图和相机位姿估计上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 单目结肠镜3D重建对机器人结肠镜手术很重要，但面临纹理弱、镜面反射、视角重叠有限、组织非刚性运动等挑战。传统多视图方法依赖稳定对应和近似刚性假设，这些在结肠镜中常不成立；现有内窥镜方法依赖特定域监督，而在体标注数据不足，难以将几何基础模型适配到临床结肠镜场景。
AI.method: 提出Colon3R，一种基于预训练VGGT的跨域半监督框架，将体模和仿真数据中耦合的相机、深度和点云图几何迁移到无标注在体结肠镜数据，无需目标域几何标注。与仅从源数据学习的微调不同，该方法通过教师模型导出的跨视图监督直接利用无标注在体视频。设计了分层准刚性可靠性机制，在序列、有向对和像素三个层级筛选可靠监督，并通过源域保持自适应在目标域适配过程中保留已学到的耦合几何。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法在深度、点云图和相机位姿估计方面的总体性能优于当前最先进方法。在真实在体结肠镜上的定性比较显示，在临床域偏移下，相比竞争方法能获得更完整、几何一致性更强的重建结果。
AI.conclusion: Colon3R通过跨域半监督与分层准刚性可靠性筛选，有效解决了临床结肠镜在体几何标注不足的问题，实现了更优的深度、点云图和相机位姿估计以及更一致的在体重建。代码将在论文被接收后公开。

title: From Tables to Quantified Statements: Evaluating LLM Inference Generation through Executable Verification
summary: LLMs can generate fluent descriptions from tables, but their outputs may remain logically unsupported by the structured data. We introduce STAT-TO-TEXT, a controlled task in which LLMs generate quantified natural language inferences from statistical tables using quantified constructions such as all, some, no, and most. To evaluate these inferences, we use an LLM generated Python checker code which when executed verifies the corresponding truth conditions against the table. We compare four open-weight LLMs across model families and scales, evaluating faithfulness, logical accuracy, table coverage, and diversity. Our results show that model scale and family matter, with the largest model (GPT-OSS-120B) consistently producing the most faithful inferences without sacrificing greater table coverage and quantifier diversity, as opposed to smaller models. These findings are supported by human annotation, which shows that the automated checker closely aligns with human judgments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 STAT-TO-TEXT 受控任务，要求 LLM 从统计表生成含全称、存在、否定、多数等量化结构的自然语言推断，并用 LLM 生成的 Python 检查器代码验证真值条件，比较四个开放权重模型在忠实性、逻辑准确性、表覆盖度与多样性上的表现。
AI.motivation: LLM 虽能生成流畅的表格描述，但其输出可能缺乏结构化数据的逻辑支撑，存在忠实性问题。作者希望以量化推断为切入点，系统考察模型在不同家族与规模下是否能生成受表格数据逻辑支持的推断，而非仅追求语言流畅度。
AI.method: 构建 STAT-TO-TEXT 任务：模型从统计表生成带量化词（all、some、no、most）的自然语言推断。评估采用由 LLM 生成的 Python 检查器代码，执行后针对表格核验相应真值条件。对四个开放权重 LLM 跨家族与参数规模进行比较，指标包括忠实性、逻辑准确性、表覆盖度和量化词多样性，并用人工标注验证自动检查器的可靠性。
AI.result: 模型规模与家族均影响表现；最大模型 GPT-OSS-120B 持续产生最忠实的推断，且未牺牲表覆盖度与量化词多样性，而较小模型则难以同时兼顾。人工标注结果表明自动检查器与人类判断高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 受控的量化推断任务结合可执行的代码检查器，为评估 LLM 对表格数据的逻辑忠实性提供了可扩展且与人工判断一致的方案；模型规模是提升忠实推断且保持覆盖度与多样性的关键因素。

title: Rethinking Diffusion Segmentation: When Does It Rely on Its Noisy State, and Does Diffusion Matter?
summary: Diffusion models are increasingly adapted from generation to conditional prediction, where a conditioning signal is combined with an evolving noisy representation of the target. In fully supervised segmentation, however, the conditioning image can already support direct target prediction, so endpoint performance alone establishes neither reliance on the added diffusion state nor a deterministic advantage over image-only prediction. For state reliance, we disrupt target-derived state content or correct image-state pairing during retraining of twelve published methods across three datasets, with ten matched seeds per setting. All 40 original-method comparisons whose evaluated-mask routes remained downstream of noised-quantity reconstruction exhibited state reliance, whereas all 30 comparisons with a segmentation-supervised bypass preserved reference performance. Rerouting five originally bypass-capable methods by forcing segmentation supervision through noise-to-mask reconstruction converted all 30 corresponding comparisons from preserved performance to state reliance. For deterministic utility, matched image-only counterparts achieved similar or better performance in 28 of 35 settings overall, including 16 of 20 whose native methods relied on both audited state properties. These results identify supervision path as a determinant of state reliance in the audited methods. Separately, matched image-only counterparts show that diffusion-specific computation often provides no deterministic endpoint advantage, including in methods that rely on the audited state properties. More generally, when conditioning already supports strong target prediction, diffusion-specific claims require additional evidence that the added state is used and that diffusion-specific computation improves the claimed capability beyond a matched condition-only counterpart.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过干预性实验审计了条件扩散分割方法对"目标衍生状态"的依赖，并检验扩散特定计算是否带来确定性端点优势。
AI.motivation: 在条件分割任务中，条件图像本身已能支持对目标的有效预测，因此仅凭端点性能无法证明方法真正依赖扩散引入的噪声状态，也无法证明其优于纯图像预测的确定性优势。作者希望厘清"状态依赖"与"扩散特定计算收益"这两个常被混淆的问题。
AI.method: 对12种已发表的扩散分割方法在3个数据集、10个配对随机种子下进行重训练，并采用两类干预：(1) 通过破坏目标衍生状态内容或打乱图像-状态配对检验状态依赖；(2) 训练匹配的"仅图像"对照模型检验扩散特定计算的确定性收益；此外还通过强制分割监督经由噪声到掩码重建路径，重定向原本可绕过的5种方法。
AI.result: 全部40个"评估掩码路径位于噪声量重建下游"的对照均表现出状态依赖；而30个存在分割监督旁路的对照均保持了参考性能。将5种可旁路方法重定向后，全部30个对照由性能保持转为状态依赖。在确定性收益方面，匹配的仅图像对照在35个设置中28个达到相当或更优性能，其中包括20个原生方法同时依赖两项被审计状态属性的设置中的16个。
AI.conclusion: 监督路径是所审计方法中状态依赖的决定因素；扩散特定计算往往并未提供确定性端点优势，即便在依赖被审计状态属性的方法中亦然。当条件信号本身已支持强目标预测时，扩散特定主张需额外证据证明所加状态被实际使用，且扩散特定计算在匹配的仅条件对照之上提升了所声称的能力。

title: UniK: Universal Knowledge Perception for Digital and Physical AI
summary: Two transformative classes of AI systems are reshaping how organizations operate: \textit{digital AI}, which reasons over enterprise knowledge to power chatbots and agent workflows; and \textit{physical AI}, which learns to control robots and autonomous systems from video, gameplay, and sensor telemetry. Both face the same foundational bottleneck: raw knowledge at scale, spanning heterogeneous modalities, locked in private corpora that existing AI infrastructure cannot access reliably or efficiently. We propose \textit{Universal Knowledge Perception (UniK)} as a common platform for both classes, covering the full knowledge lifecycle (ingestion, enrichment, indexing, retrieval, and continuous evaluation) across modalities from rich text and video to molecular data and sensor telemetry. We present UniK, built on Polymath Retrieval (multi-index fusion over automatically enriched indices) with no task-specific fine-tuning. Across five digital AI domains (medical literature, open-domain QA, chemistry, legal video proceedings, and government open data) UniK combined with an open-source 70-billion-parameter model consistently matches or outperforms frontier proprietary LLMs that are orders of magnitude larger: 76\% RAG accuracy on government data versus 47\% for GPT-5; 77.9\% on medical QA without fine-tuning; topping all open-source chemistry pipelines. We show that the same infrastructure directly addresses the data curation, indexing, and retrieval challenges facing physical AI world model training, where the knowledge problem is harder but structurally identical.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出UniK——面向数字AI与物理AI的统一知识感知平台，覆盖摄取、增强、索引、检索与持续评估的全生命周期，基于无需任务微调的Polymath Retrieval多索引融合，在多个领域以70B开源模型匹配或超越更大规模的前沿专有模型。
AI.motivation: 数字AI（如聊天机器人、智能体工作流）与物理AI（如机器人、自主系统）虽形态不同，但共享同一底层瓶颈：大规模、多模态的原始知识分散在私有语料中，现有AI基础设施无法可靠高效地访问。因此需要一个通用平台来统一处理这些异构知识。
AI.method: 提出UniK作为统一平台，覆盖知识全生命周期（摄取、增强、索引、检索、持续评估），支持从富文本、视频到分子数据和传感器遥测的多模态。核心方法为Polymath Retrieval，即在自动增强的索引之上进行多索引融合，且不进行任何任务特定的微调。
AI.result: 在五个数字AI领域（医学文献、开放域问答、化学、法律视频记录、政府开放数据）中，UniK结合开源70B参数模型持续匹配或超越规模大数个数量级的前沿专有LLM：政府数据RAG准确率76%对GPT-5的47%；医学问答无需微调达77.9%；在开源化学流程中居于首位。同时该基础设施可直接应对物理AI世界模型训练面临的数据管理、索引与检索挑战。
AI.conclusion: UniK表明，一个统一的知识感知与检索基础设施能够同时服务数字AI和物理AI，且在不做任务特定微调的情况下即可媲美或超越更大规模的专有模型，体现了通用知识基础设施的可行性与跨领域通用性。

title: AURA: Uncertainty-Routed Activation Editing for Acoustic Grounding in Speech Foundation Models
summary: Attention encoder-decoder (AED) Speech Foundation Models achieve strong ASR performance but can generate acoustically unsupported text when inputs contain no speech, weak acoustic evidence, or unreliable transcription. We propose AURA: Activation-editing with Uncertainty-Routed Adaptation, an ultra-efficient representation-editing method that freezes the pretrained model and applies sparse scale-and-shift edits to decoder cross-attention heads. AURA dynamically routes edits using cross-attention uncertainty features that capture over-concentration, diffuse attention, and abrupt frame shifts. We evaluate AURA on four datasets spanning non-speech hallucination and speech grounding stressors, including imperfect-label child speech, imperfect-label adult speech, and disfluent speech. On non-speech audio, AURA reduces hallucination rate from 89.18% to 1.94% without prior hallucination-head identification. On imperfect-label corpora, AURA approaches LoRA WER while using roughly 500x fewer trainable parameters. Sensitivity analysis and qualitative cross-attention examples are consistent with AURA's uncertainty-routed editing behavior, supporting dynamic activation editing as a practical path for grounding AED speech models.

AI.tldr: AURA 是一种超高效的表示编辑方法，通过冻结预训练模型并对解码器交叉注意力头施加稀疏的 scale-and-shift 编辑，利用交叉注意力不确定性特征动态路由编辑，显著抑制 AED 语音基础模型的非语音幻觉并改善语音接地。
AI.motivation: 注意力编解码器（AED）语音基础模型虽具强 ASR 性能，但在输入无语音、声学证据薄弱或转写不可靠时会生成声学上无依据的文本（即幻觉）。现有方法需先识别幻觉头，且效率与泛化性受限，因此亟需一种高效、无需预先定位的幻觉抑制与接地方法。
AI.method: 提出 AURA（Activation-editing with Uncertainty-Routed Adaptation）：冻结预训练模型，仅对解码器交叉注意力头施加稀疏的 scale-and-shift 表示编辑；通过交叉注意力不确定性特征（捕捉过度集中、注意力弥散、帧突变）动态路由编辑。在四个数据集上评估，涵盖非语音幻觉与语音接地压力场景，包括不完美标签的儿童语音、不完美标签的成人语音及不流畅语音。
AI.result: 在非语音音频上，AURA 无需事先识别幻觉头即可将幻觉率从 89.18% 降至 1.94%；在不完美标签语料上，AURA 的 WER 接近 LoRA，而可训练参数量约少 500 倍；敏感性分析与交叉注意力定性示例与 AURA 的不确定性路由编辑行为一致。
AI.conclusion: 动态激活编辑是使 AED 语音模型实现接地的实用路径，AURA 以极高参数效率和无需预定位幻觉头的优势，有效抑制幻觉并保持识别性能。

title: Evaluating the Generalization of Neuroimaging Foundation Models on African Brain MRI
comment: MICCAI AFRICAI Workshop, Strasbourg, France, 2026, 10 Pages, 1 Figure, 2 Tables
summary: Neuroimaging foundation models pretrained on large, predominantly western cohorts are increasingly proposed as general-purpose backbones for brain MRI analysis. Yet, their ability to generalize to underrepresented clinical populations remains largely untested. We evaluate four recent foundation models (BrainIAC, Neuro-JEPA, NeuroVFM, and Primus) on a three-way diagnostic classification task (Control, Dementia, Parkinson's disease) using a cohort of 88 subjects from a Nigerian clinical brain MRI dataset, across four modality configurations (T1w, T2w, T1w+T2w, FLAIR), and compare against an end-to-end trained ViT3D baseline. The frozen backbones collapse to majority-class predictions, while Neuro-JEPA on FLAIR shows modest but still limited discrimination. In contrast, the end-to-end trained ViT3D achieves higher accuracy and MCC on every task (up to 53.4% accuracy, MCC=0.27) and is the only model with non-trivial recall. Our findings suggest that these frozen neuroimaging foundation models are insufficient for fine-grained diagnostic classification in small, non-western clinical cohorts, motivating parameter-efficient adaptation and broader multi-site external validation for equitable deployment in global health settings.

AI.tldr: 该研究在尼日利亚88例临床脑MRI数据上评测4个神经影像基础模型（BrainIAC、Neuro-JEPA、NeuroVFM、Primus），发现冻结骨干普遍坍缩至多数类，而端到端训练的ViT3D基线精度更高（最高53.4%，MCC=0.27）。
AI.motivation: 主流神经影像基础模型多基于大规模西方人群预训练，却被称为通用骨干，其向代表性不足的临床人群（如非洲队列）的泛化能力缺乏验证，作者旨在检验这一公平性缺口。
AI.method: 在尼日利亚临床脑MRI队列（88名受试者）上执行三分类诊断任务（对照、痴呆、帕金森病），覆盖四种模态配置（T1w、T2w、T1w+T2w、FLAIR），以冻结方式评测四个基础模型，并与端到端训练的ViT3D基线对比，采用准确率、MCC与召回率等指标。
AI.result: 冻结骨干模型基本坍缩为多数类预测；仅Neuro-JEPA在FLAIR上有微弱但有限的判别力。端到端ViT3D在所有任务上准确率与MCC更优（最高53.4%，MCC=0.27），且是唯一具有非平凡召回率的模型。
AI.conclusion: 现有冻结神经影像基础模型难以胜任小型、非西方临床队列的细粒度诊断分类；需推进参数高效微调与更广泛的多中心外部验证，以实现全球健康场景下的公平部署。

title: Statistical Testing for Multiple Instance Learning via Selective Inference with Applications to Computational Pathology
summary: Multiple instance learning (MIL) is widely used in computational pathology because it enables weakly supervised analysis of whole-slide images (WSIs) without requiring patch-level annotations. In attention-based MIL, instances with high attention scores are often interpreted as diagnostically important regions and used as visual explanations. However, attention scores alone cannot determine whether selected high-attention instances are significantly different from normal instances, limiting the reliability of attention-based explanations. In this paper, we formulate the evaluation of high-attention instances as a statistical hypothesis testing problem. Specifically, we assess whether a selected high-attention instance significantly deviates from a representative normal reference instance selected based on feature similarity. A major challenge is that both the target instance and the reference instance are selected through data-dependent procedures, rendering standard hypothesis testing invalid. To address this issue, we introduce a selective inference (SI) framework that explicitly accounts for the selection events induced by attention-based instance selection and adaptive reference selection, thereby enabling the computation of valid selective $p$-values conditional on these events. Experiments demonstrate Type-I error control on synthetic and MNIST-based data and practical applicability to pathological WSIs, with higher statistical power than the conventional over-conditioning approach.

AI.tldr: 本文将高注意力实例的可靠性评估形式化为统计假设检验问题，并用选择性推断（SI）框架剔除数据依赖选择带来的偏差，从而计算有效的选择性p值。
AI.motivation: 注意力MIL中高分实例常被当作诊断重要区域作为视觉解释，但注意力分数本身无法判断所选高注意力实例是否显著偏离正常实例，导致解释可靠性不足。
AI.method: 将高注意力实例评估建模为假设检验：判断所选实例是否显著偏离基于特征相似度选出的代表性正常参考实例；针对目标实例与参考实例均由数据依赖过程选出、标准检验失效的问题，提出选择性推断框架，显式地对注意力选择与自适应参考选择诱导的选择事件进行条件化，计算有效的选择性p值。
AI.result: 在合成数据与MNIST数据上实现了Type-I错误控制，并在病理全切片图像上验证了实用性，统计功效高于传统过度条件化方法。
AI.conclusion: 选择性推断为注意力MIL的视觉解释提供了统计上有效的显著性评估，兼顾错误率控制与实际可用性。

title: WebMRIQC: A Web-Based Implementation of MRIQC for Accessible MRI Image Quality Assessment in Resource-Constrained Settings
summary: Reliable quality control (QC) of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is essential for reliable diagnostic neuroimaging, yet standard manual assessment is subjective and time-consuming. MRIQC has established standardized automated extraction of image-quality metrics (IQMs), but its reliance on local computational imaging skills and capacity including high-performance computing, limits its adoption in resource-constrained settings (RCS). We present WebMRIQC (webmriqc.mailab.io), an open-source browser-based platform that wraps the validated MRIQC engine behind a zero-installation web interface. WebMRIQC automates the DICOM-to-BIDS conversion of de-identified MRI scans, executes the unmodified containerized MRIQC pipeline on a shared compute node governed by a fair-share job queue, and returns an interactive in-browser dashboard. The dashboard grounds every IQM in published quality thresholds, benchmarks each scan against the normative distribution of high-resource open datasets, and supports cross-site multicentre implementation of optimized scan protocols in RCS.We describe the system architecture and a validation framework establishing measurement equivalence between WebMRIQC and native MRIQC across thirteen IQMs on the BraTS-Africa and BraTS 2021 datasets. Preliminary results indicate strong agreement for contrast-, signal and noise-based metrics, demonstrating that web-based implementation lowers the barrier to standardized MRI QC and provides a foundation for harmonized, regionally adapted quality benchmarks across RCS imaging sites. The code is publicly available here https://github.com/CAMERA-MRI/WebMRIqc.

AI.tldr: 提出零安装网页平台 WebMRIQC，在共享计算节点上运行原生 MRIQC 容器，验证其与本地 MRIQC 的测量等价性，以降低资源受限环境下 MRI 质量控制门槛。
AI.motivation: MRI 质量控制对诊断神经影像至关重要，但人工评估主观且耗时；MRIQC 虽实现标准化自动指标提取，却依赖本地计算影像技能与高性能计算资源，难以在资源受限地区推广。
AI.method: WebMRIQC 为开源浏览器平台，封装经校验的 MRIQC 引擎：自动完成去标识化 MRI 扫描的 DICOM 到 BIDS 转换，在公平共享作业队列调度的共享计算节点上执行未经修改的容器化 MRIQC 流程，并返回交互式浏览器仪表盘；仪表盘将每项 IQM 对应已发表质量阈值，并以高资源开放数据集常模分布为基准。系统在 BraTS-Africa 与 BraTS 2021 数据集上对 13 项 IQM 建立与原生 MRIQC 的测量等价性验证框架。
AI.result: 初步结果显示，基于对比度、信号与噪声的指标在 WebMRIQC 与原生 MRIQC 之间具有高度一致性，表明网页实现可降低标准化 MRI 质控的门槛。
AI.conclusion: 基于网页的实现为资源受限成像站点提供统一、区域适配的质量基准奠定基础，支持跨站点多中心优化扫描方案的推广；代码已公开。

title: InterHier: Learning Interconnected Hierarchical Semantics for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures. Published in IEEE Access
summary: In this paper, we investigate the limitations of fixed, hand-crafted connectors in hierarchical semantic representations for open-vocabulary object detection. Existing methods establish semantic relationships between base categories and unseen novel categories by placing a fixed connector between adjacent super-/sub-categories. However, such fixed connectors may not optimally capture the relationships within a semantic hierarchy. To address this limitation, we propose interconnected hierarchical semantic representations (InterHier), which utilize a prepended learnable context to globally guide the interpretation of prompts containing hierarchical relationships. InterHier operates in two main stages. First, it constructs a hierarchy-aware prompt by integrating super-/sub-categories and prepending a learnable context. Second, it optimizes this learnable context to align visual region embeddings and textual embeddings. InterHier consistently improves performance over methods that rely on fixed connectors and can be seamlessly integrated into existing open-vocabulary object detection models. Experiments on open-vocabulary object detection benchmarks demonstrate that InterHier achieves competitive performance against state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 InterHier，用可学习上下文替代固定连接词来构建层次语义表示，提升开放词汇目标检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇目标检测方法通过在相邻父/子类别之间放置固定的、手工设计的连接词来建立基类与未见新类之间的语义关系，但这种固定连接词无法最优地捕捉语义层次内部的关系。
AI.method: InterHier 分两阶段：首先整合父/子类别并在其前添加可学习上下文，构建层次感知提示；其次优化该可学习上下文，以对齐视觉区域嵌入与文本嵌入。
AI.result: 在开放词汇目标检测基准上，InterHier 相较依赖固定连接词的方法取得一致性能提升，并可无缝集成到现有开放词汇目标检测模型中，达到与当前最优方法相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: 以可学习上下文全局引导层次关系提示的建模，优于固定连接词方案，为开放词汇目标检测的层次语义表示提供了有效且易集成的改进思路。

title: When Evidence Conflicts: Reliability-aware Meta-review Generation
summary: Generating coherent meta-reviews from multiple peer reviews is challenging when reviewer evidence conflicts and varies in reliability. Existing approaches typically formulate meta-review generation as a multi-document summarization task and aggregate reviewer feedback uniformly, making it difficult to determine which opinions should be prioritized under disagreement. In this paper, we study meta-review generation through reliability-aware evidence aggregation. Our framework first extracts aspect-level opinions from peer reviews and identifies conflicting evidence within each aspect. It then estimates opinion-level support and review-level quality to measure evidence reliability. Based on these signals, the framework assigns reliability-aware weights to reviewer feedback, enabling the generator to prioritize better-supported arguments while preserving diverse perspectives. Experiments demonstrate that our method consistently improves meta-review generation over strong baselines on both automatic and human evaluations, with clear gains in conflict recognition and resolution under high-conflict review scenarios. The code and implementation details are publicly available at https://github.com/Wangxz729/reliability-aware-meta-review.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可靠性感知的证据聚合框架，通过提取方面级意见、识别冲突证据，并基于意见支持度与评审质量分配可靠性权重，生成更连贯的元评审。
AI.motivation: 现有元评审生成方法多将其视为多文档摘要任务，对评审反馈进行统一聚合，难以在评审意见冲突且可靠性不一时判断应优先采纳哪些意见。因此本文从可靠性感知证据聚合的角度研究该问题。
AI.method: 框架首先从同行评审中提取方面级意见，并识别每个方面内的冲突证据；随后估计意见级支持度与评审级质量以衡量证据可靠性；最后据此为评审反馈分配可靠性感知权重，使生成器优先采纳支持度更高的论点，同时保留多样化的观点。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在自动评估与人工评估中均持续优于强基线，尤其在高冲突评审场景下，冲突识别与化解方面提升明显。
AI.conclusion: 可靠性感知的证据聚合能有效改善多评审冲突下的元评审生成质量，代码与实现细节已公开。

title: Video-STLayout Pre-training
summary: In recent years, pre-training has become fundamental to learning effective video representations, enabling strong transfer to downstream tasks. A popular framework in pre-training involves aligning features of a video encoder with that of another modality, for example, language or audio. We introduce Video-STLayout pre-training, a novel strategy for obtaining rich video representations informed by spatio-temporal layout of object bounding boxes. Object layouts can easily be obtained by applying an off-the-shelf object detector on the video frames. Our method uses a contrastive loss to align video features with the layout features from a trained layout encoder. We show the effectiveness of our approach in the task of activity recognition in complex scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出 Video-STLayout 预训练策略，通过对齐视频特征与目标框时空布局特征，提升复杂场景下的活动识别性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视频预训练多依赖语言或音频等模态进行特征对齐，而目标布局这一富含时空结构信息的模态尚未被充分利用。目标布局可通过现成检测器低成本获得，因此有必要探索其作为对齐目标的潜力。
AI.method: 对视频帧应用现成的目标检测器提取物体边界框，得到时空布局；将布局输入训练好的布局编码器获得布局特征；使用对比损失将视频编码器特征与布局特征对齐，完成 Video-STLayout 预训练。
AI.result: 在复杂场景的活动识别任务上验证了该方法的有效性，表明以目标布局为对齐模态可获得更丰富的视频表示。
AI.conclusion: 目标框时空布局可作为视频预训练的有效对齐模态，Video-STLayout 为学习可迁移的视频表示提供了一种新颖且实用的策略。

title: Agentic Video Understanding: A Survey
summary: As large language models (LLMs) become capable of processing increasingly diverse modalities and longer temporal contexts, an emerging line of work is moving beyond fixed video-language inference toward agentic systems that actively decide what information to inspect, retain, verify, and act upon. This survey reviews video understanding agents: systems that use video as the primary information source and solve understanding tasks through adaptive state construction and action selection. We first formalize an agent loop for video understanding, then address a central question: why do agents matter for video understanding? To answer this, we organize the literature through a challenge-to-design taxonomy, linking context bottlenecks to hierarchical evidence memory, evidence sparsity to active evidence acquisition, temporal causality to state and process tracking, and multimodal ambiguity to role-specialized coordination. We further review state space paradigms, learning paradigms, supervision signals, benchmarks, and evaluation protocols. Finally, we identify open directions toward agentic-native temporal modeling and video-native agents. Project page: https://github.com/DXY0711/Awesome-Agentic-Video-Understanding

AI.tldr: 本篇综述系统梳理了"视频理解智能体"这一新兴方向，提出智能体循环的形式化框架，并以"挑战—设计"分类学串联文献，最后展望智能体原生时间建模等开放方向。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型能够处理日益多样的模态与更长的时序上下文，研究范式正从固定的视频—语言推理转向智能体系统：主动决定检查、保留、验证哪些信息并据此行动。然而该方向尚缺乏统一的框架与系统的文献组织，因此需要一篇综述来厘清"为什么视频理解需要智能体"以及相关设计如何对应具体挑战。
AI.method: 采用综述方法：首先形式化一个面向视频理解的智能体循环（自适应状态构建与动作选择）；随后以"挑战—设计"分类学组织文献，将上下文瓶颈对应到层次化证据记忆、证据稀疏性对应到主动证据获取、时间因果性对应到状态与过程追踪、多模态歧义性对应到角色专门化协同；并进一步回顾状态空间范式、学习范式、监督信号、基准与评测协议。
AI.result: 给出视频理解智能体的形式化循环框架与挑战—设计映射分类体系，并系统整理了状态空间范式、学习范式、监督信号以及基准与评测协议等文献脉络，形成该方向的结构化综述图景。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为视频理解智能体提供了统一框架与分类学，并指出未来开放方向，包括迈向智能体原生的时间建模与视频原生的智能体设计。

title: Graph-to-Grid (G2G): Continuous-Coordinate Feature Painting for Soccer Pass Surfaces
summary: Dense pass surfaces give, for every pitch cell, whether a pass played there would arrive, whether the carrier would choose it, and what the possession would then be worth. The networks that draw them read the state as a raster of per-cell counts, losing where inside a cell each player stands. LiDAR detectors, bird's-eye-view perception and graph weather models move entity features onto a grid, binning each entity to a cell or learning the transfer. We evaluate the interpolated form: each player's features are scattered bilinearly onto the grid at the player's measured coordinates, so the surface loss trains the per-player encoder end to end. Those systems adopt an interface; this paper measures one. On 53,628 passes from the 2022 World Cup, painting improves selection likelihood over the same core fed rasters alone by about a quarter of a nat: in every match of an eight-fold cross-validation, with every arm tuned over five seeds, and after retraining on seven Bundesliga and 2. Bundesliga matches from another provider. Thirteen pre-specified studies locate the gain: painting the nine raw player features with no encoder carries three quarters of it, and the learned encoder and message passing add a smaller, resolved increment. Painting also helps the original SoccerMap and a canonical U-Net, whereas offset channels, a finer raster, an attention painter and a raster-free decoder do not. Frozen across the provider boundary the likelihood advantage is lost; injected tracking error compresses it. These results concern observed-endpoint prediction, not calibrated evaluation of hypothetical passes.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用双线性插值将球员特征"画"到栅格上（painting），在538×538的密集传球价值面上验证其优于纯栅格输入，并系统消融定位增益来源。
AI.motivation: 密集传球价值面（dense pass surface）的现有网络把状态读作每格计数的栅格，丢失了球员在格内的精确坐标；LiDAR检测、BEV感知与图气象模型也都把实体特征离散到格或学习转移。作者要量化这种"接口选择"本身的影响，即插值式特征散布相比逐格装箱是否带来可测收益。
AI.method: 在每个球员实测坐标处以双线性插值将其特征散布到栅格（而非装箱到单一格），使传球面损失能端到端训练每球员编码器。数据为2022世界杯53,628次传球；用八折交叉验证、每个分支5个种子调参；另在另一数据商的7场德甲与2场德乙比赛上重训以检验跨提供方迁移。
AI.result: painting使选择似然相比同一核心仅用栅格提升约四分之一nat，在八折交叉验证的每场、每个分支、每个种子下均成立，跨提供方重训后仍成立。13项预设研究定位增益：仅对9个原始球员特征做painting（无编码器）即贡献约四分之三增益，学习编码器与消息传递带来较小但显著的增量；painting对原始SoccerMap和标准U-Net同样有效；而偏移通道、更细栅格、注意力painter与无栅格解码器均无效。跨提供方冻结时似然优势消失，注入跟踪误差会压缩该优势。
AI.conclusion: 特征插值（painting）是密集传球面建模中一个可测且稳健的接口改进，其增益主要来自保留球员原始坐标的朴素散布而非复杂编码器。但结论限于观测终点预测，不适用于假设性传球的校准评估。

title: U-PEN Mamba: Progressive Expansion with Selective State-Space Modeling for Efficient Retinal Vessel Segmentation
summary: Accurate retinal vessel segmentation is important for computer-aided ophthalmic analysis, yet thin vessels, low contrast, and severe foreground-background imbalance remain challenging for encoder-decoder networks. This paper presents U-PEN Mamba, a U-shaped retinal vessel segmentation architecture that couples progressive nonlinear feature expansion with selective state-space modeling. The proposed network enriches local vessel responses with progressive expansion, models long-range spatial dependencies through a Mamba Global Context (MGC) block with linear sequence complexity, and uses attention-based decoder fusion to recover fine vascular boundaries. We evaluate U-PEN Mamba on CHASE DB1 and DRIVE using a consistent patch-based preprocessing pipeline and compare it with convolutional, attention-based, transformer-based, and Mamba-based segmentation baselines. U-PEN Mamba obtains the best mean intersection over union among the compared methods, achieving 0.8394 on CHASE DB1 and 0.8221 on DRIVE, with Dice scores of 0.8187 and 0.8078, respectively, using 21.6M trainable parameters. Ablation studies show that the MGC block contributes the largest gain over the U-Net baseline, while projection dimension and state size provide practical accuracy-efficiency control. These results indicate that selective state-space modeling is a promising global-context mechanism for parameter-efficient retinal vessel segmentation. Code is available at: https://github.com/areyesan/UPEN_Mamba.

AI.tldr: 提出U-PEN Mamba网络，将渐进非线性特征扩展与选择性状态空间建模结合，用于视网膜血管分割，在CHASE DB1和DRIVE上取得最优mIoU。
AI.motivation: 视网膜血管分割对计算机辅助眼科分析很重要，但细血管、低对比度和严重的前景-背景不平衡仍是编解码网络的难点。
AI.method: 提出U形架构U-PEN Mamba：用渐进扩展增强局部血管响应，通过线性复杂度的Mamba全局上下文（MGC）模块建模长程空间依赖，并采用基于注意力的解码器融合恢复精细血管边界；在CHASE DB1和DRIVE上以一致的patch预处理流程评估，并与卷积、注意力、Transformer及Mamba基线对比。
AI.result: 在对比方法中取得最佳mIoU：CHASE DB1为0.8394，DRIVE为0.8221；Dice分别为0.8187和0.8078，参数量21.6M。消融显示MGC模块相对U-Net基线增益最大，投影维度和状态大小可调节精度-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 选择性状态空间建模是一种有前景的全局上下文机制，可实现参数高效的视网膜血管分割。

title: Calibrated Decisions at Scale: Converting Police Crash Narratives into Probabilistic Crash Variables with a System One Model (Jev)
summary: Crash datasets that carry an investigator narrative hold information the coded fields omit. Coding those narratives at scale has been blocked by three obstacles. Frontier large language models are costly at that scale, their generated text cannot be verified, and no rule says how much output a human must check. This paper formulates narrative coding as gated, typed decisions answered by Jev, a System One model that returns probabilities over analyst-defined options and generates no text. A screen covered 499,500 Texas narratives and 195,857 were coded with a 27-question schema. Cost is governed by schema size rather than narrative length. The probabilities are audited against coded fields and against 2,416 blinded human judgments drawn under a stated sampling design. Two frontier large language models are benchmarked on the same records. Against human labels the typed model attains an F1 of 0.908. One frontier model gains 0.059 and the other is indistinguishable from it. Calibration varies by model rather than by paradigm, so each model must be audited. Recalibration on the same labels reduces calibration error by a factor of 3.3. Agreement with coded fields understates fidelity to the narrative by a median of 0.26 in kappa. A resolution-floor bound covers any model that reports probabilities on a discrete grid. A review budget over flagged records gives the records a human must read per variable and per year. Adding the calibrated variables to the coded fields raises the injury and fatal crashes attributed to nine factors by 10,747 per year.

AI.tldr: 本文将交通事故叙述编码重构为"带门控的类型化决策"任务，用仅输出选项概率、不生成文本的System One模型Jev，对德州499,500条叙述进行筛查、对195,857条按27问schema编码，成本由schema规模而非叙述长度决定，并以编码字段和2,416份盲态人工判读做审计。
AI.motivation: 事故数据集中的调查员叙述含有编码字段所遗漏的信息，但规模化编码受三重障碍制约：前沿大模型在该规模下成本过高、其生成文本无法核验、且没有规则规定人工必须复核多少输出。论文即针对这三点提出可审计、可控成本的编码范式。
AI.method: 将叙述编码形式化为gated、typed决策，由System One模型Jev在分析者定义的选项上返回概率、不生成文本。筛查覆盖499,500条德州叙述，195,857条按27问schema编码。概率与编码字段比对，并与按既定抽样设计获得的2,416份盲态人工判读比对；同一批记录上基准测试两个前沿大模型。另给出resolution-floor界（适用于任何在离散网格上报告概率的模型）与基于flagged记录的复核预算。
AI.result: 相对人工标签，类型化模型F1为0.908；一个前沿模型高0.059，另一个与其无显著差异。校准误差因模型而异而非因范式而异，故每个模型都需单独审计；在同一标签上重校准可将校准误差降至1/3.3。与编码字段的一致性较真实叙述保真度低估约0.26 kappa（中位数）。将校准变量并入编码字段后，归因于九类因素的伤害与致命事故每年增加10,747起。
AI.conclusion: 类型化、仅输出概率的编码路径在成本、可审计性与精度上均可行：成本随schema规模而非叙述长度增长，保真度需用人工判读而非编码字段来衡量，校准需逐模型审计并可显著改善。以复核预算形式给出每变量、每年的人工必读量，且补充变量会实质性改变九类事故因素的年度计数。

title: Representation-guided in-context learning for medical image interpretation with multimodal large language models
summary: Medical image interpretation is central to diagnosis and care, yet adapting general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often requires resource-intensive domain-specific fine-tuning. Here we introduce representation-guided in-context learning (RG-ICL), a training-free inference framework that retrieves query-aligned demonstrations using frozen encoders, without task-specific parameter updates. Across eight datasets spanning histopathology, radiology and retinal fundoscopy, RG-ICL improved classification (mean gain 20 percentage points) and visual question answering (VQA) (mean gain 13 percentage points) over no-context and conventional ICL, approaching or exceeding training-based comparators. Which cases were retrieved mattered more than how many: 6 query-aligned cases outperformed up to 32 randomly selected ones, whereas fixed or random cases often reduced accuracy below baseline. For VQA, aligning reference cases with both image content and question intent produced further gains. These findings indicate that for medical image interpretation, curating which reference cases an MLLM sees is a practical alternative to retraining it.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练推理框架RG-ICL，用冻结编码器检索与查询对齐的示例，提升医学图像分类与VQA性能。
AI.motivation: 医学图像解读对诊断至关重要，但通用多模态大模型（MLLMs）适配医学领域通常需资源密集的领域微调，成本高。
AI.method: RG-ICL：一种免训练（training-free）的上下文学习推理框架，利用冻结编码器检索与查询对齐（query-aligned）的演示示例，不进行任务特定参数更新；对VQA进一步使参考示例同时对齐图像内容与问题意图。
AI.result: 在涵盖组织病理学、放射学与视网膜眼底镜的8个数据集上，分类平均提升20个百分点，VQA平均提升13个百分点，优于无上下文与传统ICL，接近或超过基于训练的方法；6个查询对齐示例优于最多32个随机示例，固定或随机示例常使准确率低于基线。
AI.conclusion: 对医学图像解读而言，精选MLLM所见的参考示例是替代模型重训练的一种实用方案；检索内容的质量比数量更重要。

title: All-in-One Multilingual Scene Text Recognition with Script-aware Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Multilingual scene text recognition (STR) remains challenging due to the scarcity of training data for most languages and the difficulty of serving diverse scripts within a single model. Existing solutions either deploy one recognizer per language, inflating cost and introducing error accumulation, or rely on massive vision-language models (VLMs) that are expensive and still inaccurate on many scripts. In this work, we pursue an all-in-one multilingual recognizer that is simpler than per-language experts, lighter than VLMs, and more accurate than both. First, we construct TextMuSS-10M, a large-scale synthetic scene text dataset spanning 10 scripts and 229 languages. It provides balanced and sufficient supervision where real data is unavailable. Second, we propose ScriptMoE, a script-aware Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture. It shares a single visual encoder and replaces the dense decoder with a sparse MoE block, which consists of an image-level router dispatches each image to the top-2 script-aligned experts and a shared expert absorbs cross-script knowledge. Extensive experiments on our assembled TextMuSS-Bench (10 scripts, 10,899 images) show that ScriptMoE achieves the highest accuracy of 82.06%, outperforming the strongest STR baseline by 1.31%. On the CC-OCR end-to-end multilingual task, replacing only the recognizer in PP-OCRv5 with ScriptMoE lifts F1 score from 65.71% to 80.89%, slightly surpassing the best VLM (80.73%) at a fraction of the parameter count.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了大规模多语言合成场景文本数据集TextMuSS-10M，并提出脚本感知的稀疏MoE识别器ScriptMoE，在保持轻量的同时实现了多脚本文字识别的精度提升。
AI.motivation: 多语言场景文字识别面临两大难题：多数语言训练数据稀缺；单模型服务多种文字体系困难。现有方案要么为每种语言部署单独识别器（成本高、误差累积），要么依赖庞大的视觉语言模型（昂贵且在多脚本上仍不准确）。因此作者希望设计一个"all-in-one"识别器，做到比单语言专家更简单、比VLM更轻量、且精度更高。
AI.method: 1）构建TextMuSS-10M合成场景文本数据集，覆盖10种文字体系、229种语言，在真实数据缺失时提供均衡充足的监督；2）提出ScriptMoE，一种脚本感知的混合专家架构：共享单一视觉编码器，用稀疏MoE块替代稠密解码器，其图像级路由器将每张图分配到top-2脚本对齐专家，另设共享专家吸收跨脚本知识。
AI.result: 在自建的TextMuSS-Bench（10种脚本、10,899张图像）上，ScriptMoE取得最高准确率82.06%，超过最强STR基线1.31%。在CC-OCR端到端多语言任务中，仅将PP-OCRv5的识别器替换为ScriptMoE，F1即从65.71%提升至80.89%，以极少的参数量略超最佳VLM（80.73%）。
AI.conclusion: 通过合成数据+脚本感知稀疏MoE的组合，ScriptMoE实现了统一、轻量且高精度的多语言场景文字识别，验证了脚本对齐专家路由与共享专家机制的有效性，并展示了以低参数成本超越VLM的可行性。

title: Vision Transformers versus convolutional neural networks for fine-grained orchid genus identification in a species-rich, data-poor flora: a controlled benchmark on the Orchidaceae of New Guinea
summary: New Guinea is the world's richest island flora (~2,856 orchid species), yet most species are represented by only a handful of photographs, far fewer than direct species-level classification requires. Methods for fine-grained identification in such species-rich, data-poor floras are needed, and it remains unclear which backbone architecture and pretraining strategy best support them. We built a two-stage system that first predicts the genus of a query photograph, then retrieves visually similar reference images of candidate species using FAISS. We compared four pretrained backbones -- two Vision Transformers (ViTs; DINOv2, BioCLIP 2) and two CNNs (ConvNeXt V2-L, EfficientNetV2-L) -- fine-tuned under an identical protocol on a fixed, species-stratified partition of 16,701 photographs spanning 120 genera and 1,350 species, assessing accuracy, calibration, error structure, species retrieval, and open-set detection of novel genera. DINOv2 attained the best genus performance (macro top-1 66.9%, 95% CI 63.7-70.6; global top-1 88.9%); both ViTs outranked both CNNs, and general-purpose self-supervised pretraining (DINOv2) outperformed domain-matched biological pretraining (BioCLIP 2) by 7.1 points of macro top-1. Errors concentrated on two abundant genera acting as error attractors. DINOv2 embeddings achieved species Recall@5 of 86.6% and genus Recall@5 of 98.7%; temperature scaling reduced every backbone's Expected Calibration Error to about 0.03; and a distance-based open-set gate flagged unseen genera (mean AUROC 0.958). A self-supervised Vision-Transformer backbone combined with embedding retrieval is an effective, deployable strategy for fine-grained identification in species-rich, data-poor floras. The system is released as an open web application (the New Guinea Orchid Identifier), offering a practical template for other hyperdiverse, under-documented taxa.

AI.tldr: 本文构建两阶段系统（属分类+FAISS图像检索），在16,701张、120属1,350种的新几内亚兰花照片上对比四种骨干网络。DINOv2取得最佳属级精度（macro top-1 66.9%），自监督通用预训练优于生物领域预训练；结合温度校准与开放集门控，系统以网络应用形式发布。
AI.motivation: 新几内亚拥有全球最丰富的岛屿植物区系（约2,856种兰花），但大多数物种仅有少量照片，远不足以支撑直接的物种级分类。在这样的物种丰富、数据匮乏的区系中，细粒度识别方法尚不明确，尤其是何种骨干架构与预训练策略最为有效。
AI.method: 构建两阶段系统：先预测查询照片的属，再用FAISS检索候选物种的视觉相似参考图像。在固定的、按物种分层的16,701张照片（120属、1,350种）上，以相同协议微调对比四种预训练骨干：两种ViT（DINOv2、BioCLIP 2）与两种CNN（ConvNeXt V2-L、EfficientNetV2-L）。评估指标涵盖属级精度、校准、错误结构、物种检索与新颖属的开放集检测。
AI.result: DINOv2属级表现最佳（macro top-1 66.9%，95% CI 63.7-70.6；global top-1 88.9%）；两种ViT均优于两种CNN；通用自监督预训练（DINOv2）比领域匹配的生物预训练（BioCLIP 2）高7.1个百分点的macro top-1。错误集中于两个作为“错误吸引子”的丰富属。DINOv2嵌入的物种Recall@5为86.6%、属Recall@5为98.7%；温度缩放将所有骨干的期望校准误差降至约0.03；基于距离的开放集门控可标记未见属（平均AUROC 0.958）。
AI.conclusion: 自监督ViT骨干结合嵌入检索，是物种丰富、数据匮乏区系中细粒度识别的一种有效且可部署的策略。系统已作为开放网络应用（New Guinea Orchid Identifier）发布，为其他高度多样、记录不足的类群提供实用模板。

title: Efficient Reasoning Exploration via State-Conditioned Latent Steering with Progress Guidance
summary: Best-of-$N$ is a widely used inference strategy for complex reasoning, whose effectiveness depends on whether sampled candidates can cover diverse and high-quality reasoning paths. However, post-trained reasoning models often suffer from \emph{exploration collapse}, where independent rollouts repeatedly follow similar reasoning paths and limit the gains from increasing the rollout budget. Existing methods alleviate this issue by promoting broader exploration, but do not explicitly guide exploration toward continuations that make meaningful progress, resulting in limited exploration efficiency. To address this, we propose \emph{\underline{S}tate-conditioned \underline{P}rogress-guided \underline{S}teering} (SPS), a training-free latent steering framework. Specifically, SPS constructs a state-conditioned Direction Bank containing multiple progress-guided steering vectors for different prefix-state regions. During online inference, SPS retrieves a suitable steering vector based on the current prefix state and applies it at high-uncertainty transitions to guide the next reasoning step toward meaningful progress. Extensive experiments across multiple model scales and benchmarks demonstrate that SPS consistently outperforms strong baselines. Further analyses validate the effectiveness of its key designs and offer valuable insights for future research. The code is available at https://github.com/rattlesnakey/SPS.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的隐空间引导框架SPS，通过状态条件化的进展引导向量在高不确定性推理步骤进行干预，缓解后训练推理模型的探索塌缩问题，提升Best-of-N的探索效率与效果。
AI.motivation: Best-of-N的效果取决于采样候选能否覆盖多样且高质量的推理路径，但后训练推理模型常出现"探索塌缩"：独立采样反复走向相似推理路径，增大采样预算收益有限。已有方法虽促进更广探索，却未显式引导探索朝向真正有推进意义的续写，探索效率受限。
AI.method: 提出State-conditioned Progress-guided Steering（SPS），一种免训练的隐空间引导框架。首先构建状态条件化的Direction Bank，为不同前缀状态区域存储多个由进展引导的引导向量；在线推理时，根据当前前缀状态检索合适的引导向量，并仅在高不确定性的转移处施加该向量，以引导下一步推理朝有意义的方向推进。
AI.result: 在多种模型规模和多个基准上的大量实验表明，SPS持续优于强基线；进一步分析验证了其关键设计的有效性，并为后续研究提供了有价值的见解。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: SPS以免训练、状态条件化、进展引导的隐空间干预方式，缓解推理模型的探索塌缩，提高Best-of-N探索的多样性与有效性，具备良好的通用性与可复现性。

title: Monitorable Chart Reasoning Agents via Verifiable Process Rewards
summary: Chart reasoning agents are increasingly used to extract actionable insights in critical domains, achieving state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks. Yet, high benchmark accuracy alone is insufficient for deployment, where stakeholders must be able to audit and verify how a model reaches its answer. Existing LVLM-based chart agents produce either answer-only predictions or free-form rationales that are hard to verify, obscuring whether an error arose from misreading the chart, extracting a wrong value, or miscomputing. We propose Chart-RVR, a reinforcement learning framework for training monitorable chart agents with verifiable process rewards. Chart-RVR decomposes chart reasoning into three auditable blocks: Structure, identifying the chart type; Evidence, reconstructing the underlying data table in JSON; and Derivation, exposing the stepwise trace that computes the answer. Across six in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks, Chart-RVR attains state-of-the-art accuracy among comparable-sized LVLMs. Beyond accuracy, we assess monitorability using a triangulated protocol that combines ground-truth surrogate metrics, an oracle information-gain measure, and an LLM-as-auditor scoring Process Verifiability and Evidence Localization, showing that Chart-RVR yields rationales that are markedly more verifiable and evidence-grounded than those from CoT prompting, SFT, and existing chart-specific baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 Chart-RVR，一种带可验证过程奖励的强化学习框架，将图表推理分解为 Structure、Evidence、Derivation 三个可审计模块，在六个基准上达到同级 LVLM 的 SOTA 准确率，并通过三角验证协议证明其推理过程更可验证、更扎根于证据。
AI.motivation: 基于 LVLM 的图表推理智能体在关键领域已取得 SOTA 基准表现，但高准确率不足以支撑部署，因为利益相关者需要审计和验证模型如何得到答案。现有图表智能体只输出答案或难以验证的自由形式理由，无法区分错误来源（误读图表、提取错误数值、还是计算错误），因此需要可监控、过程可验证的图表智能体。
AI.method: Chart-RVR 是一个强化学习框架，用于训练可监控的图表智能体并提供可验证的过程奖励。它将图表推理分解为三个可审计模块：Structure（识别图表类型）、Evidence（以 JSON 重建底层数据表）、Derivation（暴露计算答案的逐步轨迹）。
AI.result: 在六个域内和域外基准上，Chart-RVR 在同等规模 LVLM 中取得 SOTA 准确率。除准确率外，作者采用三角验证协议评估可监控性，结合真值代理指标、oracle 信息增益度量，以及 LLM-as-auditor 对 Process Verifiability 和 Evidence Localization 打分，结果显示 Chart-RVR 生成的推理理由在可验证性和证据扎根性上明显优于 CoT prompting、SFT 及现有图表专用基线。
AI.conclusion: Chart-RVR 通过结构化分解与可验证过程奖励，不仅提升了图表推理准确率，还显著增强了推理过程的可监控性与可审计性，为可部署的图表推理智能体提供了兼顾性能与可验证性的方案。

title: A paired synthetic construction-site image dataset for robust computer vision under adverse conditions
comment: 21 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables. Dataset and code are publicly available
summary: Computer-vision systems used for construction monitoring can degrade under adverse environmental and visual conditions, yet such conditions remain underrepresented in existing construction image datasets. We present ConSynth-X, a paired synthetic construction-site image dataset containing 34,199 images derived from 3,109 real-world source scenes. The dataset comprises 11 condition-specific subsets spanning precipitation, fog, nighttime illumination, adverse weather at night, and small-object or long-distance views. Each synthetic image is linked to its corresponding source scene, enabling controlled comparison across environmental and visual conditions. ConSynth-X includes source-derived annotations, generation metadata, provenance information, and image-quality indicators, supporting object detection, image captioning, visual grounding, and visual question answering. Technical validation evaluates source-synthetic fidelity and alignment with real adverse-condition imagery using embedding-based similarity and distributional analyses. The dataset provides a structured resource for evaluating and improving the robustness of construction vision and vision-language models under challenging field conditions.

AI.tldr: ConSynth-X：一个由3,109个真实场景生成、含11类恶劣条件子集共34,199张图像的建筑工地配对合成数据集，附带标注、生成元数据与质量指标，支持检测、描述、定位与VQA任务，并经嵌入相似度与分布分析验证保真度。
AI.motivation: 建筑监测用计算机视觉系统在恶劣环境与视觉条件下性能会退化，但现有建筑图像数据集对这些条件覆盖不足，缺乏可控、成对的评测资源。
AI.method: 以3,109个真实源场景为基础生成配对合成图像，构建11个条件专属子集（降水、雾、夜间光照、夜间恶劣天气、小目标或远距离视角），每张合成图与其源场景关联以支持跨条件可控比较；数据集包含源生标注、生成元数据、溯源信息与图像质量指标；技术验证采用基于嵌入的相似度与分布分析评估源-合成保真度及与真实恶劣条件影像的对齐程度。
AI.result: 发布包含34,199张图像、11个条件子集的配对合成数据集，支持目标检测、图像描述、视觉定位与视觉问答；验证显示合成图像在嵌入相似度与分布层面与源场景及真实恶劣条件影像具有良好保真度与对齐性。
AI.conclusion: ConSynth-X为在困难现场条件下评估与提升建筑视觉及视觉-语言模型的鲁棒性提供了结构化资源。

title: From Content Generation to Learning Support: Pedagogy-Guided Generative Video Tutors for STEM Learning
comment: accepted to EMNLP 2026, code available at GitHub
summary: Generative AI enables scalable production of educational videos, but current systems largely focus on producing visually coherent content rather than supporting learning. As a result, generated videos often lack explicit pedagogical structure, reliable quality control, and mechanisms for assessing learner understanding or addressing misconceptions. In this work, we introduce PIVOT (Pedagogy-guided Instructional VideO Tutoring), a generative video tutoring framework for STEM learning via learning-centered instructional support.1 Inspired by conventional teaching workflows, our framework integrates pedagogy into the full generation pipeline: it first uses instructional principles to guide storyboard generation, then produces verified multimodal videos through code-centric generation and a pedagogical verification harness, and finally connects videos with assessment and misconception-aware remediation. Experiments and expert evaluations across four STEM domains show that our framework produces educational videos with pedagogically aligned content, clear and engaging presentation, coherent instructional flow, and perceived effectiveness for learning. These findings suggest a human-centered perspective on educational content generation: generative systems should be evaluated and designed not only by what they produce, but also by how they support teaching practices, learner understanding, and corrective feedback.

AI.tldr: PIVOT：将教学法嵌入生成式视频全流程的STEM辅导框架
AI.motivation: 现有生成式AI教育视频系统侧重视觉连贯的内容生产，而非支持学习，导致缺少显性教学结构、可靠质量控制和评估学习理解与纠正错误概念的机制。作者主张从“以人为中心”的视角，生成系统应不仅按产出物、还应按其对教学实践、学习者理解和矫正性反馈的支撑来设计与评估。
AI.method: 提出PIVOT（Pedagogy-guided Instructional VideO Tutoring）框架，参照传统教学流程将教学法融入完整生成管线：①以教学原则引导分镜（storyboard）生成；②通过代码为中心的生成（code-centric generation）与教学验证工具（pedagogical verification harness）产出经校验的多模态视频；③将视频与测评及具错误概念意识的补救（misconception-aware remediation）相衔接。
AI.result: 在四个STEM领域的实验与专家评估表明，该框架生成的视频内容与教学法一致、表达清晰有吸引力、教学流程连贯，并被认为对学习有效。
AI.conclusion: 生成式教育内容系统应以教学法为指导进行全流程设计，并按其对教学实践、学习者理解与矫正性反馈的支持程度来评估，体现以人为中心的教育内容生成理念。

title: A Latent Distribution Perspective on Evaluating and Improving Latent Generative Models
summary: In latent generative models, reconstruction quality is often assumed to correlate with generative performance. However, reconstruction FID (rFID) can exhibit weak or even negative correlation with generation FID (gFID). We attribute this misalignment to a latent distribution mismatch: reconstruction evaluates the decoder on encoder-induced latents, whereas generation uses the same decoder on latents produced by the generative model. To characterize this shift, we introduce generation-aware reconstruction (GAR), which constructs a continuous trajectory from standard reconstruction toward generation by perturbing encoder latents with noise and denoising them through the generative model before decoding. GAR probes the decoder behavior along this trajectory, making the transition from encoder to generation-time latent distributions observable and diagnosable. The resulting trajectory-based diagnostic, GAR-FID, exhibits strong empirical correlation with gFID across diverse tokenizers and scales. Importantly, intermediate GAR latents become more generation-aware while preserving correspondence with their source images, thereby retaining paired supervision that is absent for fully generated latents. This correspondence enables decoder adaptation on intermediate GAR latents, consistently improving generative quality across model scales. Overall, latent distribution mismatch provides a useful perspective for evaluating and improving latent generative models.

AI.tldr: 论文指出重建质量与生成质量常不相关，原因在于潜在分布不匹配，并提出GAR指标来诊断和改善生成模型。
AI.motivation: 潜在生成模型中，重建FID (rFID) 常被假设与生成性能相关，但实际上它与生成FID (gFID) 相关性弱甚至为负。作者将这种错位归因于潜在分布不匹配：重建时解码器处理的是编码器产生的潜在表示，而生成时解码器处理的是生成模型产生的潜在表示，两者分布存在差异。
AI.method: 提出生成感知重建（GAR）：通过向编码器潜在表示添加噪声，并经由生成模型去噪后再解码，构造从标准重建到生成的连续轨迹。GAR沿该轨迹探测解码器行为，使编码器到生成时潜在分布的转变可观测、可诊断。基于该轨迹的诊断指标GAR-FID，并利用中间GAR潜在表示仍保留与源图像的对应关系（配对监督）进行解码器适配。
AI.result: GAR-FID与gFID在不同tokenizer和规模下表现出强经验相关性。中间GAR潜在表示兼具生成感知性并保留与源图像的对应关系，据此进行解码器适配可在多个模型规模上持续提升生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 潜在分布不匹配为评估和改进潜在生成模型提供了一个有用的视角。

title: HDND: Hierarchical Dynamic Neural Decoding for Multilingual Word/Character Retrieval from Non-Invasive Brain Recordings
summary: While deep learning has enabled language decoding from intracranial brain recordings, extending this capability to non-invasive recordings remains an unresolved challenge. Decoding individual words from non-invasive brain recordings is particularly difficult, as word-level neural evidence is weak, temporally distributed, and entangled with acoustic, lexical, and semantic structure. Existing retrieval pipelines often collapse these factors into a single representation, potentially discarding information available at intermediate temporal scales. Here, we introduce Hierarchical Dynamic Neural Decoding (HDND), a hierarchical dynamic decoding framework that treats word decoding as structured refinement rather than flat label retrieval. HDND combines intermediate neural representations, contextual semantic predictions, and, for selected reading conditions, an auxiliary character-form objective. We evaluate HDND across seven electroencephalography (EEG) and magnetoencephalography (MEG) datasets spanning English, Dutch, Mandarin, and Cantonese listening, reading, and reading-aloud conditions. Across the nine-condition word-retrieval benchmark, the proposed HDND yields a higher participant-averaged balanced Top-10 point estimate than the matched contextual word-decoding baseline in every condition and achieves the highest mean among all compared methods in eight of nine conditions. Across the same nine matched conditions, HDND also yields higher token-micro and pooled word-macro Top-10 point estimates in every setting. Sentence retrieval favors HDND in eight of nine conditions, while auditory speech-segment retrieval is mixed across the six listening conditions. These results show that hierarchical residual refinement can improve multilingual word retrieval from heterogeneous non-invasive brain recordings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分层动态神经解码框架HDND，将单词解码视为结构化逐步细化而非扁平标签检索，并在多语种EEG/MEG数据上验证其优于基线。
AI.motivation: 从非侵入式脑记录（EEG/MEG）解码单词极具挑战：单词级神经证据微弱、时间分布分散，且与声学、词汇、语义结构纠缠；现有检索流程常将这些因素压缩为单一表示，丢失中间时间尺度信息。
AI.method: HDND融合中间神经表征、上下文语义预测，并在部分阅读条件下引入辅助字符形态目标，实现分层动态的残差细化解码。
AI.result: 在覆盖英语、荷兰语、普通话、粤语的7个EEG/MEG数据集、九种条件的单词检索基准上，HDND在每种条件下参与者平均平衡Top-10点估计均高于匹配的上下文单词解码基线，八/九条件下均值最高；token-micro与word-macro Top-10亦全面领先；句子检索八/九占优；听觉语音片段检索在六个听音条件下表现参差。
AI.conclusion: 分层残差细化可提升从异构非侵入式脑记录中的多语种单词检索能力。

title: A$^2$Safe: Counterfactual Evidence-Aligned Adaptive Agent Collaboration for Safe and Effective Visual Question Answering
summary: Visual Question Answering (VQA) with Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) requires not only producing safe and effective responses, but also grounding safety decisions in the multimodal evidence that determines risk. Recent safety-alignment methods improve refusal behavior and contextual risk awareness, yet correct safety outcomes may still rely on superficial textual or visual correlations, particularly when risk emerges from interactions between individually benign image and question content. To address this issue, we propose A$^2$Safe, a counterfactual evidence-aligned adaptive agent collaboration framework for safe and effective VQA. A$^2$Safe organizes localized visual observations, textual intent, and cross-modal risk relations through a Grounded Safety Evidence Board, making the basis of safety decisions explicit. Counterfactual safety evidence alignment enforces invariance to safety-irrelevant changes while requiring appropriate safety-state and response-mode transitions when risk-critical evidence is minimally altered. The resulting evidence state further supports adaptive collaboration, enabling direct answering when grounded evidence is sufficient and invoking policy critique and response revision when evidence is risky, uncertain, or conflicting. Under complementary safety-critical and general VQA protocols, A$^2$Safe achieves a 95.72 SIUO safety score, reduces the benign refusal rate on MOSSBench to 14.67%, and maintains an average general VQA score of 78.34 with 27.8% token overhead. These results support counterfactual evidence-aligned adaptive collaboration for safe and effective multimodal question answering.

AI.tldr: 提出 A$^2$Safe 框架，通过反事实证据对齐与自适应智能体协作，实现安全且有效的多模态 VQA。
AI.motivation: 现有安全对齐方法虽改善了拒答行为与情境风险感知，但正确的安全结果仍可能依赖表面的文本或视觉相关性，尤其当风险源于图像与问题内容交互时。
AI.method: 构建 Grounded Safety Evidence Board 组织局部视觉观测、文本意图与跨模态风险关系；通过反事实安全证据对齐实现无关变化的不变性与关键证据微扰下的安全状态/响应模式转换；并据此进行自适应协作，证据充分时直接作答，风险/不确定/冲突时触发策略批判与响应修订。
AI.result: 在安全关键与通用 VQA 协议下，SIUO 安全分 95.72，MOSSBench 良性拒答率降至 14.67%，通用 VQA 平均分 78.34，token 开销 27.8%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持反事实证据对齐的自适应协作，可用于安全且有效的多模态问答。

title: You Can Tell Who's Asking: What the Web's Questions Are Made Of, and Where They Come From
comment: Accepted to the 13th Web as Corpus Workshop (WaC-13) at EMNLP 2026. 14 pages, 4 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/bodhiumlabs/tell-whos-asking
summary: Questions scraped from the web are used across academia and industry as a proxy for what people want to know. Across QA training data, retrieval benchmarks, and content strategy, questions on a page are assumed to reflect human intent. We test this assumption at scale by extracting 13.4B question occurrences across 110 FineWeb snapshots (2013-2025), and report three findings. First, you can tell who is asking: provenance (the host/page of questions) leaves a signal in question form, and a logistic model can separate genuine user questions from templated/manufactured ones at AUC 0.725 via length and surrounding context rather than question type, though only 0.554 against commerce FAQ writing. Second, question frequency does not measure demand: the most-frequent questions are boilerplate/templated (over 70% of the top thousand), so occurrence counts measure how often a string was published and not how often it was asked. Third, over twelve years the genuine share of occurrences fell by 79% (42-56% after controlling for crawl composition), with question length and context decreasing. We present the first diachronic, occurrence-level measurement of web question provenance, and find the crawlable web's questions have shifted from being asked by humans toward manufactured for machines to read.

AI.tldr: 该论文对"网页上的问题反映人类真实意图"这一假设进行大规模检验：抽取110个FineWeb快照（2013-2025）中的134亿条问题，发现来源可在问题形态上被区分，问题频次衡量的是发布量而非需求量，且12年间真实人类提问占比下降79%。
AI.motivation: 学术界与工业界普遍将网页抓取的问题作为"人们想知道什么"的代理，广泛用于问答训练数据、检索基准与内容策略。作者认为这一假设缺乏大规模验证，故对其在时间维度与发生量层面进行系统检验。
AI.method: 从110个FineWeb网页快照（2013-2025）中抽取134亿条问题出现记录；用逻辑回归模型基于问题长度与上下文语境（而非问题类型）区分真实用户提问与模板化/机器生成提问；统计高频问题构成；并以12年时间跨度追踪真实问题占比、问题长度与上下文的变化，同时控制抓取组成的影响。
AI.result: 1）来源可判定：逻辑模型区分真实提问与模板/制造提问达AUC 0.725，但针对电商FAQ文案仅为0.554；2）频次不等于需求：最高频的千条问题中超过70%为模板/样板问题，出现次数衡量的是字符串被发布的频率而非被询问的频率；3）12年间真实提问占比下降79%（控制抓取组成后为42-56%），问题长度与上下文同步缩短。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出了首个跨时间、以出现量为单位的网页问题来源测量，结论是可抓取网页上的问题已从"由人类提出"转向"为机器阅读而制造"，提醒以网页问题作为人类意图代理的研究与应用需重新审视其效度。

title: Adaptive Cortically Constrained EEG-Vision Alignment for Zero-Shot Brain-to-Image Retrieval
summary: Zero-shot brain-to-image retrieval requires robust alignment between noisy EEG responses and visual representations. Existing EEG-vision alignment methods often operate in sensor space and apply fixed visual supervision to all responses, ignoring both spatial mixing in scalp EEG and response-wise variability in alignment reliability. We propose an adaptive cortically constrained EEG-vision alignment method for zero-shot brain-to-image retrieval. The method reconstructs EEG responses into predefined ROI-level source-pattern representations and encodes them with a Neuro-ROI Attention Encoder. To handle response-wise variability, we introduce an evidence-based adaptive visual supervision strategy that weights detail-controlled visual targets using model-based alignment evidence. On THINGS-EEG, the proposed method achieves strong 200-way zero-shot retrieval performance, with ROI-level attribution providing post hoc interpretability of the learned source-pattern representations. These results show that cortically constrained representation learning and adaptive supervision can jointly support EEG-vision alignment for zero-shot brain-to-image retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自适应皮层约束的EEG-视觉对齐方法，用于零样本脑到图像检索：将EEG重建为ROI级源模式表示并用Neuro-ROI注意力编码器编码，同时引入基于证据的自适应视觉监督，在THINGS-EEG上取得较强的200路零样本检索性能。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG-视觉对齐方法多在传感器空间操作，并对所有响应施加固定视觉监督，忽略了头皮EEG的空间混叠以及不同响应间对齐可靠性的差异。
AI.method: 方法包含两部分：一是将EEG响应重建为预定义ROI级源模式表示，并通过Neuro-ROI注意力编码器进行编码；二是提出基于证据的自适应视觉监督策略，利用基于模型的对齐证据对细节受控的视觉目标进行加权。
AI.result: 在THINGS-EEG数据集上取得了较强的200路零样本检索性能，ROI级归因结果为所学源模式表示提供了事后可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 皮层约束的表示学习与自适应监督可共同支持面向零样本脑到图像检索的EEG-视觉对齐。

title: SPeaR: Test-Time Adaptation with Steering Primitives for Realigning Representations
summary: Test-time adaptation (TTA) addresses distribution shift using only unlabeled test data. Existing methods typically adapt pretrained models by updating their parameters, limiting both what is adapted and where adaptation can occur within the network. We instead keep the pretrained network frozen and steer its intermediate representations. We introduce SPeaR (Steering Primitive for Realigning Representations), which inserts lightweight learnable modules at stage boundaries and optimizes them directly from the test stream, requiring neither source data nor supervised warm-up. Each primitive is optimized using a gated objective that reduces uncertainty only when adaptation is beneficial, along with a diversity regularizer to prevent collapse, and a multi-depth anchor to stabilize adaptation. We show that steering early representations is the most effective strategy, and that the same primitive transfers across convolutional and Transformer architectures. Across CIFAR-10-C, CIFAR-100-C, and ImageNet-C, SPeaR consistently matches or outperforms methods that adapt orders of magnitude more parameters, remains robust across a wide range of batch sizes, and preserves source-domain performance during continual adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出SPeaR：冻结预训练网络，在阶段边界插入轻量可学习模块以“操纵”中间表征，实现测试时自适应。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时自适应方法通过更新预训练模型参数来应对分布偏移，这既限制了可被自适应的范围，也限制了自适应可发生的网络位置。
AI.method: 保持预训练网络冻结，在阶段边界插入轻量可学习模块（SPeaR），直接从测试流优化，无需源数据或监督式预热。每个模块采用门控目标（仅在自适应有利时降低不确定性），辅以多样性正则防止坍缩，并用多深度锚稳定自适应。
AI.result: 操纵早期表征最为有效；同一模块可在卷积与Transformer架构间迁移。在CIFAR-10-C、CIFAR-100-C、ImageNet-C上，SPeaR持续匹配或超越参数量多出数个数量级的方法，在广泛批大小范围内保持稳健，并在持续自适应中保持源域性能。
AI.conclusion: 以冻结主干+轻量表征操纵模块替代参数更新，是一种参数高效、架构通用且稳健的测试时自适应范式。

title: Calibration Count Reuse: Validity Does Not Determine Efficiency
summary: Calibration count reuse raises separate validity and efficiency questions. We give a validity criterion for general count-dependent nonconformity scores: transferring one count from another class to the scored class must not improve its conformity. A leave-self-out full conformal reference proves the criterion without requiring normalization or preservation of same-class score order. For a common separable transformation, universal exchangeable validity is equivalent to being nondecreasing in the count, provided $Kα\geq 1$; normalized multiplicative weights obey the complementary nonincreasing condition. Additive penalties are covered under the stated information restrictions. Efficiency has no parallel ordering: two iid constructions make the same valid rule improve or worsen expected size at unchanged coverage. An expanded 55-rule study finds no resolved advantage from selected live-count rules over uniform weights. Image studies identify undercoverage under iid resampling, including at numerical convergence. Separately, execution of the released Conf-OT pipeline on its DTD and Aircraft benchmark subsets produces near-nominal median coverage under fixed stratified counts. The native results are reported separately from the iid analyses, without treating a benchmark observation as a universal guarantee. The findings separate validity, classifier confidence, numerical convergence, and population-specific efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于校准计数的共形预测规则，给出计数依赖非一致性分数的有效性判据（跨类转移计数不得提升一致性），并用留一全共形证明；在可分离变换下，交换有效性等价于对计数非减（需$K\alpha\geq1$），而归一化乘性权重满足非增条件；效率无对应排序，iid下同一有效规则可提升或恶化期望集合大小，55条规则研究未发现活计数规则优于均匀权重，并报告了图像欠覆盖与Conf-OT基准近名义覆盖。
AI.motivation: 校准计数复用同时涉及有效性与效率两个独立问题，既有工作缺乏对一般计数依赖非一致性分数的有效性刻画，也缺少对效率排序的严格分析，容易将有效性、分类器置信度、数值收敛与总体效率混为一谈。
AI.method: 提出一般计数依赖非一致性分数的有效性判据：将某类计数转移至被评分类不得改善其一致性；用留己全共形（leave-self-out full conformal）参考证明该判据，无需归一化或保持同类分数序。对可分离变换证明在$K\alpha\geq1$时通用交换有效性等价于随计数非减；归一化乘性权重满足互补的非增条件；加性惩罚在给定信息约束下被覆盖。通过两个iid构造分析效率的不可排序性，并进行55条规则的扩展实验与图像/Conf-OT基准测试。
AI.result: 有效性方面：判据在无归一化条件下成立，可分离变换下交换有效性等价于计数非减（$K\alpha\geq1$），乘性权重对应非增。效率方面：两个iid构造显示同一有效规则可在覆盖率不变时改善或恶化期望集合大小，效率无平行排序；55条规则研究未发现选定的活计数规则相对均匀权重有确定优势；图像研究在iid重采样下发现欠覆盖，包括数值收敛时；Conf-OT流水线在DTD与Aircraft基准子集、固定分层计数下取得近名义中位覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 研究将有效性、分类器置信度、数值收敛与总体特定效率明确区分；基准观测不被当作普遍保证，原生结果与iid分析分开报告。

title: Patch-to-Global: Random Patch Diffusion for Globally Consistent Megapixel Artifact Inpainting in Whole Slide Images
summary: Although deep learning has advanced Whole Slide Image (WSI) Analysis, tissue artifacts like bubbles and folds often cause silent failures by concealing essential morphology. Current pathology image restoration methods are mostly restricted to small patches, struggling to maintain global structural coherence at a megapixel scale. We introduce RestorePath, a framework for globally consistent megapixel scale inpainting that reconstructs diagnostic structures in histological image to prevent incorrect high-confidence predictions and lower error rates. Our model utilizes a Latent Diffusion Model (LDM) conditioned on Pathology Foundation Model (PFM) embeddings, integrating Large Kernel Attention (LKA) to manage long-range dependencies during random patch diffusion. Enhanced by Distance-Weighted Interpolation (DWI) and an Adaptive Guidance Scale (AGS), RestorePath ensures structural consistency and fidelity by modulating information from surrounding patches. Evaluations across TCGA-BRCA, BACH, and Camelyon16 datasets for images ranging from 512 to 4608 pixels demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in maintaining histological consistency. RestorePath significantly improves downstream Computational Pathology (CP) tasks, outperforming both raw artifact images and the conventional Detect-and-Discard (D&D) approach. The code is available at https://github.com/PathfinderLab/RestorePath

AI.tldr: RestorePath提出了一种面向病理全切片图像的百万像素级全局一致修复框架，通过LDM结合PFM嵌入与LKA，并引入DWI与AGS，重建被气泡、折叠等伪影遮蔽的诊断性组织结构，从而避免高置信度误预测并降低下游任务错误率。
AI.motivation: 病理WSI分析中，气泡、组织折叠等伪影会遮蔽关键形态学信息，导致模型"静默失败"（即产生错误但高置信度的预测）。现有病理图像修复方法多局限于小图像块，难以在百万像素尺度上维持全局结构一致性，因此需要一种能够在超大尺度上实现全局一致修复的框架。
AI.method: RestorePath以潜扩散模型（LDM）为核心，条件化于病理基础模型（PFM）嵌入；引入大核注意力（LKA）以在随机图像块扩散过程中建模长程依赖；并结合距离加权插值（DWI）与自适应引导尺度（AGS），通过调制来自周围图像块的信息来保证结构一致性与保真度。
AI.result: 在TCGA-BRCA、BACH与Camelyon16数据集上，针对512至4608像素范围的多尺度图像进行评估，RestorePath在维持组织学一致性方面达到当前最优（SOTA）性能，并显著改善了下游计算病理任务，优于直接使用含伪影原图以及传统的"检测并丢弃"（Detect-and-Discard, D&D）方案。
AI.conclusion: RestorePath为百万像素级WSI伪影修复提供了全局一致的解决方案，可有效重建诊断性组织结构、抑制高置信度错误预测，并提升下游计算病理任务的性能，优于现有原始图像与D&D基线方法。

title: Re:CAP - Auditing Retrieval Coverage in Production RAG Pipelines
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is hard to monitor in production: exhaustive relevance labels do not exist for non-stationary multi-million-passage corpora that re-index in real time. As a result, retrieval quality is generally understudied and often deprioritised in favour of generation-oriented metrics. In this work, we propose auditing retrieval coverage by probing for evidence of missing documents rather than enumerating every relevant one. Our method Re:CAP (REtrieval Coverage Audit by iterative Probing) is a reference-free audit loop applied to a deployed RAG pipeline's initial answer and retrieved context: it identifies the topics already covered, generates probing questions for plausibly missing topics, retrieves candidate documents, and applies an LLM-as-judge to retain only those that introduce previously-unretrieved information. On four public benchmarks, Re:CAP recovers 9-29% of gold labels that flat BM25 top-500 cannot reach, rising to 48% on TREC-COVID. On MuSiQue Re:CAP beats flat hybrid top-500 by +12.9 pp on recall at less than half the document budget. An ensemble BM25, dense, and hybrid baseline (top-500 each) still leaves out 21.2% of gold docs on TREC-COVID that Re:CAP recovers; human annotators judge that 78.9% of those structurally distinct documents add new information to the baseline answer (Fleiss $κ$ = 0.79, n = 123), and 73.9% on live production traffic (n = 180). End-to-end recall is reproducible to within $\pm$1% across three independent runs, making Re:CAP a stable instrument for periodic retrieval audits.

AI.tldr: 提出 Re:CAP——一种无参考、迭代式探测的检索覆盖审计方法，通过寻找"缺失文档"的证据而非穷举所有相关文档，在四个公开基准和生产流量上稳定提升检索召回。
AI.motivation: RAG 在生产环境难以监控：语料规模达数百万、动态变化且实时重建索引，无法获得穷尽的相关性标注，导致检索质量研究不足、常被生成导向指标所忽视。传统基于标注的召回评估不可行，需要一种不依赖金标准的审计手段。
AI.method: Re:CAP（REtrieval Coverage Audit by iterative Probing）是一个应用于已部署 RAG 流水线的无参考审计循环，输入为初始答案与检索上下文。其流程为：(1) 识别已被覆盖的主题；(2) 针对可能缺失的主题生成探测性问题；(3) 检索候选文档；(4) 使用 LLM-as-judge 仅保留能引入此前未检索到信息的文档，从而迭代式补全覆盖。
AI.result: 在四个公开基准上，Re:CAP 找回 BM25 flat top-500 无法触及的金标注的 9–29%，在 TREC-COVID 上达 48%；在 MuSiQue 上以不到一半的文档预算，召回率比 hybrid flat top-500 高 +12.9 pp。BM25、稠密与混合三种基线各取 top-500 的集成，在 TREC-COVID 上仍遗漏 21.2% 的金文档，而 Re:CAP 可将其找回；人工标注者认为其中 78.9% 的结构性差异文档为基线答案带来新信息（Fleiss κ = 0.79，n = 123），生产流量上为 73.9%（n = 180）。端到端召回在三次独立运行中可复现至 ±1%。
AI.conclusion: Re:CAP 提供了一种稳定、可复现、无需金标准标注的检索覆盖审计工具，适用于对生产 RAG 系统进行定期检索质量审计，弥补了检索质量评估长期被忽视的问题。

title: Positive Pair Geometry Matters: Optimal Transport for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations
summary: Contrastive self-supervised learning has achieved strong performance by learning representations from multiple augmented views of the same image. However, most existing methods construct positive pairs using independently sampled stochastic augmentations, which may alter semantic content and ignore the intrinsic geometry of the data distribution. In this work, we propose OTCLR, an optimal transport-aware framework for contrastive learning representations that generates geometry-consistent positive samples. Instead of directly contrasting two randomly augmented views, we construct intermediate views between the original image and its augmented variants through entropic optimal-transport displacement interpolation. These transport-interpolated samples serve as positive views that better preserve image structure while explicitly modeling spatial distributional geometry. To further promote smooth representation learning, we evaluate auxiliary Sinkhorn regularization terms that encourage transport-interpolated views to remain consistent with their endpoint images. The proposed method can be incorporated into standard contrastive learning pipelines without modifying the encoder architecture. Experiments on multiple benchmark datasets show that our approach improves representation quality and transfer learning performance compared with conventional augmentation-based contrastive learning baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出OTCLR框架，通过熵正则最优传输位移插值构造几何一致的正样本，提升对比自监督学习的表示质量与迁移性能。
AI.motivation: 现有对比自监督方法多依赖独立采样的随机数据增强构造正样本对，这类增强可能改变语义内容，且忽略数据分布的内在几何结构，导致正样本对的语义一致性和几何合理性不足。
AI.method: 提出OTCLR（最优传输感知的对比学习表示框架）。不直接对比两个随机增强视图，而是在原图与其增强变体之间通过熵正则最优传输位移插值（entropic optimal transport displacement interpolation）构造中间视图，作为正样本以更好地保留图像结构并显式建模空间分布几何；同时引入Sinkhorn正则项，促使传输插值视图与端点图像保持一致以促进表示平滑学习；该方法可直接嵌入标准对比学习流程，无需修改编码器结构。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，相比基于传统数据增强的对比学习基线，该方法提升了表示质量与迁移学习性能。
AI.conclusion: 利用最优传输位移插值生成几何一致的正样本，是一种无需改动编码器、可即插即用的对比学习改进方案，能够有效提升表示学习效果与下游迁移能力。

title: Action-Slot: Structured Action-Centric Representation Learning for Multi-Agent Atomic Activity Understanding
summary: Atomic activity understanding aims to recognize and localize structured traffic behaviors that jointly encode motion patterns and their grounding in road topology. Unlike conventional action recognition, atomic activities are multi-agent, multi-label, and topology-aware: multiple activities co-occur while many agents remain inactive. We introduce Action-Slot, a structured action-centric representation learning framework. Slot attention is widely used for object-centric decomposition, but its permutation-invariant design and object-level inductive bias are misaligned with atomic activity semantics. We reformulate slot learning as structured activity decomposition through three designs: (1) category-aligned action slots that anchor slots to predefined activity categories, (2) parallel spatio-temporal slot updating for holistic video-level reasoning, and (3) background and negative-slot regularization that enforces competition between foreground activities and irrelevant regions. Together these establish an activity-centric inductive bias that disentangles concurrent and asynchronous activities directly from raw video. Beyond recognition, the learned representations encode transferable spatio-temporal grounding signals. We further propose an attention-difference-based pseudo mask selection framework that suppresses false positives by measuring attention changes before and after candidate region removal, enabling weakly supervised localization without dense annotations. To support systematic evaluation, we introduce TACO, a balanced synthetic dataset with full atomic activity coverage and pixel-level annotations. Experiments on OATS, TACO, and annotated nuScenes show superior recognition, strong sim-to-real transfer, and state-of-the-art weakly supervised localization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Action-Slot框架，将slot attention重构为结构化活动分解，用于原子交通活动理解，并配合注意力差分伪掩码选择实现弱监督定位，同时发布合成数据集TACO。
AI.motivation: 原子活动理解需识别并定位同时编码运动模式与道路拓扑落地的结构化交通行为，其具有多智能体、多标签、拓扑感知特性，且多个活动共现而许多智能体处于非活跃状态，区别于传统动作识别。同时slot attention的排列不变性与物体级归纳偏置与原子活动语义不匹配。
AI.method: 提出Action-Slot结构化、以动作为中心的表征学习框架，通过三项设计实现结构化活动分解：(1)类别对齐的动作slot，将slot锚定到预定义活动类别；(2)并行时空slot更新，实现整体视频级推理；(3)背景与负slot正则化，促使前景活动与无关区域竞争。此外提出基于注意力差分的伪掩码选择框架，通过衡量候选区域移除前后注意力变化抑制误检，实现无需密集标注的弱监督定位。
AI.result: 在OATS、TACO及带标注的nuScenes上实验显示：识别性能更优，具有强仿真到真实迁移能力，并取得最先进的弱监督定位效果。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的以活动为中心的归纳偏置可直接从原始视频中解耦并发与异步活动，学到的表征可编码可迁移的时空定位信号，为原子交通活动理解提供了新的框架、数据集与弱监督定位方案。

title: The Visual Target Matters: Learning across the Visual Hierarchy for Brain-to-Image Retrieval
summary: Brain-to-image retrieval seeks to identify the visual stimulus that elicited a non-invasive neural response. Candidate images are typically represented by pretrained vision models, whose internal representations vary in abstraction across depth. Existing methods usually train the neural encoder to recover a fixed final-layer visual target. Under this formulation, the visual hierarchy is reduced to a single prescribed endpoint, preventing representations at other depths from directly shaping the visual target. This limitation motivates learning how information across visual depths should contribute to the retrieval target. To this end, we introduce NeuroGlyph, which learns a trial-independent visual target from multiple depths of a frozen visual backbone. NeuroGlyph decomposes the target into factor-specific subspaces. Each subspace learns an image-conditioned allocation over visual depth. The resulting subspaces are fused into a single embedding for retrieval. Across THINGS-EEG and THINGS-MEG, NeuroGlyph outperforms final-layer supervision in all controlled comparisons. It also surpasses the post hoc best fixed-layer oracle in three of four comparisons. Parameter-matched ablations support both factorized target construction and image-conditioned depth allocation. Under comparable 200-way retrieval protocols, NeuroGlyph achieves the strongest system-level performance in six of eight reported metrics. These results support learning retrieval targets across the visual hierarchy rather than prescribing one visual depth.

AI.tldr: 提出NeuroGlyph，从冻结视觉骨干的多个深度学习试次无关的视觉目标，通过分解为因子特定子空间并做图像条件化的深度分配，融合为单一嵌入用于脑到图像检索，在THINGS-EEG/MEG上优于固定末层监督与事后最佳固定层oracle。
AI.motivation: 现有脑到图像检索方法通常训练神经编码器去回归一个固定的末层视觉目标，将视觉层级压缩为单一预设终点，使其他深度的表征无法直接影响检索目标；作者希望学习视觉各深度信息应如何贡献于检索目标。
AI.method: NeuroGlyph从冻结视觉骨干的多个深度学习试次无关（trial-independent）的视觉目标；将目标分解为因子特定子空间，每个子空间学习图像条件化的视觉深度分配，最终将各子空间融合为单一嵌入用于检索。
AI.result: 在THINGS-EEG与THINGS-MEG上，NeuroGlyph在所有受控对比中优于末层监督，并在四组比较中的三组超过事后最佳固定层oracle；参数匹配消融支持因子化目标构建与图像条件化深度分配；在可比的200类检索协议下，在八项指标中的六项取得最强系统级性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持跨视觉层级学习检索目标，而非预设单一视觉深度。

title: Data Agents: Agentic Data Systems
summary: Traditional data systems face profound limitations in the AI era, relying on human-crafted pipelines, lacking semantic understanding of heterogeneous data, and operating through rigid, reactive processing. To address these challenges, we propose a new paradigm called the Data Agent, designed to manage, process, and analyze data with minimal human intervention. Data agents autonomously execute a wide range of data-related tasks, transforming traditional data systems by shifting from manual design to autonomous orchestration, from literal manipulation to semantic interpretation, and from reactive to proactive processing. Our Data Agent system includes six components: semantic data organization, semantic operators, agentic pipeline orchestration and optimization, feedback-driven refinement, memory management, and proactive adaptation. Building on this foundation, we also develop two specialized agents: the data analytics agent and the data science agent. Experiments on real benchmarks demonstrate significant performance gains of our data agent over state-of-the-art methods. We identify open challenges to guide future research in building fully autonomous data systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"数据智能体（Data Agent）"新范式，用自主智能体取代人工数据管道，实现从人工设计到自主编排、从字面操作到语义理解、从被动响应到主动处理的转变，并提出六大组件及数据分析/数据科学两类专用智能体。
AI.motivation: 传统数据系统在AI时代存在根本局限：依赖人工构建的管道、缺乏对异构数据的语义理解、采用僵化的被动式处理方式，难以适应现代数据管理与分析需求。
AI.method: 提出Data Agent范式，使智能体在最少人工干预下自主执行数据相关任务。系统包含六大组件：语义数据组织、语义算子、智能体化管道编排与优化、反馈驱动的迭代精化、记忆管理、主动适应；并在此基础上构建数据分析智能体和数据科学智能体两类专用智能体。
AI.result: 在真实基准上的实验表明，所提出的数据智能体相较当前最先进方法取得显著性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 数据智能体有望推动构建全自主数据系统，论文同时指出了该方向的开放挑战以指导未来研究。

title: STAR: Scene- and Task-Aware 4D Radar Preprocessing Towards End-to-End Cognitive Radar
summary: Four-dimensional (4D) Radar has emerged as a key sensor for environmental perception, providing range, azimuth, elevation, and Doppler measurements while remaining robust to illumination changes and adverse weather conditions. However, conventional Radar preprocessing methods, such as constant false alarm rate (CFAR) detection, select measurements primarily based on signal-level criteria and may therefore discard information valuable for downstream perception during point cloud generation. In addition, existing 4D Radar perception pipelines typically optimize Radar data processing and downstream perception independently, preventing task objectives from directly guiding the preprocessing stage. To address these limitations, we propose a Scene- and Task-Aware Radar (STAR) Preprocessor together with an end-to-end training framework. The STAR Preprocessor incorporates scene context and downstream task objectives to generate task-relevant Radar points, enabling the Radar representation to be optimized directly for perception.
