On the K-Radar benchmark, the proposed method achieves 74.3 AP, outperforming the previous state of the art by 5.6 AP points. Furthermore, applying the task-relevant points generated by STAR to various existing 3D detectors improves detection performance in most evaluation settings and yields an overall positive average gain over point clouds produced by conventional preprocessing.

AI.tldr: 提出STAR预处理器及端到端训练框架，用场景与任务信息生成任务相关的4D雷达点云，在K-Radar上达到74.3 AP，超越此前SOTA 5.6 AP。
AI.motivation: 传统4D雷达预处理（如CFAR）仅依据信号级准则筛选测量，会丢弃对下游感知有价值的信息；且现有流程将雷达数据处理与下游感知分离优化，任务目标无法指导预处理阶段。
AI.method: 提出Scene- and Task-Aware Radar（STAR）预处理器，结合场景上下文与下游任务目标生成任务相关的雷达点；并配套端到端训练框架，使雷达表征直接面向感知任务进行优化。
AI.result: 在K-Radar基准上取得74.3 AP，较此前最优方法提升5.6 AP；将STAR生成的任务相关点应用于多种现有3D检测器，在大多数评测设置下提升检测性能，相较传统预处理的点云取得总体正向平均增益。
AI.conclusion: 将场景与任务信息引入雷达预处理并采用端到端优化，可有效提升4D雷达点云的信息利用率与下游3D检测性能，并具备良好的检测器通用性。

title: Graded-Relevance Composed Multimodal Retrieval for E-commerce Visual Search at Scale
summary: Visual search on large e-commerce catalogs must serve both "similarity" queries that ask for items resembling an uploaded image and "modifier" queries that comprise an image and text describing a desired modification (e.g. a color change or style swap). The latter is the setting known as composed image retrieval (CIR). Existing CIR methods, however, treat relevance as binary and train on triplets with a single positive target - a poor fit for real catalogs where many candidates partially satisfy a user query and ranking across that partial-match spectrum drives the customer experience. We propose a methodology for training CIR retrievers on graded relevance, consisting of: (i) a VLM to curate training data, generating both queries (object detection + modifier synthesis) and 4-level relevance labels without manual annotation, (ii) an iterative relevance-feedback loop that expands the training set by mining hard negatives from the in-training retriever, and (iii) a hierarchy-aware angular objective to train the retriever directly on the graded labels rather than collapsing them to a binary split. We call this methodology GradCIR and instantiate it on a PaliGemma2 bi-encoder trained on 3.5M graded pairs curated from raw Walmart catalog data. A controlled graded-vs-binary ablation isolates the supervision granularity and shows lift of 4.9%-5.9% in NDCG@10. The same recipe applied to other multimodal encoders lifts early-fusion backbones by up to 8.5% NDCG@10. On the public FashionIQ benchmark, GradCIR (applied to PaliGemma2) reaches 0.6703 average recall when fine-tuned, slightly ahead of the strongest peer-reviewed supervised baseline we compare against, and matching or exceeding all published CLIP-L-class zero-shot CIR methods. The system is deployed in production at Walmart, where it's serving live visual-search user traffic.

AI.tldr: 提出GradCIR方法，用分级相关性标签训练组合图像检索(CIR)模型，在沃尔玛目录上NDCG@10提升4.9%-5.9%，并已上线服务真实流量。
AI.motivation: 大型电商目录的视觉搜索需同时支持"相似性"查询（上传图像找相似项）和"修饰"查询（图像+文字描述修改，即组合图像检索CIR）。现有CIR方法将相关性视为二值、用单一正样本的三元组训练，不适配真实目录中大量候选仅部分满足查询、需在部分匹配谱上排序的场景。
AI.method: GradCIR包含三部分：(i) 用VLM自动整理训练数据，生成查询（目标检测+修饰合成）和4级相关性标签，无需人工标注；(ii) 迭代相关性反馈循环，从训练中的检索器挖掘难负样本扩充训练集；(iii) 层级感知角度目标函数，直接在分级标签上训练而非塌缩为二值。在PaliGemma2双编码器上实例化，使用从沃尔玛目录数据整理的350万分级对。
AI.result: 控制变量的分级vs二值消融隔离了监督粒度影响，NDCG@10提升4.9%-5.9%；同一配方应用于其他多模态编码器，早期融合骨干提升最高达8.5% NDCG@10。公开FashionIQ基准上，微调的GradCIR(PaliGemma2)达0.6703平均召回，略优于最强同行评审监督基线，并匹配或超越所有已发表CLIP-L类零样本CIR方法。
AI.conclusion: 分级相关性监督显著优于二值监督，方法具有良好的可迁移性，且该系统已部署于沃尔玛生产环境，服务真实视觉搜索用户流量。

title: TAC-Time: Texts as Channels For Multimodal Time Series Forecasting
summary: Most existing time series forecasting methods rely solely on numerical observations, overlooking rich contextual information from auxiliary texts. Recent multimodal approaches attempt to incorporate textual signals, but they often treat text as static features or use large language models as forecasting backbones, limiting their ability to capture temporal dynamics and increasing computational cost. To address these challenges, we propose TAC-Time, a unified framework that transforms textual information into additional temporal channels. By modeling text features jointly with numerical sequences in a shared temporal backbone, TAC-Time preserves temporal continuity and periodic structures while remaining efficient and scalable. This formulation also enables systematic interpretability analyses. We show strong cross-modal dependencies through attention and frequency-domain analyses, and identify predictive textual signals whose correlation-aware alignment yields partial forecasting improvements. Extensive experiments on real-world multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that TAC-Time outperforms prior methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出TAC-Time框架，将文本信息转化为额外的时序通道，与数值序列在共享的时序骨干网络中联合建模，以提升多模态时间序列预测性能并兼顾效率与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有时序预测方法多仅依赖数值观测，忽略辅助文本中的丰富上下文信息；现有多模态方法要么将文本视为静态特征，要么以大型语言模型作为预测骨干，难以捕捉时序动态且计算开销较大。
AI.method: TAC-Time将文本特征转换为额外的时序通道，使其与数值序列在共享的时序骨干网络中进行联合建模，从而在保持时序连续性与周期性结构的同时，兼顾高效性和可扩展性，并支持系统化的可解释性分析。
AI.result: 通过注意力与频域分析揭示了强跨模态依赖关系，识别出具有预测性的文本信号，其相关性感知对齐可带来部分预测性能提升；在真实世界多模态基准上的大量实验表明，TAC-Time优于已有方法。
AI.conclusion: TAC-Time通过将文本转化为时序通道并在共享骨干中联合建模，为多模态时序预测提供了一种高效、可扩展且可解释的统一框架，并在实证上取得优于现有方法的表现。

title: Relightable 3D Avatar Reconstruction with Semantic-Adaptive Motion-Illumination Responses
summary: Reconstructing expressive and relightable 3D head avatars from monocular videos remains challenging in computer vision, as it requires accurate modeling of both non-rigid facial motion and illumination-dependent appearance. Existing Gaussian avatar methods commonly rely on globally coupled representations, in which Gaussian primitives share a unified motion or illumination response model. Such uniform modeling neglects the distinct motion patterns and material/reflectance properties of different facial semantic regions, thereby limiting fine-grained animation accuracy and reducing relighting plausibility. To address this limitation, we propose SAMIRA, a 3D Gaussian avatar framework for semantic-adaptive motion-illumination response modeling. For motion response modeling, the Semantic-Adaptive Motion Response module rasterizes current-to-reference mesh displacements into a topology-consistent UV space and leverages facial semantics to route displacement features through semantic-specific modulators, predicting localized Gaussian geometric residuals beyond coarse mesh binding. For illumination response modeling, the Semantic-Adaptive Illumination Response module learns compact diffuse and specular response factors for each facial region, allowing Gaussians in different regions to adapt their illumination responses to novel environment lighting. These response factors are incorporated into deferred physically based shading, providing a lightweight approximation of semantic-dependent illumination effects. Extensive experiments on self-reenactment, cross-reenactment, and relighting demonstrate that SAMIRA improves both fine-grained expression reconstruction and relighting realism over existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出SAMIRA，一种语义自适应的3D高斯头像框架，通过语义引导的运动与光照响应建模，提升单目视频重建的细粒度表情与重光照真实感。
AI.motivation: 现有高斯头像方法多采用全局耦合表示，即高斯图元共享统一的运动或光照响应模型，忽略了不同面部语义区域在运动模式与材质/反射特性上的差异，从而限制了细粒度动画精度与重光照合理性。
AI.method: 包含两个模块：1）语义自适应运动响应模块，将当前帧到参考帧的网格位移光栅化到拓扑一致的UV空间，利用面部语义将位移特征路由至语义专属调制器，预测局部高斯几何残差，突破粗粒度网格绑定；2）语义自适应光照响应模块，为每个面部区域学习紧凑的漫反射与镜面反射响应因子，使不同区域的高斯能适应新环境光照，并将其融入延迟物理渲染，实现轻量化的语义相关光照近似。
AI.result: 在自我重演、跨身份重演与重光照实验中，SAMIRA在细粒度表情重建和重光照真实感上均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 面向面部语义区域进行解耦的运动与光照响应建模，可有效提升3D高斯头像的动画精度与重光照合理性，验证了语义自适应表示在头像重建中的价值。

title: An Unexpected Robot Policy: Early Evaluations of GPT-6 Astra on RoboDojo and Beyond
summary: Embodied AI systems are often organized into System 1 and System 2. System 1 is typically a pretrained policy that generates actions at high frequency, whereas System 2 is often instantiated as a vision-enabled language model for high-level planning. We ask whether a large language model (LLM) can act as the policy for robot manipulation without task-specific finetuning. We call this setting LLM as policy. We evaluate three LLMs on all 42 RoboDojo tasks and compare their scores with 40 public policies. Astra and GPT-5.5 use the official 50-episode-per-task protocol; DeepSeek-Flash uses 10 episodes per task. GPT-6 Astra achieves 22.48% average success rate and 28.97 Score over 2,100 trials, ranking above every public entry. Yet GPT-5.5 and DeepSeek-Flash reach only 0.88% and 1.92% average success rate with the same post-processing. We find that Astra exhibits a sharply polarized capability profile. It generalizes well to tasks that require semantic understanding but not high-precision control. In contrast, it performs poorly on tasks that require precision, dynamic control, or complex bimanual coordination. In-context experiments show no aggregate benefit from one-shot demonstrations, while selected interaction traces show within-episode corrections under perturbations. Overall, the evaluated LLMs vary substantially in manipulation performance. Astra stands out and provides initial evidence for the potential of a general-purpose manipulation model, although reliable precision and dynamic control remain limitations in the evaluated setting.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"LLM as policy"设定，评测三个LLM在全部42项RoboDojo任务上的表现，并与40个公开策略对比：GPT-6 Astra以22.48%平均成功率和28.97分超越所有公开结果，但能力高度两极化，精度与动态控制仍是瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 具身智能通常分为System 1（高频预训练策略）与System 2（视觉语言模型做高层规划）。作者想探究：LLM能否不经任务特定微调，直接充当机器人操作策略，即"LLM as policy"，从而评估其作为通用操作模型的潜力与边界。
AI.method: 在同一设定下评测三个LLM：GPT-6 Astra与GPT-5.5采用官方每任务50回合协议，DeepSeek-Flash采用每任务10回合；覆盖RoboDojo全部42项任务，共2,100次试验，并与40个公开策略分数对比，同时开展单样本演示与扰动下交互轨迹的上下文实验。
AI.result: GPT-6 Astra取得22.48%平均成功率和28.97分，超过所有公开条目；GPT-5.5与DeepSeek-Flash在同一后处理下仅0.88%和1.92%。Astra能力呈明显两极化：语义理解类任务泛化好，精度、动态控制与复杂双手协调任务表现差。单样本演示无整体收益，部分交互轨迹显示回合内扰动修正能力。
AI.conclusion: 所评测LLM在操作性能上差异显著，Astra表现突出，为通用操作模型提供了初步证据；但在该评测设定下，可靠的精度与动态控制仍是其主要局限。

title: LegendBench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Legend Understanding with Counterfactual Interventions
summary: Legends are fundamental to chart understanding, as reliable interpretation requires correctly binding legend entries to corresponding visual marks. While vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly applied to chart understanding, their legend understanding is poorly diagnosed by aggregate accuracy, which can be satisfied by superficial shortcuts and confound legend-specific errors with other reasoning failures. To enable fine-grained diagnosis and controlled testing, we introduce LegendBench, a parametric benchmark and generation pipeline that produces targeted legend-centric test cases. LegendBench contributes (1) a capability-task taxonomy spanning legend parsing, legend grounding, legend-conditioned reasoning, and legend-aware abstention to localize failures, and (2) counterfactual group generation, where each base chart yields multiple variants under controlled legend interventions to probe model invariance and sensitivity. Using LegendBench, we evaluate both general-purpose VLMs and specialized chart models and generate their capability profiles, revealing persistent bottlenecks in reliable legend-to-mark binding and counterfactual consistency. We then use these capability profiles to guide targeted fine-tuning, demonstrating that bottleneck-specific interventions can effectively close the localized capability gaps and generalize to unseen data. We further leverage our counterfactual design to conduct fine-grained diagnostic experiments, analyzing encoding-channel effects, legend-order shortcuts, and abstention under varying visibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LegendBench——一个面向图例理解的参数化基准与生成流水线,通过能力分类体系与反事实变体实现细粒度诊断,揭示VLM在图例-标记绑定与反事实一致性上的瓶颈,并证明瓶颈导向的微调可有效弥补局部能力缺口。
AI.motivation: 图例是图表理解的基础,可靠解读需将图例条目与对应视觉标记正确绑定。然而现有VLM图表理解评测依赖聚合准确率,既可能被表层捷径满足,又将图例相关错误与其他推理失败混淆,无法定位具体缺陷。因此需要细粒度、可控的图例专项诊断工具。
AI.method: 提出 LegendBench:参数化基准与生成流水线,产出以图例为中心的定向测试用例。包含两部分:(1) 能力-任务分类体系,覆盖图例解析、图例定位、图例条件推理、图例感知拒答;(2) 反事实分组生成,每个基础图表在受控图例干预下生成多个变体,用于探测模型的不变性与敏感性。基于生成的能力画像指导定向微调,并利用反事实设计开展诊断实验。
AI.result: 对通用VLM与专用图表模型进行评估并生成能力画像,发现其在可靠图例-标记绑定与反事实一致性上存在持续瓶颈。基于能力画像的瓶颈导向微调能有效缩小局部能力缺口,并泛化到未见数据。诊断实验进一步分析了编码通道效应、图例顺序捷径以及不同可见性下的拒答行为。
AI.conclusion: LegendBench 通过参数化、反事实、能力分层的评测范式,将图表理解中的图例能力诊断从聚合指标推进到可定位、可干预的细粒度层面;瓶颈导向的微调验证了该诊断的有效性与泛化性,为后续模型改进提供可操作指导。

title: Efficient LLM Distillation for Bangladesh Legal Context: A Smartphone-Compatible Retrieval-Augmented Generation Model
summary: Legal information in Bangladesh is inaccessible to most citizens. Statutory text is English-only, trained lawyers are concentrated in urban centres, and cloud-dependent AI fails where mobile connectivity is unreliable, a setting in which hallucinated legal text causes direct harm. The system addresses statutory interpretation only; queries that require judicial precedent or case-law reasoning fall outside its scope. We target the statutory access gap by compressing a 9-billion-parameter Gemma-2 teacher into a 2-billion-parameter student through two-phase progressive knowledge distillation. Phase 1 performs supervised fine-tuning on 9,429 quality-gated legal question-answer pairs (65% acceptance from 14,514 generated queries); Phase 2 minimises sparse Kullback-Leibler divergence against the teacher's top-50 per-token logits at temperature tau = 4.0, implemented via QLoRA (4-bit NF4, rank-32 LoRA adapters). Prior legal language models target general legal English; this system specialises in Bangladeshi statutory law. Every response is grounded through hybrid retrieval combining dense semantic search (60%) and BM25 (40%) across 36,029 statutory passages from the Bangladesh Constitution and national legislation. On a 50-query English benchmark, the distilled model reaches ROUGE-L 0.4715 and BERTScore F1 0.5679, a 103% ROUGE-L and 143% BERTScore gain over the retrieval-augmented undistilled baseline (ROUGE-L 0.2323, BERTScore 0.2340). The adapter quantises to 1.6 GB (GGUF Q4_K_M) and runs at 4-8 tokens per second on a Pixel 6 with no network access. Cross-lingual evaluation on 50 Bangla queries yields ROUGE-L 0.4083 and BERTScore 0.8133, showing effective retrieval from Bangla input against an English-only corpus. In a single-evaluator pilot, a practising lawyer rated 50 responses at a weighted mean of 4.16/5 (90% rated 4 or 5), supporting utility beyond text-overlap metrics.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过两阶段渐进式知识蒸馏，将90亿参数的Gemma-2教师模型压缩为20亿参数学生模型，并结合混合检索，构建了可在离线移动端运行的孟加拉国成文法问答系统。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国法律信息对多数公民不可及：成文法仅为英文、律师集中于城市、依赖云端的AI在移动网络不稳处失效，且法律文本幻觉会造成直接危害。既有法律语言模型面向通用法律英语，缺乏针对孟加拉国成文法的专用系统。
AI.method: 两阶段渐进式知识蒸馏：第一阶段在9,429条质量筛选后的法律问答对（由14,514条生成查询中65%通过）上做有监督微调；第二阶段在温度τ=4.0下最小化对教师模型每token前50个logits的稀疏KL散度，采用QLoRA（4-bit NF4、rank-32 LoRA适配器）。所有回答经混合检索接地，融合稠密语义检索（60%）与BM25（40%），覆盖孟加拉国宪法与国家立法的36,029个成文法段落。系统仅处理成文法解释，不涉及判例推理。
AI.result: 在50条英文查询基准上，蒸馏模型ROUGE-L 0.4715、BERTScore F1 0.5679，较检索增强的未蒸馏基线（ROUGE-L 0.2323、BERTScore 0.2340）分别提升103%和143%。适配器量化至1.6 GB（GGUF Q4_K_M），在Pixel 6上无网络环境达4-8 tokens/秒。50条孟加拉语查询的跨语言评测中，ROUGE-L 0.4083、BERTScore 0.8133，表明在英文语料上可由孟加拉语输入有效检索。单一评估者试点的50条回答经执业律师加权平均评为4.16/5（90%为4或5分）。
AI.conclusion: 该系统通过蒸馏与混合检索，在离线移动端实现了针对孟加拉国成文法的可用法律问答，跨语言检索有效，并获执业律师的实用性评价，显示出超越文本重叠指标的实用价值。

title: StenoVLA-3D: 3D-Aware Reasoning VLA for Navigation Through Gastrointestinal Stenoses
summary: Autonomous endoscopic navigation requires the policy model to predict actions from texture-poor monocular observations, make safe control decisions, and retain evidence of lesions after they leave the field of view. Existing vision-language-action (VLA) models primarily rely on visual appearance and short-term context, limiting geometric grounding and episode-level reporting. We introduce StenoVLA-3D, a 3D-aware VLA framework for navigating through stenotic regions. We integrate point-maps into the Cosmos-Reason 2 backbone through learned geometry-gated fusion, and also propose a temporal state branch to model traversal progress. Our reasoning-and-action backbone predicts grounded reasoning with actions, while dedicated heads estimate stenosis shape and generate the final lesion report. We further introduce EndoCausal, an episode-level dataset with lesion annotations, actions, and temporally grounded reasoning. On 40 held-out recorded test episodes, StenoVLA-3D reaches 95.2\% semantic accuracy and 83.4\% action accuracy. On the physical 3-DoF endoscope, it attains 88.9\% and 77.8\% task success in esophageal and colonic phantoms (36 trials each), substantially outperforming the evaluated baselines.

AI.tldr: StenoVLA-3D：一种3D感知的VLA框架，用于狭窄区域内窥镜自主导航，融合点图与几何门控、引入时序状态分支，实现推理-动作联合预测、狭窄形态估计与病灶报告生成。
AI.motivation: 自主内窥镜导航需从弱纹理单目观测预测动作、做出安全控制决策，并在病灶离开视野后保留证据。现有VLA模型主要依赖视觉外观与短期上下文，几何接地能力不足，缺乏回合级（episode-level）报告能力。
AI.method: 以Cosmos-Reason 2为骨干，通过可学习的几何门控融合（geometry-gated fusion）引入点图（point-maps）；提出时序状态分支建模穿越进度；推理-动作骨干同时预测带接地的推理与动作，专用头分别估计狭窄形态并生成最终病灶报告；并构建回合级数据集EndoCausal，含病灶标注、动作与时间接地推理。
AI.result: 在40个留存的录制测试回合上，语义准确率95.2%、动作准确率83.4%；在物理3自由度内窥镜的食管与结肠体模上（各36次试验）任务成功率分别为88.9%与77.8%，显著优于所评估的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 将3D几何信息与时序状态建模融入VLA框架，可有效提升狭窄区域导航的几何接地、控制安全性与病灶留存报告能力，并在离线与物理平台验证其优越性。

title: Benchmarking Off-the-Shelf Multimodal AI Models Against Dermatologists on Patient-Captured Skin Images
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) has advanced at a rapid pace in recent years. Initially, breakthroughs in large language models caught widespread attention. However, recent generations of frontier AI models have adopted multimodal capabilities as a first class citizen, with vision capabilities being central to that. In this paper, we evaluate three recently released models on the task of diagnosing dermatological conditions from patient-submitted images. The models chosen are at the low to mid tier in terms of pricing and thus represent a floor on current AI capabilities, not a ceiling. We evaluate AI performance relative to a panel of three certified dermatologists, who grade each image, and we present four interesting findings. Firstly, depending on the metric, the tested AI models are either on par or slightly trail humans in terms of inter-clinician agreement. Secondly, we find that asking AI models for a confidence rating produces poorly calibrated answers, meaning use of confidence thresholds should not be relied upon in a clinical setting. Thirdly, the effect of providing additional patient metadata is strongly model-specific, with one of the three models degrading on every metric considered. Finally, model cost is not predictive of performance. The best-performing model we tested costs on average $0.0045 per case.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了三个低至中价位的前沿多模态AI模型在皮肤科诊断任务上的表现，并与三位认证皮肤科医生小组对比，得出四项主要发现。
AI.motivation: 随着前沿AI模型将多模态能力（尤其是视觉能力）作为核心，AI在医学影像诊断中的应用潜力受到关注；作者希望了解当前AI在皮肤科诊断上的实际能力下限（而非上限），并探究其在临床场景中的可靠性问题。
AI.method: 选取三个近期发布、定价处于低至中档的多模态AI模型，让它们基于患者提交的图像进行皮肤科病症诊断；同时由三位认证皮肤科医生对每张图像进行评分，作为人类基准进行对比评估；此外还测试了AI模型的置信度评分以及额外患者元数据对诊断表现的影响。
AI.result: 四项发现：1）在医生间一致性指标上，测试的AI模型与人类持平或略逊；2）AI模型给出的置信度评分校准较差，临床中不应依赖置信度阈值；3）额外患者元数据的影响具有强烈的模型特异性，其中一个模型在所有指标上均出现性能下降；4）模型成本与性能不相关，表现最好的模型平均每例仅花费约0.0045美元。
AI.conclusion: 当前低至中价位的多模态AI模型在皮肤科诊断上已接近但尚未超越人类医生的一致性水平，且存在置信度校准差、元数据影响不稳定等问题；成本并非性能的可靠预测指标，临床使用需谨慎。

title: Lightweight Pedestrian Head-Orientation Recognition Network for Safe Pedestrian-Vehicle Interaction
summary: Pedestrian head orientation recognition plays an important role in autonomous driving by providing valuable cues for understanding pedestrian attention and anticipating potential crossing behavior. However, reliable recognition in real-world traffic scenes remains challenging because pedestrian head regions are often captured at low resolution. To address this challenge, we propose a lightweight Low-Resolution Head Orientation Convolutional Neural Network (LRHO-CNN) for pedestrian head orientation recognition. We construct a new dataset by extracting pedestrian head images from multiple public datasets and manually annotating them into eight orientation categories. The collected images are systematically preprocessed and augmented to increase data diversity and better represent variations in illumination and image quality. The experimental analysis compares LRHO-CNN with three fine-tuned baseline models, namely ResNet-18, ResNet-34, and VGG-16. The results demonstrate that LRHO-CNN achieves the highest classification accuracy among the evaluated models. LRHO-CNN is further evaluated on the JAAD and PIE datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness in recognizing pedestrian head orientation in real-world traffic scenes and providing informative head-orientation cues that can support downstream pedestrian behavior and intention prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级低分辨率行人头部朝向识别网络LRHO-CNN，自建八类朝向数据集，并在JAAD、PIE上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 行人头部朝向可反映注意力并预判过街行为，对自动驾驶有价值；但真实交通场景中头部区域常为低分辨率，可靠识别仍具挑战。
AI.method: 从多个公开数据集中抽取行人头部图像，人工标注为八个朝向类别，并进行系统的预处理与数据增强以提升多样性；设计轻量级卷积神经网络LRHO-CNN，并与微调后的ResNet-18、ResNet-34、VGG-16进行对比。
AI.result: LRHO-CNN在所评估模型中取得最高分类准确率；在JAAD和PIE数据集上进一步验证其在真实交通场景中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: LRHO-CNN能够有效识别真实交通场景下的行人头部朝向，为下游行人与意图预测提供有价值的朝向线索。

title: When Residualization Helps an Audit: Format Effects, Slice Gains, and Their Limits
summary: Evaluation scores used around LLM systems -- including reward models, rerankers, and LLM judges -- can track surface form instead of the quality they claim to measure. When presented with a terse correct solution and a commented buggy solution for the same MBPP problem, a public preference reward model selects the correct one no better than a coin flip (0.507). Subtracting the predictable surface component from such scores is increasingly common, but removal alone does not yield a more valid measurement: the removed component may carry construct-relevant signal, and residualization cannot tell which is which. Under designed interventions -- unit-test labels with comment-only edits -- residualization attenuates the reward model's format effects by about 0.12 on both correct and buggy code, while the correct-versus-buggy margins move by less than 0.01. In observational NLI and QA settings, we freeze a held-out replication before scoring and re-evaluate it using labels from disjoint annotators; this supports only a narrower conclusion: better agreement with the construct labels on a pre-declared slice where a surface-only predictor errs, not a repaired score. Full-population agreement falls in every observational setting with a reported positive slice gain, and within-question ranking falls in every such QA setting. When construct and surface features are entangled, residualization can decorrelate a score while degrading construct alignment, and, in a controlled model, configurations just as damaging to construct alignment pass every pre-adjustment check, so no committed gate is a guarantee. We assemble these distinctions into a reporting protocol whose outcomes, refusal included, state what an adjusted score may be claimed to show: an audit-time diagnostic reported beside the construct-alignment cost it incurs, never a replacement for the raw score.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑“从LLM评估分数中减去表面形式分量即可获得更有效测量”的普遍做法，指出残差化会同时剥离构念相关信息，既不能保证构念对齐，也不能作为原始分数的替代，最终提出一套审计时诊断报告协议。
AI.motivation: 奖励模型、重排器与LLM评判器等评估分数常追踪表面形式（如冗长度、格式）而非其声称的质量。业界普遍采用残差化（减去可预测的表面分量）来"净化"分数，但作者认为这一做法缺少合法性论证：被移除的分量可能本身携带构念相关信息，而残差化无法区分二者。
AI.method: 1）构造MBPP干预实验：同一问题的简洁正确解与带注释有缺陷解对比，并采用仅改注释、单元测试标签不变的设计性干预，量化残差化对格式效应与正确/错误边际的影响。2）观察性NLI与QA设置：预先冻结留出复制集，使用来自不相交标注者的标签重新评估，考察残差化后与构念标签的一致性。3）受控模型分析：寻找在构念对齐上同样有害的配置，检验其能否通过既有的事前检查。
AI.result: 公开偏好奖励模型在简洁正确解与带注释缺陷解之间的选择准确率仅0.507，接近抛硬币；残差化使格式效应约衰减0.12，但正确-错误边际变化不足0.01。观察性设置中仅支持较弱结论：在预声明切片（表面预测器出错处）上构念标签一致性提升，但全总体一致性在所有场景均下降，QA场景中问题内排序亦全面下降。受控模型中，与残差化同等损害构念对齐的配置可通过所有事前检查。
AI.conclusion: 残差化在构念与表面特征纠缠时，可能使分数去相关的同时损害构念对齐，且无任何事前门控能提供保证。应将其定位为审计时与构念对齐代价并列报告的诊断指标，而非原始分数的替代品；所提报告协议要求即使结论为"拒绝"，也须明确说明调整后的分数可被宣称何种内容。

title: LoopCD: Loop-wise Contrastive Decoding for Improving Reasoning in Looped Language Models
summary: Looped Language Models (LoopLMs) perform "latent reasoning" by recursively refining internal latent representations with shared weights, offering a more effective alternative to explicit verbal reasoning. Despite their effectiveness, we find that LoopLMs remain prone to loop instability: unstable refinement across iterations can produce localized uncertain "hard" tokens associated with reasoning errors. To address this, we propose LoopCD, loop-wise contrastive decoding that enhances the reasoning performance of LoopLMs by intervening on these tokens at inference time. Specifically, we exploit the internal dynamics of LoopLMs and contrast the logits from earlier iterations with logits from the last refined iteration to form the final sampling distribution. We find that this strategy is highly efficient, introducing only negligible inference overhead and requiring no additional training, while effectively improving reasoning performance by naturally refining reasoning-critical hard tokens. Extensive experiments show that our method improves the performance of recent representative LoopLMs across various reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出LoopCD（逐循环对比解码），通过在推理时对比早期迭代与最终迭代的logits来修正LoopLM中的不确定"硬"token，无需训练即可提升推理性能。
AI.motivation: Looped Language Models（LoopLMs）通过共享权重递归精炼隐表示进行"潜在推理"，优于显式语言推理，但存在循环不稳定问题：迭代过程中不稳定的精炼会产生与推理错误相关的局部不确定"硬"token，影响推理效果。
AI.method: 提出LoopCD（loop-wise contrastive decoding）逐循环对比解码方法。利用LoopLM的内部动态，在推理阶段对早期迭代的logits与最后精炼迭代的logits进行对比，构造最终采样分布，从而干预这些"硬"token，且无需额外训练。
AI.result: 该方法效率高，推理开销几乎可忽略，无需额外训练，通过自然精炼推理关键"硬"token有效提升推理性能。大量实验表明，方法在多种推理任务上提升了近期代表性LoopLMs的表现。
AI.conclusion: LoopCD是一种高效、免训练的推理时干预方法，通过逐循环对比解码缓解LoopLM的循环不稳定性，提升推理能力，并在多任务多模型上得到验证。

title: SKstars at SHROOM: Visions Agreement-Guided Ensembling of Zero-Shot and LoRA-Adapted Vision--Language Models
comment: This paper has been accepted at the SHROOM-Visions 2026 Shared Task, co-located with EMNLP2026
summary: This paper describes the SKstars submission to SHROOM-Visions 2026, a shared task on fine-grained hallucination detection in large vision-language model outputs. The task requires systems to identify hallucinated character spans, assign hallucination categories, and provide confidence estimates for their predictions. Our approach combines zero-shot predictions from Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct with those of a LoRA-adapted Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct model. The outputs of the two models are integrated through a lightweight ensemble procedure, followed by span refinement and confidence adjustment. We evaluate the main system components on a small internal development subset and report the performance of the submitted system on the official English test set. SKstars achieved a Cor+Lbl score of 0.2902, ranking 15th among 29 teams, and obtained Cor and IoU scores of 0.3642 and 0.3151, respectively, ranking 18th on both metrics. The results show that combining a large zero-shot model with a smaller adapted model provides a practical framework for multilingual and fine-grained hallucination localization, while also highlighting the difficulty of transferring development-set improvements to hidden test data. Code and predictions: https://github.com/aliathar1401/SK-Stars-shroom-visions-2026

AI.tldr: SKstars团队参加SHROOM-Visions 2026细粒度幻觉检测共享任务，采用Qwen2.5-VL-72B零样本与LoRA微调的Qwen2.5-VL-7B集成方案，在官方英文测试集上取得Cor+Lbl 0.2902（29队中第15名）。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型输出存在细粒度幻觉，需要系统识别幻觉字符片段、判定幻觉类别并给出置信度；同时探索大模型零样本能力与小模型微调能力的互补性。
AI.method: 将Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct的零样本预测与LoRA适配的Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct预测通过轻量级集成流程融合，随后进行span refinement和置信度调整；在小规模内部开发子集上评估各系统组件。
AI.result: 在官方英文测试集上，Cor+Lbl得分0.2902，29支队伍中排名第15；Cor得分0.3642、IoU得分0.3151，两项均排名第18。
AI.conclusion: 大零样本模型与小规模适配模型相结合，为多语言、细粒度幻觉定位提供了实用框架；同时揭示了开发集性能提升难以迁移到隐藏测试集的困难。

title: Vimarsha: Faithful ASR Evaluation for Indian Languages with Demographic Diversity, In-the-Wild Audio and Spelling Variations
summary: Evaluation benchmarks for Indian language automatic speech recognition (ASR) suffer from two systematic biases: optimistic scores from clean, controlled audio conditions, and pessimistic scores from overly rigid transcription standards that penalize valid linguistic variations. We introduce Vimarsha, a 100-hour benchmark spanning all 22 scheduled Indian languages, designed to address both distortions. Vimarsha combines demographically diverse on-field recordings with carefully mined in-the-wild audio selected for acoustic difficulty, alongside a lattice of variations framework that encodes multiple valid transcriptions per utterance. Evaluations of 10 state-of-the-art ASR models reveal substantial shifts in model rankings under realistic conditions, geographic and demographic performance disparities, and systematic failure modes across speaking rates and acoustic environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Vimarsha——一个覆盖印度全部22种官方语言、共100小时的ASR评测基准，通过"还原真实场景"和"容忍语言变体"两条路径，同时修正现有基准的乐观偏差与悲观偏差。
AI.motivation: 印度语言ASR评测存在两类系统性偏差：一是使用干净、受控音频导致分数虚高（乐观偏差）；二是转录标准过于僵化，把合法语言变体判为错误，导致分数偏低（悲观偏差）。二者共同扭曲了模型能力的真实判断。
AI.method: 构建 Vimarsha 基准：规模100小时，覆盖22种印度官方语言。音频来源包括人口统计特征多样的实地录制（on-field recordings）与按声学难度筛选的真实场景（in-the-wild）音频；标注上引入"变体格（lattice of variations）"框架，为每条语音编码多个合法转写。对10个SOTA ASR模型进行评测。
AI.result: 评测显示：在真实条件下模型排名发生显著变化；存在地理与人口统计维度上的性能差异；在语速和声学环境方面表现出系统性失效模式。
AI.conclusion: 真实、变体感知的评测基准能更准确地刻画印度语言ASR能力，揭示被现有基准掩盖的排名波动、公平性差距与失效模式，为后续鲁棒建模与公平评测提供依据。

title: SAFe: Segment-guided Aggregation of Feature Densities for Anomaly-aware Segmentation
summary: Visual segmentation systems encounter objects outside their training distribution during real-world deployment, hindering reliable autonomous systems that depend on scene parsing in the perception stage. Many recent methods address this by using self-supervised foundation models to train density estimators that yield low likelihood in anomalous image regions. Although promising, these methods suffer from poor feature semantics or they lack spatial consistency, both of which undermine critical downstream decisions. We address this problem with~\method, a generative method based on class-conditional density estimation over self-supervised representations. SAFe trains lightweight normalizing flows that produce class-conditional normalized likelihood estimates over frozen DINOv3 features. We combine density estimates from transformer features with density scores over multi-scale convolutional features to capture both global semantics and local detail. We introduce a method-agnostic post-processing step based on SAM3 that connects per-location likelihoods into spatially coherent segments while suppressing false positives, and enables instance-level anomaly detection without retraining. The post processing further distinguishes novel categories among anomalous objects by a similarity-based agglomerative clustering scheme. SAFe sets a new state of the art on the PANIC, OoDIS, SMIYC ObstacleTrack with strong performance on the ISSU benchmark.

AI.tldr: 提出SAFe，一种基于自监督表示做类别条件密度估计的生成式方法，用于视觉分割中的分布外/异常检测，并在多个基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 真实部署中视觉分割系统会遇到训练分布之外的对象，威胁依赖场景解析的自主系统可靠性。现有基于自监督基础模型的密度估计方法存在特征语义弱或缺乏空间一致性问题，损害下游决策。
AI.method: SAFe在冻结的DINOv3特征上训练轻量级归一化流，进行类别条件归一化似然估计；结合transformer特征的密度估计与多尺度卷积特征的密度分数，兼顾全局语义与局部细节；引入基于SAM3的与模型无关后处理，将逐位置似然连接为空间连贯分割并抑制假阳性，支持免重训练的实例级异常检测；后处理还用基于相似度的凝聚聚类区分异常对象中的新类别。
AI.result: 在PANIC、OoDIS、SMIYC ObstacleTrack上刷新SOTA，并在ISSU基准上表现强劲。
AI.conclusion: 通过类别条件密度估计结合多尺度特征与SAM3后处理，SAFe有效提升了异常分割的语义性与空间一致性，实现当前最优性能。

title: CoaG: Cylinders on a Grid for Coarse 3D Layout Control in Video Generation
summary: We ask how little geometry a person has to draw to control both where people stand and where the camera moves in a generated video. Our answer is a ground plane and one cylinder per person. A user draws a grid on the ground, places one cylinder where each person should stand, moves the cylinders and the camera over 81 frames, and the model renders a photoreal video in which the people occupy the cylinders' positions, move as the cylinders move, and are seen from the drawn camera. Appearance comes from a text prompt and a background reference image; layout and motion come from the geometry. Because no dataset pairs such a signal with video, we build the pairs ourselves: an automatic engine writes 2000 captions from a combinatorial seed, generates a clip for each with a text-to-video model, and lifts every clip back to its geometry with person tracking, background inpainting, an agentic ground-mask loop, feed-forward multi-view reconstruction and a plane fit, with no real footage and no manual labels. A LoRA on Wan2.2-Fun-Control trained on 1935 such tuples follows drawn layouts and camera paths on hold-out clips: the generated people match the cylinders' count, order, position and height, the text changes who they are, the reference image changes where they are, and dolly-in, orbit, pan and crane paths are followed, dolly-out only weakly.

AI.tldr: Just a ground grid plus one cylinder per person suffices to control both layout and camera in a generated video: a LoRA trained on 1935 auto-constructed geometry-video pairs renders the people at the cylinders and follows the drawn camera paths.
AI.motivation: The paper explores the minimal geometric signal a user must supply to jointly control where people stand and how the camera moves in a generated video, aiming to reduce authoring effort and to provide an explicit, editable control interface.
AI.method: The control interface is a ground-plane grid and one cylinder per person; users move cylinders and camera over 81 frames. Since no dataset pairs such signals with video, an automatic engine builds 2000 caption-clip pairs from a combinatorial seed via a text-to-video model, then lifts each clip back to geometry using person tracking, background inpainting, an agentic ground-mask loop, feed-forward multi-view reconstruction, and a plane fit—no real footage or manual labels. A LoRA is trained on Wan2.2-Fun-Control over 1935 tuples.
AI.result: On hold-out clips, generated people match the cylinders' count, order, position, and height; the text prompt controls identity and the reference image controls their location; dolly-in, orbit, pan, and crane camera paths are followed well, while dolly-out is only weakly followed.
AI.conclusion: Minimal geometry—a ground plane and one cylinder per person—is sufficient to control both human layout and camera motion, and geometry-video supervision can be generated automatically without real footage or manual labels.

title: ChartJudgeBench: Evaluating LMM Judges for Chart-to-Code Generation
summary: Building strong chart-to-code systems increasingly relies on reinforcement learning, whose effectiveness depends critically on the quality of the reward signal. Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) play a natural critical role in jointly assessing chart visual appearance and task requirements. They are therefore increasingly used as visual critics and reward models, yet their reliability as judges remains largely unexplored. To this end, we introduce ChartJudgeBench, a diagnostic vision-language benchmark for assessing LMM judges in chart-to-code workflows. It includes 1,003 Chart Perception Alignment (CPA) instances for pairwise chart comparison and 650 Chart Reasoning Judgment (CRJ) instances for binary Accept/Reject verification in Chart Reproduction and Chart Editing. Together, these tasks emulate the core judging decisions required in agentic refinement and RL-based chart optimization. Our evaluation of strong LMMs reveals four systematic limitations: (i) positional bias in pairwise comparison, (ii) a strong tendency to overpredict Accept, (iii) difficulty in matching visual styles and aesthetics, and (iv) an unexpected leniency bias in RL-trained models. These findings show that current LMM judges require explicit reliability validation before being used as critics or reward models in chart-to-code optimization. The code and data are available on ChartJudgeBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ChartJudgeBench，一个用于评估图表到代码任务中 LMM 评判器可靠性的诊断性视觉语言基准，包含 1,003 个成对比较实例（CPA）和 650 个二元验证实例（CRJ），揭示现有强 LMM 评判器存在四类系统性缺陷。
AI.motivation: 图表到代码系统日益依赖强化学习，而 RL 效果关键取决于奖励信号质量。LMM 因能联合评估图表视觉外观与任务需求，被广泛用作视觉批评器和奖励模型，但其作为评判者的可靠性尚未被系统探究。
AI.method: 构建 ChartJudgeBench 诊断性视觉语言基准，包含两类任务：1,003 个 Chart Perception Alignment（CPA）成对图表比较实例，以及 650 个 Chart Reasoning Judgment（CRJ）二元 Accept/Reject 验证实例，覆盖 Chart Reproduction 与 Chart Editing 场景，模拟智能体迭代优化与 RL 图表优化中的核心判断决策，并对多个强 LMM 进行评估。
AI.result: 评估强 LMM 揭示四类系统性局限：(i) 成对比较中的位置偏差；(ii) 强烈的过度预测 Accept 倾向；(iii) 难以匹配视觉风格与美学；(iv) RL 训练模型存在意外的宽厚偏差（leniency bias）。
AI.conclusion: 当前 LMM 评判器在图表到代码优化中被用作批评器或奖励模型前，必须经过显式的可靠性验证。代码与数据已在 ChartJudgeBench 公开。

title: Beyond Emotion Prompts: Fine-Grained Text-to-Image Generation Driven by Valence-Arousal-Dominance
summary: Although text-to-image models can accurately depict subjects and scenes, creators still struggle to specify the fine-grained emotions an image should convey without rewriting its content description. Natural language can suggest emotions, but it offers no control scale with stable meanings and ordered intensities. We propose EMOTRANS, which transforms psychologically grounded valence-arousal-dominance (VAD) coordinates into generation conditions that are independent of the content text and modulated across denoising stages, making emotional style a finely adjustable creative variable. To support this goal, we construct EMOVAD, an art-painting dataset that pairs objective content descriptions with separately collected emotional ratings from multiple annotators. We also coordinate emotional expression and content preservation through dual-branch training with a shared model. Objective and human evaluations show that the framework improves the accuracy of three-dimensional emotion control and produces perceptible, orderable continuous changes while maintaining competitive text alignment and image quality. This work provides a practical emotion-driven approach to image generation that extends objective content depiction to fine-grained emotional adjustment.

AI.tldr: 提出 EMOTRANS 框架，将心理学 VAD 坐标转化为与内容文本解耦、按去噪阶段调制的生成条件，实现细粒度情感可控的图像生成；并构建 EMOVAD 艺术画数据集，配合双分支训练兼顾情感表达与内容保持。
AI.motivation: 现有文生图模型能准确刻画主体与场景，但创作者若想指定图像传达的细微情感，往往不得不重写内容描述。自然语言虽可暗示情感，却缺乏含义稳定、强度可排序的控制尺度，因此需要一种与内容解耦、可连续可调的情感控制变量。
AI.method: 1) 采用心理学基础的效价-唤醒-支配（VAD）三维坐标作为情感表示；2) 提出 EMOTRANS，将 VAD 坐标转化为独立于内容文本的生成条件，并在不同去噪阶段进行调制；3) 构建 EMOVAD 艺术画数据集，将客观内容描述与多位标注者单独采集的情感评分配对；4) 使用共享模型的双分支训练，协调情感表达与内容保持。
AI.result: 客观指标与人工评估显示，该框架提升了三维情感控制的准确性，产生可感知且强度可排序的连续变化，同时保持具有竞争力的文本对齐度与图像质量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了实用的情感驱动图像生成方法，将图像生成从客观内容描绘扩展到细粒度情感调节，使情感风格成为可精细调节的创作变量。

title: From Articles to Publishers: Aggregating Language Model Predictions for News Source Reliability Inference
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Computational Social Systems (TCSS)
summary: Traditionally, the reliability of news publishers is assessed by expert organisations that evaluate editorial practices, transparency and factual standards at source. When this process is translated into a computational approach, the problem is often formulated at the level of individual articles, with models being trained on a set of pre-labelled articles and their performance being evaluated in a test phase. In this work, we investigate news source reliability inference as a source-level prediction problem. We propose a two-stage framework in which transformer-based language models first estimate the reliability of individual articles and subsequently aggregate article-level predictions to infer the reliability of previously unseen publishers. To approximate realistic deployment conditions, we enforce a strict publisher-disjoint evaluation protocol, ensuring that no publisher appears in both training and test sets. Experiments on 19,476 political news articles from 439 English-language publishers labeled with NewsGuard reliability ratings show that aggregation substantially improves robustness and performance, increasing accuracy from approximately 0.60 at the article level to 0.69 at the publisher level. Finally, we analyze how prediction errors vary across political orientations, revealing statistically significant associations between political leaning and misclassification patterns. Overall, our findings show that publisher reliability can be inferred from aggregated textual signals alone, supporting scalable and content-based approaches to automated news source assessment.

AI.tldr: 该研究将新闻来源可靠性评估建模为“来源级预测”问题，提出两阶段Transformer框架：先预测单篇文章可靠性，再聚合到出版者层面；在严格“出版者不重叠”评估下，聚合将准确率从约0.60提升至0.69，并发现误分类与政治倾向存在显著关联。
AI.motivation: 传统新闻可靠性评估依赖专家机构，从编辑规范、透明度与事实标准等来源层面进行评判；而现有计算化方法多降维为文章级分类任务，忽略来源级目标，且常采用随机划分评估，难以反映真实部署中面对全新出版者的情形。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段用基于Transformer的语言模型估计单篇文章可靠性；第二阶段将文章级预测聚合，推断未见出版者的可靠性。为实现接近真实部署的评估，采用严格的出版者不相交（publisher-disjoint）协议，确保训练集与测试集无同一出版者。数据为439家英文出版者的19,476篇政治新闻，标注使用NewsGuard可靠性评级。
AI.result: 聚合显著提升稳健性与性能：文章级准确率约0.60，出版者级提升至0.69。误差分析显示，政治倾向与误分类模式之间存在统计显著关联。
AI.conclusion: 出版者可靠性可仅由聚合后的文本信号推断，支持可扩展、基于内容的自动化新闻来源评估方法，为来源级可靠性推断提供了更贴近部署条件的评估范式。

title: Document Retrieval-Aware Chunking (D-RAC): Universal Retrieval-Aware Ingestion of Enterprise Documents via PDF Normalization and Multimodal Markdown Conversion
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems over enterprise knowledge bases must ingest heterogeneous document formats -- PDFs, Word documents, presentations, and scans -- whose content is locked inside complex visual layouts, multi-column pages, and dense tables. Rule-based extraction and OCR destroy reading order, flatten tables, and lose heading hierarchy, while fully agentic chunking over extracted text incurs high token costs and hallucination risk. We present Document Retrieval-Aware Chunking (D-RAC), an extension of our Web Retrieval-Aware Chunking (W-RAC) framework to arbitrary document formats. D-RAC first normalizes any input document into PDF, exploiting the fact that virtually every format has a faithful, deterministic PDF rendering. A single multimodal LLM pass then converts rendered pages into retrieval-optimized Markdown -- rewriting tables as self-contained prose statements and preserving heading hierarchy -- after which chunking proceeds exactly as in W-RAC: deterministic parsing into ID-addressable units followed by lightweight LLM-based chunk planning over identifiers rather than text. Source text is never regenerated during chunking, preserving W-RAC's cost, determinism, and observability benefits while unlocking every renderable format as a first-class input. On the 236-document, 795-page PDF subset of the RAG-Multi-Corpus benchmark spanning five enterprise domains, D-RAC converts and chunks the entire corpus in 72 minutes with zero errors, producing 1,748 retrieval-ready chunks. Compared to agentic chunking with frontier LLMs, D-RAC reduces chunking-stage output tokens by 95.7%, cutting chunking cost by 77.8% (GPT-4.1 pricing) to 85.6% (Gemini 2.5 Pro pricing) and chunking time by 75%. D-RAC scales linearly to documents of 500+ pages.

AI.tldr: D-RAC通过将任意文档统一渲染为PDF，并用单次多模态LLM将页面转成检索优化的Markdown，再以确定性解析+基于ID的轻量LLM分块规划，实现在多格式企业文档上的低成本、高确定性分块。
AI.motivation: 企业知识库RAG需处理PDF、Word、演示文稿、扫描件等异构格式，内容锁在复杂版式、多栏页面和密集表格中。规则抽取和OCR破坏阅读顺序、压平表格、丢失标题层级；而基于抽取文本的全智能体分块token成本高且有幻觉风险。
AI.method: D-RAC是W-RAC框架向任意文档格式的扩展：先将任意输入文档确定性渲染归一化为PDF；再用单次多模态LLM将渲染页面转为检索优化Markdown（表格改写为自包含叙述语句、保留标题层级）；随后分块流程与W-RAC一致——先确定性解析为可ID寻址单元，再对标识符而非文本进行轻量LLM分块规划，分块过程中不重新生成源文本。
AI.result: 在RAG-Multi-Corpus基准的236文档、795页PDF子集（覆盖五个企业领域）上，D-RAC以72分钟、零错误转换并分块整个语料，产出1,748个检索就绪chunk。相比前沿LLM的智能体分块，分块阶段输出token减少95.7%，成本降低77.8%（GPT-4.1定价）至85.6%（Gemini 2.5 Pro定价），分块时间减少75%，并可线性扩展至500页以上文档。
AI.conclusion: 通过PDF归一化+单次多模态LLM转Markdown+基于ID的分块规划，D-RAC在保留W-RAC成本、确定性和可观测性优势的同时，将所有可渲染格式变为一等输入，显著降低分块成本与时间并具备良好的可扩展性。

title: DiaSeg: Diagonal Segment Extraction from DTW Paths for Interpretable Gait Analysis
comment: Accepted for publication in Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery (Springer), September 2026. 28 pages, 4 figures
summary: Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) is the dominant approach for measuring similarity between time series, yet standard practice discards the optimal warping path after computing a single distance value, losing local alignment information most relevant to clinical diagnosis. We introduce DiaSeg, a framework that extracts diagonal segments from DTW paths with controlled breaks, characterizing each segment by five geometric features (effective length, interruption count, cost variation, temporal position, and path context), and enabling unsupervised pattern discovery without domain-specific feature engineering. Validated on 91 subjects across six clinical conditions (healthy aging, Parkinson's, Huntington's, ALS, brain tumor, and stroke), three findings emerge. First, diagonal segments form consistent unsupervised patterns (silhouette 0.33) aligned with biomechanical phase annotations, with label-based validation confirming near-perfect separation of healthy and pathological gait (ARI up to 0.986). Second, segments discriminate pathology at 69% (supervised) and 75% (patient-level clustering), with pathology manifesting through distributional shifts in segment length; combining segment and cycle-level features further improves classification to 91.7%. Third, while cycle-based methods achieve higher accuracy (91%), diagonal segments provide phase-specific interpretability unavailable in global representations, localizing where coordination breaks down within the gait cycle. DiaSeg thus transforms DTW from a black-box distance into a source of interpretable temporal features for neurodegenerative disease assessment.

AI.tldr: DiaSeg 从 DTW 最优对齐路径中提取"对角段"这一可解释的时序特征，在 91 名受试者、六种临床状态的步态数据上实现无监督模式发现与病理判别，兼顾精度与相位级可解释性。
AI.motivation: DTW 是时间序列相似度的主流方法，但计算完距离后通常丢弃最优扭曲路径，导致与临床诊断最相关的局部对齐信息被浪费；全局距离值缺乏相位级、可解释的时间定位能力。
AI.method: 提出 DiaSeg 框架：在受控中断条件下从 DTW 路径中抽取对角段，用五个几何特征刻画每段——有效长度、中断次数、代价变化、时间位置、路径上下文；无需领域特征工程即可进行无监督模式发现。在 91 名受试者、六种临床状态（健康衰老、帕金森、亨廷顿、ALS、脑肿瘤、卒中）上验证。
AI.result: (1) 对角段形成一致的无监督模式（silhouette 0.33），与生物力学相位标注吻合，基于标签的验证对健康与病理步态近乎完美分离（ARI 最高 0.986）；(2) 段级特征判别病理达 69%（监督）、75%（患者级聚类），病理表现为段长的分布性漂移，结合段级与周期级特征后分类提升至 91.7%；(3) 周期级方法精度更高（91%），但对角段提供全局表示所不具备的相位特异性可解释性，可定位步态周期内协调性崩溃发生的位置。
AI.conclusion: DiaSeg 将 DTW 从黑箱距离度量转化为可解释时序特征的来源，为神经退行性疾病评估提供兼顾判别性能与相位级可解释性的新途径。

title: SRPR-Net: Semantic and Relational Prompt Refinement for Automated SAM-based Instance Segmentation
summary: Instance segmentation is a fundamental computer vision task with diverse real-world applications. Recently, prompt-driven foundation models have shown promising generalization. However, automated prompting remains limited by insufficient semantic guidance and inter-instance modeling. To address this challenge, we propose a novel architecture, named Semantic Relational Prompt Refinement Network (SRPR-Net), for automated SAM-based instance segmentation. A sequential prompt refinement mechanism is introduced to enrich detector geometry with visual-language semantics and then incorporate same-image instance dependencies, enabling context-aware box adjustment before SAM segmentation. Experiments on multiple standard benchmarks demonstrate that SRPR-Net achieves consistent improvements in segmentation performance over existing state-of-the-art approaches. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/JeremyXSC/SRPR-Net.

AI.tldr: 提出SRPR-Net，通过序贯提示细化机制，将视觉-语言语义与同图实例依赖注入检测器几何，实现自动化的SAM实例分割。
AI.motivation: 提示驱动的基础模型（如SAM）泛化能力好，但自动提示存在语义引导不足与实例间建模缺失的问题，导致自动分割性能受限。
AI.method: 设计序贯提示细化机制：先用视觉-语言语义丰富检测器生成的几何提示，再引入同图实例依赖关系，从而在SAM分割前进行上下文感知的框调整。
AI.result: 在多个标准基准上，SRPR-Net的分割性能相较现有最先进方法取得一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: 语义与实例关系引导的提示细化能有效提升自动化SAM实例分割性能，代码已开源。

title: IMPLICIT-Bench: Measuring Implicit Bias in Text-to-Image Models under Neutral Prompts
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) models are typically evaluated for bias using slot-based templates such as ``a photo of a [profession]''. Such templates probe only \emph{explicit} demographic attributes (e.g., gender, skin tone) in isolation. They overlook a broader \emph{implicit} bias that arises in natural prompts: when stereotype-relevant attributes are left unspecified, models still default to stereotypical outputs. We introduce IMPLICIT-Bench, a benchmark for measuring implicit bias in T2I models under such prompts. The key design is a structured-knowledge-graph (KG) construction of controlled prompt triplets: neutral, stereotype, and anti-stereotype variants that differ only along a single bias dimension while preserving scene semantics. This enables precise attribution of bias effects that template benchmarks cannot achieve. IMPLICIT-Bench comprises 5,493 prompts across 11 bias categories, validated through multi-model agreement, CLIP-based verification, and human evaluation. Using this benchmark, we show that state-of-the-art T2I models exhibit systematic bias under neutral prompts, a failure mode largely invisible to existing evaluations. We then use IMPLICIT-Bench to evaluate debiasing methods, uncovering a fundamental trade-off between bias reduction and semantic fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出 IMPLICIT-Bench，基于知识图谱构建受控提示三元组，系统评测 T2I 模型在自然提示下未被明示刻板属性时的隐式偏见，并揭示去偏方法与语义保真度之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有 T2I 偏见评测多用「a photo of a [profession]」式槽位模板，只孤立地探测显式人口统计属性（如性别、肤色），无法捕捉自然提示中更广泛的隐式偏见——当刻板印象相关属性未被指明时，模型仍会默认输出刻板结果。
AI.method: 构建 IMPLICIT-Bench：以结构化知识图谱（KG）方式构造受控提示三元组——中性、刻板、反刻板变体，仅在单一偏见维度上不同而保持场景语义一致，从而可精确归因偏见效应。数据集含 11 类偏见、5,493 条提示，并通过多模型一致性、基于 CLIP 的验证及人工评估进行校验。随后用该基准评测去偏方法。
AI.result: 当前最先进 T2I 模型在中性提示下表现出系统性偏见，这一失效模式在现有评测中基本不可见；用该基准评测去偏方法时，发现偏见降低与语义保真度之间存在根本性权衡。
AI.conclusion: IMPLICIT-Bench 提供了可精确归因的隐式偏见评测手段，暴露了以往评测遗漏的系统性偏见问题，并揭示去偏中的偏见-保真度权衡，为后续 T2I 公平性研究提供基准与分析框架。

title: Memory vs. Context? Influential Factors of Factual Recall in Language Models
comment: Accepted to the BlackboxNLP 2026 Reproducibility Challenge (Special Track), EMNLP 2026
summary: We reproduce and stress-test the work of Yu et al. (2023), who characterize how language models (LMs) arbitrate between memorized knowledge and contradictory in-context statements. We replicate their world-capitals experiments on 31 models spanning Pythia, GPT-2, Qwen3, and Ministral families, including base and post-trained variants, and extend evaluations to five additional knowledge relation types from the ParaConflict dataset. We empirically confirm most of their original findings: larger models and higher-frequency entities tend to favor memorized answers, with substantial family-level variance. However, several conclusions do not generalize cleanly: entity-frequency effects disappear on Qwen3-14B and 32B; post-training shifts the memory-context trade-off inconsistently across families; question phrasing alone can change a model's reliance on memorized knowledge by up to 80 percentage points; and semantically unrelated prose can mimic coherent supporting context. Our results clarify where Yu et al.'s claims hold and to what extent they generalize to other prompts.

AI.tldr: 本文复现并压力测试Yu et al. (2023)关于语言模型如何权衡记忆知识与上下文矛盾陈述的研究，在31个模型（Pythia、GPT-2、Qwen3、Ministral）上验证世界首都实验并扩展至ParaConflict的5类知识关系。大部分原始结论被证实（大模型与高频实体倾向记忆答案），但若干结论不具普适性：实体频率效应在Qwen3-14B/32B上消失，后训练的影响跨族不一致，问题措辞可致记忆依赖变化达80个百分点，语义无关文本亦可模拟连贯支持上下文。
AI.motivation: Yu et al. (2023)刻画了语言模型在记忆知识与上下文矛盾信息之间的仲裁机制，但其结论的稳健性与泛化能力尚未得到充分检验。本文旨在通过多模型、多知识关系的复现与压力测试，厘清这些主张在何种条件下成立、在何种程度上可推广至其他提示。
AI.method: 在31个模型（涵盖Pythia、GPT-2、Qwen3、Ministral家族，包含基座与后训练变体）上复现世界首都实验，并将评估扩展至ParaConflict数据集的5种额外知识关系类型；通过改变问题措辞、引入语义无关文本等方式进行压力测试，考察实体频率、模型规模、后训练等因素对记忆—上下文权衡的影响。
AI.result: 证实了原始研究的大部分发现：模型规模越大、实体频率越高，越倾向于选择记忆答案，且存在显著的家族层面差异。但多项结论不能干净泛化：实体频率效应在Qwen3-14B与32B上消失；后训练对记忆—上下文权衡的位移在不同家族间不一致；仅问题措辞变化即可使模型对记忆知识的依赖度改变最多80个百分点；语义无关的散文也能模拟出连贯的支持性上下文。
AI.conclusion: Yu et al.的核心主张在特定条件下成立，但其泛化性受模型家族、规模、后训练方式及提示措辞的显著制约；记忆与上下文仲裁并非单一稳定机制，需在更广的提示与模型条件下审慎解读相关结论。

title: Look Where It Counts: A Free, Label-Free Visual Evidence Signal for Fine-Grained Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) fail at fine-grained visual questions less because they cannot reason than because they never see the evidence: high-resolution images are downsampled before encoding, so the model answers from linguistic priors. The standard remedies are expensive: annotated answers (SFT), hand-engineered verifiers (RLVR), or a large external teacher (on-policy distillation). We ask whether the visual evidence itself can supply the signal for free. We formalize the contrastive evidence gap, the per-token log-likelihood ratio that a model assigns to its own output when conditioned on a question-relevant region versus an irrelevant one, and study it across Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Qwen3-VL-8B, and Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B on V*Bench. Our main positive result is training-free: selecting the candidate crop under which the model's answer distribution is most peaked, using a single-view, label-free criterion, discovers the answer-bearing region with no bounding boxes, training, or labels. It localizes the target 4.4 to 5.1 times better than chance and raises fine-grained accuracy from 70 percent to 85 percent at inference. We further show that the gap is complementary to the model's own confidence. Combining them predicts correctness better than either alone, with AUC up to 0.99, and flags confidently wrong answers, with AUC ranging from 0.97 to 1.00 within the high-confidence subset. All effects concentrate on perception-bottleneck questions and vanish on a global-context control. Finally, we report an honest negative result: converting the same signal into a training method, gated self-distillation (SEG-Distill), does not outperform the base model at pilot scale across three gate designs, while more aggressive gating degrades accuracy. The signal is real, but converting it into training gains remains an open problem.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"对比证据差"(contrastive evidence gap)这一无需标注的信号：模型在问题相关区域与无关区域条件下输出token的对数似然比。基于该信号的无训练裁剪选择方法可将细粒度视觉问答准确率从70%提升至85%，定位能力是随机猜测的4.4–5.1倍；但将其转化为训练方法(SEG-Distill)未能超越基线。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在细粒度视觉问答上的失败主因并非推理能力不足，而是高分辨率图像在编码前被下采样，导致模型"看不到证据"而依赖语言先验作答。现有补救手段代价高昂：SFT需人工标注答案，RLVR需手工设计验证器，在线策略蒸馏需大型外部教师模型。作者试图探究：视觉证据本身能否免费提供训练/推理信号。
AI.method: 形式化定义"对比证据差"——模型在给定问题相关区域与无关区域条件下，对其自身输出所赋予的每token对数似然比；在Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B、Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B三个模型与V*Bench上开展研究。推理阶段采用无训练、无标签、单视图准则：选择使模型答案分布最尖锐(最peaked)的候选裁剪。进一步分析该信号与模型自身置信度的互补性，并尝试将其转化为训练方法SEG-Distill(带门控的自蒸馏)。
AI.result: 无训练裁剪选择方法在无边界框、无训练、无标签条件下定位目标区域的能力是随机猜测的4.4–5.1倍，将细粒度准确率从70%提升至85%。该信号与模型置信度互补，联合预测正确性优于任一单独指标，AUC最高达0.99；在高置信子集内识别"自信但错误"答案的AUC为0.97–1.00。所有效应集中于感知瓶颈类问题，在全局上下文对照上消失。负面结果：SEG-Distill在三种门控设计下于试点规模均未超越基线，更激进的门控反而降低准确率。
AI.conclusion: 视觉证据本身可免费提供真实有效的推理期信号，用于区域定位、准确率提升与错误检测；但该信号能否转化为训练收益仍是一个未解决的问题。

title: Taramandal-GPT: Enhancing Astrodynamics Problem-Solving with Knowledge Retrieval and Structured Thinking
comment: Proceedings of All India Hindi Technical Conference, 05-06 February 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable progress in natural language understanding, yet their effectiveness in specialized fields like astronomy and astrodynamics remains limited due to challenges in multi-step reasoning, symbolic manipulation, and domain-specific terminology. To address this, we present Taramandal-GPT (Constellation-GPT), a domain-adapted framework built on the Qwen3-8b backbone, enhanced with a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline and a fallback mechanism for improved contextual precision. We evaluate it on the Astrodynamics Problems Benchmark (APBench), a dataset of 299 questions covering foundational to advanced levels of space science. Using a dual evaluation method - numeric margin-based scoring and semantic similarity assessment - Taramandal-GPT achieves competitive performance against state-of-the-art open- and closed-source models, with notable strength in thinking-intensive tasks. These results highlight the value of specialized LLMs for domains demanding accuracy and interpretability, positioning Taramandal-GPT as a step toward reliable Artificial Intelligence (AI) assistants for astrophysics, spacecraft engineering, and space exploration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Taramandal-GPT，一个基于Qwen3-8b、融合RAG与回退机制的天体动力学领域适配框架，并在299题的APBench基准上通过数值评分与语义相似度双重评估，取得与先进开源及闭源模型相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在自然语言理解上进展显著，但在天文学与天体动力学等专业领域仍受限于多步推理、符号运算及领域术语等挑战，效果有限。
AI.method: 以Qwen3-8b为骨干构建领域适配框架Taramandal-GPT，增强检索增强生成（RAG）流水线与回退机制以提升上下文精度；并构建Astrodynamics Problems Benchmark（APBench），含299道覆盖基础到高级空间科学的问题，采用数值容差评分与语义相似度评估的双重评价方法。
AI.result: Taramandal-GPT在APBench上与先进开源和闭源模型相比具有竞争力，在思考密集型任务上表现尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了专用LLM在需要准确性与可解释性的领域中的价值，将Taramandal-GPT定位为面向天体物理、航天器工程与空间探索的可靠AI助手的探索性一步。

title: Reinforcement Learning Inspired Black-box Adversarial Attacks for Computer Vision
summary: Neural networks, both convolution or transformer based, are essential for modern computer vision systems. However, they are vulnerable to small perturbations, almost imperceptible to humans, which significantly alter the model's prediction. These adversarial attacks are often considered to be a significant threat to the implementation of neural networks in safety-critical applications. Most attacks utilize the white-box threat model and therefore require full access to the target model, making them unrealistic to use in practice. We propose a novel approach under the more realistic black-box threat model that utilizes concepts from reinforcement learning to optimize perturbations with a non-differentiable target model. Reinforcement learning algorithms have already been optimized to be query efficient, making them an ideal starting point when designing black-box adversarial attacks. We show the success of our reinforcement learning inspired black-box adversarial attack (RIBA) in generating adversarial perturbations using only a small number of queries to the target model, by comparing it to state of the art attacks on different models on the Cifar10 and ImageNet data sets. RIBA takes $25.4\%$ fewer median queries to generate attacked images against a ResNet-18 on Cifar10 and $22.5\%$ fewer median queries to fool a Vit-B/16 model on ImageNet. Additionally, we demonstrate that RIBA can match the performance of white-box attacks on an adversarially trained model.

AI.tldr: 提出RIBA，一种基于强化学习的黑盒对抗攻击方法，用少量查询即可生成有效扰动，性能优于现有攻击。
AI.motivation: 神经网络（卷积与Transformer）对微小、人类几乎不可察觉的扰动脆弱，这种对抗攻击对安全关键应用构成威胁。但多数攻击采用白盒威胁模型，需要完全访问目标模型，实际中不现实，因此需要更现实的黑盒攻击方案。
AI.method: 在更现实的黑盒威胁模型下，利用强化学习概念，针对不可微的目标模型优化扰动。由于强化学习算法已被优化得查询高效，适合用作黑盒对抗攻击的起点。
AI.result: 在Cifar10和ImageNet上对不同模型与最先进攻击比较：对Cifar10的ResNet-18生成攻击图像所需中位查询数减少25.4%；对ImageNet的ViT-B/16模型减少22.5%。此外，RIBA在对抗训练模型上可媲美白盒攻击的性能。
AI.conclusion: RIBA证明了强化学习用于黑盒对抗攻击的有效性：以更少查询达到更高攻击效率，并在对抗训练模型上达到白盒级别的攻击效果。

title: OpenFlyScan: A Quality-Guided Aerial Reconstruction System for Consumer Drones
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides high-fidelity scenes for large-scale embodied simulation, but constructing large-scale urban assets remains constrained by expensive equipment and delayed quality feedback. Preset surveys can leave complex surfaces insufficiently observed, with defects discovered only after reconstruction, requiring return visits and repeated processing. We present OpenFlyScan, a quality-guided aerial reconstruction system for consumer drones that integrates a GS quality model, a reacquisition planner, and a custom-designed mobile app. The model learns from GS rendering errors to predict regional reconstruction quality. Based on these predictions, the planner then generates complementary reacquisition strips to be executed through the app, which also supports automated oblique surveys and data transfer without additional hardware on board. Across real aerial scenes, the model effectively identifies regions that are likely to be poorly reconstructed. In the Expo West field experiment, targeted reacquisition improves PSNR at additional views by 10.95 dB. With consumer drones, OpenFlyScan integrates capture, targeted reacquisition, and reconstruction to support rapid, low-cost urban asset creation. Code and models will be made publicly available at https://openflyscan.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OpenFlyScan，一套面向消费级无人机的质量引导航拍重建系统，集成了 GS 质量模型、重采集规划器和移动端 App，实现"采集—定向补采—重建"闭环，显著提升城市场景重建质量。
AI.motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting 虽能为大规模具身仿真提供高保真场景，但构建大规模城市资产受限于昂贵设备与滞后的质量反馈：预设航线常导致复杂表面观测不足，缺陷只能在重建后才发现，从而需要返工重访与重复处理。
AI.method: 系统由三部分组成：(1) 基于 GS 渲染误差学习区域重建质量预测的质量模型；(2) 依据预测结果生成互补重采集航带（reacquisition strips）的规划器；(3) 自研移动端 App，通过它执行补采航线，并支持自动化倾斜摄影与数据传输，无需机载额外硬件。
AI.result: 在真实航拍场景中，质量模型能有效识别可能重建不佳的区域；在 Expo West 实地实验中，定向补采使额外视角的 PSNR 提升 10.95 dB。
AI.conclusion: OpenFlyScan 借助消费级无人机把采集、定向重采集与重建整合为统一流程，支持快速、低成本的城市资产创建；代码与模型将公开于 https://openflyscan.github.io/。

title: Canonical Procedural Actions: An Auditable Annotation Protocol for Tool-Use Agent Traces
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Includes ancillary files for reproducing the reported analyses
summary: Tool-use agent traces identify messages and API calls, but procedural analyses also need explicit units of action and inspectable links to their evidence. We present Canonical Procedural Actions (CPAs), an annotation protocol that records a procedural function, its first agent-event anchor, the agent events that realize it, and separate contextual evidence. Multiple actions may share a message anchor without an inferred within-message order. A retail case study produces a versioned 24-entry codebook through open induction, recorded consolidation, and successive application audits. Two isolated LLM contexts annotate 32 trajectories disjoint from development at the trajectory level, producing 499 and 491 occurrences with anchor-label overlap A=0.982. Requiring identical context-event references reduces overlap to 0.798. These are structural repeatability measures, not semantic accuracy: 16 of 26 task IDs also occur in development, and historical tool payloads were truncated to 110 characters. Retrospective controls show that collapsing all labels raises overlap to 0.986, while simple endpoint rules reproduce the tool-anchored portion with 0.997 overlap. Assistant-message actions have 0.971 overlap, with a per-label minimum of 0.816. Applying the frozen codebook to 244 further trajectories yields 4,058 records, including eight diagnostic outcomes. The contribution is an explicit, auditable annotation instrument and a case study of its construction and measurement limits; human-reference validity and downstream utility remain to be established.

AI.tldr: 提出"规范程序动作"(CPAs)标注协议，用于在工具使用型智能体轨迹中标注可审计的程序动作单元及其证据链接，并通过零售场景案例研究验证其结构可重复性。
AI.motivation: 工具使用智能体的轨迹虽能记录消息与API调用，但程序性分析缺乏显式的动作单元及可检验的证据链接，因此需要一个明确的、可审计的标注工具。
AI.method: CPAs协议记录：程序功能、首个智能体事件锚点、实现该功能的事件集合，以及独立的上下文证据；允许多动作共享消息锚点而不推断消息内部顺序。通过开放式归纳、记录式合并和逐次应用审计，构建版本化的24条目的代码簿。由两个隔离的LLM上下文对32条与开发集在轨迹层面不相交的轨迹进行标注，并设置回顾性对照（标签坍缩、简单端点规则）。最后将冻结的代码簿应用于另外244条轨迹。
AI.result: 两标注者分别产出499和491个出现，锚点-标签重叠A=0.982；要求上下文事件引用完全一致时重叠降至0.798。回顾性对照中，全部标签坍缩使重叠升至0.986，简单端点规则对工具锚定部分的重现重叠为0.997；助手消息动作重叠0.971，单标签最低0.816。冻结代码簿应用于244条轨迹共产生4,058条记录，含8种诊断结果。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于一个显式、可审计的标注工具及其构建与测量局限的案例研究；这些指标为结构可重复性而非语义准确性，人类参照效度与下游效用仍待验证。

title: Unsupervised Brain Anomaly Detection as a Bayesian Inverse Problem with Diffusion Prior
summary: Unsupervised anomaly detection (UAD) aims to localize abnormal regions in medical scans without pixel-level annotations. A typical strategy seeks to reconstruct a pseudo-healthy image that preserves subject-specific anatomy. Recently, diffusion models have been proposed to perform UAD. However, these methods rely on heuristic noise schedules or synthetic corruptions to balance subject-specificity and anomaly removal. In this work, we propose an alternative formulation of UAD as a Bayesian inverse problem under a diffusion prior. First, we introduce a latent spatial anomaly mask that models pixel-wise consistency between a test image and its latent corresponding pseudo-healthy image. Then, we propose an approximation of the unknown generation process that links healthy anatomy, anomalies, and the observed image, enabling a well-defined likelihood within the Bayesian framework. Building on recent advances in diffusion-based inverse problem methods, we jointly infer the pseudo-healthy image and the anomaly mask via annealed posterior sampling. We evaluate our approach on FDG PET (ADNI) and FLAIR MRI (BraTS 2021), demonstrating improved anomaly localization performance compared to other diffusion-based approaches and validating the contribution of our introduced model. Our code is available at https://github.com/HuguesRoy/UAD_DAPS.

AI.tldr: 该论文将无监督异常检测（UAD）重新表述为扩散先验下的贝叶斯逆问题，通过引入潜空间异常掩码并联合推断伪健康图像与异常掩码，提升了医学影像异常定位性能。
AI.motivation: UAD旨在无像素级标注下定位医学扫描中的异常区域，常规做法是重建保留受试者个体解剖结构的伪健康图像。近期基于扩散模型的方法虽被提出用于UAD，但依赖启发式噪声调度或合成扰动来平衡"受试者特异性"与"异常去除"，缺乏原则性，因此作者寻求一种更严谨的替代建模范式。
AI.method: 提出将UAD建模为扩散先验下的贝叶斯逆问题。首先引入潜空间异常掩码，刻画测试图像与其潜对应伪健康图像之间的逐像素一致性；随后提出对未知生成过程的近似，将健康解剖、异常与观测图像联系起来，从而在贝叶斯框架内定义良置似然；最后借鉴扩散逆问题求解的最新进展，通过退火后验采样联合推断伪健康图像与异常掩码。
AI.result: 在FDG PET（ADNI）与FLAIR MRI（BraTS 2021）数据集上评估，异常定位性能优于其他基于扩散的方法，并验证了所引入模型的贡献。代码开源。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为UAD提供了原则性的贝叶斯逆问题建模范式，避免了对启发式噪声调度与合成扰动的依赖，在两类医学影像模态上取得更优的异常定位表现，验证了潜空间异常掩码与联合后验推断的有效性。

title: Structure Before Sampling: Community-Aware Core-Set Selection for Data-Efficient Text-to-Speech
summary: Text-to-speech (TTS) corpora are costly to record, yet many utterances add little new phonetic information. Core-set selection reduces this cost by choosing a small training subset under a fixed audio-duration budget. We represent a corpus as a phonotactic graph that links each utterance to its most phonemically similar ones, and we first test whether this graph has structure. In Bangla and English corpora, its clustering is 199 and 56 times that of a size-matched random graph, and its modularity is more than twice that of a degree-preserving random graph. We then propose Community Representative, a selector that samples across graph communities and spreads its choices within each one, starting from utterances rich in rare phonemes. At every budget and in both languages, it covers more rare phoneme bigrams than random and entropy-based selection, and this lead holds on held-out utterances. TTS models trained on its 20% core-sets have a significantly lower character error rate (CER) than models trained on equal-duration random or entropy-based subsets in both languages. When all models train for the same number of epochs, the Bangla core-set model also outperforms full-corpus training (3.93% vs. 4.47% CER) with 4.5x less training time.

AI.tldr: 该论文将语音语料表示为音位组合图，验证其具有显著社区结构，并提出 Community Representative 选择器，在固定时长预算下采样核心集；在孟加拉语和英语上，其20%核心集训练的TTS模型CER显著更低，孟加拉语下甚至优于全语料训练且训练时间减少4.5倍。
AI.motivation: TTS语料录制成本高昂，但许多话语几乎不提供新的语音信息，因此需要在固定音频时长预算下进行核心集选择以降低成本。现有随机或基于熵的选择方法未能充分利用语料的音位结构。
AI.method: 将语料建模为音位组合图，每个话语连接到音位上最相似的话语，并检验其结构（聚类系数、模块度对比随机图）；提出 Community Representative 选择器：跨图社区采样，并在各社区内部扩散选择，优先从含稀有音素的话语开始。
AI.result: 在孟加拉语和英语语料中，图的聚类系数分别为规模匹配随机图的199倍和56倍，模块度超过度保持随机图的两倍。在所有预算和两种语言下，该方法覆盖的稀有音素二元组多于随机和熵基选择，且在留出话语上保持优势。其20%核心集训练的TTS模型CER显著低于等时长随机或熵基子集；相同epoch数下，孟加拉语核心集模型甚至优于全语料训练（3.93% vs. 4.47% CER），训练时间减少4.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 音位组合图具有强社区结构，可用于指导核心集选择；Community Representative 在音素覆盖和TTS性能上均优于随机与熵基方法，并能在部分场景下以更少数据与时间超越全语料训练。

title: Hierarchical Prompt Learning for Hyperbolic Vision-Language Models
summary: Hyperbolic vision-language models (VLMs) represent image and text features in a geometry naturally suited to hierarchy, but their adaptation to downstream tasks has largely relied on fixed prompts. Existing prompt learning methods, meanwhile, treat class labels as a flat set and do not exploit available taxonomic structure. We address this gap with a hierarchical prompt learning plug-in for frozen hyperbolic VLMs. Given a fixed offline parent-class hierarchy, it augments a class prompt learner with a separate parent prompt learner, parent-level supervision, hyperbolic entailment regularization, and parent-feedback logit fusion. We instantiate the method with CoOp, CoCoOp and MaPLe, yielding HyPLO, CoHyPLO and MaHyPLO. Across the standard 11-dataset benchmark, all variants improve base-to-new generalization and cross-dataset transfer, and remain comparable to their prompt learning baselines under domain shift. Six hierarchical metrics and embedding analyses show that the method produces more taxonomically consistent predictions and induces a hierarchy-consistent organization of parent, class, and image embeddings in hyperbolic space. Its gains are largest when novel classes must be placed within a fixed taxonomy, and smallest for fine-grained confusions among sibling classes or shifts affecting only the image distribution.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用于冻结双曲视觉-语言模型的分层提示学习插件，在类提示学习器上增加父类提示学习器、父级监督、双曲蕴含正则与父反馈logit融合，实例化为HyPLO/CoHyPLO/MaHyPLO，在11数据集基准上提升基类到新类泛化与跨数据集迁移。
AI.motivation: 双曲视觉-语言模型天然适合表示层次结构，但其下游适配主要依赖固定提示；现有提示学习方法将类别标签视为扁平集合，未利用可用的分类学结构。该工作旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 在冻结的双曲VLM上构建分层提示学习插件。给定固定的离线父类层次，为类提示学习器附加独立的父类提示学习器，并引入父级监督、双曲蕴含正则化以及父反馈logit融合。方法以CoOp、CoCoOp、MaPLe为骨干实例化，得到HyPLO、CoHyPLO和MaHyPLO。
AI.result: 在标准11数据集基准上，所有变体均提升基类到新类的泛化能力与跨数据集迁移性能，在域偏移下与提示学习基线相当。六项层次化指标与嵌入分析表明，方法产生更具分类学一致性的预测，并在双曲空间中诱导父类、类与图像嵌入形成层次一致的组织。增益在新类必须置入固定分类学体系时最大，在同级类别的细粒度混淆或仅影响图像分布的偏移时最小。
AI.conclusion: 将离线父类层次结构通过父类提示学习、父级监督、双曲蕴含正则与logit融合注入提示学习，可在不微调双曲VLM的前提下提升泛化与迁移，并使双曲嵌入呈现层次一致性；其收益取决于任务是否依赖固定分类学约束。

title: Classifier-Free Guidance in Flow Matching: Non-Autonomous Potentials, Overshoot, and Posterior-Mean Control
summary: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) improves conditional generation in Flow Matching, but strong guidance can distort the generated distribution and reduce diversity. We provide a geometric account of this behavior by viewing Flow Matching as a time-varying gradient flow and characterizing how CFG reshapes its underlying potential. This view explains how stronger alignment can be accompanied by mean displacement and trajectory concentration, and motivates controlling guidance through the model-implied terminal posterior mean. We therefore propose Posterior-Mean-Capped CFG (PMC-CFG), a training-free, per-sample method that adaptively retains the strongest feasible guidance without additional network evaluations. Experiments on synthetic and large-scale image-generation benchmarks show that PMC-CFG limits guidance-induced distortion and concentration while improving the alignment--diversity trade-off, with particularly strong benefits when nominal guidance is large.

AI.tldr: 该论文从几何视角解释Flow Matching中CFG的失真机制，提出免训练的自适应引导方法PMC-CFG，改善对齐-多样性权衡。
AI.motivation: Classifier-free guidance (CFG)虽提升Flow Matching的条件生成质量，但过强引导会扭曲生成分布并降低多样性，需理解其机理并加以控制。
AI.method: 将Flow Matching视为时变梯度流，刻画CFG如何重塑其潜在势函数，揭示均值位移与轨迹集中现象；据此提出Posterior-Mean-Capped CFG (PMC-CFG)，一种免训练、逐样本、无需额外网络评估的自适应引导上限策略，通过模型隐含的终端后验均值控制引导强度。
AI.result: 在合成数据与大规模图像生成基准上，PMC-CFG限制了引导导致的分布扭曲与集中，改善了对齐-多样性权衡，尤其在高名义引导强度下收益显著。
AI.conclusion: 通过几何分析揭示CFG失真本质，PMC-CFG以极低计算成本实现自适应引导控制，有效缓解失真并提升生成质量与多样性的平衡。

title: SupportCal: Label-Free Calibration of Post-Trained LLMs via Reference Support and Corroboration
summary: Post-training often improves task performance but can degrade confidence calibration, leaving post-trained language models (PoLMs) more overconfident than their corresponding pretrained language models (PLMs). Because task-specific labeled calibration data can be costly or unavailable, the corresponding PLM provides a natural label-free reference for post-hoc calibration. Prior agreement-gated PLM-referenced calibration fits a scalar temperature using only examples on which the PoLM and its PLM reference agree, excluding disagreement examples because direct alignment can drive the fitted temperature excessively high and induce under-confidence. We revisit this binary treatment. A controlled reintroduction diagnostic reveals a non monotonic aggregate effect: admitting a moderate fraction of disagreement examples can improve calibration, whereas the benefit diminishes as unit weight inclusion approaches the full disagreement set. We introduce SupportCal, a label-free post-hoc method that retains agreement examples at unit weight and assigns disagreement examples continuous weights based on the own-base PLM's relative support and corroboration from pretrained references selected from a size-compatible candidate pool. We further characterize when the resulting weighted objective admits a finite optimal temperature. Across MedMCQA and MathQA, SupportCal yields lower mean ECE than the agreement-only baseline for nearly all evaluated target-model configurations; supplementary TweetEval Sentiment results show the same pattern on a fixed-label classification task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出无标签后验校准方法 SupportCal：以同源 PLM 为参照，对 PoLM 与 PLM 一致样本赋单位权重、对分歧样本按 PLM 支持度与辅助预训练参照给连续权重，并刻画加权目标存在有限最优温度的条件；在 MedMCQA、MathQA 与 TweetEval Sentiment 上取得比仅用一致样本更低的平均 ECE。
AI.motivation: 后训练虽提升任务性能，却常使 PoLMs 比对应 PLMs 更过度自信，破坏置信度校准。任务标注校准数据昂贵或不可得，而同源 PLM 可作为天然的无标签参照。既有的一致性门控校准只使用 PoLM 与 PLM 一致的样本拟合标量温度，排除分歧样本，因为直接对齐会使拟合温度过高、导致欠自信；作者重新审视这一二元处理。
AI.method: 通过受控重新引入分歧样本的诊断实验，观察分歧样本比例对校准的聚合效应。据此提出 SupportCal：保留一致样本的单位权重，对分歧样本赋予连续权重，权重由 own-base PLM 的相对支持度以及从尺寸兼容候选池中选出的预训练参照的佐证程度决定。同时刻画加权目标何时存在有限最优温度。
AI.result: 诊断实验显示非单调聚合效应：纳入中等比例分歧样本可改善校准，而当单位权重纳入接近全部分歧集时收益递减。在 MedMCQA 与 MathQA 上，SupportCal 在几乎所有评估的目标模型配置下平均 ECE 均低于仅用一致样本的基线；TweetEval Sentiment 的补充结果在固定标签分类任务上呈现相同模式。
AI.conclusion: 对分歧样本的二元排除过于粗糙，适度且有差别地纳入分歧样本有益于校准；SupportCal 提供了一种无需标签、基于权重细化的后验校准方案，并在多任务上稳定优于仅一致样本基线。

title: Scale-Vector Alignment: A Scale-Aware Framework for Spatially Resolved Morphological Similarity in Astronomical Images
comment: 13 pages, 10 figures. Submitted to ApJS. Comments welcome
summary: Astronomical maps made with different tracers are not expected to have identical morphology. Excitation, optical depth, chemistry, radiation, and ISM phase alter the response of a tracer, and the resulting differences can depend on both position and spatial scale. We propose scale-vector alignment, a scale-aware method based on Constrained Diffusion Decomposition (CDD). CDD decomposes an image into localized scale components; at each position, their amplitudes define a scale vector that describes how the measured intensity is distributed over spatial scale. We define the pixel-wise similarity $\Spix(x,y)$ as the normalized alignment of two local scale vectors. The normalization removes the overall amplitude, so $\Spix$ compares relative scale composition rather than absolute flux. We also define the scale-wise similarity $\Sscale(l)$ by comparing the two CDD component maps at each spatial scale. Spatial shifts are used to construct an empirical shifted reference distribution for $\Spix$. In Orion~A, the tracer with the highest similarity to the dust-derived column-density map changes from $^{12}$CO to $^{13}$CO to C$^{18}$O toward higher column density. In NGC~6334I(N), the line--continuum similarity decreases locally around the brightest compact structures, where radiative-transfer effects can alter the observed line morphology. In NGC~3627, CO is most similar to 21~$μ$m emission, and $\Sscale$ reaches its maximum at an intermediate sub-kpc scale. The method measures where two tracers have similar multiscale structure and at which scales their spatial distributions agree. The implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/meng-ke/Scale-Vector-Alignment.

AI.tldr: 提出尺度矢量对齐方法，基于受约束扩散分解实现尺度感知的天文示踪图像相似性比较。
AI.motivation: 不同示踪物绘制的天文图形态不同，激发、光学厚度、化学、辐射及ISM相态均会改变示踪响应，差异依赖位置和空间尺度，需要尺度感知的定量比较方法。
AI.method: 基于受约束扩散分解（CDD）将图像分解为局部尺度分量，构建位置相关的尺度矢量及像素级相似度Spix（归一化后比较相对尺度组成而非绝对流量），并定义尺度级相似度Sscale比较各尺度分量图；用空间位移构造Spix的经验参考分布。
AI.result: Orion A中与尘埃柱密度图最相似的示踪物随柱密度升高由12CO变为13CO再变为C18O；NGC 6334I(N)中谱线-连续谱相似度在最亮致密结构附近局部下降；NGC 3627中CO与21μm最相似，Sscale在中等亚kpc尺度达最大。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可度量两示踪物在何处具有相似多尺度结构及其空间分布一致的尺度，代码已公开。

title: HappyWorld-Bench
summary: Evaluating world models requires assessing both the quality of the worlds they generate and their consistency and responsiveness under exploration, interaction, and modification. We introduce HappyWorld-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates whether generated worlds remain reliable as agents interact with them. Our design is built on a hierarchical capability framework of six world capabilities (W1-W6), from generative construction to unified world modeling, instantiated across three independent evaluation tracks: video world models, spatial world models, and embodied world models. HappyWorld-Bench comprises 1,138 video prompts, 300 spatial scenes, and 254 embodied test cases. Across all three tracks, we build and operate HappyWorld-Arena to organize human A/B comparisons and derive model-level Elo ratings, which complement newly designed automated metrics that capture behavioral correctness. We evaluate 14 video world models, 9 spatial systems, and 8 embodied candidates under this unified framework. Results reveal remaining reliability gaps across all three tracks: video models exhibit reduced consistency during extended rollouts and revisits, spatial models achieve at best 70.14% placement accuracy and 73.33% edit execution, and embodied models struggle to preserve state across multi-step actions and respond precisely to altered action conditions and physical rules. These findings highlight the need to evaluate world models not only by visual quality, but also by state consistency and the correctness of their responses to actions and interventions.

AI.tldr: 提出 HappyWorld-Bench 基准，从生成、空间、具身三条评测线评估世界模型在交互中的可靠性与状态一致性，并配套 HappyWorld-Arena 人类 Elo 评测与自动化行为指标。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型评测多聚焦生成世界的视觉质量，缺乏对探索、交互与修改过程中世界是否保持可靠、一致与可响应的评估，因此需要一套统一的可靠性评测框架。
AI.method: 构建六项世界能力（W1–W6）的分层能力框架，覆盖从生成式构建到统一世界建模；在视频世界模型、空间世界模型、具身世界模型三条独立评测线上实例化。数据规模为 1,138 条视频提示、300 个空间场景、254 个具身测试用例；通过 HappyWorld-Arena 组织人类 A/B 对比并得出模型级 Elo 评分，同时设计刻画行为正确性的自动化指标。评测对象包括 14 个视频世界模型、9 个空间系统、8 个具身候选模型。
AI.result: 三条评测线均存在可靠性缺口：视频模型在长时 rollout 与重访时一致性下降；空间模型最优仅为 70.14% 放置准确率和 73.33% 编辑执行率；具身模型难以在多步动作中保持状态，且对动作条件与物理规则改变的精确响应不足。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型评测不应只看视觉质量，还需衡量状态一致性与对动作、干预响应的正确性；HappyWorld-Bench 为统一、可比的可靠性评测提供了框架与实证依据。

title: Morpho-VITS: Variational Inference with Morphological Modeling for End-to-End Speech Synthesis of a Tonal Bantu Language
summary: Text-to-speech models for Bantu tonal languages are challenged by a tonal system that is rooted in both the lexis (i.e., the inventory of words, stems, and affixes) and the grammar (i.e., morpho-syntax). To complicate matters, the standard writing systems of these languages often omit tone markings and syllable duration information, which must be disambiguated by the reader based on context. Motivated by linguistic descriptions of Bantu language tone systems, we propose an end-to-end text-to-speech model that augments the text encoding mechanism with a morpho-syntactic prior. We replace the standard phoneme encoder in the VITS architecture with a morpheme sequence encoder and a phoneme-to-morpheme attention network. We posit that, by using this explicit morphological modeling, we can capture the information required to produce the correct tone. Experiments conducted on the Kinyarwanda language, a tonal and morphologically complex Bantu language, reveal substantial TTS improvement from this morphological modeling. Specifically, the proposed method significantly improves the naturalness, intonation, and intelligibility of the produced synthetic voices.

AI.tldr: 本文针对班图语声调语言的TTS难题，提出在VITS架构中以语素序列编码器与音素-语素注意力网络替换标准音素编码器，引入形态句法先验；在基尼亚卢旺达语上实验证明该方法显著提升合成语音的自然度、语调与可懂度。
AI.motivation: 班图语声调系统同时根植于词汇层（词、词干、词缀的集合）与语法层（形态句法），且标准书写系统常省略声调标记与音节时长信息，需读者依据上下文消歧。这使得面向班图语声调语言的TTS建模尤为困难，需要额外的语言学信息来推断正确声调。
AI.method: 受班图语声调系统的语言学描述启发，提出一种端到端TTS模型，在文本编码环节引入形态句法先验。具体地，将VITS架构中的标准音素编码器替换为语素序列编码器，并加入音素到语素的注意力网络，以显式形态建模捕获生成正确声调所需的信息。
AI.result: 在基尼亚卢旺达语（一种声调且形态复杂的班图语）上的实验表明，形态建模带来了显著的TTS性能提升，所提方法明显改善了合成语音的自然度、语调和可懂度。
AI.conclusion: 显式形态建模可为班图语声调语言的TTS提供有效的形态句法先验，缓解书写系统缺失声调标注带来的歧义问题，是一种可行且有效的建模路径。

title: AnalogDepth: Multi-view Geometry from FPV drones under Analog Video Transmission
summary: Analog video transmission (VTX) remains widespread in FPV drones due to low latency, weight and low cost. However analog VTX suffers from complex spatially structured image degradation which differ fundamentally from digital image corruption (e.g. AWGN) used in standard training augmentation. This work shows that this type of noise severely degrades the accuracy of Depth Anything 3 (DA3), a state-of-the-art feed forward visual geometry foundation model.
