To address this gap, we present AnalogDepth, a parameter-efficient training pipeline that adapts DA3 to analog FPV imagery using student-teacher knowledge distillation with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) injected into the DINOv2 backbone. Rather than synthesizing noise analytically, we build a noise bank from static FPV recordings under diverse conditions and compare real-noise injection against PSD-matched Gaussian synthesis and AWGN as baselines. Experiments on six real FPV flight sequences across three indoor scenes show that training with our noise bank consistently reduces per-frame depth RMSE and 3D reconstruction Chamfer distance compared to the pretrained DA3 baseline and both Gaussian noise variants. These results demonstrate that replicating the spatial structure of real analog transmission noise is critical for effective adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出 AnalogDepth 训练流程，利用真实模拟视频噪声库与 LoRA 蒸馏将 DA3 适配至 FPV 模拟图，显著降低深度 RMSE 与重建 Chamfer 距离。
AI.motivation: 模拟视频传输（VTX）因低延迟、轻量、低成本在 FPV 无人机中广泛使用，但其图像退化具有复杂空间结构，与标准增强所用的高斯白噪声等数字失真本质不同。这类噪声严重削弱 SOTA 前馈几何基础模型 Depth Anything 3（DA3）的精度，且现有解析合成噪声无法还原其空间特性，存在明确适配缺口。
AI.method: 构建参数高效训练流程 AnalogDepth：采用学生-教师知识蒸馏，并在 DINOv2 主干中注入 Low-Rank Adaptation（LoRA）以适配 DA3。不作解析噪声合成，而是从多种条件下的静态 FPV 录制中构建真实噪声库，并设置 PSD 匹配高斯合成与 AWGN 作为对照。
AI.result: 在三个室内场景的六段真实 FPV 飞行序列上，使用噪声库训练相较预训练 DA3 基线及两种高斯噪声变体，一致降低逐帧深度 RMSE 与 3D 重建 Chamfer 距离。
AI.conclusion: 复现真实模拟传输噪声的空间结构对有效适配至关重要，真实噪声注入优于解析式高斯合成，为 FPV 模拟图像下的几何基础模型适配提供了可行且参数高效的方案。

title: NeuIDO: Neural Intrinsic Dynamics Operator for Physics-Informed 4D World Models
comment: Accepted by ECCV 2026; Project Page: https://github.com/JiajingLin/NeuIDO
summary: World models aim to capture environmental dynamics and predict future trajectories, showing growing potential for embodied intelligence. Physics-informed 4D generation integrates physical simulation to predict 3D object interactions, offering a promising pathway toward world models. However, this paradigm relies on manually imposed dynamical assumptions rather than internalizing world dynamics, and thus still leaves a gap toward a true world model. To bridge this gap, we propose NeuIDO, a novel world dynamics modeling framework that learns a unified intrinsic dynamics representation from visual observations, advancing physics-informed 4D generation toward a world model. Specifically, we formulate world modeling as a neural operator learning problem and introduce a two-stage training strategy to learn a generalizable mapping from the visual observation distribution to the intrinsic dynamics distribution. Building on this observation-dynamics mapping, NeuIDO enables zero-shot dynamics inference directly from videos and can be further aligned with complex real-world dynamics via few-shot adaptation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NeuIDO effectively unifies the intrinsic dynamics underlying diverse visual observations into a shared representation and rapidly infers dynamics in novel scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出NeuIDO，将世界建模转化为神经算子学习问题，通过两阶段训练从视觉观测中学习统一的内在动力学表征，实现零样本动力学推断与少样本适应。
AI.motivation: 现有物理信息4D生成依赖人工设定的动力学假设，而非内化世界动力学，与真正的世界模型仍有差距，需要一种能自主学习内在动力学表征的框架。
AI.method: 将世界建模形式化为神经算子学习问题，从视觉观测分布到内在动力学分布学习可泛化映射；采用两阶段训练策略，支持零样本动力学推断与少样本适应。
AI.result: 实验表明NeuIDO能将多样视觉观测背后的内在动力学统一为共享表征，并能快速在新场景中推断动力学。
AI.conclusion: NeuIDO推动物理信息4D生成向世界模型迈进，为通用、可迁移的世界动力学建模提供了新范式。

title: AlignMorph: Tuning-Free Diffusion Image Morphing via Explicit Semantic Transport
summary: Image morphing aims to produce a smooth and semantically consistent transition between two input images. Existing diffusion-based morphing methods either require expensive per-pair optimization or rely on implicit spatial alignment, which easily fails under large layout discrepancies. To address these limitations, we propose AlignMorph, a novel tuning-free diffusion framework guided by the principle of transport-then-denoise. We explicitly decouple geometric alignment from generative denoising to avoid structural entanglement. Our framework consists of two core components. (1) Global Semantic Transport, which achieves diffusion-compatible semantic alignment via entropic optimal transport and reliability-aware latent warping; and (2) Coordinate-Aligned Generation, which uses a symmetric bi-phase attention handoff to maintain consistent spatial coordinates throughout denoising. Without any tuning, AlignMorph effectively eliminates ghosting and achieves superior structural coherence and temporal smoothness on morphing benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/51xOne/Alignmorph.

AI.tldr: 提出免调优扩散框架 AlignMorph，通过"先传输后去噪"解耦几何对齐与生成去噪，实现大布局差异下的高质量图像形变。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的图像形变方法要么需要昂贵的逐对优化，要么依赖隐式空间对齐，在大布局差异下容易失败。
AI.method: AlignMorph 遵循 transport-then-denoise 原则，显式解耦几何对齐与生成去噪，包含两个核心组件：(1) 全局语义传输，通过熵正则最优传输与可靠性感知的隐空间形变实现扩散兼容的语义对齐；(2) 坐标对齐生成，使用对称双阶段注意力交接，在去噪全过程中保持空间坐标一致。
AI.result: 在形变基准上，无需任何调优即可有效消除重影，并获得更优的结构连贯性与时间平滑度。
AI.conclusion: AlignMorph 是一种免调优的扩散形变框架，通过解耦几何对齐与去噪过程，克服了逐对优化成本高及隐式对齐易失败的问题。

title: LiAuto-MindViT: A Hybrid Vision Backbone with Adaptive Bidirectional Mamba
summary: While Mamba-based models have shown strong potential for long sequence modeling, adapting them to vision is challenging due to the requirement of local neighborhood correlations and multi-directional spatial contexts for visual understanding. In this paper, we present LiAuto-MindViT, a novel hybrid vision backbone that synergizes the strengths of CNNs, Mamba, and Transformers. The core of our design is the Adaptive Bidirectional Mamba (ABM), which eliminates the directional bias of unidirectional SSMs through bidirectional selective scanning with learnable alpha blending, enabling content-adaptive directional fusion without the overhead of exhaustive multi-path routing. To further accelerate inference, we propose a deployment-friendly Reparameterized ConvSE (RepConvSE) module that leverages structural reparameterization to reduce latency and memory access overhead. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LiAuto-MindViT achieves state-of-the-art performance on image classification, object detection, and semantic segmentation while enabling efficient inference through reparameterization.

AI.tldr: 提出混合视觉骨干网络LiAuto-MindViT，融合CNN、Mamba与Transformer，通过自适应双向Mamba与重参数化RepConvSE模块，在分类、检测、分割任务上取得SOTA且推理高效。
AI.motivation: Mamba在长序列建模表现优异，但直接迁移到视觉任务存在困难：视觉理解需要局部邻域相关性以及多方向的空间上下文，而现有Mamba类模型（如单向SSM）存在方向偏置，难以满足这些需求，且多路径路由会带来额外开销。
AI.method:
1. 提出混合视觉骨干LiAuto-MindViT，协同CNN、Mamba与Transformer优势；
2. 核心模块Adaptive Bidirectional Mamba (ABM)：采用双向选择性扫描与可学习的alpha混合权重，消除单向SSM的方向偏置，实现内容自适应的方向融合，避免穷举式多路径路由的开销；
3. 提出面向部署的Reparameterized ConvSE (RepConvSE)，利用结构重参数化降低延迟与内存访问开销。
AI.result: 在图像分类、目标检测和语义分割任务上均达到最先进（SOTA）性能，同时通过重参数化实现高效推理。
AI.conclusion: LiAuto-MindViT验证了将CNN局部建模、Mamba长序列建模与Transformer全局建模相结合的有效性，ABM与RepConvSE分别解决方向偏置与推理效率问题，为高效视觉骨干设计提供了可行方案。

title: OmniFysics-Captioner Technical Report: Grounding Omni-Modal Understanding in the Physical World for Better Captioning
summary: Building omni-modal models with physical intelligence requires fine-grained supervision that captures physical evidence such as contact, support, deformation, and state transitions. However, existing omni-modal captioners primarily model general audiovisual semantics and often overlook transient or spatially localized physical evidence. We present a unified framework for physics-aware audiovisual captioning spanning data construction, training, and evaluation. Firstly, we build a data construction pipeline that identifies physics-rich clips and leverages OmniFysics-Agent to coordinate audio, visual, and physical-perception tools for collecting spatiotemporally aligned and traceable cross-modal evidence; within the Agent, a physical perception model (PPM) fine-tuned on approximately 2M image-level samples serves as a dedicated tool for extracting object-interaction and state-change cues. Secondly, we build the Daily-Physics 50K dataset and introduce the evidence-driven OmniPhysCap (OPC) benchmark to evaluate the recovery of physical and cross-modal evidence from generated captions. Finally, we train OmniFysics-Captioner from the resulting data. Our Captioner matches Gemini 3.1 Pro on audiovisual captioning, achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple video-captioning benchmarks, and substantially outperforms other open-source models. Ablations show that PPM evidence improves physical coverage and produces finer-grained, more reliable cross-modal descriptions.

AI.tldr: 提出统一的全模态物理感知音视频描述框架，涵盖数据构建、训练与评测，训练出OmniFysics-Captioner，性能匹配Gemini 3.1 Pro并达到多项基准SOTA。
AI.motivation: 构建具备物理智能的全模态模型需要捕获接触、支撑、形变、状态转换等物理证据的细粒度监督，但现有全模态描述模型主要建模通用音视频语义，常忽略瞬时或空间局部化的物理证据。
AI.method: 1）数据构建流水线：识别物理丰富片段，利用OmniFysics-Agent协调音频、视觉与物理感知工具，采集时空对齐且可追溯的跨模态证据；其中物理感知模型（PPM）在约200万图像级样本上微调，用于提取物体交互与状态变化线索。2）构建Daily-Physics 50K数据集与证据驱动的OmniPhysCap（OPC）基准，评测生成描述对物理与跨模态证据的还原能力。3）基于所得数据训练OmniFysics-Captioner。
AI.result: OmniFysics-Captioner在音视频描述上匹配Gemini 3.1 Pro，在多个视频描述基准上取得SOTA，显著优于其他开源模型。消融实验表明PPM证据提升了物理覆盖度，并产生更细粒度、更可靠的跨模态描述。
AI.conclusion: 物理证据驱动的数据构建与感知工具可有效提升全模态描述中的物理覆盖度与跨模态可靠性，为物理智能建模提供了数据、方法与评测闭环。

title: LIBERO-VPro: Benchmarking Closed-Loop Visual Robustness of Robotic Foundation Models
summary: Robotic foundation models achieve impressive performance on standard manipulation benchmarks, yet these evaluations typically assume clean, timely, and consistent visual observations throughout execution. We introduce LIBERO-VPro, a benchmark for systematically evaluating the closed-loop visual robustness of robotic foundation models by perturbing the visual evidence available during execution. LIBERO-VPro covers four complementary dimensions, including Visual Evidence Degradation, Camera Staleness, Visual Source Consistency, and Task-Relevant Scene Variation, spanning 12 challenge categories, 96 experimental settings, and 3,296 task-condition cases. We evaluate three vision-language-action models and three world-action models over approximately 196,000 simulated episodes, complemented by 200 real-world rollouts on a Franka Research 3. Our results reveal that strong nominal performance can mask substantial weaknesses in visual grounding and adaptation. Models often remain successful despite severe object-level occlusion, yet degrade sharply when local interaction cues are disrupted or familiar spatial priors are violated. They are also highly sensitive to stale or missing observations and struggle when changed task preconditions require behavioral adaptation. Finally, VLAs and WAMs exhibit distinct robustness profiles, showing that visual robustness is multi-dimensional and architecture-dependent. LIBERO-VPro provides a systematic diagnostic framework for developing robotic foundation models that can more reliably ground and adapt their actions under challenging visual conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出 LIBERO-VPro 基准，通过扰动执行过程中的视觉证据，系统评估机器人基础模型的闭环视觉鲁棒性，覆盖4个维度、12类挑战、96种设置、3296个任务条件案例，评估3个VLA和3个WAM模型。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人基础模型在标准操作基准上表现优异，但这些评估通常假设执行过程中视觉观测干净、及时且一致，忽略了真实场景中视觉证据被扰动的情况，导致标称性能掩盖了视觉 grounding 与适应能力的不足。
AI.method: 构建 LIBERO-VPro 基准，围绕四个互补维度进行视觉扰动：视觉证据退化、相机陈旧（观测延迟）、视觉来源一致性、任务相关场景变化；涵盖12个挑战类别、96种实验设置、3296个任务条件案例。评估3个视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）和3个世界-动作模型（WAM），共约196,000个仿真回合，并在 Franka Research 3 上补充200次真实世界 rollout。
AI.result: 强标称性能可能掩盖视觉 grounding 与适应性的显著弱点；模型在严重物体级遮挡下常仍成功，但当局部交互线索被破坏或熟悉空间先验被违反时性能急剧下降；对陈旧或缺失观测高度敏感；当任务前提变化需要行为适应时表现吃力；VLA 与 WAM 呈现不同的鲁棒性剖面，说明视觉鲁棒性是多维且依赖架构的。
AI.conclusion: LIBERO-VPro 为开发能在挑战性视觉条件下更可靠地进行动作 grounding 与适应的机器人基础模型提供了系统化诊断框架，表明视觉鲁棒性需分维度、分架构评估。

title: Mitigating Entity Type Confusion in Cross-Domain NER via Multidimensional Quantification and Reasoning Enhancement
summary: Cross-domain Named Entity Recognition (CD-NER) aims to transfer the rich knowledge in the source domain to the target domain. Recent studies adopting decomposition or generation paradigms have achieved significant performance improvements, demonstrating high accuracy in entity span detection. However, during entity type classification, models severely suffer from entity type confusion, the erroneous tendency that models classify entities of one type in the text as another similar but incorrect type. To address this issue, we first propose a Multidimensional Confusion Quantification Model (MCQM) that quantifies a model's confusion extent between entity types from three dimensions: source-target hierarchy analysis, semantic similarity analysis, and explicit data evaluation. Moreover, we propose the Progressive Bidirectional Reasoning Chain (PBRC). PBRC leverages the source-target hierarchy and confusion analysis from the MCQM to prompt the LLM to generate two-stage reasoning information. The two-stage reasoning information is utilized to augment the knowledge of the model, significantly mitigating entity type confusion and improving the model's generalization performance. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves new state-of-the-art results on all domains of the CrossNER dataset.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对跨域命名实体识别中的实体类型混淆问题，提出多维混淆量化模型（MCQM）与渐进式双向推理链（PBRC），在CrossNER数据集所有域上取得新的SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有跨域NER方法在实体跨度检测上已取得较高准确率，但在实体类型分类阶段严重存在"实体类型混淆"，即把某类实体错误归类为相似但不正确的类型，制约了模型性能与泛化能力。
AI.method: 1) 提出多维混淆量化模型（MCQM），从源-目标层级分析、语义相似度分析、显式数据评估三个维度量化模型在实体类型间的混淆程度；2) 提出渐进式双向推理链（PBRC），利用MCQM得到的源-目标层级与混淆分析结果，提示大语言模型生成两阶段推理信息，用于增强模型知识。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，该方法在CrossNER数据集的所有域上均达到新的最先进（SOTA）性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过量化并显式建模实体类型混淆，并借助两阶段推理信息增强模型知识，可显著缓解实体类型混淆、提升跨域NER的泛化能力。

title: Dissecting Agentic Forensics: The Role of Triage, Prompting, and Evidence Arbitration in Open-World Fake Image Detection
comment: Accepted at the 2026 Workshop on AI for Multimedia Forensics and Disinformation Detection (AI4MFDD), ECCV 2026. 34 pages (17 main paper incl. references, 17 appendix), 7 figures, 5 tables
summary: Image forensics is increasingly an open-world problem: manipulations range from fully synthetic images to localized edits, splicing and swapping, while most forensic detectors remain specialized to a single manipulation family. Agentic AI has recently emerged as a promising solution. In principle, such systems can assess the reliability of individual detectors, identify out-of-scope evidence, and arbitrate conflicting reports. However, it remains unclear which components actually drive performance and whether their benefits persist under distribution shift. To answer these questions, we study a training-free agentic framework built around specialist detectors, per-detector triage, and conflict-aware evidence arbitration. Using six configurations and three multimodal large language model backbones, we dissect the role of triage, prompting, and reasoning quality on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution data. Our results show that naive detector fusion suffers from severe false-positive rates on authentic images. Triage and prompting consistently improve performance by filtering unreliable evidence and exposing detector limitations. However, the dominant factor is represented by reasoning itself: A stronger judge substantially outperforms a weaker one, particularly under distribution shift. Most notably, manipulation recall is nearly saturated across all configurations, indicating that the main challenge of open-world image forensics is not detecting manipulations, but calibrating trust in specialized forensic tools and arbitrating conflicting evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究免训练的图像取证智能体框架，通过六种配置与三种多模态大模型骨干，分析分流、提示与推理质量对分布内和分布外数据的影响，发现推理能力是性能主导因素。
AI.motivation: 图像取证日益成为开放世界问题：篡改类型涵盖全合成图像、局部编辑、拼接与换脸，而多数取证检测器仅针对单一篡改家族。智能体AI被视为潜在解决方案，可评估单检测器可靠性、识别超出范围的证据并仲裁冲突报告，但尚不清楚哪些组件真正驱动性能，以及其收益能否在分布偏移下持续。
AI.method: 构建免训练的智能体框架，围绕专家检测器、逐检测器分流和冲突感知的证据仲裁；采用六种配置和三种多模态大模型骨干，在分布内与分布外数据上剖析分流、提示与推理质量的作用。
AI.result: 朴素检测器融合在真实图像上产生严重假阳率；分流与提示通过过滤不可靠证据、暴露检测器局限而稳定提升性能；但主导因素是推理本身——更强的评判者在分布偏移下显著优于较弱者；篡改召回率在各配置下几乎饱和。
AI.conclusion: 开放世界图像取证的主要挑战并非检测篡改，而是校准对专用取证工具的信任并仲裁冲突证据。

title: TReViS: Temporal Repetition Structure Aware Video Synthesis for Self-supervised Repetitive Action Counting
comment: Accepted for publication in Image and Vision Computing (Elsevier). This is the author-accepted manuscript and not the final published version of record. The DOI and link to the published version will be added when available
summary: Fully supervised repetitive action counting (RAC) has achieved strong performance, but requires dense temporal annotations that are costly and difficult to scale. We propose TReViS, a self-supervised video synthesis framework that enables training RAC models without any repetition labels. TReViS estimates the underlying temporal repetition structure of an unlabeled video via a Temporal Self-Similarity Matrix, infers its cycle statistics, and synthesizes new training sequences that preserve realistic repetition patterns while introducing controlled temporal variability. These synthesized videos are paired with pseudo-labels and used to train existing RAC architectures from scratch. Across multiple datasets and backbones, TReViS consistently outperforms prior self-supervised methods and achieves performance competitive with several supervised baselines, while remaining fully label-free, demonstrating the effectiveness of structure-aware video synthesis for label-free RAC. The source code is available at https://github.com/yfqi/TReViS.

AI.tldr: 提出TReViS自监督视频合成框架，利用时序自相似矩阵估计视频重复结构并合成带伪标签的训练序列，实现无重复标签的重复动作计数（RAC）训练。
AI.motivation: 现有全监督重复动作计数（RAC）性能强，但依赖密集时序标注，成本高、难以扩展；因此需要无需重复标签的RAC训练方法。
AI.method: TReViS通过时序自相似矩阵（Temporal Self-Similarity Matrix）估计无标签视频的潜在时序重复结构，推断周期统计量，并合成保留真实重复模式、同时引入可控时序变化的训练序列，配合伪标签从零训练现有RAC架构。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和骨干网络上，TReViS持续优于已有自监督方法，性能与若干监督基线相当，且完全无需标签，验证了结构感知视频合成在无标签RAC中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知的视频合成可有效支撑无标签重复动作计数，为摆脱密集时序标注提供可行路径；代码已开源。

title: Prescriptive SVD-Inspired Attention via Spectral Energy Retention
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026
summary: Self-attention is central to modern Transformer architectures, but its dense dot-product formulation makes it difficult to identify which internal directions are structurally important and which can be modified without disrupting the model. SVD-Inspired Attention (SVDA) addresses part of this problem by introducing a learned diagonal spectrum into the query-key score interaction, making latent attention directions explicitly inspectable through indicators such as spectral entropy, effective rank, sparsity, alignment, selectivity, and perturbation response. This paper examines the transition from diagnostic interpretation to operational intervention. A diagnosis--intervention--verification framework is proposed, and one intervention is evaluated: spectral energy retention in the attention-score pathway. Across FashionMNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Food-101, the $ρ=0.90$ prescription removes 24.5--53.7\% of score directions, reduces parameters by 2.6--4.3\%, and reduces estimated MACs by 2.8--5.4\%. The paired mean accuracy change of the dimension-reduced model ranges from $-0.03$ to $+0.05$ percentage points over three seeds. These results support SVDA as an intrinsically interpretable attention mechanism whose learned spectrum exposes an operational coordinate system for deterministic and verifiable modification of attention-score formation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"诊断—干预—验证"框架，在SVDA（SVD-Inspired Attention）的谱指标基础上，评估谱能量保留这一干预手段，验证注意力分数通路的可操作性。
AI.motivation: 现代Transformer的自注意力采用稠密点积，难以辨别内部哪些方向在结构上重要、哪些可被修改而不破坏模型。SVDA虽通过引入可学习对角谱使注意力潜在方向可被检查，但仅停留在诊断层面，尚缺乏从诊断解释走向实际干预与验证的路径。
AI.method: 提出诊断—干预—验证框架，并评估一种干预：注意力分数通路中的谱能量保留。使用谱熵、有效秩、稀疏度、对齐度、选择性、扰动响应等指标进行诊断；在FashionMNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、Food-101上按ρ=0.90的处方进行维度缩减。
AI.result: ρ=0.90处方移除24.5%–53.7%的分数方向，参数量减少2.6%–4.3%，估计MACs减少2.8%–5.4%；三个随机种子下配对平均精度变化为−0.03至+0.05个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持SVDA作为一种内在可解释的注意力机制，其学习到的谱暴露出一套可操作的坐标系，可用于对注意力分数形成进行确定性且可验证的修改。

title: URA-NER: A Unified Retrieval-Augmented Framework with Retrieval Alignment and Uncertainty Reduction for Low-Resource NER
comment: 8 pages,3 figures, accepted at IJCNN 2026, conference WCCI 2026
summary: In-context learning (ICL) based on large language models (LLMs) has shown promising potential in alleviating performance bottlenecks caused by the limited availability of annotated data in Named Entity Recognition (NER). However, existing methods still face issues of retrieval misalignment and generation uncertainty, making their performance heavily dependent on the LLM's capabilities. As the parameter scale of LLMs decreases, their performance in few-shot settings deteriorates significantly. In this paper, we propose a novel unified retrieval-augmented framework, URA-NER, including three key components: Progressive Granularity Retrieval (PGR), Model-aware Representation Enhancement (MaRE), and Reason-aware Knowledge Verification. PGR is a two-stage retrieval mechanism that achieves stage alignment. It first retrieves demonstrations for span detection based on the query's global semantics, and then for type classification based on the specific entity context, providing fine-grained local information. Moreover, MaRE employs entity pre-recognition to guide the construction of representations, ensuring the query and demonstrations are aligned within the LLM's semantic space and attention pattern. In addition, to mitigate generation uncertainty, we propose RaKV, a closed-loop "generation-retrieval-verification" process. It explicates the LLM's reasoning paths, leverages them for the retrieval of external knowledge, and reorganizes the knowledge into verification evidence aligned with the original reasoning paths. We conduct extensive experiments on multiple low-resource NER datasets. Results demonstrate that URA-NER significantly enhances the performance of LLMs under low-resource settings, with particularly pronounced gains for smaller LLMs, achieving new state-of-the-art results on several benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一检索增强框架URA-NER，包含渐进粒度检索(PGR)、模型感知表示增强(MaRE)和推理感知知识验证(RaKV)，缓解低资源NER中ICL的检索错位与生成不确定性问题，显著提升小规模LLM性能。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的上下文学习(ICL)在缓解NER标注数据稀缺方面有潜力，但现有方法存在检索错位(retrieval misalignment)与生成不确定性(generation uncertainty)问题，性能高度依赖LLM能力；当LLM参数量减小时，少样本性能显著下降。
AI.method: 提出URA-NER统一检索增强框架，含三部分：(1) PGR两阶段检索，先基于查询全局语义检索span detection的demonstrations，再基于具体实体上下文检索type classification的demonstrations，实现阶段对齐并提供细粒度局部信息；(2) MaRE利用实体预识别引导表示构建，使query与demonstrations在LLM语义空间与注意力模式中对齐；(3) RaKV闭环"生成-检索-验证"过程，显化LLM推理路径，据此检索外部知识并重组为与原始推理路径对齐的验证证据。
AI.result: 在多个低资源NER数据集上广泛实验，URA-NER显著提升LLM在低资源下的性能，对小规模LLM提升尤为明显，在多个基准上取得新的SOTA。
AI.conclusion: URA-NER通过阶段对齐检索、表示对齐与推理验证的协同设计，有效缓解检索错位与生成不确定性，降低对LLM规模的依赖，为低资源NER提供了有效方案。

title: Topographic Training Concentrates Causal Circuits Without Improving Neuron Monosemanticity
comment: Accepted at the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at ICML 2026
summary: Mechanistic interpretability of vision transformers seeks to decompose model computation into human-readable units, but learned representations entangle many concepts in each neuron. Feature superposition is widely treated as the central obstacle to this decomposition, yet most mitigations (sparse autoencoders, dictionary learning) are post-hoc and leave the underlying network unchanged. We ask whether a spatial-locality training loss (TopoLoss) can act as a lightweight, training-time prior that improves interpretability of standard mech-interp tools. Training ViT on ImageNet-100 across multiple TopoLoss weights $α$, we measure causal sufficiency of topographic clusters via activation patching and feature geometry via sparse autoencoders fit to the same residual stream. At $α=1.0$, topographic clusters are 2.79$\times$ more causally sufficient than random unit sets of the same size, with the effect increasing monotonically in $α$. SAE L0 sparsity decreases by 11% and dead-feature fraction rises 19-fold, yet standard neuron-level monosemanticity scores are unchanged, indicating that topographic pressure acts at circuit level, concentrating causal mass into spatially local structures without disentangling individual neurons. This dissociation suggests current neuron-level monosemanticity metrics are insensitive to a class of real interpretability gains, and positions cheap architectural priors as a viable training-time complement to post-hoc tooling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用空间局部性训练损失 TopoLoss 作为训练期先验，检验其能否提升视觉 Transformer 的可解释性；结果显示该损失在电路层面提升因果充分性，但未改变神经元级单义性，揭示现有度量对一类真实可解释性收益不敏感。
AI.motivation: 机制可解释性希望把模型计算分解为人类可读单元，但神经元表征存在概念纠缠，特征叠加被视为核心障碍。现有缓解手段（稀疏自编码器、字典学习）多为事后处理，不改变原网络，因此需要探索轻量、训练期引入的先验是否能改善标准机制可解释性工具的效果。
AI.method: 在 ImageNet-100 上训练 ViT，并设置多个 TopoLoss 权重 α。评估两类指标：一是通过激活补丁（activation patching）测量地形学簇（topographic clusters）的因果充分性；二是对同一残差流拟合稀疏自编码器（SAE），分析特征几何、L0 稀疏度与死特征比例，并对比标准神经元级单义性分数。
AI.result: 在 α=1.0 时，地形学簇的因果充分性比同规模随机单元集合高 2.79 倍，且该效应随 α 单调增强。SAE 的 L0 稀疏度下降 11%，死特征比例上升 19 倍，但标准神经元级单义性分数保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 地形学约束作用于电路层面，将因果质量集中到空间局部结构中，而非拆解单个神经元。这表明当前神经元级单义性度量对某类真实可解释性收益不敏感，廉价架构先验可作为事后工具的训练期补充。

title: A Lightweight Convolutional Neural Network for Real-Time Recognition of Hand-Drawn Geometric Shapes
summary: Recognizing hand-drawn geometric shapes is a foundational sub-problem of sketch recognition, with applications in education, human-computer interaction, and diagram digitization. This paper presents the design, implementation, and evaluation of a desktop application that recognizes four basic hand-drawn geometric shapes, circle, square, rectangle, and triangle using a compact Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). A dataset of 2,000 labeled 28x28-pixel shape images was collected independently and released publicly. The classifier consists of three convolutional blocks (16, 32, and 64 filters) with max-pooling, an in-model data-augmentation stage (random horizontal flip, rotation, and zoom), a dropout-regularized dense layer of 128 units, and a 4-way linear output layer, totaling 97{,}956 trainable parameters. The network is trained with the Adam optimizer on a sparse categorical cross-entropy objective computed directly on logits. On an 80/20 train-validation split, the model achieves 94.80% training accuracy and 96.01% validation accuracy with a validation loss of 0.1437. A Tkinter-based graphical interface allows a user to draw a shape with the mouse and receive an immediate class prediction with a confidence score. We situate this system within the broader sketch and shape-recognition literature, compare its accuracy against related hand-drawn shape classification studies, and discuss the limitations inherent to a small, single-contributor dataset. The complete source code, trained model, and per-class datasets are released publicly to support reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文设计并实现了一个基于紧凑CNN的桌面应用，识别圆、正方形、矩形、三角形四种手绘几何图形，在自建2000张28x28数据集上达到96.01%验证准确率，并提供Tkinter实时绘图预测界面，代码与数据全部开源。
AI.motivation: 手绘几何图形识别是草图识别的基础子问题，在教育、人机交互、图表数字化等场景有应用价值；同时需要一个轻量、可复现的识别方案与公开数据集，并厘清小规模单标注者数据集的局限性。
AI.method: 独立采集并公开2000张28x28像素的标注图形数据集；构建三卷积块（16/32/64滤波器）加最大池化的紧凑CNN，含模型内数据增强（随机水平翻转、旋转、缩放）、dropout正则化的128单元全连接层与4类线性输出层，共97,956个可训练参数；使用Adam优化器，在logits上直接计算稀疏分类交叉熵；按80/20划分训练与验证。
AI.result: 模型训练准确率94.80%，验证准确率96.01%，验证损失0.1437；基于Tkinter的图形界面支持鼠标绘制并即时返回类别预测及置信度。
AI.conclusion: 系统在草图与形状识别文献背景下被定位，其精度与相关手绘形状分类研究进行了对比；同时讨论了小规模、单贡献者数据集带来的固有局限。完整源代码、训练模型与各类别数据集均已公开以支持可复现性。

title: Can Spiking Neural Networks play pinball? A neuromorphic motion detector for target tracking
summary: Biological visual systems achieve continuous, low-latency motion perception by processing sparse, asynchronous spiking signals, enabling real-time tracking under strict energy constraints. Event-based cameras, inspired by the mammalian retina, replicate this efficiency by capturing only local brightness changes as asynchronous events, offering a natural substrate for spiking neural networks (SNNs) to parallelise computation and adapt to fast-changing scenes. Pinball provides a controlled yet dynamic testbed, requiring precise motion estimation and fast reaction to a small, rapidly moving target. This work presents a fully spiking, real-time perception-to-action pipeline for closed-loop pinball gameplay. A dynamic vision sensor observes a small, fast-moving ball, and a network of spiking Time-Difference Encoders on the SpiNNaker neuromorphic platform jointly estimates its position, speed, and direction. The system is characterised across receptive field size, accumulation window, and angular tuning width for real-time operation, and benchmarked in closed loop against human players across two flipper regimes of increasing physical realism. It achieves a hit rate of 56.1%, nearly double the human average, reacting within 21.7 ms (5 ms network latency) and consuming an estimated 148 μW using fewer than 25k neurons, among the fastest and most energy-efficient event-based closed-loop demonstrators benchmarked. Under more realistic flipper dynamics, tuning a single interpretable policy parameter reproduces the full spectrum of human play styles, from cautious to aggressive, with no change to the perception pipeline. A physical demonstrator, tracking a real ball and actuating real flippers in closed loop, confirms the principle operates beyond simulation. Its fully spiking, learning-free design offers a compact, energy-efficient example of real-time neuromorphic perception-to-action.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个全脉冲、实时的感知-行动闭环弹球系统:用动态视觉传感器捕捉小球运动,在SpiNNaker神经形态平台上用脉冲时间差编码器网络联合估计位置、速度与方向,实现56.1%命中率、21.7 ms反应延迟、约148 μW功耗,并已在物理样机上验证。
AI.motivation: 生物视觉系统以稀疏异步脉冲实现连续低延迟运动感知,在严格能耗约束下完成实时追踪。事件相机只捕捉局部亮度变化,天然适配脉冲神经网络(SNN)的并行与快速响应特性。弹球任务要求对快速移动的小球进行精确运动估计与快速反应,为闭环神经形态感知-行动提供了可控且动态的测试平台。
AI.method: 构建全脉冲的实时感知-行动闭环弹球流水线:动态视觉传感器观测快速移动的小球;在SpiNNaker神经形态平台上部署脉冲时间差编码器(Time-Difference Encoders)网络,联合估计球的位置、速度和方向。系统在感受野大小、累积窗口、角度调谐宽度等参数上进行实时运行表征,并在两种物理真实性递增的挡板(flipper)机制下与人类玩家进行闭环对比测试。
AI.result: 命中率达56.1%,接近人类平均水平的两倍;反应时间21.7 ms(其中网络延迟5 ms);估计功耗约148 μW;使用神经元不足25k,是同类事件驱动闭环演示中速度最快、能效最高的系统之一。在更真实的挡板动力学下,仅调节单一可解释策略参数即可复现从谨慎到激进的人类完整打法谱系,且无需改动感知流水线。物理样机通过追踪真实小球并闭环驱动真实挡板,验证了该原理的可实机操作性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了全脉冲、免学习设计的紧凑、高能效实时神经形态感知-行动系统,为事件驱动的闭环控制提供了可落地范例,并证明单一可解释参数即可覆盖多样的行为策略与人类打法风格。

title: DeCo: Efficient Decouple-to-Couple Learning for Multi-Task Visual Grounding
summary: Multi-task visual grounding requires models to jointly understand linguistic semantics and perform accurate visual localization and segmentation. Despite the success of multimodal large language models, effectively adapting them to multiple grounding objectives remains challenging. Existing methods commonly enforce task cooperation through shared representations, while overlooking the intrinsic conflict between task-oriented feature interests. In this paper, we introduce $\textbf{DeCo}$, an efficient $\textbf{De}$couple-to-$\textbf{Co}$uple learning framework that resolves this dilemma through a two-stage paradigm: task-specific representation decoupling followed by complementary prior coupling. Specifically, we first propose Task-aware Semantic Decoupling (TSD) to route shared visual cues into individual features under salient word-level guidance, alleviating representation interference between localization and segmentation. Furthermore, we observe that segmentation naturally provides informative localization priors due to dense supervision. Based on this insight, we introduce Hybrid Prior Coupling (HPC), which integrates sentence-level semantic prior with mask-derived spatial prior for enhanced grounding. Built upon a frozen multimodal encoder, DeCo requires lightweight trainable parameters while achieving strong generalization across multiple grounding objectives. Extensive experiments on RefCOCO/+, G-Ref, ReferIt, Flickr, DIOR-RSVG, SARVG1.0, RRSIS-D, RIS-LAD, and RefDIOR demonstrate that DeCo achieves state-of-the-art performance on both natural and remote sensing benchmarks. The code and models are available at https://github.com/xiaoqiang-lu/DeCo.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeCo，一个"解耦-耦合"两阶段多任务视觉定位框架，通过任务感知语义解耦与混合先验耦合缓解定位与分割间的表征冲突，在自然与遥感基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 多任务视觉定位需同时理解语言语义并完成精确定位与分割。现有多模态大模型方法多依赖共享表征强制任务协作，忽视了任务导向特征兴趣之间的内在冲突。
AI.method: 在冻结多模态编码器上构建轻量可训练框架：先由任务感知语义解耦（TSD）在显著词级引导下将共享视觉线索路由到各任务专属特征，缓解定位与分割的表征干扰；再利用分割的密集监督为定位提供先验，通过混合先验耦合（HPC）融合句级语义先验与掩码导出的空间先验。
AI.result: 在RefCOCO/+/g、G-Ref、ReferIt、Flickr、DIOR-RSVG、SARVG1.0、RRSIS-D、RIS-LAD、RefDIOR等自然与遥感基准上均达到当时最优性能，且仅需少量可训练参数并具备强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 显式解耦任务特征再耦合互补先验，比共享表征更能平衡多任务定位目标，是兼顾性能、参数效率与跨域泛化的有效范式。

title: End-to-end Jordanian dialect speech-to-text self-supervised learning framework
summary: Speech-to-text engines are extremely needed nowadays for different applications, representing an essential enabler in human-robot interaction. Still, some languages suffer from the lack of labeled speech data, especially in the Arabic dialects or any low-resource languages. The need for a self-supervised training process and self-training using noisy training is proven to be one of the up-and-coming feasible solutions. This article proposes an end-to-end, transformers-based model with a framework for low-resource languages. In addition, the framework incorporates customized audio-to-text processing algorithms to achieve a highly efficient Jordanian Arabic dialect speech-to-text system. The proposed framework enables ingesting data from many sources, making the ground truth from external sources possible by speeding up the manual annotation process. The framework allows the training process using noisy student training and self-supervised learning to utilize the unlabeled data in both pre- and post-training stages and incorporate multiple types of data augmentation. The proposed self-training approach outperforms the fine-tuned Wav2Vec model by 5% in terms of word error rate reduction. The outcome of this work provides the research community with a Jordanian-spoken data set along with an end-to-end approach to deal with low-resource languages. This is done by utilizing the power of the pretraining, post-training, and injecting noisy labeled and augmented data with minimal human intervention. It enables the development of new applications in the field of Arabic language speech-to-text area like the question-answering systems and intelligent control systems, and it will add human-like perception and hearing sensors to intelligent robots.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer的端到端低资源语言语音识别框架，结合自监督预训练、噪声学生训练和定制化音频处理，用于约旦阿拉伯语方言语音转文本。该方法在词错误率上较微调Wav2Vec模型降低5%，并提供了约旦口语数据集。
AI.motivation: 语音转文本在人机交互中至关重要，但阿拉伯方言等低资源语言缺乏标注语音数据。自监督训练和基于噪声数据的自训练被证明是可行方案，因此需要面向低资源语言的高效框架。
AI.method: 提出端到端、基于Transformer的框架，并集成定制化音频到文本处理算法。框架支持多源数据摄取、加速人工标注以获取外部真值，采用噪声学生训练和自监督学习，在预训练和后训练阶段利用未标注数据，并结合多种数据增强。
AI.result: 所提出的自训练方法在词错误率降低方面优于微调后的Wav2Vec模型5%。研究还提供了约旦口语数据集。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为研究社区提供了约旦口语数据集及面向低资源语言的端到端方案，通过预训练、后训练以及注入带噪标注与增强数据并以最少人工干预实现。可推动阿拉伯语语音转文本领域的新应用，如问答系统和智能控制系统，并为智能机器人增加类人感知与听觉传感器。

title: Estimating Accurate Hand Pose in Camera Space with Vision Transformer
summary: Monocular RGB-based hand pose estimation has emerged as a critical research frontier in computer vision. The local hand pose estimation methods predict hand poses relative to the wrist, while global hand pose estimation also requires estimating the wrist's position in the camera coordinate system. However, this camera-space estimation confronts two fundamental challenges: (1) depth ambiguity in monocular settings, and (2) the coupling effect of hand local poses and global wrist positions in the perspective projections. In particular, this coupling reflects that the projections are jointly determined by local hand poses, wrist positions, and camera intrinsics. To overcome these challenges, our framework proposes two key innovations: Transformation-Isomorphism Supervision for hand-depth information extraction and Perspective Information Embedding for resolving above coupling effect of local pose and wrist position, both integrated within the mainstream encoder-decoder architecture. Besides, we propose a novel framerate-aware multi-dataset training strategy for sequential pose refinement. Our fully integrated approach achieves at most 37.1\% superiority in CS-MJE over SOTA on HO3D. Project page: https://github.com/Mine268/CS-ViT.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对单目RGB全局手部姿态估计中的深度歧义与手部局部姿态-手腕全局位置耦合问题，提出Transformation-Isomorphism Supervision、Perspective Information Embedding及帧率感知多数据集训练策略，在HO3D上CS-MJE指标最高超越SOTA 37.1%。
AI.motivation: 单目RGB手部姿态估计是计算机视觉重要方向；局部手部姿态估计只需预测相对手腕的姿态，而全局手部姿态估计还需估计手腕在相机坐标系中的位置，这在单目场景下面临两个根本挑战：(1) 单目深度歧义；(2) 透视投影中手部局部姿态与全局手腕位置的耦合效应——投影由局部手部姿态、手腕位置和相机内参共同决定。
AI.method: 提出两项关键创新：Transformation-Isomorphism Supervision用于提取手部深度信息，Perspective Information Embedding用于解耦局部姿态与手腕位置的耦合效应，二者集成于主流编码器-解码器架构中；此外提出帧率感知的多数据集训练策略用于序列姿态细化。
AI.result: 完整集成方法在HO3D数据集上CS-MJE指标最高超越SOTA达37.1%。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模手部深度信息、解耦透视投影中局部姿态与手腕位置，并结合帧率感知的多数据集序列细化训练，可显著提升单目RGB全局手部姿态估计精度。

title: 1% of Tokens Can Be Enough: On Gradient Estimation in On-Policy Distillation
summary: Sparse on-policy distillation (OPD) allocates teacher supervision to a small subset of tokens in student-generated trajectories. However, useful teacher guidance can yield a noisy update when its gradient is estimated from a sampled next token. We study this estimation problem at a fixed prefix in information geometry and propose an information-efficiency ratio (IER) based on a signal-to-noise decomposition. IER characterizes relative gradient estimation error under an optimal scalar baseline. A candidate-set approximation enables token selection based on IER and its combination with existing usefulness scores, while retaining the sampled reverse-KL training objective. On mathematical and medical reasoning tasks, adding IER improves existing selectors in multiple settings, with sparse configurations matching or exceeding full OPD without token selection at small token budgets of 0.1\%--1\%. These results support accounting for both usefulness and gradient-estimation reliability when allocating sparse supervision. Our code is available at https://github.com/BruceSheng1202/IER-OPD.

AI.tldr: 本文研究稀疏on-policy蒸馏中教师监督的梯度估计问题，提出基于信噪比分解的信息效率比（IER），用于token选择，并验证其在数学和医学推理任务上的有效性。
AI.motivation: 稀疏OPD将教师监督分配到学生生成轨迹的小部分token上，但即使教师指导有用，当梯度基于采样的下一token估计时也可能产生噪声更新，因此需要在分配稀疏监督时同时考虑有用性与梯度估计可靠性。
AI.method: 在固定前缀下从信息几何角度研究该估计问题，基于信噪比分解提出信息效率比（IER），刻画最优标量基线下的相对梯度估计误差；通过候选集近似实现基于IER的token选择，并与已有有用性分数结合，同时保留采样的reverse-KL训练目标。
AI.result: 在数学和医学推理任务上，加入IER在多种设置下改进了现有选择器；在0.1%–1%的小token预算下，稀疏配置可匹配或超过未做token选择的全量OPD。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在分配稀疏监督时同时考虑有用性与梯度估计可靠性，代码已开源。

title: Do LiDAR Language Models Really Understand Spatio-temporal Relationships?
summary: Recent 4D LiDAR language models aim to reason about objects and their evolving spatial relationships. Yet, in our evaluation, always selecting the same option nearly matches the multiple-choice accuracy of two B4DL-derived configurations. We introduce LiDAR-Hallu, a geometry-referenced benchmark and diagnostic protocol with 10,000 questions across 150 nuScenes scenes. It covers object existence, ego-relative position, distance ordering, relative motion, and temporal localization, with explicit rules for selecting objects, comparing times, and determining reference answers. Our protocol combines fixed-answer and candidate-content controls, cross-scene pairs with identical prompts but opposite reference answers, and relation-specific recall. Analysis of 100,000 recorded responses reveals failures hidden by aggregate accuracy. Candidate duration alone makes temporal answers predictable without observing LiDAR. On paired questions, the models frequently give the same answer to scenes requiring opposite answers. Relation-specific analysis further shows that both configurations miss every positive lateral-motion case across all tested conditions. Temporal-shuffle contrastive decoding provides little net improvement, as repairs are largely offset by new errors and the main failures persist. These results show that evaluating spatio-temporal reasoning requires testing whether models distinguish the queried physical relationships, rather than relying on individual-answer accuracy alone. The source code, checkpoints, and data are released at https://github.com/Awesome4D/4DMLLM_Hallucination_Bench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LiDAR-Hallu几何参照基准与诊断协议，揭示4D LiDAR语言模型在时空推理评测中的答案偏差与虚假高分，并表明仅凭单项准确率无法衡量模型是否真正区分物理关系。
AI.motivation: 近期4D LiDAR语言模型旨在推理物体及其演化的空间关系，但现有评测存在问题：在作者评估中，"总是选择同一选项"这一简单策略几乎能匹配两个基于B4DL的配置的多项选择题准确率，说明聚合准确率可能掩盖模型的真实失败。因此需要一套能够检验模型是否真正区分所查询物理关系的诊断性评测方法。
AI.method: 提出LiDAR-Hallu：一个几何参照基准与诊断协议，包含150个nuScenes场景中的10,000个问题，覆盖物体存在性、自车相对位置、距离排序、相对运动和时间定位；为物体选择、时间比较与参考答案判定制定明确规则。协议结合固定答案控制与候选内容控制、提示相同但参考答案相反的跨场景配对，以及关系特定的召回率分析。
AI.result: 对100,000条记录响应的分析揭示了聚合准确率所掩盖的失败：(1) 仅凭候选时长即可在不观察LiDAR的情况下预测时间类答案；(2) 在配对问题上，模型对需要相反答案的场景常给出相同回答；(3) 关系特定分析显示两个配置在所有测试条件下都漏掉了全部正向横向运动案例；(4) 时间打乱对比解码几乎无净收益，修复项大体被新增错误抵消，主要失败依旧存在。
AI.conclusion: 评估时空推理必须检验模型是否区分所查询的物理关系，而不能只依赖单项答案准确率。代码、检查点与数据已开源。

title: MECAIL: Communication-Aware Incremental Learning for Object Detection with 14.6 KB Spatiotemporal Experts
summary: Intelligent transportation systems require Incremental Learning (IL) to continually improve their overall performance in dynamic environments. However, most edge devices lack the computational resources to support on-device IL, requiring updates to be transmitted from centralized servers. We propose using this setup to obtain dense, specialized module coverage that adapts a fixed base model to specific spatiotemporal contexts, such as parking lots, gas stations, ferries, or construction sites. However, in order to reliably transmit these modules to the edge device, using TCP, UDP, and BTP over V2X, Wi-Fi, and 2G-5G hardware, we establish a strict limit of 14.6 KB per module to fit within the first TCP window and to minimize UDP/BTP fragmentation. We further introduce Mixture-of-Experts for Communication-Aware Incremental Learning (MECAIL), the first method that meets this strict requirement, in which each new domain or environment is served by a small expert network that adapts the base model. We validate MECAIL on D-RICO and ODinW-13, where it largely matches the performance of parameter-heavy approaches while enabling practical, bandwidth-efficient large-scale deployment. This allows comprehensive coverage by experts for highly specific, focused, and temporary situations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通信感知增量学习方法 MECAIL，通过为每个新环境训练小规模专家网络来适配固定的基础模型，将单模块大小严格限制在 14.6 KB 以内，从而支持在边缘设备上通过 V2X/Wi-Fi/蜂窝网络高效传输并实现大规模部署。
AI.motivation: 智能交通系统需要在动态环境中持续提升性能，因此依赖增量学习；但多数边缘设备缺乏支持端侧增量学习的算力，更新必须由中心服务器下发。而可靠传输这些更新模块（经由 TCP/UDP/BTP 与 V2X、Wi-Fi、2G-5G 硬件）存在严格的带宽与分片约束，现有参数密集型方法难以满足实际部署需求。
AI.method: 提出 MECAIL（Mixture-of-Experts for Communication-Aware Incremental Learning）。其核心是用密集、专用的模块覆盖来将固定基础模型适配到特定时空场景（如停车场、加油站、渡口、施工现场）；每个新领域或环境由一个小的专家网络负责适配基础模型。为满足传输约束，设定每模块不超过 14.6 KB 的严格上限，以适配首个 TCP 窗口并减少 UDP/BTP 分片。
AI.result: 在 D-RICO 和 ODinW-13 上验证 MECAIL，其性能基本可匹敌参数密集型方法，同时实现了实用且带宽高效的大规模部署，使专家能够对高度特定、聚焦且临时的场景进行全覆盖。
AI.conclusion: MECAIL 是首个满足 14.6 KB 严格模块大小要求的方法，在保持与参数密集型方法相当性能的同时，实现了面向边缘设备的带宽高效、可大规模落地的通信感知增量学习方案。

title: Fysiverse-3D-SimReady Technical Report: Agentic Physical Simulation for Pragmatic 3D World Reconstruction
summary: Agentic recognition requires visual perception to move beyond static scene understanding and produce structured scene representations that support the perception--reasoning--action loop. Existing single-image 3D generation methods, however, mainly produce visually plausible object assets rather than simulation-ready scene states. When independently generated meshes are composed in a shared space, they may fail to align with the input camera, violate gravity, interpenetrate nearby objects, or become unstable under physics simulation. We present Fysiverse-3D-SimReady, a grounded refinement framework for reconstructing simulation-ready multi-object scenes from a single RGB image with instance and ground prompts. The method places generated object meshes into a shared gravity-aligned scene, refines their camera-space poses through differentiable rendering, and corrects scene-level supports and contacts for stable physical execution. The scene is then used by an agentic simulation workflow, which converts a scene-specific task goal into an executable physics rollout rendered from the original camera view. Experiments show that Fysiverse-3D-SimReady improves input-view alignment, contact plausibility, and physical stability over existing single-image reconstruction and scene generation baselines, while enabling goal-conditioned physical interactions from a single image.

AI.tldr: 提出 Fysiverse-3D-SimReady 框架，从单张 RGB 图像重建可用于物理仿真的多物体场景，支持智能体感知—推理—动作闭环。
AI.motivation: 现有单图 3D 生成方法主要产出视觉上合理的物体资产，而非仿真就绪的场景状态。独立生成的网格在共享空间中组合时，常出现与输入相机不对齐、违反重力、相互穿插或在物理仿真中不稳定等问题，难以支撑智能体的感知—推理—动作闭环。
AI.method: 给定单张 RGB 图像及实例与地面提示，将生成的物体网格放置于统一的、重力对齐的共享场景中；通过可微渲染优化其相机空间位姿；并对场景级的支撑与接触关系进行校正，以保证物理执行的稳定性。随后由智能体仿真工作流将场景特定任务目标转换为可执行的物理仿真 rollout，并从原始相机视角渲染。
AI.result: 在输入视角对齐、接触合理性和物理稳定性方面，Fysiverse-3D-SimReady 优于现有单图重建与场景生成基线，同时支持从单张图像进行目标条件下的物理交互。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将单图 3D 生成从"视觉合理的资产生成"推进到"仿真就绪的场景状态重建"，为智能体提供可直接用于物理交互的场景表示，打通了感知—推理—动作闭环。

title: SGAM: Shared Gaussian Geometry with Implicit Amplitude Modeling for Scan-Specific 3D Multi-Contrast MRI Reconstruction
summary: Three-dimensional (3D) multi-contrast magnetic resonance imaging (MCMRI) provides rich anatomical and quantitative information but requires long acquisition times, motivating k-space undersampling. However, reconstruction of large volumetric datasets imposes substantial computational and memory demands. To address this challenge, we propose SGAM, a memory-efficient, scan-specific framework for joint full-volume 3D MCMRI reconstruction. SGAM is based on a shared-geometry Gaussian representation in which amplitudes are modeled by a multi-output implicit neural representation (INR) and contrast-specific phases by explicit variables. This design exploits common anatomical structure across contrasts while preserving contrast-specific signal variations. The representation is jointly optimized using only the acquired multi-coil k-space without external training data. Experiments showed that SGAM consistently outperformed the comparison methods across imaging tasks and acceleration factors, with greater improvements under stronger undersampling. SGAM also achieved a favorable balance between reconstruction quality and computational cost, demonstrating its effectiveness for 3D multi-contrast MRI reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出SGAM——一种内存高效、扫描特异的共享几何高斯表示框架，用于联合全容积3D多对比MRI重建，仅用采集的多线圈k空间联合优化，在各任务与加速倍数下均优于对比方法。
AI.motivation: 3D多对比MRI能提供丰富解剖与定量信息，但采集时间长，需k空间欠采样；而大体积数据集的欠采样重建带来巨大计算与内存负担。
AI.method: 基于共享几何的高斯表示：幅值由多输出隐式神经表示（INR）建模，对比特异相位用显式变量表示。该设计利用跨对比的共有解剖结构，同时保留对比特异信号变化；表示仅用已采集的多线圈k空间联合优化，无需外部训练数据。
AI.result: 实验表明SGAM在多种成像任务与加速倍数下持续优于对比方法，且在更强欠采样下提升更明显；在重建质量与计算成本之间取得良好平衡。
AI.conclusion: SGAM对3D多对比MRI重建有效，兼具重建质量与计算效率优势。

title: Spatial Action Review: A Visual Analytics Dashboard for Auditing Language-to-Action Hand-offs in Electron Microscopy
comment: Accepted at the IEEE VIS 2026 Workshop on Visual Analytics in the Age of Autonomous Science (VAxAutoSci)
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly explored as interfaces for scientific image analysis, where a visual question-answering (VQA) response may be paired with a spatial output that guides a downstream stage. A supervisor reads the language answer, while a downstream workflow such as segmentation or region review consumes the point-set output. We call this transition from inspecting the answer to relying on its point action the language-to-action hand-off. A silent failure occurs when the answer is correct while the paired action misses annotated objects needed downstream, so answer-based oversight clears a region whose action is unreliable. We introduce Spatial Action Review, a visual analytics dashboard for auditing this failure mode in electron microscopy (EM) mitochondria analysis. It links paired answer-action records through an answer-action ledger, a task-by-dataset risk map, and an image-region audit view, connecting aggregate patterns to image evidence while an adjustable action-reliability gate supports re-audit. The review ends in a human-AI hand-off, where a supervisor records whether the action is accepted, escalated, held under a stricter gate, or flagged for model revision. Across 541 image regions from an EM-adapted Qwen3-VL case-study run, point actions fail the gate in 54.4% of records with a correct VQA response, and 27.4% of all records are silent failures. A correct answer is associated with only a 5.8-percentage-point higher probability of a reliable action, with a bootstrap interval spanning zero; the point-biserial correlation between answer correctness and object coverage is 0.061. This weak coupling persists across five model conditions on 753 matched image regions. Spatial Action Review makes answer-action mismatches visible and ties them to image evidence and a recorded decision before MLLM outputs enter autonomous scientific workflows.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示并可视化审计了多模态大模型在科学图像分析中的"语言-动作交接"静默失败：答案正确但配对的空间动作漏检下游所需目标，由此提出可视化分析面板 Spatial Action Review。
AI.motivation: MLLM 日益被用作科学图像分析的接口，VQA 答案供监督者阅读，而点集等空间输出被下游分割/区域复核流程消费。此时答案正确并不保证动作可靠，可能产生"静默失败"——基于答案的监督会放行动作不可靠的区域。作者需要一种手段审计这类失败模式。
AI.method: 提出 Spatial Action Review，一个用于审计 EM 线粒体分析中该失败模式的可视分析面板。通过 answer-action ledger（答案-动作台账）、task-by-dataset risk map（任务×数据集风险图）和 image-region audit view（图像区域审计视图）连接配对记录，将聚合模式与图像证据关联，并提供可调的动作可靠性门槛以支持复审计；审查以人机交接结束（接受/升级/严格门槛下保留/标记模型修订）。在 EM 适配的 Qwen3-VL 案例中跨 541 个图像区域评估，并在 5 种模型条件下、753 个匹配图像区域复核。
AI.result: 在 541 个图像区域中，VQA 答案正确时仍有 54.4% 的记录动作未通过门槛，全部记录中 27.4% 为静默失败。答案正确仅使动作可靠概率高 5.8 个百分点，bootstrap 区间跨零；答案正确性与目标覆盖率的点二列相关为 0.061。这种弱耦合在 5 种模型条件、753 个匹配区域的复核中持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 答案正确性与空间动作可靠性之间耦合极弱，静默失败普遍存在。Spatial Action Review 使答案-动作不匹配可见，并将其与图像证据和人工记录决策绑定，从而在 MLLM 输出进入自主科学流程前提供审计保障。

title: Fathom-Vaidya: Advancing Medical Reasoning with Rubric-Based Rewards
summary: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in healthcare requires robust performance across two complementary dimensions - diagnostic reasoning: the convergent, evidence-driven task of inferring a patient's condition from clinical data to produce a diagnosis, and clinical healthcare reasoning: the broader, navigational judgment required to communicate, plan, and adapt across multi-turn clinical interactions where a single correct answer may not exist. Recent benchmarks such as HealthBench and MedXpertQA reveal persistent weaknesses in both areas, exposing failures in complex diagnostic scenarios and limitations in contextual, patient-centered dialogue. We introduce a sequential training framework that targets these facets using synthetic data and rubric-based reinforcement learning. First, we improve diagnostic reasoning using MedBullets-derived questions with rule- and rubric-guided Reinforcement Learning (RL). We then shift to clinical reasoning by generating 5.3k synthetic multi-turn scenarios, each paired with multi-dimensional rubrics to comprehensively assess the response. This approach yields over 10% improvement on MedXpertQA, and our 30B model achieves 50.1% accuracy on HealthBench-Hard, surpassing proprietary baselines including GPT-5 (thinking). Our results show that targeted synthetic datasets and rubric-based training can systematically improve both diagnostic and interactive clinical reasoning in medical LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出顺序训练框架，用合成数据与评分标准强化学习，依次提升医疗LLM的诊断推理与临床交互推理能力。
AI.motivation: 医疗LLM需同时具备两类能力：从临床数据推断诊断的收敛性诊断推理，以及多轮交互中沟通、规划与适应的临床医疗推理。现有基准（HealthBench、MedXpertQA）显示这两方面均存在持续短板。
AI.method: 采用顺序训练框架：先基于MedBullets问题，用规则与评分标准引导的强化学习提升诊断推理；再生成5.3k个合成多轮临床场景，每个场景配多维评分标准，转向临床推理训练。
AI.result: MedXpertQA提升超过10%；30B模型在HealthBench-Hard上达到50.1%准确率，超过包括GPT-5（thinking）在内的专有基线。
AI.conclusion: 针对性合成数据集与基于评分标准的训练，可系统性提升医疗LLM的诊断推理与交互式临床推理能力。

title: STA-TFM: Spatio-Temporal Aggregation Across Views TransForMer for Pose Estimation
summary: Monocular 3D human pose estimation (HPE) remains challenging due to depth ambiguity, occlu- sions, and the need for temporal consistency. While multi-view methods provide superior accuracy over monocular approaches, they often require complex setups. We introduce STA-TFM, a transformer-based architecture that combines spatial and temporal information for multi-view pose estimation. The approach leverages DSTformer, a monocular feature extractor, to capture long-range pose dependencies within each view. A fusion transformer then aggregates information across views to produce coherent 3D estimates. To address training data scarcity, we use a data generation pipeline that transforms any existing 3D pose dataset into multi-view setups with controllable parameters. Experiments on various datasets demonstrate that STA-TFM outperforms existing camera-parameter-free multi-view methods. STA-TFM achieves 50.9% and 49.5% reductions in mean per joint position error (MPJPE) and mean per joint velocity error (MPJVE) on the DHP19 dataset. Furthermore, it achieves 6.7% and 7.7% respective reductions on HAA4D, and a 15.2% MPJPE reduction on TotalCapture. STA-TFM handles noisy and missing 2D inputs, supporting potential deployment in healthcare monitoring, athletic assessment, and immersive technologies. Code, training checkpoints, and data are available at https://zenodo.org/records/22832620.

AI.tldr: 提出STA-TFM，一种结合空间与时序信息的多视角三维人体姿态估计Transformer架构，通过单视角特征提取器DSTformer与跨视角融合Transformer实现无相机参数的高精度3D姿态估计，并配套可控的多视角数据生成流程。
AI.motivation: 单目3D人体姿态估计受深度歧义、遮挡及时序一致性困扰，而多视角方法精度更高但通常依赖复杂的相机标定与采集设置；同时多视角训练数据稀缺。
AI.method: STA-TFM采用Transformer架构融合时空信息：使用DSTformer作为单目特征提取器捕捉各视角内长距离姿态依赖，再由融合Transformer聚合跨视角信息生成一致的3D估计；并设计数据生成流程，将任意现有3D姿态数据集转换为参数可控的多视角设置以缓解训练数据稀缺。
AI.result: 在DHP19上MPJPE与MPJVE分别降低50.9%和49.5%；HAA4D上分别降低6.7%和7.7%；TotalCapture上MPJPE降低15.2%；优于现有无相机参数的多视角方法，并能处理含噪与缺失的2D输入。
AI.conclusion: STA-TFM在无相机参数条件下取得优于现有多视角方法的精度，具备对噪声和缺失2D输入的鲁棒性，可潜在应用于健康监测、运动评估与沉浸式技术。代码、检查点与数据已公开。

title: VPRune: Efficient Training-free Pre-LLM Visual Token Pruning
summary: Visual token pruning is a promising approach to reducing the inference cost of large vision-language models (LVLMs), yet aggressive token reduction often causes substantial performance degradation. We identify three key factors behind this degradation: text-guided selection bias, information loss from discarded tokens, and positional distortion caused by sequence compaction. Based on these observations, we propose \textbf{VPRune}, a training-free pre-LLM pruning framework consisting of visual-only diversity selection, similarity-guided token recycling, and position-preserving restoration. Experiments on FastVLM-1.5B across multiple vision-language benchmarks demonstrate that VPRune achieves a favorable accuracy--compression trade-off, with particularly pronounced advantages under aggressive compression. Furthermore, evaluations on edge-device show that VPRune effectively reduces end-to-end inference latency while maintaining superior task performance, demonstrating its practicality for resource-constrained LVLM deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的pre-LLM视觉token剪枝框架VPRune，通过视觉多样性选择、相似性引导回收与位置保持恢复，缓解激进压缩下的性能下降，在边缘设备上兼顾精度与延迟。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）推理成本高，视觉token剪枝是有前景的降本手段，但激进的token削减常导致显著性能退化。作者识别出退化的三个关键因素：文本引导的选择偏差、被丢弃token的信息损失、序列压缩造成的位置扭曲。
AI.method: 提出VPRune，一个免训练（training-free）的pre-LLM剪枝框架，由三部分组成：仅视觉的多样性选择（visual-only diversity selection）、相似性引导的token回收（similarity-guided token recycling）、位置保持恢复（position-preserving restoration）。
AI.result: 在FastVLM-1.5B上跨多个视觉语言基准测试表明，VPRune取得良好的精度—压缩权衡，在激进压缩下优势尤为明显；边缘设备评测显示其能有效降低端到端推理延迟，同时保持优越的任务性能。
AI.conclusion: VPRune验证了针对选择偏差、信息损失与位置扭曲进行协同设计的有效性，具备在资源受限场景下部署LVLM的实用价值。

title: AgentSTAR: Agentic Shape Tracking and Reconstruction from Monocular Videos
summary: In this work, we present a method for shape reconstruction and tracking from video via agentic analysis-by-synthesis. Unlike prior methods which first estimate dense pixel correspondences and then recover object motion from them, our method infers a structured 3D object model, including its geometry and kinematic structure, and uses this model to optimise object track estimates over time. In our optimisation loop, a Vision-Language Model (VLM) agent iteratively refines shape or generalised pose through a render-and-compare loop, combining coarse visual reasoning with numerical pose optimisation for precise state estimation. This structured formulation enables our method to track through large motion, articulation, and severe occlusion without relying on pixel-matching objectives. Quantitatively, on ARCTIC, our method substantially outperforms state-of-the-art 3D point-tracking baselines for articulated objects, and on HOT3D it outperforms all evaluated rigid-object tracking baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于智能体分析-合成（agentic analysis-by-synthesis）的从视频中进行形状重建与追踪的方法：不再先估计稠密像素对应再恢复运动，而是推断包含几何与运动学结构的3D物体模型，并用该模型在优化循环中迭代优化追踪结果；循环中由VLM智能体通过渲染-比较精化形状或广义位姿，结合粗粒度视觉推理与数值位姿优化。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常先估计稠密像素对应关系，再从中恢复物体运动，这种流程在大幅运动、铰接变化和严重遮挡下容易失效。本文希望用结构化的3D物体模型（几何+运动学结构）直接驱动时序追踪，从而摆脱对像素匹配目标的依赖。
AI.method: 采用智能体分析-合成框架：推断结构化的3D物体模型（几何与运动学结构），并在优化循环内用该模型优化时序追踪估计。循环中，VLM智能体通过渲染-比较迭代精化形状或广义位姿，将粗粒度视觉推理与数值位姿优化结合，实现精确状态估计。
AI.result: 在ARCTIC数据集上，方法显著优于面向铰接物体的最先进3D点追踪基线；在HOT3D数据集上，优于所有被评估的刚体物体追踪基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过将追踪表述为结构化模型驱动的分析-合成优化，并引入VLM智能体进行渲染-比较迭代，方法能够在大幅运动、铰接和严重遮挡下稳定追踪，并在铰接与刚体追踪基准上取得优于现有基线的表现。

title: Identity-Consistent Analysis of Long-Shot Windsurfing Video: A Domain-Specific Offline Tracking System
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Project code and evaluation artifacts: https://github.com/BertilBraun/Windsurf-Analysis/tree/windsurf-report-v1.5
summary: Long-shot windsurfing video combines small targets, large camera pans, prolonged overlaps, and rapidly changing backgrounds. The desired output is not a generic MOT trace but a separate, stable rider-relative video for each surfer; one false identity merge can invalidate an otherwise useful result. We present an offline analysis system that detects surfers, forms conservative local tracklets, links them globally with camera-compensated motion and a foreground-masked sail-color descriptor, and uses two pose keypoints on the rig to drive a rider-relative virtual camera. The tracking stage is evaluated on 21 manually reconstructed development videos containing 41,004 retained observations. On this fixed-observation protocol, the production system achieves 0.957 pairwise precision, 0.918 recall, and 0.937 F1, compared with 0.792 F1 for OC-SORT and 0.828 for BoT-SORT. Compared with OC-SORT, it reduces fragmentation excess from 845 to 42, but nine of its 95 output tracks mix rider identities and these errors affect seven of the 21 videos.

AI.tldr: 提出离线长镜头帆板视频分析系统，通过保守局部轨迹段、全局关联及姿态关键点驱动的骑手相对虚拟相机，实现独立稳定的逐冲浪者视频输出。
AI.motivation: 长镜头帆板视频存在小目标、大范围镜头平移、长时间遮挡重叠及背景快速变化等难点；目标不是通用MOT轨迹，而是每位冲浪者独立、稳定的骑手相对视频，一次身份误合并即会破坏整体结果的有效性。
AI.method: 检测冲浪者，构建保守的局部轨迹段（tracklets），利用相机补偿运动与前景区分掩膜下的帆色描述子进行全局关联，并基于帆具上两个姿态关键点驱动骑手相对虚拟相机。
AI.result: 在21段人工重建的开发视频（41,004个保留观测）上评估跟踪阶段：固定观测协议下，生产系统取得0.957成对精确率、0.918召回率、0.937 F1，优于OC-SORT（0.792 F1）和BoT-SORT（0.828）；相比OC-SORT，碎片化超额从845降至42；但95条输出轨迹中有9条混合了骑手身份，影响21段视频中的7段。
AI.conclusion: 该系统在固定观测协议下显著优于OC-SORT与BoT-SORT，并大幅降低碎片化，但仍存在少量身份混合错误，是后续需改进的关键问题。

title: CMAMBADEPTH: Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation with Channel Mamba and Hybrid Attention
summary: Accurate monocular depth estimation serves as a core enabler for single camera scene understanding. However, existing self-supervised monocular depth estimation methods generally suffer from the bottleneck of inefficient cross-scale information interaction and difficulty in balancing local and global spatial modeling. In this paper, we propose CMambaDepth, a self-supervised framework that achieves efficient multi-scale feature fusion and fine-grained contextual modeling via channel-wise selective state propagation. Specifically, Bidirectional Channel Mamba (Bi-CMamba) aligns encoder features across scales and enables bidirectional information exchange among ordered scale groups. Unidirectional Channel Mamba (Uni-CMamba) progressively aggregates decoder features and retains fine-grained scale groups through a group selection mechanism for subsequent fusion. Furthermore, a Hybrid Attention Module (HAM) is introduced to combine large-kernel local context and Manhattan self-attention for complementary spatial modeling. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves highly competitive performance. Specifically, our model achieves an AbsRel of 0.094 and an RMSE of 4.156 on KITTI, and an AbsRel of 0.140 on DDAD. In the zero-shot cross-dataset generalization test on NYUv2, it attains an AbsRel of 0.232, outperforming the baseline RA-Depth by 7.2%.

AI.tldr: 提出 CMambaDepth 自监督单目深度估计框架，通过通道选择性状态传播实现高效多尺度融合与上下文建模，并在 KITTI、DDAD、NYUv2 上取得竞争性精度。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督单目深度估计方法存在跨尺度信息交互效率低、难以平衡局部与全局空间建模的瓶颈。
AI.method: 设计 Bi-CMamba 对齐编码器跨尺度特征并实现有序尺度组间双向信息交换；Uni-CMamba 逐级聚合解码器特征，并通过组选择机制保留细粒度尺度组用于后续融合；引入 HAM 混合注意力模块，结合大核局部上下文与 Manhattan 自注意力实现互补的空间建模。
AI.result: 在 KITTI 上 AbsRel 为 0.094、RMSE 为 4.156；DDAD 上 AbsRel 为 0.140；NYUv2 零样本跨数据集泛化中 AbsRel 为 0.232，较基线 RA-Depth 提升 7.2%。
AI.conclusion: CMambaDepth 能有效缓解跨尺度交互与局部—全局建模的平衡问题，并在单目深度估计及跨数据集泛化上取得具有竞争力的性能。

title: 0.5%>100%: Bidirectional Reciprocal Learning for Referring Image Segmentation
summary: Recent advances in vision foundation models (VFMs) have shown remarkable capabilities across diverse unimodal visual tasks. However, adapting VFMs to referring image segmentation (RIS) typically necessitates precise vision-language alignment via full fine-tuning, incurring substantial computational overhead and risking catastrophic forgetting. While existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods enable safe knowledge transfer with minimal training costs, they predominantly operate independently within individual modalities or focus exclusively on unidirectional guidance from language to vision, overlooking progressive cross-modal interaction and visual feedback for textual refinement. To address these limitations, we propose $\textbf{B}$idirectional $\textbf{R}$eciprocal $\textbf{L}$earning ($\textbf{BRL}$), a novel adapter-based PEFT framework that facilitates hierarchical, bidirectional information flow within both token-mixing and channel-mixing layers of frozen foundation models. Specifically, BRL introduces two complementary lightweight modules. The Reciprocal Attention Adapter (RAA) performs cross-modal query-key exchanges at the token level, enabling visual and linguistic tokens to mutually attend to each other for fine-grained spatial grounding. The Reciprocal Gate Adapter (RGA) generates cross-modal gating signals at the channel level, allowing global semantic context from one modality to adaptively recalibrate channel activations of the other. Extensive experiments on RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of BRL over prior RIS methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance while requiring less than 0.5% backbone parameter updates. Code and models will be released at https://github.com/xiaoqiang-lu/BRL.

AI.tldr: 提出双向互惠学习（BRL）适配器框架，在冻结视觉基础模型中实现分层双向跨模态信息流，以不到0.5%的主干参数更新在RIS任务上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 将视觉基础模型适配到指代图像分割通常需全量微调，计算开销大且有灾难性遗忘风险；现有PEFT方法多在单模态内独立作用或仅做语言到视觉的单向引导，缺乏渐进式跨模态交互与视觉反馈对文本的细化。
AI.method: BRL是一个基于适配器的PEFT框架，在冻结基础模型的token-mixing与channel-mixing层中引入双向信息流：互惠注意力适配器（RAA）在token级进行跨模态query-key交换，实现视觉与语言token互为注意以完成细粒度空间定位；互惠门控适配器（RGA）在channel级生成跨模态门控信号，用一模态的全局语义上下文自适应重校准另一模态的通道激活。
AI.result: 在RefCOCO、RefCOCO+、RefCOCOg基准上优于既有RIS方法，达到state-of-the-art性能，且主干参数更新不到0.5%。
AI.conclusion: BRL通过分层双向跨模态适配，在极低参数更新代价下实现优越的指代图像分割性能，验证了双向互惠学习作为PEFT范式的有效性。

title: LLJ Cards: Best practices for the Use of LLMs as Judges
summary: In recent years, large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a popular alternative for evaluation. Often referred to as LLMs as judges (LLJs), these systems have been widely adopted by researchers and practitioners across a broad range of measurement tasks, driven by their strong performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness relative to human judgment. However, a growing body of work has shown that the use of LLJs raise concerns about their validity and reliability as evaluators. Existing efforts to address these challenges have largely focused on developing bias-mitigation techniques and refining prompting strategies. While these approaches represent an important step forward, they primarily offer technical fixes and leave a more fundamental challenge unaddressed: the lack of standardized, transparent, and reproducible evaluation practices. In this paper, we introduce LLJ Cards, a framework that synthesizes best practices from measurement theory, natural language generation, and machine learning literature into practical guidelines for LLJ-based evaluations. While LLJs offer a promising path toward scalable evaluation, their effective use requires grounding in rigorous evaluation principles to ensure validity, reliability, and reproducibility. LLJ Cards addresses this need by providing a structured framework for applying these principles in the design and reporting of automated evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LLJ Cards 框架，将测量理论、自然语言生成与机器学习的最佳实践整合为面向 LLM 作为评判者（LLJs）评估的实用指南，以弥补现有研究仅聚焦技术性修复、缺乏标准化与可复现评估实践的不足。
AI.motivation: LLM 作为评判者因性能强、可扩展、成本低而被广泛采用，但其效度与信度受到质疑。已有工作多集中在偏差缓解技术与提示策略优化，属于技术性修补，未解决更根本的问题：评估实践缺乏标准化、透明度与可复现性。
AI.method: 提出 LLJ Cards 框架，系统综合测量理论、自然语言生成与机器学习三个领域的最佳实践，形成可用于设计与报告 LLJ 评估的结构化指南。
AI.result: 构建了一个结构化框架，用于在自动化评估的设计与报告中落实效度、信度与可复现性原则。
AI.conclusion: LLJs 是通往可扩展评估的有前景路径，但其有效使用必须以严谨的评估原则为基础；LLJ Cards 通过提供结构化框架满足这一需求。

title: Not All Task Vectors Need Equal Rank: Energy-Proportional Allocation for Model Merging
summary: Model merging aims to combine multiple fine-tuned models derived from a common pretrained model into a single multi-task model without additional joint training. Recent spectral merging methods improve over simple weight averaging by exploiting low-rank structures of task-specific updates, but they commonly assign the same rank capacity to every task. This uniform allocation ignores that task vectors can have heterogeneous spectral complexity, causing the shared merging space to be used suboptimally. In this paper, we propose Spectral Energy-proportional Rank Allocation (SERA), a simple task-adaptive strategy that allocates ranks according to the singular-value energy structure of each task vector. By assigning richer spectral capacity to complex or isolated tasks and fewer directions to compact tasks, SERA extends SVD-based model merging from uniform-capacity merging to task-dependent capacity allocation. Experiments under standard vision model merging protocols show that SERA improves multi-task merging performance while preserving the same total rank budget as existing spectral merging methods. Further analysis demonstrates that task-level spectral concentration is closely related to the per-task effect of adaptive rank allocation, providing insight into when and why SERA is effective.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SERA（谱能量比例秩分配），一种任务自适应策略，根据各任务向量的奇异值能量结构分配秩，将基于SVD的模型合并从统一容量扩展为任务相关容量分配，在不增加总秩预算的前提下提升多任务合并性能。
AI.motivation: 模型合并旨在无需联合训练即可将多个同源微调模型整合为单一多任务模型。现有谱合并方法虽利用任务特定更新的低秩结构改进了简单权重平均，但对所有任务分配相同的秩容量，忽略了任务向量谱复杂度的异质性，导致共享合并空间利用次优。
AI.method: 提出SERA（Spectral Energy-proportional Rank Allocation），一种简单的任务自适应策略：依据每个任务向量的奇异值能量结构分配秩。对复杂或孤立任务分配更丰富的谱容量，对紧凑任务分配更少方向，在保持与现有谱合并方法相同总秩预算的条件下实现任务相关的容量分配。
AI.result: 在标准视觉模型合并协议下，SERA在保持与现有谱合并方法相同总秩预算的同时提升了多任务合并性能。进一步分析表明，任务级谱集中度与自适应秩分配的单任务效果密切相关。
AI.conclusion: SERA将基于SVD的模型合并从统一容量合并推进到任务相关容量分配，性能提升且不增加预算；任务级谱集中度可用于解释何时以及为何自适应秩分配有效。

title: Preoperative Prediction of Microvascular Invasion in Hepatocellular Carcinoma by Integrating Multimodal Ultrasound and Clinical Data: A Multicenter Study
comment: Main manuscript: 37 pages, 5 figures, and 4 tables; supplemental material: 18 pages, 6 figure, and 9 tables
summary: Background: Microvascular invasion (MVI) predicts recurrence and survival in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) but requires postoperative histopathology for diagnosis. We developed and validated a model integrating multimodal ultrasound and clinical data for preoperative MVI prediction. Methods: This multicenter study included 489 patients with HCC from eight centers. All patients had B-mode ultrasound (BUS), color Doppler flow imaging (CDFI), dynamic contrast-enhanced ultrasound (DCE-US), and clinical information. Data from seven centers (n = 421) were used for model development with five-fold cross-validation; data from the remaining center (n = 68) formed an independent external validation cohort. The proposed multimodal information fusion network used modality-specific encoders, a hemodynamic temporal change module for bidirectional DCE-US perfusion changes, and a representation consistency learning module to align heterogeneous ultrasound representations before Transformer-based fusion. Results: In external validation, DCE-US achieved the highest single-modality area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC; 0.8545+/-0.0198), versus clinical information (0.6715+/-0.0156), CDFI (0.6435+/-0.0344), and BUS (0.6087+/-0.0417). Pixel-difference sampling and the proposed temporal module outperformed alternative sampling and video representation methods. The full model achieved the best performance, with an AUC of 0.8953+/-0.0180, accuracy of 81.18%+/-2.83%, sensitivity of 86.40%+/-6.69%, and specificity of 78.14%+/-6.28. Conclusions: Integrating multimodal ultrasound and clinical information enabled promising preoperative MVI prediction in HCC. DCE-US was the main source of predictive information, while BUS, CDFI, and clinical information provided complementary value. The proposed framework may support preoperative risk stratification and individualized clinical decision-making.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发并验证了一种融合多模态超声与临床信息的模型，用于肝细胞癌微血管侵犯（MVI）的术前预测，外部验证AUC达0.8953。
AI.motivation: MVI可预测肝细胞癌的复发与生存，但其诊断依赖术后组织病理学检查，缺乏术前无创预测手段，因此需要构建术前MVI预测模型以支持风险分层与个体化决策。
AI.method: 多中心研究纳入8个中心489例HCC患者，均具备B型超声（BUS）、彩色多普勒血流成像（CDFI）、动态对比增强超声（DCE-US）及临床信息。7个中心421例用于建模并采用五折交叉验证，剩余1个中心68例作为独立外部验证队列。所提多模态信息融合网络包含模态特异性编码器、针对DCE-US双向灌注变化的血流动力学时序变化模块，以及在Transformer融合前对齐异构超声表征的表征一致性学习模块。
AI.conclusion: 融合多模态超声与临床信息可实现有前景的HCC术前MVI预测；DCE-US是主要预测信息来源，BUS、CDFI及临床信息提供互补价值，该框架有望支持术前风险分层与个体化临床决策。

title: ME-VLM: A Unified VLM for Embodied Cognition and Agent Coordination
summary: Physical AI requires models to ground visual and linguistic understanding in real-world environments while accounting for environmental constraints and execution feedback. We introduce MachEmbodied-VLM (ME-VLM), a unified vision-language model with two variants, 4B and 35B-A3B, that brings together embodied cognition and multimodal agent capabilities. Our work emphasizes physical perception and spatiotemporal reasoning, together with planning, interaction, and outcome assessment in both digital and physical environments. We construct training data spanning embodied and multimodal agent tasks, including execution observations and feedback to support outcome assessment and decision refinement. The training pipeline comprises embodied capability injection, separate reinforcement learning of embodied and multimodal-agent experts, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation that consolidates their complementary capabilities into a single model. Experiments show competitive performance on both embodied and agent benchmarks, as well as on autonomous-driving and embodied-navigation tasks. For edge deployment, visual token compression, W4A8 quantization, and hardware-software co-optimization enable on-device inference of the 4B variant on the M100, reducing prefill latency from 400 ms to 188 ms. Project Page: https://machembodied.com/ME-Brain/ME-VLM.html Code Repository: https://github.com/MachEmbodied/ME-VLM

AI.tldr: 提出统一视觉语言模型MachEmbodied-VLM（ME-VLM），含4B与35B-A3B两个版本，融合具身认知与多模态智能体能力，通过能力注入、分专家强化学习与多教师在线策略蒸馏进行训练，在具身与智能体基准上具竞争力，并实现4B模型端侧部署。
AI.motivation: 物理AI需要模型将视觉与语言理解锚定于真实环境，同时兼顾环境约束与执行反馈；现有模型在物理感知、时空推理以及数字与物理环境中的规划、交互和结果评估方面能力尚不统一。
AI.method: 构建涵盖具身与多模态智能体任务的训练数据（含执行观测与反馈）；训练流程包括：具身能力注入、对具身与多模态智能体专家分别进行强化学习、以及多教师在线策略蒸馏，将互补能力整合进单一模型；端侧部署采用视觉token压缩、W4A8量化与软硬件协同优化。
AI.result: 在具身与智能体基准以及自动驾驶、具身导航任务上取得有竞争力的性能；4B版本可在M100上端侧推理，预填充延迟由400 ms降至188 ms。
AI.conclusion: ME-VLM验证了统一融合具身认知与多模态智能体能力的可行性，并通过蒸馏与端侧优化兼顾了多任务性能与部署效率。

title: Dynamic Thermal Gaussians: Multimodal 4D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Thermography plays a vital role in military and broader thermal analysis applications. Recent progress in 3D thermal reconstruction has extended temperature analysis from 2D to 3D space, yet most existing works assume static temperature distributions, neglecting the temporal dynamics of heat transfer in real-world environments. To address this limitation, we propose the first dynamic RGB-Thermal reconstruction framework for complex scenes. Our method jointly models RGB appearance, thermal observations, and scene geometry as they change over time. Specifically, we introduce a multimodal dynamic scene representation that anchors both the color and thermal modalities to a shared geometric substrate, ensuring their consistency under spatiotemporal deformations. We further design multimodal embeddings to enhance the motion expressiveness for each modality, and propose a multimodal routing mechanism that retains a unified set of shared multimodal Gaussians as the geometric backbone while adaptively spawning modality-specific Gaussians to strengthen the representational capacity in detail-rich regions of each individual modality. In addition, we contribute a novel benchmark dataset featuring high-frequency temperature variations to facilitate the evaluation of 4D reconstruction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves high-fidelity spatiotemporal reconstruction of both appearance and temperature. Our code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/LinLif1869/DTG.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个动态RGB-热成像重建框架，通过多模态动态场景表示、多模态嵌入与路由机制，实现复杂场景中外观与温度的4D高保真重建，并贡献了高频温度变化基准数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有3D热重建工作多假设温度分布静态，忽略了真实环境中热传递的时间动态性，无法刻画温度随时间的演化。
AI.method: 联合建模随时间变化的RGB外观、热观测与场景几何；引入多模态动态场景表示，将颜色与热模态锚定到共享几何基座以保证时空形变下的一致性；设计多模态嵌入增强各模态运动表达；提出多模态路由机制，保留统一的共享多模态高斯作为几何主干，并自适应生成模态特定高斯以增强各模态细节丰富区域的表达能力。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法在外观与温度两方面均实现高保真的时空（4D）重建。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了动态RGB-热重建的空白，验证了多模态动态高斯表示的可行性，并公开代码与数据集以推动4D热重建研究。

title: MIRAGE: Full-Body Bystander Privacy for Smart Glasses with Consent-Based Restoration
summary: Video recording on smart glasses exposes more than faces. Continuous capture reveals full-body biometric signatures, including gait, posture, and silhouette, that enable person re-identification (ReID) even after conventional face sanitization. We present MIRAGE, a three-tier architecture for privacy-preserving smart glasses that enforces full-body privacy, supports synthetic full-body replacement, and retains encrypted recovery material for consent-based restoration. We implement MIRAGE on a Raspberry Pi~5 (a CPU-only proxy for smart-glasses compute), companion phones, and a cloud generative backend. Compared to prior systems, MIRAGE achieves 0.948 AP and 0.976 AR while accurately detecting the complete visible body. Its bounding box masking reduces learned silhouette-based ReID to essentially random guessing, with 10.86% Rank-1 accuracy compared with an 11.12% measured chance level. Even against an adaptive adversary retrained on MIRAGE's sanitized pose signals, Rank-1 gait identification drops from 90.25% to 26.20%, removing 72.5% of the adversary's identification advantage.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MIRAGE——一个面向智能眼镜的三层隐私保护架构，实现对全身生物特征（步态、姿态、轮廓）的隐私化处理，同时支持合成全身替换与同意后恢复。
AI.motivation: 智能眼镜的持续视频录制不仅暴露人脸，还会泄露包括步态、姿态、轮廓在内的全身生物特征，使得即便去除人脸后仍可进行行人重识别（ReID）。现有方案多聚焦于面部脱敏，无法应对全身层面的隐私风险，因此需要一种覆盖全身的隐私保护机制。
AI.method: MIRAGE采用三层架构：执行全身隐私强制、支持合成全身替换、并保留加密恢复材料以支持基于同意的还原。系统在Raspberry Pi 5（作为智能眼镜算力的纯CPU代理）、配套手机以及云端生成后端上实现。方法核心包括全身精确检测与边界框掩码处理，以削弱基于轮廓和姿态的ReID信号。
AI.result: MIRAGE实现0.948 AP和0.976 AR，可准确检测完整可见身体。其边界框掩码将基于轮廓的ReID降至接近随机猜测，Rank-1准确率从实际随机水平11.12%对应的10.86%。面对在MIRAGE脱敏姿态信号上重新训练的自适应攻击者，步态识别Rank-1从90.25%降至26.20%，消除攻击者72.5%的识别优势。
AI.conclusion: MIRAGE能够在保持全身检测精度的同时有效抑制基于轮廓、姿态和步态的全身重识别，对自适应攻击者亦具鲁棒性，并兼顾合成替换与同意后恢复，为智能眼镜场景提供了可行的全身隐私保护方案。

title: QLoRA Fine-Tuning of Ministral LLM for Sequence-to-Function Protein Annotation
summary: Functional annotation of newly sequenced proteins remains a bottleneck in molecular biology: the number of sequences in public repositories grows far faster than the capacity for manual curation. Most computational approaches consider annotation as multi-label classification over a fixed ontology, which constrains predictions to a predefined label set. In this work we study the the protein annotation as a sequence-to-text generation problem. We fine-tune the 3B-parameter Ministral 3 base model with QLoRA (4-bit NF4 quantization with low-rank adapters) on sequence annotation pairs. We assess predictions with an LLM-as-expert protocol: a GPT model prompted as a senior molecular-biology curator scores organism identification as binary and function annotation quality. We conclude that QLoRA-fine-tuned compact LLMs can generate curator-style annotations with genuine biological value for a substantial subset of proteins. We also discuss future directions in data quality, model scaling, and evidence grounding that are needed to make the approach sufficiently reliable for practical use.

AI.tldr: 本文将蛋白质功能注释重构为序列到文本的生成任务，用QLoRA微调3B参数的Ministral 3模型，并以LLM-as-expert协议评估，发现紧凑型LLM可为相当一部分蛋白质生成具有真实生物学价值的注释。
AI.motivation: 公共数据库中的蛋白质序列增长速度远超人工注释（curation）能力，功能注释成为分子生物学的瓶颈。现有计算方法多将注释视为固定本体上的多标签分类，预测被限制在预定义标签集合内，缺乏灵活性。
AI.method: 将蛋白质注释建模为序列到文本的生成问题；在序列-注释配对数据上，使用QLoRA（4-bit NF4量化结合低秩适配器）微调3B参数的Ministral 3基座模型。评估采用"LLM作为专家"协议：以GPT模型扮演资深分子生物学注释专家，对生物体识别作二分类判定，并评价功能注释质量。
AI.result: 经QLoRA微调的紧凑型LLM能够为相当一部分蛋白质生成注释专家风格的注释，且具有真实的生物学价值；同时论文讨论了在数据质量、模型扩展和证据溯源方面尚需改进之处，以提升方法可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 生成式建模范式可突破固定标签集的限制，QLoRA微调的紧凑LLM在蛋白质注释上具备实用潜力，但要达到实际应用所需的可靠性，仍需在数据质量、模型规模和证据支撑（evidence grounding）等方向继续研究。

title: Incentive Noise and Structural Prior Infusion for Multi-modal Object Re-Identification
comment: Accepted by ECCV 2026. The version of record may differ slightly
summary: Multi-modal object Re-Identification (ReID) benefits from complementary information across heterogeneous imaging modalities. To further enrich semantic representation, text descriptions have recently been incorporated as an additional modality. However, recent vision-language approaches often treat text descriptions as clean, deterministic signals and overlook their inherent noise, including modality-mismatched phrases and semantically ambiguous expressions. Moreover, prevailing methods lack explicit mechanisms to reconcile fine-grained structural discrepancies between modalities, even after high-level semantic alignment. To address these challenges, we propose a novel framework centered on Positive-Incentive Noise (π-noise) and structured prompt modulation. First, the Semantic Cross-Modal Modulator harnesses task-aware π-noise, sampled from a distribution conditioned on both visual and text inputs, to perturb global tokens and enable semantics-guided cross-modal compensation. Second, the Structure-Aware Prompt Adapter injects learnable geometric priors via prompts to enhance spatial consistency. Third, the Context-Aware Sparse Fusion module distills structural context to guide adaptive fusion while shielding identity features from noisy local details. Experiments on three multi-modal ReID benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of our approach. The code is available at https://github.com/zw-absin/INSPI.

AI.tldr: 提出以正向激励噪声（π-noise）与结构化提示调制为核心的框架，用于多模态目标重识别，增强语义表征并抑制文本噪声与模态结构差异。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言多模态ReID方法将文本描述视为干净、确定性的信号，忽视其固有噪声（模态不匹配短语、语义歧义表达），且缺乏显式机制调和模态间细粒度结构差异，即使已完成高层语义对齐。
AI.method: 1) 语义跨模态调制器：采样以视觉与文本输入为条件的任务感知π-noise，扰动全局token，实现语义引导的跨模态补偿；2) 结构感知提示适配器：通过提示注入可学习几何先验以增强空间一致性；3) 上下文感知稀疏融合模块：蒸馏结构上下文指导自适应融合，同时保护身份特征免受噪声局部细节干扰。
AI.result: 在三个多模态ReID基准上验证了方法的有效性与鲁棒性，代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模文本噪声与结构差异，π-noise与结构化提示调制可提升多模态ReID的语义表征与融合质量。

title: Toward a Unified Mathematics of Concepts
summary: Concepts are commonly defined as abstract, compact representations of knowledge and treated as basic units of intelligent behavior. Yet, cognition, psychology, and AI lack a shared mathematical language for them.
