Modern systems represent concepts as vectors, distributions, symbols, graphs, and other structures, but these formalisms are typically treated as competing rather than as solutions to a common problem. We propose an operation-based view that evaluates mathematical frameworks by the conceptual operations they support, identifying thirteen operations (including similarity, composition, generalization, and grounding) that recur across cognition, psychology, and AI. We show that ten frameworks embody distinct commitments to concepts as self-contained content, relational structure, or evolving process, and that these commitments determine which operations each supports naturally. For example, vector-based models facilitate graded similarity and generalization but struggle with explicit composition, whereas symbolic models support composition but offer but generalize poorly. No single framework we examined naturally supports all operations without extension. We test this account empirically using categorization as a case study, operationalizing nine theories on the same items against human judgments. Despite addressing the same conceptual question, the theories produce different procedures and results, demonstrating that mathematical commitment shapes what a theory can explain. We call for hybrid formalisms that treat content, relation, and process as jointly primary.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"基于操作的视角"，用概念操作（13种）来评估不同数学框架，指出10种框架对"内容/关系/过程"的不同承诺决定了其自然支持的操作，并以分类任务实证验证，呼吁混合形式化。
AI.motivation: 概念被视为智能行为的基本单元，但认知、心理学与AI缺乏共享的数学语言。现有系统用向量、分布、符号、图等表示概念，却常被当作互相竞争的方案，而非针对同一问题的不同解答，因此需要一个统一的评判标准。
AI.method: 提出基于操作（operation-based）的视角：以框架所支持的概念操作来评估数学框架，归纳出跨领域反复出现的13种操作（如相似性、组合、泛化、grounding）。分析10种框架对概念的三类承诺（自足内容、关系结构、演化过程）。以分类任务为案例，在同一组项目上操作化9种理论，并与人类判断对比。
AI.result: 不同框架的承诺决定其自然支持的操作：向量模型利于渐进相似性与泛化但难以显式组合；符号模型支持组合但泛化能力差。所考察的框架中无一能在不扩展的情况下自然支持全部操作。分类案例中，9种理论针对同一概念问题却产生不同程序与结果，说明数学承诺塑造了理论能解释的内容。
AI.conclusion: 数学形式化的选择决定了理论的可解释范围，应发展将内容、关系与过程共同视为基本要素的混合形式化（hybrid formalisms）。

title: Evaluating Transformation Models for pCLE Mosaic Registration
summary: Confocal Laser Endomicroscopy (CLE) provides real-time, cellular-resolution optical biopsy but has a narrow field of view, which image mosaicing can extend to provide anatomical context. Because of line-by-line acquisition, probe motion, and probe-tissue interaction, frame alignment generally requires a non-linear transformation whose accuracy is difficult to quantify: flexible transformation models can fit intensity features and noise, so appearance-based metrics such as Normalized Cross-Correlation (NCC) can improve without a genuine gain in geometric accuracy. We therefore establish a dataset of 132 frame pairs across fourteen pCLE sequences from 4 patients with manually annotated landmark correspondences, so that Target Registration Error (TRE) can serve as a geometrically grounded complement to NCC. We assess the effect of progressively increasing the transformation model's degrees of freedom, from translation to Thin Plate Spline (TPS), and of six feature-matching backends spanning classical (Shi-Tomasi, Lucas-Kanade) and learned (SuperPoint, SuperGlue, LightGlue, LoFTR, RoMa) approaches. Translation and rigid models prove insufficient under tissue deformation, while TPS with random sampling achieves the strongest landmark-derived alignment of the evaluated configurations; among the learned matchers, used without fine-tuning, only RoMa offers a robust, if modest, advantage over other methods. At the sequence level, pairwise registration quality proved an unreliable predictor of final mosaic quality, so mosaic quality must be evaluated directly rather than inferred from pairwise metrics.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对探针式共聚焦激光显微内镜（pCLE）图像拼接中非线性配准精度难以量化的问题，构建了含14个序列、132对帧、4名患者的人工标注基准数据集，以目标配准误差（TRE）作为几何层面的评价指标，系统比较了从平移到薄板样条（TPS）的变换模型及六种特征匹配后端。
AI.motivation: CLE可提供实时细胞级"光学活检"，但视野狭窄，需依靠图像拼接获得解剖上下文。由于逐行采集、探头运动及探头-组织交互，帧间对齐通常需要非线性变换，而此类模型的精度难以量化：柔性变换模型能够拟合强度特征与噪声，使NCC等基于外观的指标提升却未必带来真实的几何精度改善。因此需要以几何为基础的评价手段。
AI.method: 构建pCLE基准数据集（4名患者、14个序列、132对帧），对关键点对应关系进行人工标注，从而以TRE作为NCC的几何互补指标。逐步提高变换模型自由度（从平移、刚性到TPS），并对比六种特征匹配后端，涵盖经典方法（Shi-Tomasi、Lucas-Kanade）与学习方法（SuperPoint、SuperGlue、LightGlue、LoFTR、RoMa），学习方法不作微调。
AI.result: 在组织形变下，平移与刚性模型均不充分；在受评配置中，采用随机采样的TPS取得最佳的关键点对齐效果。在学习型匹配器中，未经微调时仅RoMa相较其他方法表现出稳健但有限的优势。在序列层面，成对配准质量并不能可靠预测最终拼接质量。
AI.conclusion: 非线性柔性模型（如配合随机采样的TPS）更适合pCLE帧间配准；仅凭外观指标（如NCC）不足以反映几何精度，需以TRE等几何指标验证。更重要的是，拼接质量必须直接评估，而不能由成对配准指标推断。

title: Less Uniform Discrete Diffusion is More Powerful and Scalable
summary: Although uniform diffusion language models (UDLMs) represent a promising diffusion paradigm, scaling them remains challenging. We identify the core obstacle as an over-uniform training objective and condition-target confusion during sampling. To address these, we propose Less Uniform Diffusion (LUDI), a novel UDLM framework. Specifically, we (i) introduce a less uniform loss that directs each reverse transition toward the clean token, and (ii) equip the model with per-token time embeddings that supply token-level corruption hints, enabling confidence-based few-step sampling. Experiments across scales show that LUDI yields cleaner supervision and improves few-step generation. We further continue-train a 7B autoregressive model into LUDI-7B, resulting in a UDLM capable of complex reasoning. It achieves a 3-token-per-step speedup over AR decoding and competitive performance compared with masked diffusion baselines, revealing that the full potential of UDLMs for complex generation remains to be unlocked.

AI.tldr: 提出LUDI，一种改进的统一扩散语言模型框架，通过"less uniform损失"和"逐token时间嵌入"解决过度均匀训练目标与采样时的条件-目标混淆问题，实现少步采样和复杂推理能力。
AI.motivation: 统一扩散语言模型（UDLMs）虽是有前景的扩散范式，但扩展困难。作者识别出核心障碍为：训练目标过于均匀（over-uniform），以及采样过程中的条件-目标混淆。
AI.method: LUDI框架包含两项设计：(i) 一种"less uniform损失"，引导每一次反向转移都朝向干净token；(ii) 为模型配备逐token时间嵌入，提供token级损坏提示，从而支持基于置信度的少步采样。此外将7B自回归模型继续训练为LUDI-7B。
AI.result: 跨规模实验显示LUDI提供更干净的监督信号并改善少步生成。LUDI-7B在复杂推理任务上达到相比AR解码3 token/步的加速，与掩码扩散基线相比性能具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: UDLMs在复杂生成任务上的全部潜力尚未被充分挖掘；LUDI表明统一扩散语言模型可被扩展并胜任复杂推理生成。

title: HyperCLIP++: Fine-tuning CLIP forOpen-vocabulary Semantic Segmentation in Hyperbolic Space
summary: CLIP, a foundational vision-language model, has emerged as a powerful tool for open-vocabulary semantic segmentation. While freezing CLIP's text encoder is known to preserve its generalization capability, recent studies show that fine-tuning both CLIP's text and image encoders jointly significantly enhances segmentation performance, especially for classes from open sets. In this work, we explain this phenomenon from the perspective of hierarchy alignment, since during fine-tuning, the hierarchical level of image embeddings shifts from image-level to pixel-level. We achieve this by leveraging hyperbolic space, which naturally encodes hierarchical structures. Our key observation is that, during fine-tuning, the hyperbolic radius of CLIP's text embeddings decreases, facilitating better alignment with the pixel-level granularity of visual data. Building on this, we propose HyperCLIP++, a novel and parameter-efficient adaptation strategy. HyperCLIP++ directly adjusts the hyperbolic radius of CLIP's embeddings via scaling transformations to achieve a hierarchy alignment to the target task, i.e., segmentation. To ensure this hierarchy alignment is effected consistently across both modalities and preserves their cross-modal alignment during training, HyperCLIP++ integrates a Dual Cross-Relation Communication (DCRC) module that synchronizes these adjustments between the vision and text pathways. Our experiments show that HyperCLIP++ achieves state-of-the-art performance across three benchmarks while fine-tuning only approximately 5% of CLIP's total parameters. More importantly, we observe that after adjustment, CLIP's text embeddings exhibit a relatively fixed hyperbolic radius across datasets, suggesting that the hierarchical level required for this segmentation task might be quantified using the hyperbolic radius.

AI.tldr: 本文从层级对齐（hyperbolic radius）视角解释联合微调CLIP能提升开放词汇分割性能，并提出参数高效的HyperCLIP++适配策略，仅调约5%参数即在三个基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 冻结CLIP文本编码器可保持泛化性，但近期研究表明联合微调文本与图像编码器能显著提升分割性能，尤其对开放集类别。作者希望解释这一现象并提供一种高效适配方案。
AI.method: 借助双曲空间天然编码层级结构，观察微调时CLIP文本嵌入的双曲半径减小、从图像级向像素级粒度对齐；据此提出HyperCLIP++，通过缩放变换直接调整嵌入的双曲半径以对齐分割任务层级，并引入Dual Cross-Relation Communication（DCRC）模块在视觉与文本通路间同步调整、保持跨模态对齐。
AI.result: 在三个基准上取得SOTA性能，仅微调约5%的CLIP总参数；调整后CLIP文本嵌入在不同数据集上呈现相对固定的双曲半径。
AI.conclusion: 联合微调带来的收益可用层级对齐解释；HyperCLIP++以少量参数实现层级对齐并提升分割性能，且文本嵌入的双曲半径可用以量化该分割任务所需的层级水平。

title: What Survives on Real Drawings: Active Sampling, Connectome Wiring, and Matched Baselines in Architectural Document Vision
comment: 11 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Major revision with a preregistered held-out evaluation, matched graph nulls, temporal sampling controls, real-drawing evaluation, and an ancillary animation
summary: A connectome-constrained model of the fly visual system, optimized for motion and then frozen, can be driven over architectural drawings by prescribed motion and used as a texture representation. We compare it with information-matched baselines that see the same 721 photoreceptor samples. On clean synthetic data the frozen model transfers but loses to task training: 0.857 area-weighted accuracy in one-shot hatch matching versus 0.959 for a 5,888-parameter CNN, and 0.619 IoU in wall segmentation versus 0.905 for a matched network. Under scan noise and thickened strokes, the trained networks lose up to 0.188 accuracy while the frozen pipeline loses 0.030. On fourteen production sheets, opened once, a 1,876-parameter fly model reaches 0.505 average precision versus 0.415 for a network two hundred times larger. A preregistered held-out split confirms the clean-data ordering: 0.835 for the circuit, 0.894 for receptors only, and 0.971-0.980 for trained CNNs. Rewiring the connectome while preserving degrees or type pairs and transmitter signs costs 0.271-0.356 accuracy across three seeds, so the exact wiring is load-bearing. Yet the intact circuit does not beat its moving retina, and T4/T5 silencing leaves both tasks intact. Longer observations reverse the circuit-receptor ordering once the stimulus spans a period, but not through T4/T5. Thus active sampling and exact structure matter, while clean-data practical performance remains dominated by task-trained networks and the useful transfer margin is largely retinal.

AI.tldr: 果蝇视觉系统连接组约束模型经运动优化后冻结，可驱动于建筑图纸作为纹理表征；在干净数据上不及任务训练CNN，但在扫描噪声与加粗笔画下鲁棒性显著更优，泛化优势主要来源于视网膜前端采样。
AI.motivation: 探究生物连接组结构（精确布线、T4/T5运动通路、主动采样）是否为视觉任务性能的必要来源，以及能否以连接组约束的冻结模型替代任务训练网络；同时检验其泛化与鲁棒性边界。
AI.method: 构建果蝇视觉系统连接组约束模型，先针对运动任务优化后冻结，用规定运动驱动其处理建筑图纸作为纹理表征；与信息量匹配的基线（相同721个光感受器采样）对比；进行连接组重连实验（保持度数、类型配对与递质符号）；消融T4/T5；延长观测使刺激跨越一个周期；并在14张生产图纸上一次性评估，辅以预注册的留出划分。
AI.result: 干净合成数据：冻结模型可迁移但低于任务训练，hatch匹配面积加权精度0.857 vs 5,888参数CNN 0.959，墙分割IoU 0.619 vs 匹配网络0.905。扫描噪声与加粗笔画下，训练网络精度下降达0.188，冻结流程仅下降0.030。14张生产图纸上，1,876参数果蝇模型平均精度0.505，优于大其200倍的网络（0.415）。预注册留出划分确认干净数据排序：电路0.835、仅受体0.894、训练CNN 0.971-0.980。连接组重连（保持度数或类型配对与递质符号）在三个随机种子下损失0.271-0.356精度，说明精确布线不可替代。完整电路未胜过其运动视网膜，T4/T5沉默对两任务无影响。延长观测后电路-受体排序反转（需刺激跨周期），但非经T4/T5实现。
AI.conclusion: 精确连接结构与主动采样确为性能关键（重连显著损害精度），但干净数据上的实际性能仍由任务训练网络主导；可迁移的实用增益主要来自视网膜前端而非中央运动通路，T4/T5非必需，冻结生物模型的价值体现在噪声鲁棒性与小参数量下的泛化。

title: Evaluating Decision Models for Text Annotation in Computational Social Science
summary: Computational social science increasingly relies on large language models for text annotation, and the validity of published findings now rests on the labels generated by such models. Decision models, a new model class built for categorical question answering, answer typed questions with a choice, a probability distribution over the label set, and a confidence score rather than free text, at a small fraction of frontier inference prices. Whether their answers are accurate, and whether that stated confidence can be trusted on social science constructs, are unknown. Here, we mirror the evaluation of Ziems et al. (2024) on 18 computational social science classification tasks (7,977 items), comparing the first commercial decision model and two open-weight counterparts against 19 frontier and open-weight language models under the same zero-shot protocol, and extending the decision-model comparison to eleven open-weight systems released in the week after it. The decision model trails the per-task best LLM on 14 of 15 evaluation tasks, with a median deficit of 11.6 macro-F1 points, at a median 44 times lower measured cost. Its confidence is better calibrated than the verbalized confidence of 16 of the 19 LLMs, yet three frontier models show lower median calibration error (0.157 against 0.066). While items above 0.9 confidence are typically labeled accurately (median accuracy 0.815), on one task, empathy in peer-support dialogues, the model reports high confidence while performing near chance. Nonetheless, our results suggest that decision models are useful as a first step in the annotation pipeline: routing low-confidence items to an LLM matches or exceeds the LLM alone at a quarter to half of its cost.

AI.tldr: 该论文在18个计算社会科学分类任务（7,977条样本）上，将首个商业"决策模型"及两个开源同类模型与19个前沿/开源语言模型在相同零样本协议下对比。决策模型在15个评测任务中的14个落后于最佳LLM（macro-F1中位差11.6），但成本中位低44倍；其置信度校准优于19个LLM中的16个，但三个前沿模型的校准误差更低（0.066 vs 0.157）。作者认为决策模型适合作为标注流水线的第一步，将低置信样本路由给LLM。
AI.motivation: 计算社会科学日益依赖大语言模型进行文本标注，已发表结论的有效性取决于模型生成的标签。决策模型作为面向分类问答的新模型类别，能以远低于前沿模型的价格输出选项、标签概率分布和置信度分数，但其答案准确性以及在社会科学构念上的置信度可信度尚不明确，亟需系统评估。
AI.method: 复现Ziems et al. (2024)的评估框架，覆盖18个计算社会科学分类任务（7,977条样本），在相同零样本协议下，将首个商业决策模型与两个开源同类模型，同19个前沿及开源语言模型进行对比；并将决策模型比较扩展至其发布后一周内推出的11个开源系统。
AI.result: 决策模型在15个评测任务中的14个落后于每任务最佳LLM，macro-F1中位差11.6分，但测量成本中位低44倍。其置信度校准优于19个LLM中的16个的口头化置信度，但三个前沿模型的中位校准误差更低（0.066 vs 0.157）。置信度高于0.9的样本通常标注准确（中位准确率0.815），但在"同伴支持对话中的共情"任务上，模型表现出高置信度却接近随机水平。低置信样本路由给LLM后，整体表现达到或超过单独使用LLM，成本仅为其四分之一到一半。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型虽在准确性上普遍不及最佳LLM，但凭借极低成本与相对良好的校准性，适合作为标注流水线的第一环节；通过将低置信样本路由至LLM，可在显著降低成本的同时保持或提升整体标注质量。

title: What do VLM-Based Vision-Language Navigation Models Rely on: Interpreting and Steering Policy Behavior
summary: Modern Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) models rely mostly on pre-trained large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to predict navigation actions. While this fusion of language instructions and visual observations allows multimodal reasoning, it obscures how information is routed across modalities or what mechanisms drive navigation decisions. Thus, it remains unclear whether VLN models ground their predictions in relevant semantic cues or can track task progress. In this work, we study the interpretability and steerability of VLN models. We use intervention-based metrics that measure how visual observations, instructions, and visual memory causally influence navigation decisions. Our results show that these navigation policies are sensitive to all input modalities and do not depend on a single one. We further show that these agents encode navigation progress and retain semantic structure from their VLM backbones, enabling concept-level steering through internal activations. Finally, we extract activation vectors for abstract behaviors to transfer them zero-shot to out-of-distribution real-world scenarios, improving performance without additional fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究视觉语言导航（VLN）模型的可解释性与可操控性，通过干预式指标揭示各输入模态的因果影响，发现模型编码导航进度与语义结构，并可通过激活向量实现概念级引导与零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有VLN模型依赖预训练大型视觉语言模型（VLM），其语言指令与视觉观测的融合虽支持多模态推理，但信息如何在模态间路由、何种机制驱动导航决策仍不透明。因此无法判断模型是否基于相关语义线索进行预测，或能否跟踪任务进度。
AI.method: 采用基于干预（intervention-based）的指标，量化视觉观测、指令与视觉记忆对导航决策的因果影响；进一步分析模型内部表征，考察其对导航进度与语义结构的编码，并提取抽象行为的激活向量用于概念级引导。
AI.result: 导航策略对所有输入模态均敏感，并非依赖单一模态；模型编码了导航进度并保留其VLM骨干的语义结构，可实现概念级引导；提取的抽象行为激活向量可零样本迁移至分布外真实场景，无需额外微调即提升性能。
AI.conclusion: VLN模型具有可解释性与可操控性：其决策受多模态因果影响，内部激活蕴含语义与进度信息，激活向量可作为可迁移的行为表示以改善真实场景泛化。

title: Applications of Neural Cellular Automata: State of the Art, Challenges and Opportunities
summary: Neural Cellular Automata (NCAs) are a new type of neural network architecture which enable accurate and robust inference at extremely small model sizes. Recently, NCAs have advanced to become interesting low-resource alternatives to convolution- and attention-based architectures for various tasks such as image analysis, synthetic image generation, and simulation. The rapid development and increased research interest necessitate a comprehensive review of the emerging technology. This review provides an overview of the fundamentals of NCAs, applications to medical imaging, as well as insights into the state of the art. We analyze recent modifications to the originally proposed NCA architecture with respect to their efficiency and accuracy. Furthermore, we review practical applications in real-world scenarios with a focus on medical image analysis, segmentation, classification, registration, depth estimation, and image synthesis. Finally, we identify several advantages of NCAs, research gaps, and conclude with an analysis of future opportunities for NCAs in medical applications in confined settings or areas that have particular demands for robustness or efficient data processing.

AI.tldr: 本文综述神经细胞自动机（NCA）的基本原理、架构改进与在医学影像中的应用现状，并指出研究空白与未来方向。
AI.motivation: NCA作为可在极小模型规模下实现准确、鲁棒推理的新型神经网络，近年发展迅速并受到广泛关注，但缺乏系统性综述，因此需要对该新兴技术进行全面梳理。
AI.method: 综述性研究：介绍NCA基本原理，分析近期对原始NCA架构的修改及其效率与精度表现，并回顾其在医学影像分析、分割、分类、配准、深度估计与图像合成等真实场景中的实际应用。
AI.result: 归纳了NCA相较卷积与注意力架构在低资源场景下的优势，总结了架构改进带来的效率与精度权衡，并梳理了其在医学影像多类任务中的应用现状。
AI.conclusion: NCA在资源受限或对鲁棒性、高效数据处理有特殊需求的医学应用中具备潜力，但仍存在研究空白，未来机会值得进一步探索。

title: Beyond Uniform Subspaces: Spectrum-Aware and Depth-Adaptive Fusion for Multi-Task Model Merging
summary: Model merging aims to consolidate multiple task-specific models without access to extra training process. However, existing subspace-based methods largely rely on a uniform treatment of task updates, overlooking their intrinsic spectral and depth-wise heterogeneity. We identify two key deviations from this assumption: different tasks require different subspace capacity and exhibit different tolerance to spectral transformation, while subspace projection introduces depth-dependent distortion. Based on these observations, we propose SADA-Merging, a spectrum-aware and depth-adaptive framework for data-free model merging. SADA-Merging allocates task-specific subspace capacity according to spectral complexity, adapts spectral preservation according to task-wise plasticity, and applies depth-dependent anchoring to compensate for projection-induced distortion. This enables the fusion process to adapt to both the intrinsic geometry of each task and its sensitivity across network depth. SADA-Merging operates directly on task updates and is applicable to both full fine-tuning and LoRA settings. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over existing data-free merging methods across different task scales and adaptation settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SADA-Merging，一个频谱感知且深度自适应的无数据模型合并框架，通过按任务分配子空间容量、自适应频谱保留和深度锚定，克服现有子空间方法对任务更新统一处理的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有子空间模型合并方法对任务更新进行统一处理，忽略了任务间的内在频谱异质性与深度异质性：不同任务需要不同子空间容量、对频谱变换容忍度不同，且子空间投影会引入随深度变化的失真。
AI.method: SADA-Merging包含三项机制：（1）依据频谱复杂度为每个任务分配特定子空间容量；（2）根据任务的可塑性自适应调整频谱保留程度；（3）采用深度相关的锚定来补偿投影引起的失真。该方法直接作用于任务更新，适用于全量微调与LoRA两种设置。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，在不同任务规模和适应设置下，SADA-Merging相较现有无数据合并方法均取得一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过将任务更新的频谱与深度异质性纳入合并过程，SADA-Merging实现了更自适应的无数据模型合并，验证了频谱感知与深度自适应设计的有效性。

title: UK-PRBENCH: A Paragraph-Level Precedent Retrieval Benchmark for United Kingdom Case Law
summary: Prior case retrieval (PCR) aims to identify precedent cases relevant to a given query case. Existing PCR benchmarks and methods predominantly operate at the document level, treating entire judgments as the unit of relevance. This formulation is suboptimal for legal practitioners, as judgments address multiple legal issues and only a small subset of paragraphs is relevant to a particular query. Addressing this gap, we introduce UK-PRBench, a benchmark for paragraph-level precedent retrieval in UK case law, constructed from judgments obtained from the UK National Archives and covering a broad range of UK courts and tribunals. Furthermore, we evaluate state-of-the-art retrieval models and establish baseline results. Our experiments show that paragraph-level precedent retrieval remains challenging for current retrieval approaches, highlighting substantial room for improvement. UK-PRBench provides a standardised benchmark for evaluating fine-grained precedent retrieval and advancing retrieval systems for the UK legal domain.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出UK-PRBench，一个面向英国判例法的段落级先例检索基准，构建自英国国家档案馆判例，覆盖多类法院与裁判机构，并评估了当前先进检索模型，表明段落级先例检索仍具挑战性。
AI.motivation: 现有先例检索（PCR）基准与方法多在文档级进行，将整份判决视为相关单位。但判决通常涉及多个法律议题，仅少量段落与查询相关，文档级设定对法律实务者不够理想，因此需要更细粒度的段落级先例检索资源。
AI.method: 构建UK-PRBench：基于英国国家档案馆获取的判决，覆盖广泛的英国法院与裁判机构，形成段落级先例检索基准；并评估多种当前最先进（SOTA）检索模型，建立基线结果。
AI.result: 实验显示，现有检索方法在段落级先例检索任务上仍表现不佳，说明该任务具有显著挑战，存在较大改进空间。
AI.conclusion: UK-PRBench为细粒度先例检索提供了标准化评测基准，有助于推动英国法律领域的检索系统发展。

title: Video-based Surgical Skill Assessment Using Dynamics-and-Uncertainty-Aware Tree-based Gaussian Process Classifier
comment: 4 figures, 17 tables, 31 pages. It is Under Review in scientific reports Journal
summary: The proposed pipeline integrates a representation-flow convolutional neural network with a dynamics- and uncertainty-aware tree-based Gaussian Process classifier. In this framework, latent motion dynamics are exploited both as discriminative representations and as a source of input uncertainty, enhancing robustness against temporal variations and abnormal motion transitions. Compared with conventional deep learning approaches, the proposed strategy requires less training data and offers improved computational efficiency. To further improve classification performance, we introduce novel semantic-aware compound kernels that effectively capture semantic, flow, and dynamic information embedded in surgical video features. In addition, uncertainty-aware kernels are developed to strengthen the robustness and practical applicability of the compound kernel framework. The proposed method is evaluated on two benchmark datasets, namely the JIGSAWS and the Cataract-LMM (Capsulorhexis) datasets. Experimental results demonstrate strong performance across both datasets, including the LOSO and LOUO evaluation protocols on JIGSAWS, including the subject-independent LOUO protocol on JIGSAWS, on which the framework attains a mean accuracy of \ph{96.9}\%; results under the within-subject LOSO protocol are reported for comparability with prior work, achieving competitive accuracy while substantially reducing computational cost. Overall, the proposed pipeline provides an efficient and accurate framework for video-based surgical skill assessment.

AI.tldr: 提出融合表征流卷积神经网络与动态/不确定性感知树状高斯过程分类器的流水线，用于视频手术技能评估，在两个基准数据集上取得优异性能。
AI.motivation: 传统深度学习方法用于手术技能评估需大量训练数据、计算开销大，且对时间变化和异常运动转移的鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 将表征流卷积神经网络与动态及不确定性感知的树状高斯过程分类器集成；利用潜在运动动态作为判别表征和输入不确定性来源；引入语义感知复合核（捕捉语义、流、动态信息）及不确定性感知核以增强鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在JIGSAWS和Cataract-LMM（Capsulorhexis）两个基准数据集上表现强劲；在JIGSAWS的受试者独立LOUO协议下平均准确率达96.9%；在受试者内LOSO协议下精度具竞争力且计算成本显著降低。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线为基于视频的手术技能评估提供了一种高效且准确的框架。

title: Custom Named Entity Recognition and Topic Classification for Global Health Publications
summary: How should natural language processing models be selected and adapted for global health literature in environments where annotated data and computational resources are limited? This thesis investigates these challenges through experiments on semantic tag discovery, named entity recognition (NER), and multi-label topic classification. First, skip-gram word2vec models trained on progressively larger specialized corpora are compared with BioWordVec to assess how corpus size and domain context influence tag discovery. Vocabulary coverage and qualitative evaluation indicate that broader coverage does not necessarily yield more useful domain-specific associations. The analysis then turns to entity extraction, comparing convolutional spaCy models with a RoBERTa-based transformer on 1,000 annotated sentences. Under a lenient scoring protocol, the transformer achieves 0.80 micro-F1 versus 0.65-0.69 for convolutional models, but takes 82 seconds rather than 5-6 seconds. This trade-off motivates fine-tuning convolutional models and integrating a disease recognizer that achieves 81.33% test F1 on the NCBI Disease Corpus. Combined with PDF preprocessing, entity filtering, and MeSH enrichment, the resulting pipeline supports document-level indexing. To complement entity extraction with thematic annotation, MiniLM-based few-shot classification is compared with BART-MNLI zero-shot inference across 50 topics and 1,000 handcrafted test sentences. BART-MNLI achieves 95.2% single-label accuracy versus 59%; reported multi-label accuracies are 88% and 32% under partly manual assessment. However, its higher inference cost limits practical integration. The results show where domain specialization and lightweight adaptation offer practical value, and where transformer accuracy justifies higher inference costs, providing an empirical basis for building knowledge systems under resource constraints.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨资源受限环境下全球健康文献的NLP模型选择与适配问题，围绕语义标签发现、命名实体识别（NER）和多标签主题分类展开实验，揭示领域特化与轻量化适配的适用边界，为知识系统构建提供实证依据。
AI.motivation: 在全球健康文献场景中，标注数据和计算资源往往有限，如何在此约束下选择并适配NLP模型缺乏系统性实证指导，因此本文旨在厘清领域特化与轻量化适配的价值边界及Transformer精度与推理成本的权衡。
AI.method: 采用三组实验：(1) 逐级扩大专业语料训练skip-gram word2vec并与BioWordVec对比，评估语料规模与领域上下文对语义标签发现的影响；(2) 在1,000条标注句上对比卷积spaCy模型与RoBERTa Transformer的NER性能，并微调卷积模型、集成在NCBI Disease Corpus上达81.33%测试F1的疾病识别器，配合PDF预处理、实体过滤与MeSH富集构建文档级索引流水线；(3) 在50个主题、1,000条人工测试句上对比MiniLM少样本分类与BART-MNLI零样本推理。
AI.result: 词汇覆盖率与定性评估显示更广覆盖未必带来更有用的领域关联；宽松评分下Transformer的micro-F1为0.80，卷积模型为0.65–0.69，但耗时82秒对5–6秒；疾病识别器测试F1达81.33%；单标签分类中BART-MNLI达95.2%准确率而少样本方法仅59%，多标签准确率分别为88%与32%（部分人工评估），但BART-MNLI推理成本更高。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明领域特化与轻量化适配在部分任务中具有实用价值，而在另一些任务中Transformer的精度优势可抵消其更高推理成本，为资源受限条件下构建知识系统提供了实证基础与模型选择依据。

title: Relationally Grounded Latent World Models for Autonomous Driving
comment: Accepted at the NeuRo-SymBolic World Models (RoBoWoMo) Workshop at IROS 2026
summary: Latent world models learn predictive representations for autonomous driving, but the relational semantics these states preserve often remain implicit. We investigate whether traffic scene graphs can serve as privileged semantic supervision for latent world representations. Building on LAW, we construct actor-centric scene graphs from nuScenes 3D annotations, encode their serialized relational structure using a frozen text embedding model, and align the visual latent representations with this semantic target during training. We remove the supervision branch at inference, so it requires neither scene graphs nor 3D annotations and adds no test-time computation. On nuScenes, our method reduces average trajectory L2 error from 0.661 to 0.622 (5.9%) and collision rate from 0.456 to 0.217 (52.4%) relative to our retrained LAW baseline. It also outperforms an unstructured caption-style semantic target, supporting the benefit of explicit relational structure for latent world-model representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文探究将交通场景图（scene graph）作为特权语义监督，对齐LAW潜在世界模型的视觉表征；推理时去除监督分支，不增加测试开销。在nuScenes上轨迹L2误差降低5.9%，碰撞率降低52.4%。
AI.motivation: 潜在世界模型虽能学习预测性表征，但其状态所保留的关系语义通常是隐式的，缺乏显式的结构化语义约束；作者希望验证交通场景图能否为潜在世界表征提供有效的特权语义监督。
AI.method: 在LAW基础上，从nuScenes 3D标注构建以主体（actor）为中心的场景图，用冻结的文本嵌入模型编码其序列化关系结构，并在训练中将视觉潜在表征与该语义目标对齐；推理阶段移除监督分支，故不需场景图或3D标注，也不增加测试时计算。同时与无结构的caption式语义目标进行对比。
AI.result: 在nuScenes上，相对重新训练的LAW基线，平均轨迹L2误差从0.661降至0.622（降低5.9%），碰撞率从0.456降至0.217（降低52.4%）；且优于无结构的caption式语义目标。
AI.conclusion: 显式关系结构对潜在世界模型的表征学习具有优势，交通场景图可作为有效的特权语义监督，在零额外推理开销下提升预测精度并显著降低碰撞风险。

title: FedMust: Semi-supervised Multi-task Student-Teacher Federated Learning for Multi-organ CT Segmentation
comment: This manuscript has been accepted for publication at the 7th International Conference on Medical Imaging and Computer-Aided Diagnosis (MICAD 2026)
summary: Multi-organ segmentation using deep learning requires large amounts of annotated patient data; however, institutions often lack sufficiently large and diverse annotated datasets. Privacy constraints further prevent institutions from sharing patient data to overcome this limitation. Moreover, due to the labor-intensive nature of annotation and the scarcity of diverse expertise, institutions typically have labels for only a small portion of their local data, leaving the larger unlabeled portion unused. In this work, we propose a flexible semi-supervised federated multi-task student-teacher framework that leverages federated learning (FL) to improve multi-organ segmentation using both labeled and unlabeled data across participating sites. At each communication round, the proposed framework initiates local training, where clients with labels for the same task form a federation to produce an aggregated teacher model. The resulting teachers generate task-specific features for all data at each client. Subsequently, all clients form a second federation to train a multi-task student model with a shared encoder and task-specific decoders that replicate the teacher-generated features across all segmentation tasks. The aggregated student model is then used to update the local teachers and initiate the next training round. Extensive experiments demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed method compared with local and federated single-organ models, yielding an average performance gain of 13 percent across clients. The experiments also demonstrated the impact of multi-task learning and unlabeled data and the applicability of the framework in relaxing labeled-data requirements for client participation. The code is available at https://github.com/AshknMrd/FedMust.

AI.tldr: 提出FedMust半监督联邦多任务师生框架，跨站点利用有标注与无标注数据协同提升多器官分割，平均性能提升13%。
AI.motivation: 多器官分割依赖大量标注数据，但机构普遍存在标注数据规模小、多样性不足的问题；隐私约束又阻碍数据共享以弥补这一缺陷。同时，标注工作量大且专业人才稀缺，导致各机构仅有少量本地数据被标注，大量无标注数据被闲置。因此需要一种能在不共享原始数据的前提下，同时利用有标注和无标注数据、并缓解标注需求的协作学习方案。
AI.method: 提出灵活的FedMust半监督联邦多任务师生框架。每轮通信先进行本地训练：拥有同一任务标注的客户端组成联邦，聚合出教师模型；教师为各客户端全部数据生成任务特定特征；随后所有客户端组成第二个联邦，训练共享编码器加任务特定解码器的多任务学生模型，以复现教师生成的所有分割任务特征；聚合后的学生模型用于更新本地教师并进入下一轮。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法相比本地模型与联邦单器官模型均更有效，在客户端上平均性能提升13%。实验还验证了多任务学习与无标注数据的作用，以及该框架在放宽客户端参与所需标注数据要求方面的适用性。
AI.conclusion: FedMust通过联邦师生机制在隐私约束下整合跨站点有标注与无标注数据，实现多任务多器官分割的知识共享，降低了对本地标注数据的依赖，具有实际部署价值，代码已开源。

title: High-resolution Nitrogen Dioxide Maps Reveal Exposure Limit Breaches across Europe
summary: Nitrogen dioxide (NO2) is a common air pollutant, released into the atmosphere through the incomplete burning of fossil fuels, and associated with respiratory and cardiovascular diseases in humans. Ambient NO2 concentrations are regulated through air-quality limits assessed with a sparse network of fixed monitors. The revised EU Ambient Air Quality Directive (2024/2881) introduces a daily NO2 limit to be met from 2030. At present, neither the regulatory monitoring network nor existing coarse, annual-mean models can resolve NO2 concentrations at the spatio-temporal resolutions necessary to assess compliance. Here we map NO2 across Europe at hourly and 10m resolution with a machine-learning model that combines ground monitors with satellite, reanalysis, land-use, traffic and emission data and returns a calibrated predictive distribution at every location. Validated against held-out regulatory monitors and independent citizen-science campaigns, the maps resolve high-resolution spatiotemporal NO2 gradients for 110 metropolitan areas in Europe. We reconstruct the daily compliance statistic across those regions and find limit breaches in 91 EU air quality zones deemed compliant by the regulatory monitoring network, covering a population of approximately 135M. Beyond air quality zones and monitor locations, an estimated 9-9.4% (20M) of the population in mapped regions lives in areas where the daily NO2 limit is breached. The high-resolution maps offer a route to population-scale assessment of compliance with the 2030 limits.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建机器学习模型，以10米、逐小时分辨率绘制欧洲NO2浓度图，并评估2030年欧盟日均NO2限值的达标情况，发现监管网络遗漏了大量超标区域。
AI.motivation: NO2是常见空气污染物，与呼吸系统和心血管疾病相关。修订后的欧盟空气质量指令（2024/2881）引入2030年起执行的日均NO2限值，但现有监管监测网络稀疏，且已有模型为粗分辨率的年均值模型，无法在所需时空分辨率上评估达标情况。
AI.method: 构建机器学习模型，融合地面监测站数据与卫星、再分析、土地利用、交通和排放数据，在每小时、10米分辨率上绘制欧洲NO2浓度图，并在每个位置给出校准后的预测分布。以留出的监管监测站和独立公民科学观测活动进行验证。
AI.result: 模型成功解析欧洲110个大都市区的高分辨率时空NO2梯度。重建这些区域的日均达标统计量后，发现在91个被监管网络判定为达标的EU空气质量区内存在限值超标，涉及约1.35亿人口；在制图区域内，估计9%–9.4%（约2000万）人口居住在日均NO2限值超标地区。
AI.conclusion: 高分辨率NO2制图可揭示监管监测网络未能捕捉的超标区域，为2030年EU日均NO2限值的群体尺度达标评估提供了可行路径。

title: Written as a Record, Read as an Address: What a Forward Pass Leaves in an Operation's KV Cache
summary: When a language model reads an operation such as "Swap the contents of Box F and Box B", its forward pass writes keys and values for those tokens into the KV cache. Prior work on entity tracking establishes what models use: bindings are resolved at query time rather than stored as explicit latent state. We ask what they write at the operation span and how it is accessed. We split a forward pass into a frozen writer and a reader: the writer's cache is recomputed without gradients, while the reader sees only the instruction and operation tokens, with all state descriptions hidden, and is trained in isolation. Anything the reader recovers was therefore already present in the unmodified cache. On a synthetic boxes task, a base reader recovers $\leq 0.06$ of queried bindings against $0.75$--$1.00$ after training, and recoverability tracks the operation's read/write footprint. We find two modes of access. Across Llama-3.1-8B and Mistral-7B, operation-span transplants causally redirect which visible state is read even when the two worlds hold identical values, revealing a routing record. Isolation training preserves routing and adds direct access to the payload, the value the operation read, from the single operand-name token in a narrow mid-depth band (layers 12--15 of 32 in Llama-3.1-8B, 14--17 in Mistral-7B) --- the same site that holds the routing record. The same recipe extends to further operations, ToMi and GSM8K, but is bounded by training coverage and costs open-book accuracy. Operation tokens thus leave localized, causally recoverable records that support both routing and direct payload access, though the model that writes them reads mainly the address they carry and not the value.

AI.tldr: 该论文将一次前向传播拆分为冻结的writer与独立的reader，探究语言模型在处理"交换盒子内容"等操作指令时，KV cache中操作span到底写入了什么、又如何被读取。
AI.motivation: 先前关于实体追踪的工作已确立模型并非以显式潜状态存储绑定，而是在查询时解析。但操作token处究竟写入什么、以何方式被访问尚不清楚，本文旨在回答这一问题。
AI.method: 把前向传播拆为冻结writer与reader：writer的cache无梯度重算，reader仅见指令与操作token（隐藏状态描述）并单独训练，因此reader恢复出的内容必已存在于未修改的cache中。在合成盒子任务上评估，并跨Llama-3.1-8B与Mistral-7B进行操作span移植实验，同时扩展至ToMi与GSM8K。
AI.result: 基线reader对查询绑定的恢复率≤0.06，训练后达0.75–1.00，可恢复性随操作读写足迹变化。发现两种访问模式：操作span移植可因果性地改变读取哪一可见状态（路由记录）；隔离训练保留路由并新增对payload（操作所读值）的直接访问，位于单个操作数名token的中层窄带（Llama-3.1-8B第12–15层，Mistral-7B第14–17层），与路由记录所在位置相同。
AI.conclusion: 操作token留下局部化、可因果恢复的记录，同时支持路由与直接payload访问；但写入这些记录的模型主要读取其携带的地址而非值。该方案可扩展至其他操作、ToMi与GSM8K，但受训练覆盖限制并会牺牲开卷准确率。

title: Qwen-Audio-3.1-Realtime: Towards Reliable Agentic Voice Interaction
summary: Real-time voice assistants must reason over evolving requests, execute actions, and follow conversational rules. Qwen-Audio-3.1-Realtime brings these requirements together through Think, Act, and Speak and Coordinate. Think combines Core-Cocktail supervised fine-tuning with Multimodality and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (M$^{2}$-OPD) to transfer language capabilities and develop native audio skills. Act uses self-evolving executable environments and multi-granularity rollouts for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), teaching the model to use tools, interpret feedback, and complete tasks. Speak and Coordinate aligns whether, when, and how the assistant speaks or acts. We evaluate audio reasoning, multilingual understanding, tool use, conversational behavior, full-duplex interaction, and safety. Compared with Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realtime, 3.1 raises overall task success from 78.4% to 82.0% on our half-duplex speech-to-text adaptation of $τ$-Voice. On speech-to-speech Full-Duplex-Bench v1.5, the response rate to background speech falls from 73.0% to 13.0%. We also present a separate Voice Harness prototype, using Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realtime as its foreground, that extends spoken interaction to persistent tasks through foreground--background coordination and memory.

AI.tldr: Qwen-Audio-3.1-Realtime 通过 Think、Act、Speak and Coordinate 三部分统一实时语音助手的推理、执行与对话规则能力，任务成功率与全双工交互表现显著提升。
AI.motivation: 实时语音助手需在动态演化的请求下进行推理、执行动作并遵守对话规则，现有系统难以同时满足这些要求，因此需要统一建模 Reasoning、Acting 与 Conversational Rules。
AI.method: Think：Core-Cocktail 监督微调结合多模态与多教师在线策略蒸馏（M²-OPD），迁移语言能力并习得原生音频技能；Act：自演化可执行环境与多粒度 rollout 用于 GRPO，训练工具使用、反馈理解与任务完成；Speak and Coordinate：对齐助手是否、何时以及如何发声或行动。
AI.result: 相比 Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realtime，在 τ-Voice 半双工语音转文本适配任务上总体任务成功率从 78.4% 提升至 82.0%；在 speech-to-speech Full-Duplex-Bench v1.5 上，对背景语音的响应率从 73.0% 降至 13.0%。另提出 Voice Harness 原型，以 Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realtime 为前台，通过前台—后台协调与记忆扩展持续任务的口语交互。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过 Think、Act、Speak and Coordinate 的统一框架有效提升实时语音助手在推理、工具使用、对话行为、全双工交互与安全等方面的综合表现。

title: Assessing Readability with LLMs: The Role of Reasoning and Few-Shot Prompting
summary: Readability assessment is essential for tailoring texts to intended audiences across educational, healthcare, and information retrieval domains. However, traditional readability formulas struggle to generalize across genres and languages, while supervised machine learning models rely on scarce, domain-specific annotated corpora, limiting their applicability--particularly for less-resourced languages. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a highly scalable, multilingual alternative that requires no task-specific training, yet the impact of advanced prompting strategies on their performance remains underexplored. In this paper, we conduct a systematic benchmark of diverse open-source LLMs for multilingual readability assessment, focusing on the prediction of discrete readability levels required by educational frameworks. In addition to English, we evaluate our approach on a less-resourced language, Slovenian, to establish whether LLMs remain effective in low-resource settings. Specifically, we investigate the influence of explicit reasoning, demonstrating that Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting and reasoning-oriented models yield significant improvements over direct answering. Furthermore, our exploration of few-shot in-context learning reveals that providing just one labelled example per category (1-shot) substantially enhances prediction quality compared to zero-shot settings, with additional examples offering diminishing returns. By comprehensively comparing these approaches against traditional unsupervised metrics and state-of-the-art supervised baselines, we establish the viability of out-of-the-box LLMs as robust, cross-lingual readability assessors.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评测开源LLM在多语言可读性评估中的表现，论证CoT提示与推理型模型、单样本上下文学习均可显著提升离散可读性等级预测效果，从而验证即用型LLM作为跨语言可读性评估器的可行性。
AI.motivation: 可读性评估对教育、医疗与信息检索等领域的文本适龄化至关重要，但传统可读性公式跨体裁、跨语言泛化性差，有监督模型依赖稀缺的领域标注语料，在低资源语言上尤为受限。LLM虽具可扩展、多语言、免任务训练的优势，但高级提示策略对其可读性评估性能的影响尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 对多种开源LLM进行多语言可读性评估的系统基准测试，任务为预测教育框架所需的离散可读性等级；在英语之外引入低资源语言斯洛文尼亚语；对比直接回答、CoT提示与推理型模型；考察few-shot上下文学习（0-shot、1-shot及更多示例）的影响；并与传统无监督指标及SOTA有监督基线进行对比。
AI.result: CoT提示与推理导向模型相较直接回答有显著提升；few-shot中每类仅需一个标注示例（1-shot）即可大幅提升预测质量，继续增加示例收益递减；综合对比表明即用型LLM在跨语言可读性评估上具备与无监督指标及有监督基线竞争的稳健性能。
AI.conclusion: 即用型LLM可作为稳健、跨语言的可读性评估器，无需任务特定训练，在低资源语言场景下依然有效；显式推理与极少示例的上下文学习是提升其性能的关键策略。

title: Circuit Hypernetworks for Quantum-Augmented Diffusion Language Models
summary: Language models can be adapted by changing the computations applied to individual tokens. Quantum circuits offer one such approach, but evaluating wider circuits inside a large model can be computationally demanding. Here we introduce HyperQ, which adds token-conditioned quantum residual branches to a frozen masked-diffusion language model. A quantum residual branch is a module in each transformer block that reads a token's hidden state, emits the coordinates of that token's circuit, executes it, and adds the measured values back through a residual connection. The backbone remains frozen, and only the added branches are trained. Within each branch, a lightweight circuit hypernetwork emits token-specific rotation angles, coupling strengths, and measurement axes in a shared sparse circuit structure. The required expectation values have an exact classical expression whose evaluation cost grows linearly with the qubit count, enabling circuits from 16 to 64 qubits to be trained within a 1.1-billion-parameter backbone. Across downstream benchmarks, increasing circuit width raises the average score from 47.65 to 54.30. At 64 qubits, HyperQ exceeds the backbone and its low-rank-adapted counterpart by 4.71 and 3.67 points, respectively. HyperQ is fine-tuned on 20,000 prompt-response pairs, compared with 200,000 for the classical baselines. These findings support token-conditioned circuit emission as a tractable architectural approach to quantum-augmented language modelling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HyperQ，将 token 条件化的量子残差分支加入冻结的掩码扩散语言模型，仅训练新增分支，使 16–64 量子比特电路可在 11 亿参数骨干内训练，显著提升下游平均分。
AI.motivation: 语言模型可通过改变作用于单个 token 的计算来实现适配，量子电路是其中一种途径。但在大模型内部评估较宽的量子电路计算开销大，因此需要一种可扩展且高效的方式将量子计算引入语言模型。
AI.method: HyperQ 在每个 transformer 块加入 token 条件化的量子残差分支：该分支读取 token 隐状态，输出该 token 电路的坐标并执行，再将测量值经残差连接加回。骨干模型保持冻结，仅训练新增分支。分支内使用轻量级电路超网络，在共享稀疏电路结构上生成 token 特定的旋转角、耦合强度和测量轴。所需期望值存在精确经典表达式，其评估成本随量子比特数线性增长。
AI.result: 在多项下游基准上，增加电路宽度使平均分从 47.65 提升至 54.30。在 64 量子比特时，HyperQ 分别超出骨干模型及其低秩适配版本 4.71 和 3.67 分。HyperQ 仅在 20,000 对提示-响应对上微调，而经典基线使用了 200,000 对。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持 token 条件化电路发射作为一种可行的架构方法，用于量子增强语言建模。

title: Ev-YOLO: Uncertainty-Aware Object Detection via a Unified Evidential Formulation
comment: Preprint / submitted manuscript. This version has not undergone peer review. To appear in the proceedings of the 9th International Conference on Belief Functions (BFAS 2026), Springer, LNAI
summary: Reliable uncertainty estimation is essential for deploying object detectors in autonomous systems operating in uncertain environments. Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) provides a principled framework for uncertainty-aware classification by representing network outputs as evidence and interpreting predictions through subjective logic. However, existing evidential object detectors typically combine evidential classification with regression uncertainty models that do not share the same theoretical foundation. In this work, we propose an evidential version of YOLOv8 in which both classification and bounding-box regression are formulated within a common evidential framework. Our approach exploits YOLOv8's distribution-based bounding-box representation, allowing the evidential formulation to be applied not only to classification but also to localisation. As a result, both tasks produce belief, uncertainty, and probability estimates that can be interpreted within the Dempster--Shafer framework. Experiments on KITTI, MUSES, and nuScenes show that the resulting detector remains broadly competitive with standard YOLOv8 in terms of detection accuracy while providing a localisation uncertainty that effectively discriminates between correct and erroneous detections. Moreover, this uncertainty becomes increasingly discriminative under domain shift.

AI.tldr: 本文提出YOLOv8的证据版本，将分类与边界框回归统一到证据深度学习框架下，在Dempster-Shafer框架内产生信念、不确定性与概率估计。在KITTI、MUSES、nuScenes上，检测精度与标准YOLOv8大致相当，而定位不确定性可有效区分正确与错误检测，且在域偏移下判别性进一步增强。
AI.motivation: 可靠的不确定性估计对部署于不确定环境中的自主系统目标检测器至关重要。证据深度学习提供了有原则的不确定性感知分类框架，但现有证据目标检测器通常将证据分类与理论基础不一致的回归不确定性模型结合，导致分类与定位的不确定性缺乏统一解释。
AI.method: 提出证据版YOLOv8：利用YOLOv8基于分布的边界框表示，将证据公式化同时应用于分类与定位，使两项任务都在同一证据框架下产生信念、不确定性与概率估计，并可在Dempster-Shafer框架内解释。
AI.result: 在KITTI、MUSES、nuScenes上，所得检测器检测精度与标准YOLOv8大致相当，同时提供能有效区分正确与错误检测的定位不确定性；在域偏移下该不确定性的判别能力增强。
AI.conclusion: 统一证据框架可在保持检测精度的同时提供可解释、判别性强的定位不确定性，尤其适用于域偏移场景，为不确定性感知目标检测提供了理论与实现一致的方案。

title: Muon Can Outperform Dedicated Continual Learning Methods
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Presented at the 5th Conference on Lifelong Learning Agents (CoLLAs), Work-in-Progress Track, 2026. Sebastian George Sincari and Bogdan Alexandru Gheorghe contributed equally
summary: Continual learning with Low-Rank Adapters (LoRA) typically mitigates forgetting by penalizing the overlap between a new update and the accumulated past weights, which discourages certain update directions without controlling how an update distributes its energy over the ones that remain. We ask whether that restriction has to be task-aware, or whether a generic one supplied by the optimizer is enough. We train a plain incremental LoRA (IncLoRA) with Muon, which orthogonalizes each update, and compare it against O-LoRA and ELLA over five seeds and three task orders on the Standard CL Benchmark and three seeds on TRACE. IncLoRA+Muon reaches the accuracy band of the dedicated methods on Standard CL and improves on every AdamW configuration on TRACE. One update-constraining mechanism is enough, whether it comes from the loss or from the optimizer; on Standard CL a second one does not help, and for the most restrictive method it costs 8.4 points of accuracy and the plasticity to fit each task. What separates the two optimizers is not the size of the update, which under Muon is 0.91 to 2.06 times that under AdamW, but how it is distributed. AdamW confines it to between 1.4 and 1.8 effective singular directions, Muon spreads it over 7.0, and the two do not overlap in any tracked run. Part of the advantage usually attributed to dedicated CL methods may therefore be explained by the geometry of the optimizer's updates.

AI.tldr: 该论文质疑LoRA持续学习中"任务感知更新约束"的必要性，提出使用Muon优化器对增量LoRA更新做正交化，即可以单一通用机制达到专用方法的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有LoRA持续学习通过惩罚新更新与累积历史权重的重叠来缓解遗忘，但这种做法只抑制某些更新方向，并未控制更新在剩余方向上的能量分布。作者想探究这种限制是否必须任务感知，抑或优化器提供的通用限制就足够。
AI.method: 训练朴素增量LoRA（IncLoRA）并配以Muon优化器（对每次更新做正交化），在Standard CL Benchmark（5个随机种子、3种任务顺序）和TRACE（3个种子）上与O-LoRA、ELLA对比；同时分析两种优化器更新的奇异方向分布。
AI.result: IncLoRA+Muon在Standard CL上达到专用方法的精度区间，并在TRACE上优于所有AdamW配置。增加第二种约束机制在Standard CL上无益，对最严格的方法反而损失8.4个精度点及拟合各任务的可塑性。Muon更新幅度为AdamW的0.91–2.06倍，但AdamW将更新限制在1.4–1.8个有效奇异方向，Muon则分布在7.0个方向，二者在跟踪运行中无重叠。
AI.conclusion: 一个更新约束机制就足够，无论来自损失还是优化器。专用CL方法的部分优势可能源于优化器更新的几何特性，而非任务感知约束本身。

title: Think Like a World Model, Act Like a VLA: Distilling World-Model Representations into Compact Robot Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map observations to actions with no objective that accounts for how the world responds, so their robustness is bounded primarily by data coverage. World models carry precisely that missing objective and are better grounded for it, yet rolling the future forward costs seconds per decision and rules them out of the control loop. We show the two can be separated. What a world model knows about physical scenes lives in its internal features; generating the future is merely the objective that produced them, so the grounding can be inherited while the generative machinery is left behind. We add one feature-alignment term to ordinary VLA training: a frozen world model is run over the training frames once and cached, and the student learns to agree with that cache. No teacher is loaded during training, the projector is discarded after it, and the deployed policy is identical to the undistilled baseline, running in 32ms and 1.86GB on a consumer RTX5090, so every gain is attributable to the representation rather than to added capacity or test-time compute. A 0.8B student reaches 97.9% on LIBERO, improves from 48.2% to 50.5% on RoboCasa-GR1 humanoid manipulation, and the same objective carries over to real hardware, on both a single-arm and a bimanual platform. The gain survives changes of student scale, backbone, alignment layer, and teacher, indicating a broad representational prior rather than a fragile alignment between two particular networks. Project page: https://thaw-vla.trung-dt.com/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将世界模型与生成能力解耦：冻结的世界模型特征被缓存，学生VLA模型仅通过一个特征对齐项继承其物理场景表征，不加载教师、不增加部署开销，即以32ms/1.86GB的原始策略获得鲁棒性提升。
AI.motivation: VLA模型以观测直接映射动作，缺少考虑"世界如何响应"的目标函数，其鲁棒性主要受数据覆盖范围限制。世界模型恰好具备该目标，但每次决策需秒级滚动未来，无法进入控制回路。因此动机是：能否继承世界模型的物理接地能力，而抛弃其昂贵的生成机制。
AI.method: 核心洞察是——世界模型对物理场景的知识存在于内部特征中，生成未来只是产生这些特征的目标，因此可继承接地、舍弃生成机制。具体做法：在普通VLA训练中加一个特征对齐项；冻结的世界模型对训练帧只运行一次并将特征缓存；学生被训练去与缓存保持一致（投影器训练后丢弃，训练时不加载教师）。部署策略与未蒸馏基线完全一致。
AI.result: 0.8B学生在LIBERO达97.9%；RoboCasa-GR1人形操作从48.2%提升到50.5%；同一目标迁移到真机，在单臂与双臂平台上均有效。增益在学生规模、骨干、对齐层与教师更换下均保持，说明是广泛的表征先验而非两个特定网络间的脆弱对齐。部署为32ms、1.86GB（消费级RTX5090）。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型的表征价值可从其生成机制中剥离并低成本迁移到VLA。由于改动仅是训练目标中的一项，且部署模型与基线完全相同，所有提升均可归因于表征本身而非额外容量或测试时计算。稳健的跨配置迁移性表明这是一种通用表征先验，而非特定网络间的对齐技巧。

title: What Makes a Good Medical Image Tokenizer? Rethinking Reconstruction and Generation in Medical Image Tokenization
summary: Latent diffusion models now dominate medical image generation, and every such pipeline rests on a \emph{tokenizer} that compresses images into the latent codes for image generation to operate on. Thereby, the tokenizer choice bounds every downstream task from reconstruction fidelity and generation quality to the representations available for downstream analysis. Yet, medical imaging pipelines routinely utilize tokenizers from natural imaging on the hypothesis that their behavior carries over. However, this is an assumption never tested in the medical imaging regime, where datasets are orders of magnitude smaller and images exhibit far lower inter-sample variance. We present a systematic evaluation of medical image tokenizers evaluating thirty configurations across ten model families on twelve datasets at three compression factors, spanning reconstruction, generation, latent geometry, downstream classification, and memorization. We find that (1) performance on image reconstruction and generation strongly correlate, unlike prior reports on natural images; (2) modern tokenizers use nearly all of their codebook entries, but still leave most of the latent space unused; (3) training-set memorization is mild and is further suppressed by stronger latent space compression; and (4) discrete quantization can largely preserve downstream classification, with lookup-free schemes being the main exception.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评测了医学图像生成中的tokenizer，覆盖10个模型家族、30种配置、12个数据集、3种压缩率，考察重建、生成、潜在几何、下游分类与记忆化五个维度，揭示了与自然图像领域不同的若干规律。
AI.motivation: 潜在扩散模型已成为医学图像生成的主流范式，而每个流程都依赖tokenizer将图像压缩为潜在码。tokenizer的选择决定了从重建保真度、生成质量到下游分析表征的所有下游任务。然而医学图像流程通常直接沿用自然图像的tokenizer，假设其行为可以迁移。该假设从未在医学图像场景中被检验——医学数据集规模小几个数量级，且样本间方差远低。因此需要系统评估医学图像tokenizer的真实行为。
AI.method: 对医学图像tokenizer进行系统评估：涵盖10个模型家族、30种配置、12个数据集、3种压缩因子；评估维度包括重建、生成、潜在空间几何、下游分类和记忆化。
AI.result: (1) 与自然图像上的既有报告不同，图像重建与生成性能在医学图像上强相关；(2) 现代tokenizer几乎用尽码本条目，但仍留下大部分潜在空间未被使用；(3) 训练集记忆化程度轻微，且更强的潜在空间压缩可进一步抑制记忆化；(4) 离散量化基本能保持下游分类性能，主要例外是无查找表（lookup-free）方案。
AI.conclusion: 医学图像场景下tokenizer行为与自然图像存在显著差异，直接沿用自然图像tokenizer的假设不成立；压缩率、量化方式对生成、几何结构、分类与记忆化各有不同影响，需针对医学图像特性重新评估与选择tokenizer。

title: Adapting Tree-Structured Speculative Decoding to DeepSeek-V4 for Efficient Inference
summary: Repeated execution of the target model during autoregressive decoding is a major source of LLM inference latency. Unlike linear speculation, which follows a single candidate chain, tree-structured speculation retains multiple branches from shared prefixes; under the same budget, this broader coverage can improve acceptance and efficiency. Adapting it to DeepSeek-V4 is nontrivial: its CSA/HCA online compressed attention concentrates the difficulty on the target-verify side, where branches diverging from a shared prefix compress into different states, breaking cross-branch state consistency. We integrate tree-structured speculative decoding into the DeepSeek-V4-Flash pipeline via branch-aware causal verification, temporary state isolation, and accepted-path state refresh, keeping verification and compressed-state updates consistent across branches. Across budgets D=5 to D=8, batch sizes 1 to 64, and three datasets (GSM8K, MBPP, ShareGPT), tree speculation achieves a higher accepted length than the matched linear configurations in all settings (e.g., at D=8 about 2.83--3.41 versus 2.39--2.84) and improves throughput in nearly all configurations---marginal only at the smallest budget---by up to about 18.5%. More importantly, the gains follow stable, transferable regularities: the relative gain grows with the budget and is most pronounced for less predictable workloads at small-to-medium batch sizes, while beyond a certain budget throughput plateaus and decouples from the still-rising accepted length. These results show that retaining multiple candidate paths under the same budget can effectively improve DeepSeek-V4 decoding efficiency, and offer experience for adapting speculative decoding to future models with compressed, sparse, or structured context representations.

AI.tldr: 本文将树结构推测解码集成到DeepSeek-V4-Flash，通过分支感知因果验证、临时状态隔离与接受路径状态刷新解决CSA/HCA压缩注意力下的跨分支状态一致性问题，在多个预算、批量与数据集上提升接受长度与吞吐。
AI.motivation: 自回归解码中目标模型重复执行是LLM推理延迟的主要来源。与单链的线性推测相比，树结构推测在共享前缀下保留多条分支，同等预算下覆盖更广，可提升接受率与效率。但将其实用于DeepSeek-V4存在困难：其CSA/HCA在线压缩注意力把难点集中在目标验证侧，同一前缀的不同分支会被压缩成不同状态，破坏跨分支状态一致性。
AI.method: 在DeepSeek-V4-Flash pipeline中集成树结构推测解码，采用三项关键机制：分支感知因果验证（branch-aware causal verification）、临时状态隔离（temporary state isolation）以及接受路径状态刷新（accepted-path state refresh），从而在跨分支间保持验证与压缩状态更新的一致性。
AI.result: 在预算D=5至D=8、批量1至64、三个数据集（GSM8K、MBPP、ShareGPT）的全部设置下，树推测的接受长度均高于匹配的线性配置（如D=8时约2.83–3.41对2.39–2.84）；在几乎所有配置下吞吐提升，仅最小预算时提升甚微，最高约18.5%。增益呈现稳定可迁移的规律：相对增益随预算增大而增大，在中小批量、可预测性较低的工作负载上最显著；超过一定预算后吞吐趋于平台并与其仍在上升的接受长度解耦。
AI.conclusion: 在相同预算下保留多条候选路径可有效提升DeepSeek-V4的解码效率，并为将推测解码适配到具有压缩、稀疏或结构化上下文表示的未来模型提供了经验。

title: ReSTI: A Source-Grounded Audit and Repair of STI-Bench
summary: Spatial--temporal benchmarks are valid only when their questions, source annotations, and answer options identify the same physical quantity. We audit STI-Bench against the official ScanNet, Waymo, and Omni6DPose sources and find systematic coordinate-system and timestamp errors, under-specified targets and times, and disagreements between keyed options and answer details. We introduce ReSTI, a source-backed revision that reconstructs every recoverable answer under an explicit target, time, coordinate system, physical quantity, and unit. Source reconstruction reveals task-level geometric failures: ScanNet Grounding omits the required alignment between annotation and raw camera coordinate systems, while Orientation measures camera rotation on the wrong plane. ReSTI replaces these labels with explicit, source-consistent geometric definitions and corrects other source-verifiable defects, including Waymo poses evaluated at the wrong timestamp. Across 2,064 legacy questions, ReSTI retains 1,782 questions and records 282 evidence-backed exclusions. ReSTI therefore provides a conservative and source-traceable basis for evaluating precise video spatial--temporal reasoning. Project page: https://github.com/pengzhansun/ReSTI.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计了时空基准STI-Bench，发现其存在坐标系、时间戳、目标与选项不一致等系统性错误，并提出基于源数据的修订版ReSTI。
AI.motivation: 时空基准只有在问题、源标注与答案选项指向同一物理量时才有效；而STI-Bench可能存在标注不可追溯或不一致的问题，影响精确视频时空推理评估的可靠性。
AI.method: 对照ScanNet、Waymo、Omni6DPose官方源数据审计STI-Bench；提出ReSTI，在明确目标、时间、坐标系、物理量与单位下重建每个可恢复答案，并记录有证据支持的排除项。
AI.result: 发现任务级几何失败：ScanNet Grounding遗漏标注与原始相机坐标系所需对齐，Orientation在错误平面上测相机旋转，Waymo姿态在错误时间戳评估；在2,064个旧问题中，ReSTI保留1,782个，记录282个有证据支持的排除。
AI.conclusion: ReSTI提供了一个保守且源可追溯的评估基础，可用于精确视频时空推理评测。

title: GraphSVR: q-Space--Aware Graph-Based Slice-to-Volume Registration for Diffusion MRI
summary: Diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) remains highly vulnerable to subject motion, particularly in time-efficient protocols and in motion-prone populations. While slice-to-volume registration (SVR) can mitigate inter-slice and inter-stack misalignment, diffusion MRI introduces additional complexity due to diffusion-direction-dependent contrast and the requirement to align dozens of measurements within a common reference frame, effectively yielding a 4D registration problem. Existing approaches rely primarily on sequential modeling or pairwise similarity and often degrade under sparse gradient sampling or severe motion. We introduce GraphSVR, a q-space-aware graph-based framework for 4D SVR registration in DWI. GraphSVR represents slice groups as nodes in an acquisition-structured graph, with edges encoding temporal proximity, spatial slice geometry and diffusion encoding relationships. A graph neural network predicts globally consistent stack-wise rigid motion, optimized in a self-supervised, zero-shot manner using only an anatomical reference image, without requiring paired ground-truth motion. We evaluate GraphSVR using both fully synthetic diffusion simulations and realistic recombination-based simulations from real acquisitions with controllable motion severity and gradient sparsity. Performance is quantified using grid error (mm) and rotation error relative to known ground-truth transforms. Under severe motion, GraphSVR reduces grid error and rotation error by 73% compared to FSL eddy, the standard DWI motion-correction method, with the largest gains observed in sparse-direction regimes. These results demonstrate that explicitly modeling acquisition structure through graph-based reasoning improves robustness and global consistency in 4D DWI motion estimation. Code is available at https://github.com/nogakertes/GraphSVR.git.

AI.tldr: 提出GraphSVR，一种q空间感知的图神经框架，用于DWI的4D切片到体积配准，以自监督零样本方式估计全局一致的运动，在严重运动下较FSL eddy显著降低误差。
AI.motivation: DWI对受试者运动高度敏感，稀疏采样协议和易动人群尤甚。SVR虽可缓解层间/堆栈错位，但弥散MRI存在方向依赖对比，需将数十次测量对齐到统一参考框架，构成4D配准问题；现有方法多依赖序列建模或成对相似度，在梯度稀疏或严重运动下性能下降。
AI.method: GraphSVR将切片组建模为采集结构图中的节点，边编码时间邻近性、空间切片几何与弥散编码关系；用图神经网络预测全局一致的堆栈级刚体运动，仅以解剖参考图像进行自监督零样本优化，无需成对运动真值。采用全合成弥散仿真与基于真实采集的可控运动重组仿真进行评估。
AI.result: 以网格误差(mm)与旋转误差（相对已知真值变换）量化。严重运动下，GraphSVR较标准DWI校正方法FSL eddy将网格误差和旋转误差降低73%，且在稀疏方向情形增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 显式通过图推理建模采集结构，可提升4D DWI运动估计的鲁棒性与全局一致性。代码已开源。

title: MiTHras: Task-specific Hierarchical Semi-supervised Contrastive Masked Autoencoder for Mitotic Figure Analysis
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Includes supplementary material
summary: Mitotic figure (MF) analysis supports tumor grading and prognostic assessment, but automated models remain sensitive to differences in tissue type and image acquisition. We present MiTHras, a task-specific pretraining framework that combines pseudo-label-guided image- and token-level contrastive learning with masked reconstruction. We construct TCGA-MF-Pseudo, a corpus of 1.8 million cell-centered images from 14 TCGA cohorts spanning 11 organ sites. Comprehensive evaluation on MF classification, detection, count-based survival prediction, and subtype classification demonstrates the efficacy of MiTHras. It achieves the highest mean F1 on all three MF classification benchmarks and both subtype benchmarks. MiTHras also outperforms general-purpose and pathology foundation encoders by a larger margin under frozen-encoder linear probing than under full fine-tuning. Although detection gains are modest due to a shared candidate-detection stage, ablations confirm that token-level supervision improves typical-versus-atypical classification and linear probing. These findings establish that MiTHras yields robust, transferable representations for automated mitotic activity assessment.

AI.tldr: MiTHras：面向有丝分裂图（MF）分析的任务特定预训练框架，结合伪标签引导的图像级与token级对比学习及掩码重建，在14个TCGA队列构建180万细胞图像语料，在多任务上取得最优或具竞争力表现。
AI.motivation: 有丝分裂图分析可支持肿瘤分级与预后评估，但现有自动化模型对组织类型差异和图像采集条件高度敏感，缺乏稳健、可迁移的表征。
AI.method: 提出MiTHras任务特定预训练框架：以伪标签引导的图像级与token级对比学习，配合掩码重建；构建TCGA-MF-Pseudo语料，包含来自14个TCGA队列、覆盖11个器官部位的180万张细胞中心图像；在分类、检测、基于计数的生存预测和亚型分类任务上评估，并与通用及病理基础编码器对比（冻结编码器线性探测 vs 全量微调），辅以消融实验。
AI.result: 在三个MF分类基准和两个亚型基准上均取得最高平均F1；相比通用与病理基础编码器，在冻结编码器线性探测下优势幅度大于全量微调；受共享候选检测阶段限制，检测增益有限；消融显示token级监督改善典型与非典型分类及线性探测表现。
AI.conclusion: MiTHras能够产生稳健、可迁移的表征，为自动化有丝分裂活性评估提供有效方案；token级监督是该框架的关键增益来源。

title: Ananke: Contractive Torus Attractor Networks
summary: We introduce Ananke, a representation-learning framework that scaffolds latent representations onto a structured product-torus prior, and its flagship visual backbone realization, Contractive Torus Attractor Networks (CTAN). By factorizing high-dimensional latent spaces into an orthogonal direct sum of two-dimensional phase planes ($\bigoplus_{k=1}^K \R^2$), Ananke coordinates feature updates via a decoupled dual-phase continuous flow: skew-symmetric Hamiltonian transport moves features tangentially along energy level sets to preserve semantic phase invariants, while signed gradient dissipation contracts transverse perturbations normally toward target invariant manifolds. For circular potential families with frozen parameters, logarithmic radial feedback yields the Exact Log-Symplectic Flow (ELSF), an analytical closed-form mapping with exact exponential decay of log-radius error that evaluates in a single forward pass without numerical integration. We establish local input-to-state bounds for level-set deviations and log-radius errors, and characterize the normal hyperbolicity and persistence of the ideal product torus under bounded perturbations. We further formulate the architecture through Lie--Trotter operator splitting, unifying spatial depthwise diffusion with local manifold contraction, and analyze both exact trigonometric flows and hardware-friendly symplectic dual-shear variants. Across natural image benchmarks (CIFAR-100) and clinically challenging endoscopy datasets (Kvasir-v2), CTAN demonstrates exceptional parameter efficiency: an ultra-compact hierarchical model with merely 0.27M parameters achieves 90.52\% accuracy on Kvasir-v2, outperforming 25M+ baselines (ResNet-50, DenseNet-161) by nearly two orders of magnitude in capacity, while scaled variants attain 80.32\% top-1 accuracy on CIFAR-100.

AI.tldr: 提出表示学习框架Ananke及其视觉主干CTAN，将隐空间映射到乘积环面先验，通过哈密顿输运与梯度耗散的解耦双相流实现几何约束学习，并导出无需求解的闭式精确对数辛流ELSF，在极小参数量下取得优异分类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有表示学习缺乏对隐空间几何结构的显式约束，特征更新往往混合语义保持与扰动收缩两种作用，难以同时保证语义不变性与对扰动的鲁棒性；同时高维流模型的数值积分代价高，难以高效部署。本文旨在以结构化乘积环面先验替代自由隐空间，实现语义相位的守恒与横向扰动的解析收缩。
AI.method: 将高维隐空间分解为二维相平面的正交直和（⊕ R²），构建解耦双相连续流：斜对称哈密顿输运沿能量水平集切向移动以保持语义相位不变量，带符号梯度耗散沿法向收缩横向扰动至目标不变流形。对冻结参数的圆势族，采用对数径向反馈导出精确对数辛流（ELSF），获得单次前向传播的解析闭式映射，无需数值积分。进一步以Lie–Trotter算子分裂统一空间深度可分离扩散与局部流形收缩，分析精确三角流与硬件友好的辛双剪切变体，并给出水平集偏差与对数半径误差的局部输入-状态界、理想乘积环面的法向双曲性与有界扰动下的持续性。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100自然图像与Kvasir-v2内窥镜数据集上验证参数效率：仅0.27M参数的超紧凑分层模型在Kvasir-v2达90.52%准确率，超越参数量高近两个数量级的ResNet-50、DenseNet-161（25M+）基线；扩展变体在CIFAR-100取得80.32% top-1准确率。
AI.conclusion: 以乘积环面为结构化先验、以双相辛-耗散流为动力学核心的Ananke/CTAN，在理论与实现层面统一了几何守恒与扰动收缩，并借助ELSF实现闭式高效推理；实验表明其在保持流形几何约束的同时具备极高的参数效率，适用于资源受限的医学与自然图像任务。

title: PrismGPT: Proxy-Guided Learning for Region-Aware Photo Editing with Self-Synthesized Reasoning
summary: Professional photo finishing relies on both global adjustments and region-specific local edits guided by semantic masks, yet current automated methods handle this workflow only partially. We present PrismGPT, a Vision-Language Model (VLM) framework that produces structured, region-aware editing plans from a single input image without relying on commercial black-box tools. Training a VLM to simultaneously diagnose aesthetic deficiencies at both global and local levels while predicting precise editing parameters is challenging due to the vast combinatorial decision space. We address this through proxy-guided learning: two simpler proxy tasks -- operation decomposition and region-aware aesthetic ranking -- teach the foundational skills the model needs, while a competence-based dynamic scheduler automatically rebalances the multi-task training ratio, progressively shifting emphasis from the proxy tasks to the primary editing task as each skill is mastered. Crucially, all reasoning traces used for supervised fine-tuning are self-synthesized by the same base model, eliminating the need for a stronger external teacher. Experiments on MIT-Adobe FiveK and SPIRE, a new professionally retouched benchmark we introduce, show that PrismGPT achieves state-of-the-art results while using only ~6% of the training data compared to the previous best method.

AI.tldr: 提出 PrismGPT，一个视觉语言模型框架，能从单张图像生成结构化、区域感知的编辑方案，通过代理引导学习与能力动态调度解决组合决策空间过大的难题，并以仅约6%训练数据取得SOTA效果。
AI.motivation: 专业修图依赖全局调整与基于语义掩码的区域局部编辑，但现有自动化方法仅能部分覆盖该流程。训练VLM同时进行全局与局部美学缺陷诊断并预测精确编辑参数，面临巨大组合决策空间，且通常依赖更强的外部教师模型，成本与数据需求高。
AI.method: 提出 PrismGPT：不依赖商业黑盒工具，由单一输入图像输出结构化区域感知编辑计划。采用代理引导学习，引入两个更简单的代理任务——操作分解与区域感知美学排序——以教授基础技能；并用基于能力的动态调度器自动重新平衡多任务训练比例，随着技能掌握逐步将重点从代理任务转移到主编辑任务。所有用于监督微调的推理轨迹由同一基础模型自合成，无需更强外部教师。
AI.result: 在 MIT-Adobe FiveK 以及新提出的专业修图基准 SPIRE 上，PrismGPT 达到 state-of-the-art 结果，且训练数据量仅为先前最佳方法的约6%。
AI.conclusion: 代理引导学习与能力驱动的动态多任务调度能有效降低组合决策空间的训练难度，自合成推理轨迹可替代外部教师；该框架在区域感知自动修图任务上兼具高性能与高数据效率。

title: Brain Metastases Segmentation for BraTS 2026 Task 1: A Multi-Architecture Comparison
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure. Accepted as a poster at the BraTS 2026 Challenge, MICCAI 2026. Code: https://github.com/mahdiislam79/BraTS_METS_2026
summary: Brain metastases are the most common intracranial malignancy, occurring in roughly 30% of patients with primary solid tumors and carrying a median survival near 5.9 months. Automated segmentation is critical for treatment planning and volumetric monitoring, but metastases are frequently small, numerous, and heterogeneous in size within a single patient. We compare a plain nnU-Net baseline, a Residual Encoder Large (ResEncL) variant, region-based training, and a Primus transformer model for BraTS-METS 2026 Task 1, using patient-grouped cross-validation to prevent leakage from the longitudinal UCSD subset. Primus (label-based) is our strongest individual model by aggregate DSC/NSD, achieving 0.710/0.761 (ET), 0.742/0.785 (TC), 0.683/0.689 (WT), and 0.531/0.436 (RC). ResEncL trails Primus on aggregate DSC/NSD but achieves substantially higher lesion-wise F1 (e.g. ET: 0.452 vs. 0.052); a probability-averaging ensemble of the two only partially preserves ResEncL's F1 advantage (ET lesion-wise F1: 0.064). We further report three postprocessing and label-reconstruction pitfalls we believe generalize beyond this challenge. Code is available at https://github.com/mahdiislam79/BraTS_METS_2026.

AI.tldr: 该论文比较了nnU-Net、ResEncL、区域训练与Primus Transformer在BraTS-METS 2026任务1脑转移瘤分割中的表现，发现Primus在聚合DSC/NSD上最优，而ResEncL在病灶级F1上显著更优，并指出了三个后处理与标签重建陷阱。
AI.motivation: 脑转移瘤是最常见的颅内恶性肿瘤，约30%的实体瘤患者会发生，中位生存期仅约5.9个月。自动分割对治疗计划和体积监测至关重要，但转移灶常表现为体积小、数量多、尺寸异质性大，给分割带来挑战。因此需要在BraTS-METS 2026任务1框架下系统比较不同分割方法。
AI.method: 采用患者分组的交叉验证以防止来自UCSD纵向子集的泄漏，比较四种方法：普通nnU-Net基线、Residual Encoder Large (ResEncL)变体、基于区域的训练，以及Primus Transformer模型。评估指标包括聚合DSC/NSD与病灶级F1，并测试了两种模型概率平均集成的效果。
AI.result: Primus（基于标签）在聚合DSC/NSD上为最强单模型，ET 0.710/0.761、TC 0.742/0.785、WT 0.683/0.689、RC 0.531/0.436。ResEncL在聚合DSC/NSD上略逊于Primus，但病灶级F1显著更高（如ET：0.452 vs 0.052）。二者概率平均集成仅部分保留ResEncL的F1优势（ET病灶级F1为0.064）。
AI.conclusion: 聚合DSC/NSD与病灶级F1存在明显权衡：Primus在体素重叠指标上更强，而ResEncL在小病灶检测上更优，简单概率集成无法完全兼顾两者。此外，研究总结了三个可推广至该挑战之外的后处理与标签重建陷阱。代码已开源。

title: Virtual neural networks: hundreds of souls in a body
summary: A new concept, termed virtual neural networks, is introduced, where the count of trainable parameters is kept constant, and scalability is attained purely through computational resources. This concept is an abstract framework that can be realized using any standard convolutional neural network. It merges siamese neural networks with a deep ensemble technique by generating numerous virtual models that share weights derived from a small set of physical models. The ensemble comprises up to hundreds of trained models simultaneously. All virtual networks take the same input, and their interconnected structure induces an internal distortion that boosts the entire ensemble robustness. The accuracy of the ensemble improves as the number of virtual networks increases, without changing the capacity. Virtual neural networks outperform larger capacity models, typical deep ensembles, and contemporary approaches like SWA and Masksembles. Additionally, the highest-performing individual model from the ensemble surpasses other models trained individually, even those with a greater number of parameters. Code: gitlab.com/EnginCZ/virtual-models-public

AI.tldr: 提出"虚拟神经网络"概念：可训练参数量恒定，仅靠算力扩展规模；将孪生网络与深度集成结合，用少量物理模型的共享权重生成大量虚拟模型，集成最多数百个模型，提升鲁棒性与精度。
AI.motivation: 希望在保持模型容量（可训练参数量）不变的前提下，仅通过增加计算资源来获得可扩展的性能提升，从而突破传统"扩容即增参"的范式限制。
AI.method: 以任意标准卷积网络为骨架，融合孪生神经网络的共享权重机制与深度集成技术，由一小组物理模型派生出大量共享权重的虚拟模型，同时接受同一输入，通过虚拟网络之间互联结构诱导的内部扰动增强整体集成的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 集成精度随虚拟网络数量增加而提高，且容量不变；虚拟神经网络优于更大容量模型、典型深度集成以及SWA、Masksembles等主流方法；集成中表现最好的单个模型也超过独立训练的模型，即使后者参数更多。
AI.conclusion: 虚拟神经网络表明，在不增加可训练参数的前提下，仅靠算力扩展即可实现鲁棒性和精度的持续提升，是一种可基于标准卷积网络落地的通用抽象框架。

title: Streaming Video Editing with Easy Adaptation
summary: In this paper, we propose SVEET, a framework that requires merely training on a pretrained bidirectional video diffusion model but supports high-quality streaming video editing in an auto-regressive fashion. To tackle this problem, we first systematically revisit existing video-to-video diffusion approaches and identify two key principles for such streaming adaptation: backbone feature disentanglement and conditional frame independence. Building on these insights, we develop a novel paradigm for controllable video generation. At its core, an auxiliary model branch encodes source video inputs with temporally independent self-attention, and the intermediate features are injected into the corresponding backbone blocks for streaming-compatible control. Moreover, to bridge the discrepancy between the feature spaces of bidirectional and streaming models, we propose a decoupled training scheme that explicitly enforces the orthogonality between the optimization directions of video controllability and model causality. Such disentanglement ensures compatibility between the two objectives at inference and facilitates smooth zero-shot knowledge transfer across heterogeneous backbone architectures. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SVEET achieves superior editing quality while maintaining real-time performance, attaining 15 FPS on a single H100 GPU 17 without any auxiliary acceleration techniques. Codes are available at https://github.com/YujiaHu1109/SVEET.

AI.tldr: 提出SVEET框架，仅需在预训练双向视频扩散模型上训练，即可支持自回归式高质量流式视频编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有视频到视频扩散方法难以直接适配流式（自回归）编辑场景，双向与流式模型在特征空间和因果性上存在本质差异，需要新的适配原则与训练方案。
AI.method: 系统回顾v2v扩散方法，提出两大原则：骨干特征解耦与条件帧独立性。核心是辅助模型分支以时间独立自注意力编码源视频，并将中间特征注入对应骨干块以实现流式可控；同时提出解耦训练方案，显式约束视频可控性与模型因果性的优化方向正交，弥合双向与流式特征空间差异，实现零样本跨异构骨干知识迁移。
AI.result: 大量实验表明SVEET在保持实时性能的同时取得更优编辑质量，单张H100 GPU上达15 FPS，且无需任何辅助加速技术。
AI.conclusion: SVEET验证了通过特征解耦与独立性设计可将双向视频扩散模型高效转化为流式视频编辑器，兼顾质量与实时性，并具备跨架构迁移能力。

title: Toward a foundation model for forest point clouds
summary: Forest inventories increasingly rely on artificial intelligence (AI) models to derive forest attributes from large-scale 3D point clouds. Current models are typically specialized to a single task, sensor, and forest type, making adaptation expensive in terms of annotations, computation, and expertise. We ask whether a single pretrained model can instead learn transferable representations across diverse forest inventory settings. Inspired by recent developments in language modelling and computer vision, we take a step toward a foundation model (FM) for 3D forestry. Using LitePT as backbone, we first establish a strong supervised baseline that sets a new state of the art on forest semantic and instance segmentation, tree species classification, and age regression benchmarks. We then curate a large-scale unlabelled corpus spanning airborne, UAV, and mobile laser scanning across diverse forest ecosystems, and pretrain the same backbone using self-supervised learning. We systematically evaluate representation learning strategies by comparing training from scratch, supervised pretraining, and self-supervised pretraining across four representative forestry tasks, under varying annotation budgets. Compared with training from scratch, self-supervised pretraining accelerates model convergence and consistently improves performance when annotations are scarce. Compared with task-specific supervised pretraining, self-supervised pretraining yields more transferable representations across downstream forestry tasks. These findings identify the practical regime in which pretrained representations are most valuable and suggest that instance discrimination, rather than forest semantics, is the main remaining obstacle to a general-purpose 3D forest foundation model. Code and models are available at: https://github.com/prs-eth/ForPT.

AI.tldr: 本文探索3D林业基础模型的可行性，以LitePT为骨干，构建大规模无标注点云语料进行自监督预训练，并在四类林业任务上系统比较从零训练、监督预训练与自监督预训练的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有林业AI模型往往针对单一任务、传感器和森林类型专门化，适配成本高（标注、算力、专业知识），因此需要验证单一预训练模型能否学习跨多样化林业场景的可迁移表示。
AI.method: 以LitePT为骨干：(1) 建立强监督基线；(2) 构建涵盖机载、UAV和移动激光扫描、跨多样森林生态系统的大规模无标注语料，用自监督学习预训练同一骨干；(3) 在四类代表性林业任务、不同标注预算下，系统比较从零训练、监督预训练和自监督预训练三种策略。
AI.result: 强监督基线在森林语义与实例分割、树种分类和树龄回归基准上达到新的最优。自监督预训练相较从零训练可加速收敛，并在标注稀缺时持续提升性能；相较任务特定监督预训练，其表示在跨下游林业任务上迁移性更强。
AI.conclusion: 研究界定了预训练表示最具价值的实际适用区间，并指出实例判别（而非森林语义）是构建通用3D森林基础模型的主要剩余障碍。代码与模型已开源。

title: When Quantization Preserves Accuracy but Not Evidence: Explanation-Aware Post-Training Quantization for Medical LLMs
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) enables efficient deployment of large language models, and PTQ methods are usually optimized and evaluated with generic reconstruction, perplexity, or answer accuracy. But in explanation-critical domains, preserving only the final answer may be insufficient, since users may also inspect generated rationales to judge whether a prediction is trustworthy. We study this issue in medical multiple-choice question answering, where rationales should provide evidence that supports the selected answer. We propose an explanation-aware objective for transformation-based PTQ. Our method builds an offline faithfulness cache from full-precision teacher rationales and uses it during optimization to preserve answer-supporting evidence tokens and evidence-conditioned answer behavior. We instantiate it on OSTQuant under W4A4KV4 quantization and evaluate four 7B--8B medical and instruction-tuned LLMs on MedExQA, MedExpQA, and ChallengeClinicalQA. While a same-calibration OSTQuant baseline preserves task accuracy, it can substantially weaken answer-supporting rationales. Our objective is to preserve the full-precision model's answer-supporting behavior rather than improve gold-label accuracy, and our method better preserves the full-precision model's answer behavior and rationale-to-answer support. These results suggest that PTQ for explanation-critical settings should evaluate preservation of answer-supporting evidence, not only answer accuracy. Code and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/dut0817/EAQuant.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向解释的量化目标（EAQuant），在W4A4KV4下通过离线忠实度缓存保留支持答案的证据token与答案行为，优于仅保精度的OSTQuant基线。
AI.motivation: PTQ通常以重构误差、困惑度或答案准确率进行优化与评估。但在解释关键领域（如医疗问答），仅保留最终答案不足够，用户还需检查生成的理由（rationale）以判断预测可信度；现有方法可能保住了准确率却削弱了支持答案的证据。因此需要一个保留理由-答案支持关系的量化目标。
AI.method: 针对基于变换（transformation-based）的PTQ提出解释感知目标：先用全精度教师模型的理由构建离线忠实度缓存（faithfulness cache），在量化优化过程中利用该缓存，以保留支持答案的证据token以及证据条件下的答案行为。在OSTQuant上实例化，配置为W4A4KV4。
AI.result: 在MedExQA、MedExpQA、ChallengeClinicalQA上评估4个7B–8B医疗与指令微调LLM。相同校准的OSTQuant基线能保持任务准确率，但会显著削弱支持答案的理由；所提方法更好地保留了全精度模型的答案行为及理由到答案的支持关系。
AI.conclusion: 该目标旨在保留全精度模型的答案支持行为而非提升金标签准确率。结果表明，面向解释关键场景的PTQ应评估支持答案的证据保留情况，而不仅是答案准确率。代码与评估脚本已公开。

title: MSI-Bench: Evaluating Multi-Speaker Voice Interaction for Collaborative AI Agents
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/M2cha4l1124/MSI-Bench ; Code: https://github.com/boson-ai/MSI-Bench
summary: Voice provides a natural and immediate interface for AI agents. Many settings in which voice agents could be useful, including meetings, households, and collaborative work, are inherently multi-speaker. Supporting these settings introduces challenges that are largely absent from one-on-one interaction. We introduce the Multi-Speaker Interaction Benchmark (MSI-Bench) for evaluating multi-speaker voice interaction. Each test case is a short multi-party multi-turn audio scene with participant context, expected tool calls, and atomic rubrics. The benchmark targets three capability families: multi-speaker memory, multi-speaker instruction following, and multi-speaker reasoning. It comprises 1,152 test cases, evenly split between Mandarin Chinese and English (576 each). The strongest configuration on each split passes all rubrics on only 66.8% of English and 54.5% of Mandarin cases, and the strongest open-weight configuration on 34.0% and 19.3%. Failure analysis separates perception from reasoning: open-weight models are bottlenecked by the multi-speaker audio front-end, while frontier systems still fail speaker-scoped decision making on clean transcripts---and models across the board often respond when no one has addressed them. These results identify speaker-grounded perception, speaker-scoped decision making, and conversational restraint as concrete targets for future voice agents.

AI.tldr: 提出多说话人交互基准 MSI-Bench，含1152条中英双语多方多轮音频测试用例，评测多说话人记忆、指令跟随与推理能力，揭示当前语音智能体在说话人定位感知、决策与对话克制上的显著不足。
AI.motivation: 语音是AI智能体的自然交互接口，但会议、家庭、协作等真实场景本质上是多说话人的。这类场景带来的挑战在一对一交互中基本不存在，而现有评测缺乏针对多说话人语音交互的系统性基准。
AI.method: 构建 MSI-Bench 基准：每个测试用例为一段简短的多方多轮音频场景，附带参与者上下文、期望的工具调用以及原子化评分细则（atomic rubrics）。基准覆盖三类能力：多说话人记忆、多说话人指令跟随、多说话人推理。共1152条用例，中英文各576条，规模均衡。通过对比最强闭源与开源配置并做失败分析，将感知失败与推理失败分离考察。
AI.result: 最强配置在英文分片上仅66.8%用例通过全部评分细则，中文为54.5%；最强开源配置分别仅为34.0%和19.3%。失败分析显示：开源模型瓶颈在多说话人音频前端感知；前沿系统即便在干净转写文本上也仍会在说话人限定决策上失败；且各类模型普遍在无人对其发话时仍做出响应。
AI.conclusion: 多说话人语音交互仍是显著短板，未来语音智能体需聚焦三个具体目标：基于说话人的感知（speaker-grounded perception）、说话人限定的决策（speaker-scoped decision making）以及对话克制（conversational restraint）。

title: INTCORT: Training-Free Spatial Reasoning Enhancement for Vision-Language Models via Input Transformations and Confidence Routing
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in multimodal tasks, yet they still exhibit poor ability in spatial reasoning. Existing training-dependent and training-free enhancement methods suffer from high computational costs with catastrophic forgetting and internal mechanism interference that compromises general capabilities, respectively. In this work, we first verify two key hypotheses: appropriate geometric image transformation and query-reversal transformation can recover incorrect spatial predictions, and correct predictions exhibit higher relation-token confidence than incorrect ones. Based on these findings, we propose INTCORT, a training-free spatial reasoning enhancement framework that constructs multiple inference views through input transformations and aggregates their predictions via relation-token confidence routing, without modifying the VLM's internal mechanisms. Experimental results on several commonly-used benchmarks demonstrate that INTCORT substantially improves spatial reasoning accuracy across diverse VLMs, achieving an average improvement of 10.01% over all models and benchmarks. Compared with prior works, INTCORT achieves superior performance with improvements of up to 25.01%.

AI.tldr: INTCORT是一种免训练的空间推理增强框架，通过输入变换构建多推理视图并用关系token置信度路由聚合预测，平均提升10.01%的空间推理准确率。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在多模态任务中表现优异，但空间推理能力较差。现有增强方法存在问题：依赖训练的方法计算成本高且会导致灾难性遗忘；免训练方法则干扰模型内部机制、损害通用能力。因此需要一种既高效又不损害通用能力的增强方案。
AI.method: 作者首先验证了两个关键假设：(1) 适当的几何图像变换与查询反转变换能够恢复错误的空间预测；(2) 正确预测比错误预测具有更高的关系token置信度。基于此提出INTCORT——一种免训练框架，通过输入变换构建多个推理视图，并利用关系token置信度路由聚合各视图的预测，且不修改VLM的内部机制。
AI.result: 在多个常用基准上的实验表明，INTCORT显著提升了多种VLM的空间推理准确率，在所有模型和基准上平均提升10.01%；与先前工作相比，性能提升最高达25.01%。
AI.conclusion: INTCORT作为一种免训练、不修改模型内部机制的空间推理增强框架，在多种VLM和基准上均取得了显著且优于先前方法的性能提升，为空间推理增强提供了高效可靠的方案。

title: Mobile Imaging Solutions for Medical Diagnosis: Trends and Applications
summary: Advances in processing power, camera technologies, and mobile image analysis have made smartphones and other mobile devices, such as laptops, increasingly suitable for medical diagnosis and healthcare applications.
