Researchers have developed low-cost solutions for the early detection and monitoring of various health conditions, including eye and ENT diseases, malnutrition, heart rate variability, skin and oral conditions, and injuries, using images captured by non-medical devices such as smartphones and webcams. This survey examines existing research on mobile image-based medical diagnosis, with an emphasis on its potential to enable low-cost and accessible healthcare. We comparatively analyze state-of-the-art solutions across different healthcare application categories, examining their advantages and limitations. Based on this analysis, we identify desirable characteristics of mobile image-based diagnostic tools and highlight areas where existing approaches have made progress as well as areas requiring further research. We also discuss application-specific and common challenges and outline directions for future research. Overall, this study provides a comprehensive overview of mobile image-based healthcare solutions and their potential to support low-cost disease diagnosis and monitoring, particularly for underserved populations in remote and resource-constrained settings.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了基于移动设备（智能手机、笔记本电脑、网络摄像头）拍摄图像进行医疗诊断的现有研究，按应用类别对比分析各类方案的优缺点，总结理想诊断工具特性、研究进展与不足，并讨论应用特定及共性挑战与未来方向，强调其在资源匮乏地区支持低成本、可及医疗的潜力。
AI.motivation: 处理能力、相机技术和移动图像分析的进步使智能手机等移动设备日益适用于医疗诊断与健康监护；同时，偏远和资源受限地区医疗服务不足，亟需低成本、易获取的诊断手段。因此有必要系统梳理移动图像诊断研究现状，明确其优势、局限与研究方向。
AI.method: 采用综述方法，对现有基于移动图像的医疗诊断研究进行归纳整理；按不同医疗应用类别对比分析最先进方案，考察其优势与局限；在此基础上提炼移动图像诊断工具应具备的理想特性，识别已有进展领域与需进一步研究的领域，并分析应用特定挑战与共性挑战。
AI.result: 综述覆盖了眼科与耳鼻喉疾病、营养不良、心率变异性、皮肤与口腔状况以及外伤等多种健康问题的低成本早期检测与监测方案，这些方案均基于智能手机、网络摄像头等非医疗设备采集的图像。对比分析揭示各类方案在成本、可及性与性能上的特点及局限，并明确现有方法的进展与空白。
AI.conclusion: 移动图像诊断在支持低成本疾病诊断与监测方面具有显著潜力，尤其适用于偏远和资源受限地区的弱势人群。研究提供了该领域的综合性概览，并指出应用特定与共性挑战及未来研究方向，以推动低成本、可及的医疗服务发展。

title: PanOVOcc: Panoramic Embodied Open-Vocabulary Occupancy Mapping with Long-term Spatial Voxel Memory
comment: The source code and the established benchmarks will be available at https://github.com/bakereet/PanOVOcc
summary: Persistent semantic occupancy mapping is essential for embodied scene understanding. However, perspective-based systems provide limited spatial coverage, while existing panoramic methods primarily predict local volumes from single observations. We introduce PanOVOcc, a training-free framework for persistent open-vocabulary semantic occupancy mapping from panoramic sequences. PanOVOcc unifies panoramic SLAM, open-vocabulary perception, and long-term spatial voxel memory within an online architecture, continuously integrating geometric and semantic evidence into a global, language-queryable map. To facilitate systematic evaluation of this setting, we establish Pan-Replica and Pan-Holo360D, two benchmarks pairing continuous panoramic RGB-D sequences with scene-level semantic occupancy ground truth across synthetic and real-world scenes. Compared with the strongest evaluated baseline for each metric, PanOVOcc improves occupancy IoU and semantic mIoU by absolute +20.03 and +7.06 on Pan-Replica, and by +43.26 and +20.16 on Pan-Holo360D, respectively. The source code and the established benchmarks will be available at https://github.com/bakereet/PanOVOcc.

AI.tldr: PanOVOcc：免训练的全景开放词汇语义占据建图框架，结合全景SLAM、开放词汇感知与长时体素记忆，实现在线持久全局建图，并建立Pan-Replica和Pan-Holo360D两套基准。
AI.motivation: 具身场景理解需要持久语义占据建图，但透视方法空间覆盖有限，现有全景方法多仅从单次观测预测局部体素，缺乏持续全局建图能力。
AI.method: 提出免训练框架PanOVOcc，将全景SLAM、开放词汇感知与长时空间体素记忆统一于在线架构中，持续融合几何与语义证据，构建全局、可用语言查询的占据地图；并建立Pan-Replica与Pan-Holo360D基准，包含连续全景RGB-D序列与场景级语义占据真值。
AI.result: 相比各项指标最强基线，PanOVOcc在Pan-Replica上占据IoU与语义mIoU分别绝对提升+20.03和+7.06，在Pan-Holo360D上分别提升+43.26和+20.16。
AI.conclusion: PanOVOcc为全景序列下持久开放词汇语义占据建图提供了有效框架，并配套基准促进该方向系统评测，代码与基准将开源。

title: Uranus: Building the Next-Generation Simulation Infrastructure for Embodied AI
comment: Project Page: https://d-robotics-ai-lab.github.io/large-model-team/blog/uranus/ Inference Code: https://github.com/D-Robotics-AI-Lab/Uranus-OSS Inference Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/D-Robotics/Uranus-Demo-Data SDK Code: https://github.com/D-Robotics-AI-Lab/Uranus-SDK Model Weights: https://huggingface.co/collections/D-Robotics/uranus
summary: Scalable simulation is essential for robot data generation, policy training, evaluation, and safe iteration, yet real-world interaction is costly and conventional simulators require labor-intensive construction. We present Uranus, a data-driven robot simulator built around a joint-trajectory-conditioned autoregressive diffusion model. Uranus offers three key capabilities: (1) streaming, open-ended rollout, which receives future joint-position trajectories online and autoregressively generates one latent frame per step, corresponding to four RGB frames, without a fixed horizon; (2) low-latency generation, achieving 24 FPS after inference optimization; and (3) scalable, extensible robot control, providing a unified interface for synchronized multi-view generation across diverse robot embodiments and camera configurations. We conduct comprehensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution data, providing an objective assessment of Uranus and clearly identifying its current limitations. We release the code and model weights to empower the community with practical tools and insights.

AI.tldr: 提出 Uranus，一个以联合轨迹为条件、基于自回归扩散模型的数据驱动机器人仿真器，支持无固定时域的流式长程推演、24 FPS 低延迟生成，以及跨机器人形态与相机配置的统一多视角同步生成接口，并公开代码与权重。
AI.motivation: 可扩展仿真是机器人数据生成、策略训练、评估与安全迭代的关键，但真实交互成本高，传统仿真器构建需大量人工。因此需要一种数据驱动、可扩展的机器人仿真方案。
AI.method: Uranus 采用以关节轨迹为条件的自回归扩散模型：在线接收未来关节位置轨迹，逐步自回归生成一个潜帧（对应四帧 RGB），无固定预测时域；并通过推理优化实现低延迟生成；同时提供统一接口，支持不同机器人形态与相机配置下的多视角同步生成。
AI.result: 推理优化后达到 24 FPS；支持无固定时域的流式开放式推演；在分布内与分布外数据上进行了定量与定性综合评估，客观刻画了 Uranus 的能力并明确指出当前局限。
AI.conclusion: Uranus 展示了数据驱动机器人仿真在可扩展性、实时性与跨形态泛化方面的潜力，并通过公开代码与模型权重为社区提供实用工具与洞见，同时坦承现有限制。

title: PanoFuse: Panorama-Enhanced Vision-Language-Action Learning with Decoupled Semantic-Geometric Routing
comment: Code and data will be released publicly at https://xux-hnu.github.io/PanoFuse
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies have shown promising performance in language-conditioned robotic manipulation. However, most existing VLA systems rely on conventional perspective cameras with limited fields of view, often missing global scene context and leading to unreliable manipulation under visual occlusions, distractors, and unseen environments. In this work, we propose PanoFuse, a panorama-enhanced VLA framework that complements local manipulation observations with global panoramic perception. PanoFuse introduces a dedicated panoramic branch that leverages a pretrained panoramic foundation model to extract complementary semantic and geometric representations from omnidirectional observations. Rather than directly mixing these heterogeneous features, we introduce Decoupled Semantic-Geometric Routing (DSGR), which maintains semantic and geometric representations as separate context streams and selectively routes both to downstream state and action representations through structured block-wise attention. This design provides the action expert with global spatial context while preserving task-relevant semantic information from the pretrained VLA backbone. We further develop a synchronized data collection pipeline and construct a new real-world manipulation dataset containing panoramic RGB observations, wrist-view images, language instructions, robot states, and actions. Across seven evaluation settings, PanoFuse achieves an average success rate of 52.9%, outperforming the evaluated baselines and achieving consistent gains under novel-object, unseen-background, and distractor-rich settings. Code and data will be released publicly at https://xux-hnu.github.io/PanoFuse.

AI.tldr: PanoFuse：全景增强的VLA框架，通过解耦语义-几何路由（DSGR）融合全景语义与几何表征，在7个评测设置下平均成功率52.9%，优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略多依赖视场有限的透视相机，缺乏全局场景上下文，在视觉遮挡、干扰物和未知环境下操作不可靠。
AI.method: 提出PanoFuse框架，引入专门的全景分支，利用预训练全景基础模型从全向观测中提取互补的语义与几何表征；并提出解耦语义-几何路由（DSGR），将语义与几何表征作为独立上下文流，通过结构化分块注意力选择性路由至下游状态与动作表征，在保留VLA主干任务相关语义的同时为动作专家提供全局空间上下文。此外构建同步数据采集流程与真实世界操作数据集（含全景RGB、腕部视角图像、语言指令、机器人状态与动作）。
AI.result: 在7个评测设置下平均成功率达52.9%，优于所评估基线，并在新物体、未见背景及干扰物丰富场景中取得一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 全景感知可有效补充局部操作观测，解耦路由设计能兼顾全局空间上下文与任务相关语义，提升VLA在遮挡、干扰与未知环境下的鲁棒性；代码与数据将公开。

title: When is a closed-form RGB->S/P ratio adequate? A hyperspectral characterization on natural scenes for mesopic display
summary: Mesopic and low-light display transforms require, as their driving signal, a per-pixel scotopic-to-photopic luminance ratio (S/P); the exact spectral S/P is unavailable for ordinary RGB content, so a low-cost closed form that estimates S/P from a linear-RGB triplet is used in its place. Such closed forms exist but have been characterized only on narrowband / LED sources, i.e. spectrally sparse spectra, where a relative error of ~41% has been reported for a three-channel projection. Display content, however, is natural and broadband. We ask whether the same closed form is adequate there, using per-pixel spectral S/P from hyperspectral imagery as ground truth. On a daylight radiance time-series, a six-scalar closed form (three photopic and three scotopic channel weights) reproduces spectral S/P with a median error of ~0.07 that is time-invariant once the RGB input is chromatically adapted to D65; evaluated in un-adapted sRGB the error instead carries a color-temperature tilt across illuminants (~0.19), so adaptation is the enabling step for this use case. The result generalizes to an independent fifty-scene set (pooled median 0.024; 45/50 scenes within a pre-registered 0.10 band), with the few exceedances concentrated in saturated, spectrally-peaky surfaces that approach the narrowband regime (floral close-ups in this set). The scotopic weight vector is shown to be primary-model dependent, but the value used here is corroborated by a primary-free XYZ projection, and the median error stays within the band across all principled coefficient choices. We do not claim observer-validated appearance fidelity or adequacy on narrowband sources; both are out of scope. Both outcomes follow from the same three-channel projection: it is overwhelmed by spectrally sparse inputs and adequate on spectrally smooth ones.

AI.tldr: 本文检验线性RGB三通道闭式模型估计S/P（暗视觉/明视觉亮度比）在自然宽光谱显示内容上的适用性，发现经D65色适应后该模型误差中位数约0.07且不随时间变化，并在独立场景集上得到验证。
AI.motivation: 中间视觉与低照度显示变换需要逐像素S/P作为驱动信号，但普通RGB内容无法获得精确光谱S/P。已有低成本的线性RGB闭式估计仅在窄带/LED等光谱稀疏光源上被验证过（三通道投影误差约41%），而显示内容通常是自然且宽光谱的，其在此类内容上是否适用尚不清楚。
AI.method: 以高光谱影像逐像素光谱S/P作为真值，在日光辐射时间序列上评估一个六标量闭式模型（三个明视觉通道权重加三个暗视觉通道权重）；对比RGB输入经D65色适应与未适应sRGB两种情形；并在独立五十场景集上用预注册的0.10误差带进行验证，同时通过无基色XYZ投影和不同系数选择检验暗视觉权重向量的稳健性。
AI.result: 经D65色适应后，闭式模型复现光谱S/P的中位误差约0.07且不随时间变化；未适应sRGB时误差随光源呈现色温倾斜（约0.19），说明色适应是该应用的关键前提。结果在独立五十场景集上泛化良好（合并中位误差0.024，45/50场景落在预注册0.10带内），少数超限集中在饱和、光谱尖峰、接近窄带情形的表面（如花卉特写）。暗视觉权重向量依赖于基色模型，但所用取值得到无基色XYZ投影的佐证，且在所有合理系数选择下中位误差均在带内。
AI.conclusion: 同一三通道投影在光谱稀疏输入上失效、在光谱平滑输入上足够，两种结论同源。作者不主张经观察者验证的外观保真度，也不主张在窄带光源上的适用性，二者超出研究范围。

title: The Answer-Basin Representation Hypothesis: We Are Not Probing or Steering Concepts
summary: Linear probing and activation steering use linear directions to predict and control behavior-level concepts such as correctness, safety, and social bias in question answering. We call these \emph{behavior-level concept directions}. Drawing on the Linear Representation Hypothesis (LRH) and circuit studies, these directions are often interpreted as concept representations. Yet controlled evidence for linear concept structure and local mechanisms does not establish that these directions represent the intended behavioral concepts, leaving probing and steering without a unified theoretical account. We propose the \emph{Answer-Basin Representation Hypothesis} (ABRH): the model's own answer measure organizes the linear structure of these directions. For each question, all continuations yielding the same answer form an answer basin, whose mass is their total probability; these masses define the model's answer distribution. ABRH posits that its concentration before generation and the relative mass of each answer after generation are represented along linear directions shared across questions. Experiments span four Qwen2.5 and Gemma-3 models on correctness, social bias, and safety tasks. Decoupling concept labels from basin mass shows that probing and steering exhibit concept-consistent effects when labels align with mass orderings, weaken as mass gaps shrink, and reverse under conflict. Probes trained solely on mass orderings among wrong answers still select correct answers; a fixed steering vector can instead favor wrong answers when labels conflict with mass orderings. These results support an answer-measure account of behavior-level concept directions and of when probing and steering succeed, fail, or reverse.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"答案盆地表征假说"（ABRH），认为行为层概念方向（如正确性、安全、社会偏见）的线性结构由模型自身的答案度量组织，解释并统一了线性探测与激活引导的成功、失效与反转现象。
AI.motivation: 线性探测与激活引导用线性方向预测和控制正确性、安全性、社会偏见等行为层概念，常被解释为概念表征，但受控证据仅表明存在线性概念结构与局部机制，无法证明这些方向真正表征了目标行为概念，导致探测与引导缺乏统一的理论解释。
AI.method: 提出ABRH假说：对每个问题，产生相同答案的所有续写构成一个"答案盆地"，其质量为总概率，这些质量定义模型的答案分布；假说认为生成前的答案分布集中度与生成后各答案的相对质量沿跨问题共享的线性方向被表征。在四个Qwen2.5与Gemma-3模型上，针对正确性、社会偏见与安全任务，解耦概念标签与盆地质量进行实验。
AI.result: 当标签与质量排序一致时，探测与引导呈现概念一致效应；质量差距缩小则效应减弱；标签与质量排序冲突时效应反转。仅用错误答案间质量排序训练的探针仍能选出正确答案；而固定引导向量在标签与质量排序冲突时可转而偏向错误答案。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果支持以答案度量来解释行为层概念方向，并说明探测与引导何时成功、失败或反转，为线性探测与激活引导提供了统一的理论框架。

title: ZVeC: A Zero-Shot Framework for Instance-Level Vehicle Extraction and Generative Point Cloud Completion
summary: LiDAR point clouds acquired in underground environments exhibit severe geometric incompleteness due to occlusions and limited sensor viewpoints, making reliable point cloud completion challenging without large supervised datasets. We propose ZVeC, a zero-shot, instance-driven framework that reformulates scene-level completion as compositional object-level reconstruction. By decomposing a scene into semantic object instances, ZVeC reduces reconstruction ambiguity in cluttered environments while eliminating the need for scenario-specific training. Each segmented vehicle is completed independently using a depth- and 3D Gaussian-conditioned diffusion model that exploits generalized geometric priors before the reconstructed instances are recomposed into the original scene. To evaluate our approach, we construct a real-world dense LiDAR benchmark of underground parking environments. Experimental results demonstrate consistent improvements over representative scene-level baselines in both quantitative metrics and visual quality. The completed point cloud differs substantially from the measured input (average KL divergence ~ 2.1), yet reducing the input to only 1% of the original LiDAR measurements changes the completed reconstruction only marginally (KL divergence < 0.50). This demonstrates that ZVeC produces geometrically consistent completions even under extreme input sparsity.

AI.tldr: ZVeC是一个零样本、实例驱动的点云补全框架，将场景级补全重构为对象级重建：先分解出语义实例，用深度与3D高斯条件扩散模型逐个补全，再重组回场景，并在自建真实地下停车场稠密LiDAR基准上验证其优于场景级基线，且在极端稀疏输入下保持几何一致。
AI.motivation: 地下环境采集的LiDAR点云因遮挡与视角受限存在严重几何不完整，而可靠补全通常依赖大规模监督数据集，获取困难；同时杂乱场景下的场景级补全存在高度歧义，且需要针对具体场景训练。
AI.method: 提出ZVeC零样本、实例驱动框架，将场景级补全改写为组合式对象级重建：把场景分解为语义对象实例以降低杂乱环境中的重建歧义并免除场景特定训练；对每个分割出的车辆实例，使用深度与3D高斯条件化的扩散模型、借助泛化几何先验独立补全，随后将重建实例重组回原始场景。为评估方法，构建了真实世界地下停车环境的稠密LiDAR基准。
AI.result: 在地下停车场基准上，ZVeC在定量指标与视觉质量上均稳定优于代表性场景级基线。补全点云与实测输入差异显著（平均KL散度约2.1），而当输入缩减至原始LiDAR测量的1%时，补全结果仅发生微小变化（KL散度<0.50）。
AI.conclusion: 实例级分解与扩散先验相结合可实现零样本、无需场景特定训练的点云补全，即使在输入极端稀疏条件下仍能产生几何一致的补全结果，为地下等受限环境的LiDAR补全提供了可行方案。

title: When Wider Views Fail: Stress-Testing Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
summary: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models enable efficient geometry estimation from sparse images, but their pretrained nature can make them vulnerable to distribution shifts beyond their training data. Identifying these failure modes is important for understanding when such models can be reliably deployed in unconstrained imaging settings. We investigate viewpoint variation as a controlled distribution shift by varying the angular span of sparse image inputs while keeping the input budget fixed. Across multiple feed-forward reconstruction models, we observe substantial degradation as viewpoint span increases, with wide spans producing both incomplete surface coverage and geometry unsupported by the observed imagery. These results reveal that viewpoint variation can induce failure modes beyond conventional reconstruction incompleteness, highlighting the need to evaluate pretrained feed-forward models under distribution shifts that challenge their learned geometric priors.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究前馈式三维重建模型在视角分布偏移下的失效模式，发现随视角跨度增大，模型性能显著下降，出现表面覆盖不全及几何缺乏观测支撑的问题。
AI.motivation: 前馈式三维重建模型可从稀疏图像高效估计几何，但其预训练特性使其在训练分布之外易受分布偏移影响。识别这些失效模式对于判断模型能否可靠部署于无约束成像场景至关重要。
AI.method: 将视角变化作为受控的分布偏移变量，在保持输入图像数量固定的前提下，改变稀疏输入的角跨度，并在多个前馈式重建模型上进行评测。
AI.result: 在多个前馈式重建模型中，随着视角跨度增大，性能出现显著退化；大跨度下同时产生不完整的表面覆盖以及缺乏观测图像支撑的几何。
AI.conclusion: 视角变化会诱发超出传统"重建不完整"范畴的失效模式，表明需要在挑战模型所学几何先验的分布偏移条件下对预训练前馈模型进行评估。

title: Revisiting Multi-View Stereo: A Sequence-to-Sequence Formulation
summary: Computing accurate geometry from multi-view images is a fundamental problem in computer vision. Recent feed-forward (FF) models jointly estimate 3D geometry and camera parameters, but they typically suffer from geometry distortion caused by reconstruction ambiguity, even when ground-truth camera parameters are supplied. In this paper, we study the multi-view stereo (MVS) problem with known camera parameters and propose a novel approach that bridges conventional MVS and FF methods. Rather than casting MVS as a sequence-to-one mapping that predicts depth only for a single reference view, we reformulate it as a sequence-to-sequence task, akin to FF models, that jointly predicts geometry for all input views. We introduce a global transformer-based architecture with two components that explicitly exploit camera-induced priors: ray-map embeddings that inject camera parameters into image patch tokens, making the transformer camera-aware, and a unified global cost volume that replaces conventional per-view cost volumes to jointly capture 3D structure across all views. Extensive experiments on multiple public benchmarks show our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing both MVS and FF reconstruction baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文将已知相机参数的多视图立体（MVS）重构为序列到序列任务，提出融合相机先验的全局Transformer架构，在多基准上超越传统MVS与前馈方法。
AI.motivation: 前馈模型虽能联合估计几何与相机参数，但即便给定真值相机参数仍存在因重建歧义导致的几何畸变。现有MVS通常作为序列到单输出的映射（仅预测单一参考视图深度），难以利用全视图几何一致性。作者旨在桥接传统MVS与前馈方法，缓解几何畸变并提升精度。
AI.method: 1）将已知相机的MVS重新表述为序列到序列任务，联合预测所有输入视图的几何；2）提出全局Transformer架构，包含两个显式利用相机先验的组件：（a）射线图嵌入（ray-map embeddings），将相机参数注入图像块token，使Transformer具备相机感知能力；（b）统一全局代价体，替代传统逐视图代价体，跨所有视图联合捕捉3D结构。
AI.result: 在多个公开基准上进行大量实验，该方法达到最先进性能，超过传统MVS与前馈重建两类基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过序列到序列重构与相机感知的全局Transformer设计，可在已知相机参数下有效提升多视图几何重建质量，验证了桥接传统MVS与前馈范式的有效性。

title: Extracting Arguments, Not Just Classifying Them: Instruction-Tuned LLMs for Generative Component Detection
summary: Argumentative component detection (ACD) is a core subtask of Argument(ation) Mining (AM) and one of its most challenging aspects, as it requires jointly delimiting argumentative spans and classifying them into components such as claims and premises. While research on this subtask remains relatively limited compared to other AM tasks, most existing approaches formulate it as a simplified sequence labeling problem, component classification, or a pipeline of component segmentation followed by classification. In this paper, we propose ITFACD, a novel approach based on instruction-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs) using compact instruction-based prompts, and reframe ACD as a language generation task, enabling arguments to be identified directly from plain text without relying on pre-segmented components. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that our approach achieves higher performance compared to state-of-the-art systems. To the best of our knowledge, this is one of the first attempts to fully model ACD as a generative task, highlighting the potential of instruction tuning for complex AM problems. Our code and the datasets used are openly available in the following GitHub repository.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ITFACD，将论辩组件检测（ACD）重建为语言生成任务，基于指令微调LLM与紧凑指令提示，无需预分割组件即可从纯文本中直接识别论点，在标准基准上超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: ACD是论辩挖掘的核心且最具挑战性的子任务，需同时界定论辩片段并分类为claim、premise等组件。现有研究相对有限，多数方法将其简化为序列标注、组件分类或"分割+分类"的流水线，存在误差传播与任务简化问题。
AI.method: 提出ITFACD：基于指令微调的大语言模型（LLM），采用紧凑的指令式提示，将ACD重构为语言生成任务，使论点可直接从纯文本中识别，不依赖预先分割的组件。
AI.result: 在标准基准上的实验表明，该方法相比当前最先进系统取得了更高的性能。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首批将ACD完全建模为生成式任务的尝试之一，凸显了指令微调在复杂论辩挖掘问题上的潜力；代码与数据集已在GitHub开源。

title: MM-VeriRec: Failure-Guided Fusion for Verifiable Agentic Multimodal Recommendation
comment: Accepted at the 1st International Workshop on Agentic Multimodal Intelligence: Models, Benchmarks, and Applications (AMI '26), co-located with ACM Multimedia 2026
summary: Images often carry recommendation constraints that text metadata only hints at. A movie may need to look dark, a product may need a minimal style, and a visually impossible request should be rejected. Agentic multimodal recommenders must reason over text-image evidence, decide when visual evidence is decisive, and abstain when no valid action exists. We introduce MM-VeriRec, a verifiable multimodal recommendation protocol and failure-guided fusion method for hidden visual constraints, image-text mismatch, and impossible-task abstention. MM-VeriRec builds tasks from real movie-poster and product-image datasets, verifies each recommendation with deterministic visual attributes, and converts failures into actionable labels: text-trap following, visual ignorance, and false acceptance. Fusion should not merely concatenate modalities, but should diagnose which modality failed and route to the appropriate repair. Across MM-ML 1M and Amazon Reviews datasets, stronger text and vision embeddings improve retrieval but do not remove these failure modes, whereas failure-guided fusion does. The adaptive attribute gate reads the same tags the verifier checks and its scores are verifier-aligned upper bounds testing whether the taxonomy routes to the correct repair. More informative is transfer under a non-aligned gate: an independently derived leave-one-out CLIP detector still reaches 0.7028 and 0.6111 visual-grounded success, above both a VBPR baseline and plain fusion. The text-versus-visual gap reproduces across two LLM families, and the repair that helps differs by domain. MM-VeriRec is both a benchmark and a practical diagnostic loop for trustworthy agentic multimodal recommendation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MM-VeriRec，一套可验证的多模态推荐协议与失败引导融合方法，针对隐藏视觉约束、图文不匹配与不可行任务弃答问题构建基准并诊断失败模式。
AI.motivation: 图像常携带文本元数据无法表达的推荐约束（如影片需显暗、商品需极简风格），且视觉上不可行的请求应被拒绝。现有多模态推荐器仅增强检索，无法识别模态失败并做相应修复，也缺乏对失败模式的验证与弃答机制。
AI.method: 基于真实电影海报与商品图像数据集构建任务，用确定性视觉属性验证每条推荐，并将失败转化为可操作标签（文本陷阱跟随、视觉忽视、误接受）；提出失败引导融合，先诊断失败模态再路由到对应修复，而非简单拼接。设置自适应属性门（与验证器对齐，分数为对齐上界）；并做非对齐门迁移测试，用独立推导的留一法 CLIP 检测器验证。
AI.result: 在 MM-ML 1M 与 Amazon Reviews 上，更强的文本与视觉嵌入提升检索但无法消除失败模式，失败引导融合可消除；非对齐门下留一法 CLIP 检测器仍达 0.7028 与 0.6111 的视觉接地成功率，优于 VBPR 基线与普通融合；文本-视觉差距在两个 LLM 家族中复现，且有效修复因领域而异。
AI.conclusion: MM-VeriRec 既是多模态推荐基准，也是可信智能体多模态推荐的实用诊断闭环，强调融合应诊断模态失败并路由修复。

title: DTKDP: A Dual Teacher Knowledge Distillation and Pruning Framework for Lightweight Oriented SAR Ship Detection
comment: Published in Remote Sensing. The version of record is available at https://doi.org/10.3390/rs18183172
summary: Two-stage oriented detectors achieve high localization accuracy in synthetic aperture radar (SAR) ship detection, but their large backbones, feature pyramids, proposal modules, and heavy region of interest (RoI) heads hinder deployment. Existing lightweight SAR ship detectors typically use one-stage frameworks that lack proposal-level refinement for precise rotated localization. This paper presents a dual-teacher knowledge distillation and pruning (DTKDP) framework for lightweight oriented SAR ship detection. DTKDP introduces learnable gates into convolutional, normalization, and linear layers to prune convolutional channels and RoI-head neurons. Rotated proposal alignment (RPA) distills teacher and student predictions in a shared teacher-generated rotated proposal space, while a dual-teacher scheme combines classification and regression guidance from a homogeneous main teacher with complementary classification cues from a heterogeneous auxiliary teacher. Experiments on the SAR Ship Detection Dataset (SSDD) and Rotated Ship Detection Dataset in SAR Images (RSDD-SAR) show that DTKDP reduces the parameters of Oriented Region-based Convolutional Neural Network (Oriented R-CNN) and RoI Transformer equipped with ResNet-50 backbones by 87.5-91.8% and their floating-point operations (FLOPs) by 75.6-79.9%. In terms of average precision (AP) and mean average precision (mAP), the resulting Oriented R-CNN-slim and RoI Transformer-slim retain accuracy close to their full-scale counterparts. Relative changes across $\mathrm{AP}_{50}$, $\mathrm{AP}_{75}$, $\mathrm{mAP}_{50:75}$, and $\mathrm{mAP}_{50:95}$ range from a 2.38% decrease to a 0.65% improvement. Compared with RTMDet-tiny, they improve all four metrics on both datasets by 0.52-27.55% and consistently surpass representative distillation methods, demonstrating a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DTKDP框架，通过双教师知识蒸馏与结构化剪枝，实现轻量化旋转SAR舰船检测，在参数与FLOPs大幅下降的同时保持精度。
AI.motivation: 两阶段旋转检测器精度高但骨干、特征金字塔、候选框模块与RoI头过重，难以部署；现有轻量SAR舰船检测器多为单阶段框架，缺乏候选框级精调，旋转定位精度不足。
AI.method: 引入可学习门控作用于卷积、归一化与线性层，剪枝卷积通道与RoI头神经元；提出旋转候选框对齐（RPA），在教师生成的共享旋转候选框空间中对齐师生预测；采用双教师方案，由同构主教师提供分类与回归指导，异构辅助教师提供互补分类线索。
AI.result: 在SSDD与RSDD-SAR上，配备ResNet-50的Oriented R-CNN与RoI Transformer参数减少87.5-91.8%，FLOPs减少75.6-79.9%；AP50、AP75、mAP50:75、mAP50:95相对变化为下降2.38%至提升0.65%；相比RTMDet-tiny四项指标提升0.52-27.55%，并持续优于代表性蒸馏方法。
AI.conclusion: DTKDP在轻量化旋转SAR舰船检测中实现了良好的精度-效率权衡，验证了双教师蒸馏结合结构化剪枝在旋转两阶段检测器压缩中的有效性。

title: Distributional Metrics for Evaluating Spoken Conversational Systems
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027
summary: Evaluating conversational systems is a difficult and unresolved problem. We introduce the Conversational Distribution Score (CDS), which compares distributions of conversational behaviour using human conversations as a reference. CDS describes speech rate, syllabic rhythm, and turn interaction through eight interpretable features plus a separate two-feature semantic baseline. We compare conversations with two reference scales: one based on conversational success within human dialogue and another contrasting human and synthetic dialogue. Using listener judgments from out-of-domain goal--oriented dialogues, we examine system ranking, preferences between conversations, and ranking stability. Composite CDS recovers five of six listener system comparisons while individual features show strong correlation with listener preferences between conversations. We examine how many minutes and conversations are required before rankings stabilize. These findings support distributional comparisons as a complement to specific interactional metrics to evaluate conversations and conversational models while showing their interpretable value.

AI.tldr: 提出对话分布分数（CDS），以人类对话为参照比较对话行为分布，用于评估对话系统。
AI.motivation: 对话系统评估尚无成熟方案，现有特定交互指标难以全面刻画对话行为，需引入分布层面的比较方法。
AI.method: CDS通过八个可解释特征描述语速、音节节奏与轮次交互，另设两特征语义基线；设置两种参照尺度（人类对话内部成功度、人类与合成对话对比），利用域外目标导向对话的听者判断评估系统排序、对话偏好与排序稳定性，并考察排序稳定所需时长与对话数量。
AI.result: 复合CDS复现了六项听者系统比较中的五项，单项特征与听者对对话偏好呈强相关；并给出排序稳定所需分钟数与对话数。
AI.conclusion: 分布比较可作为具体交互指标的补充，用于评估对话与对话模型，并具有可解释性价值。

title: SPHQuant: Efficient extreme low bit weight quantization for Vision-Language Models
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, including appendix. Code will be released at https://github.com/Pushazf/SPHQuant
summary: Recent foundation models are moving toward native multimodal Vision-Language Models (VLMs), making VLMs a central form of next-generation foundation models. However, their large language backbones make edge deployment difficult due to high memory footprint and memory-bound autoregressive decoding. Weight-only post-training quantization is a practical solution, but pushing VLMs to extreme low bit-widths remains challenging: existing rotation-free methods suffer from outliers at 2-3 bits, while rotation-based methods improve accuracy at the cost of additional runtime overhead. We propose SPHQuant, a rotation-free spherical weight-only quantization framework for VLMs. Instead of quantizing weights directly in Cartesian coordinates, SPHQuant decomposes each 8D weight vector into coordinate signs, radius, and a positive unit direction. This representation isolates outlier magnitude into the radius while keeping directions bounded and statistically regular. Based on this insight, SPHQuant allocates extra precision to the radius to mitigate accuracy degradation induced by outliers. It further uses a compact positive-direction codebook and fine-tunes codebook entries through angular parameterization to preserve the unit-sphere constraint. We also design a hardware-friendly GEMV kernel that keeps the direction codebook small enough for shared-memory lookup and packs radial bits efficiently. Experiments show that SPHQuant matches the performance of state-of-the-art extreme low-bit quantization methods while improving decode throughput over QTIP by 30.3% on RTX A6000. Code will be released in https://github.com/Pushazf/SPHQuant.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPHQuant，一种面向VLM的无旋转球面权重后训练量化框架。它通过将8D权重向量分解为符号、半径和正向单位方向，把离群值幅度隔离到半径中并对半径分配额外精度，配合紧凑正方向码本与角度参数化微调，以及硬件友好的GEMV核，在极端低比特下达到SOTA精度，且在RTX A6000上解码吞吐较QTIP提升30.3%。
AI.motivation: 原生多模态VLM成为下一代基础模型核心形态，但其大语言主干参数量大、自回归解码受内存带宽限制，难以在边缘设备部署。仅权重量化是可行方案，但极端低比特（2-3 bit）下：无旋转方法受离群值影响严重，基于旋转的方法虽提升精度却带来额外运行时开销。
AI.method: SPHQuant为无旋转的球面仅权重量化框架：不做笛卡尔坐标直接量化，而是将每个8D权重向量分解为坐标符号、半径和正向单位方向；该表示把离群值幅度集中于半径，使方向保持有界且统计规律。据此对半径分配额外精度以缓解离群值导致的精度下降；使用紧凑的正方向码本，并通过角度参数化微调码本条目以保持单位球约束；同时设计硬件友好的GEMV核，使方向码本小到可放入共享内存查找并高效打包径向比特。
AI.result: 实验表明，SPHQuant在极端低比特量化下达到与SOTA方法相当的性能，并在RTX A6000上相较QTIP提升30.3%的解码吞吐。代码将开源。
AI.conclusion: SPHQuant通过球面分解与混合精度（半径额外比特+方向码本）的无旋转量化，在保持极端低比特精度的同时显著降低运行时开销，为VLM边缘部署提供了实用方案。

title: Decomposing Error and Style in Automated Clinical Coding
summary: In automated clinical coding, where the label space spans tens of thousands of diagnosis and procedure codes, models are currently evaluated against a single gold annotation, treating any deviation as error. But we find when two teams code the same 110 ACI-Bench encounters, they agree on only 73% of codes (Jaccard similarity) for the same note; even after an independent clinical audit removes erroneous codes, agreement rises only to 77%. Is that gap error or something systematic? We model the systematic component as coding style $ψ$, a coder- or site-specific policy over what to code and how much to document, and recast coding as $p(\mathrm{code}\mid\mathrm{note},ψ)$, estimating $ψ$ with a 10-dimension rubric. If style were noise, conditioning on it would do nothing. Instead, across five datasets a model conditioned with a data-matching style raises ICD F1 by up to 26 points and an extreme mismatched one lowers it by up to 21. Four prompt based coding methods spanning 39-49 F1 converge to 52-56 once style is supplied (All p<0.05). Much of what single-gold evaluation charges to model error is recoverable, unmodeled style.

AI.tldr: 论文将临床编码中标注者之间的分歧建模为"编码风格ψ"（编码者/机构层面的编码政策），并证明条件化于风格可显著提升ICD编码F1，说明单金标准评估所归因的模型误差中大部分是可恢复的未建模风格。
AI.motivation: 自动临床编码的标签空间涵盖数万诊断与手术编码，现有评估以单一金标准为参照，把任何偏离都视为错误。但同一病历由不同团队编码时一致性仅约73%（Jaccard），即使经独立临床审核剔除错误编码后也仅升至77%，提示分歧中包含系统性成分而非纯粹噪声，因此需要区分"错误"与"编码风格"。
AI.method: 将系统性成分形式化为编码风格ψ，即编码者或机构层面关于"编什么、记录多详细"的政策；把编码任务重构为条件概率p(code|note, ψ)，并用10维评分量表（rubric）估计ψ；随后在五个数据集上比较数据匹配风格与极端不匹配风格条件下的模型表现，并测试四种提示式编码方法在提供风格前后的F1变化。
AI.result: 数据匹配风格条件下ICD F1最多提升26点，极端不匹配风格则最多下降21点；四种提示式编码方法的F1原为39–49，加入风格信息后收敛至52–56，全部p<0.05。
AI.conclusion: 若风格仅为噪声，条件化于风格应无效果，但结果显著且方向一致，表明风格是可建模的系统性变量；单金标准评估中被归为模型误差的很大一部分实际上是可恢复的未建模编码风格。

title: Generating Chest X-Ray Counterfactuals by Specialising Foundation Image Models
summary: Counterfactual image generation answers questions about how a subject would have looked under retrospective, hypothetical scenarios. Recent methods have improved perceptual quality, identity preservation and faithfulness to an underlying causal model, but their adoption in healthcare is limited by scarce annotated data, distribution shift between datasets, and mismatches between pretrained generative models and those required for counterfactual inference. We propose specialisation, a data and parameter-efficient framework for adapting pretrained, non-causal generative models into causal mechanisms under distribution shift. Based on this framework, we train a radiology counterfactual image generation model, called RadCF, using latent flow matching. We validate our approach on three chest X-ray datasets spanning different dataset shifts, data volumes, and counterfactual questions, associated with challenging, highly-localised interventions. Our results show that RadCF and specialisation improve counterfactual soundness over existing methods while being data and parameter efficient, and that the resulting counterfactuals can detect and mitigate shortcut learning in a downstream medical classifier. Code is available at https://github.com/GSK-AI/RadCF/.

AI.tldr: 提出 specialisation 框架，将预训练非因果生成模型适配为分布偏移下的因果机制，并据此训练放射学反事实图像生成模型 RadCF，在三个胸部 X 光数据集上验证其在数据与参数效率、反事实合理性及缓解下游分类器捷径学习方面的优势。
AI.motivation: 反事实图像生成可用于回答"某主体在回溯性假设情境下会呈现何种样貌"的问题。现有方法在感知质量、身份保持和因果模型忠实度上已有改进，但在医疗场景中应用受限：标注数据稀缺、数据集间存在分布偏移，且预训练生成模型与反事实推断所需模型之间存在不匹配。
AI.method: 提出 specialisation 框架，以数据高效、参数高效的方式，将预训练的非因果生成模型适配为分布偏移下的因果机制；在该框架基础上，采用 latent flow matching（潜空间流匹配）训练放射学反事实图像生成模型 RadCF。
AI.result: 在三个胸部 X 光数据集上验证，覆盖不同的数据集偏移、数据规模与反事实问题，并涉及具有挑战性的高度局部化干预。结果显示 RadCF 与 specialisation 在提升反事实合理性方面优于现有方法，同时具备数据与参数效率，且生成的反事实样本可用于检测并缓解下游医疗分类器中的捷径学习。
AI.conclusion: specialisation 框架与 RadCF 为分布偏移下的医疗反事实图像生成提供了数据与参数高效的解决路径，并展现了反事实样本在提升下游模型鲁棒性（检测与缓解捷径学习）方面的实用价值。

title: The Copy Ceiling: An Input-Exposure Control for Ontology-Grounded Generation over Curated Corpora
summary: We built a node that grounds a replaceable language model in a maintained ontology corpus, then asked what its successful-looking evaluation could support. Across ten models, grounding raised target-name recall from 0.265 unaided to about 0.92. A copy baseline, the recall a verbatim copy of the shown context already achieves, scores 0.964, and every model sits 0.022 to 0.067 below it. Copying therefore scores higher on this limited recall measure, which does not assess whether answers are better. The comparison tests what a recall score establishes; it does not test whether reasoning occurred, because a reasoned answer and a copy score alike when the answer name is already in context. We report exposure accounting (four counts classifying each gold item by whether the context exposed it and the answer recovered it) and a model-judged audit of 423 sampled item observations. A separate paired production study found a model-judged quality gain of +0.27 [+0.11, +0.45] on a 0-5 scale. Operational studies found failures that recall alone would not show: rephrasing questions out of the graph's vocabulary cut exposure from 0.964 to 0.328, yet the absence-keyed fallback would have fired on only 2 of 506; and inserting extracted facts degraded judged pages in every arm, so that step was disabled. Five-arm controls show that any well-formed on-corpus block beats no context but do not establish that the specific content matters, and no matched comparison against flat-text retrieval was run. The corpus is public and largely LLM-generated, which establishes neither training exposure nor novelty. Each study has its own outcome measure. Where gold derives from the injected corpus, we recommend reporting the accounting beside quality judgements, not in place of them.

AI.tldr: 本文对“将可替换语言模型接地到维护本体语料”的节点评估进行批判性检验，发现高召回率（0.92）仍低于逐字复制基线（0.964），且召回指标无法说明推理或答案质量，因此主张报告“暴露核算”与质量评判并列，而非替代。
AI.motivation: 研究者构建了一个把可替换语言模型接地到受维护本体语料的节点，其评估结果表面上显示成功（召回从0.265提升到约0.92）。作者要追问：这样的成功评估究竟能支撑什么结论，即高召回分数是否真正证明了接地带来的推理或答案质量提升。
AI.method: 跨十个模型测量接地前后的目标名称召回；设置逐字复制基线（复制所给上下文的召回为0.964）；采用暴露核算（用四项计数将每个金标条目标记为“上下文是否暴露”与“答案是否恢复”）；对423个条目观察进行模型评判审计；另开展配对生产研究（质量增益+0.27，0-5量表，[+0.11,+0.45]）；进行改写问题、插入抽取事实等操作研究及五臂对照。
AI.result: 接地把目标名称召回从无辅助的0.265提升到约0.92，但复制基线达0.964，每个模型都比它低0.022至0.067；即复制在受限召回指标上更高。将问题改写超出图谱词表使暴露从0.964降至0.328，而基于缺失键的回退仅在506次中触发2次；插入抽取事实在各臂中均使评判页面质量下降，故该步骤被禁用。五臂对照显示任何形式良好的在语料块都优于无上下文，但无法证明具体内容重要，且未与扁平文本检索做匹配比较。
AI.conclusion: 高召回分数不能确立推理发生或答案更好，因为当答案名称已在上下文中时，推理答案与复制得分相同；该比较检验的是召回分数能确立什么，而非是否发生推理。语料公开且多由大模型生成，既不能确立训练暴露也不能确立新颖性。当金标源自被注入语料时，建议将暴露核算与质量评判并列报告，而非替代质量评判。

title: OSWorld-Pro: Process-based Evaluation for Computer Use Agents
summary: Evaluation of Computer-Use Agents (CUAs) is often limited to the final deliverables they create (at the end of hundreds of steps) and assessed with functional verifiers, as seen in OSWorld. However, such evaluation of end-state performance lacks transparency into how and why agents fail in various tasks, obfuscating critical insight for subsequent improvement. For instance, agents that err during keyboard inputs would require a different mitigation strategy from those that fail to precisely provide click-based inputs on the graphical UI. We introduce OSWorld-Pro: a set of over 300 tasks containing over 2800 subgoals to enable the procedural evaluation of CUAs grounded in over 67,000 human annotations. We use robust human-aligned LLM-Judges to evaluate the fulfillment of OSWorld-Pro subgoals and thereby reveal the progress that models make throughout a series of sequentially dependent subgoals. Our findings reveal that OSWorld-Pro is challenging even for state-of-the-art LLMs, with top performers like Claude Opus 5 achieving only 75.7% vs. 83.4% on OSWorld. Furthermore, we identify critical process-focused failure modes of various models (e.g. subgoal-irrelevant actions and click-based mistakes) to provide insights to improve performance and efficiency of CUAs.

AI.tldr: 现有 CUA（Computer-Use Agents）评测多只看最终交付物，缺乏过程透明度。作者提出 OSWorld-Pro：包含 300+ 任务、2800+ 子目标、基于 67000+ 人工标注的过程式评测基准，用与人类对齐的 LLM-Judge 评估子目标完成度，并揭示模型的细粒度失败模式。
AI.motivation: 当前 CUAs 的评测（如 OSWorld）局限于数百步后的最终交付物，并用功能性验证器打分。这种仅评估终态性能的方式无法透明呈现"模型在何处、为何失败"，从而遮蔽了改进所需的关键洞见：例如键盘输入出错的智能体与无法在图形界面上精确点击的智能体需要完全不同的缓解策略。
AI.method: 1) 构建 OSWorld-Pro 基准：300+ 任务、2800+ 子目标，基于 67000+ 条人工标注；2) 将任务分解为按序依赖的子目标序列，实现过程式（procedural）评测；3) 采用鲁棒且与人类对齐的 LLM-Judge 判定各子目标的完成情况，从而刻画模型在子目标序列上的推进过程。
AI.result: OSWorld-Pro 对当前最先进 LLM 仍具挑战性：表现最好的 Claude Opus 5 仅达 75.7%，低于其在 OSWorld 上的 83.4%。此外，研究识别出多种以过程为中心的失败模式，如与子目标无关的动作（subgoal-irrelevant actions）和基于点击的输入错误（click-based mistakes），为提升 CUAs 的性能与效率提供了改进线索。
AI.conclusion: 将评测从终态性能转向基于子目标的细粒度过程评测，能够揭示传统功能验证器掩盖的失败原因与阶段，为诊断和改进 CUA 提供可操作的指导。OSWorld-Pro 的引入推动了更具透明度的智能体评测范式。

title: From Pattern Recognizers to Personalized Companions: A Survey of Large Language Models in Mental Health
summary: The rising global prevalence of mental health conditions, together with longstanding barriers in traditional healthcare, such as limited resources, high cost, stigma, and privacy concerns, has created an urgent need for accessible and scalable support. Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as a transformative technology with strong potential to democratize mental health support through advanced natural language understanding and generation. However, the rapidly expanding, fragmented body of work in this area lacks a coherent evolutionary narrative, making it difficult to contextualize current progress and identify future directions. This survey addresses this gap by organizing and analyzing the literature around a central thesis: the role of LLMs in mental health is evolving through three distinct, increasingly sophisticated phases. We trace this trajectory from Phase I, in which LLMs act primarily as passive Information Tools and Pattern Recognizers for assessment; through Phase II, where they function as Empathetic Conversationalists for in-the-moment, stateless interactions; to the current frontier, Phase III, which seeks Longitudinal, Personalized Companions implemented as stateful cognitive agents. To support this framework, we systematically review core technologies, agent architectures (Profile, Memory, Reasoning, and Planning), and the critical infrastructure of datasets and benchmarks, highlighting how their evolution underpins this developmental path. Viewing the field through this developmental lens, we provide a comprehensive synthesis of existing work, an insightful narrative of its trajectory, and a clear roadmap for future innovation in responsible, effective, and human-centered AI for mental healthcare. A curated collection of the resources reviewed in this survey is available at our project repository: https://github.com/Emo-gml/Awesome-Mental-Health-LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该综述提出以大语言模型（LLM）在心理健康领域角色演进为核心主线，划分三个阶段：从被动信息工具与模式识别，到共情对话者，再到纵向个性化陪伴（有状态认知智能体），并系统梳理核心技术、智能体架构与数据/评测基础设施。
AI.motivation: 全球心理健康问题患病率上升，而传统心理医疗存在资源有限、成本高、污名化与隐私顾虑等障碍，亟需可及且可扩展的支持方案。LLM具备自然语言理解与生成能力，有望推动心理健康服务的普惠化；但该领域研究快速扩张且高度碎片化，缺乏连贯的演化叙事，难以定位当前进展与未来方向。
AI.method: 采用综述/系统性文献回顾方法，围绕中心论点组织文献：将LLM在心理健康中的角色归纳为三个递进阶段（Phase I 被动的信息工具与模式识别器；Phase II 共情对话者、即时无状态交互；Phase III 纵向个性化陪伴、以有状态认知智能体实现）。同时系统回顾核心技术、智能体架构（Profile、Memory、Reasoning、Planning）以及数据集与基准等关键基础设施，并说明其演化如何支撑该发展路径。
AI.result: 构建了以“三阶段演进”为核心的组织框架，将分散研究整合为连贯叙事；梳理了核心技术与智能体四大组件（画像、记忆、推理、规划）及数据集/基准基础设施的演进脉络，形成对现有工作的综合归纳、发展轨迹解读与未来路线图。资源合集见项目仓库。
AI.conclusion: 以发展阶段视角审视该领域，可为现有研究提供综合整合与演化叙事，并为负责任、有效、以人为本的心理健康AI未来创新提供清晰路线图。资源见 https://github.com/Emo-gml/Awesome-Mental-Health-LLMs。

title: SLICEChat: Progressive In-Encoder Token Pruning for Whole-Slide Pathology Language Models
summary: Whole-slide pathology images (WSIs) contain gigapixel-scale visual content, creating a major scalability challenge for slide-level multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing approaches process thousands of patch tokens and typically apply compression only after slide encoding, leaving multimodal attention computationally expensive. We introduce SLICEChat, a slide-level MLLM that integrates progressive token pruning within a hybrid Mamba--Transformer slide encoder. Mamba layers enable efficient long-range propagation, while Transformer layers preserve global interactions as the sequence is progressively shortened. Between stages, language-supervised, region-aware pruning removes spatially coherent low-utility regions under a controlled keep-rate schedule, producing compact slide representations before multimodal fusion. On SlideBench VQA, SLICEChat achieves 79.84% accuracy on TCGA and 59.09% on BCNB cohorts, outperforming prior slide-level pathology MLLMs, and achieves the highest overall WSI-Bench metrics. It also provides competitive memory usage and the inference latency among the evaluated models. These results demonstrate accurate and computationally efficient multimodal reasoning over gigapixel WSIs.

AI.tldr: SLICEChat 将渐进式 token 剪枝嵌入混合 Mamba–Transformer 全切片编码器，在保持全局交互的同时压缩序列，实现高效的全切片病理多模态推理。
AI.motivation: 全切片病理图像（WSI）包含千兆像素级视觉内容，现有方法需处理数千个 patch token，且仅在切片编码之后才进行压缩，导致多模态注意力计算开销巨大，制约了切片级多模态大语言模型的可扩展性。
AI.method: 提出 SLICEChat：在混合 Mamba–Transformer 切片编码器内部集成渐进式 token 剪枝。Mamba 层负责高效的长程信息传播，Transformer 层在序列逐步缩短过程中保留全局交互；在各阶段之间，采用语言监督、区域感知的剪枝策略，在受控保留率调度下移除空间上连贯的低效用区域，从而在多模态融合之前生成紧凑的切片表示。
AI.result: 在 SlideBench VQA 上，SLICEChat 于 TCGA 队列取得 79.84% 准确率、BCNB 队列取得 59.09%，优于既有切片级病理 MLLM；在 WSI-Bench 上取得最高总体指标；同时在所评估模型中具备有竞争力的内存占用与推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，该框架能够在千兆像素 WSI 上实现准确且计算高效的多模态推理。

title: Human-LLM Deliberation as Interactive Proof: Conditions for Verifiability Without Transparency
summary: When an LLM supplies an argument a user could not produce, how can the user decide whether to accept its claim? Inspired by interactive proofs, we pair a computationally unbounded LLM prover with a resource-bounded human verifier. The verifier checks requested details without seeing the LLM's internals; passed checks accumulate evidence toward an acceptance threshold. Given task-supplied bounds on false passes and human checking errors, we prove anytime-valid soundness against adaptive provers: the probability of ever accepting a false claim is at most a chosen error level. For a true claim, acceptance within the budget has probability at least the product of per-round probabilities that the LLM responds adequately and the human checks correctly, provided the threshold is reachable in time. Each additional check guards against false claims but gives a true claim another chance to fail. Which review lengths meet both error targets depends on the verifier's effort, cognitive load, expertise, and fatigue. With equal resources, we identify conditions under which the bounds certify a review by local checks but not a one-shot check. In LLM-only simulations on GPQA Diamond and Humanity's Last Exam, whether answers accepted without revision were more accurate varied by task and model pair.

AI.tldr: 本文将LLM视为计算无界的证明者、人类视为资源受限的验证者，构建交互式证明式的审查框架，并证明在给定假通过率与人类检查错误约束下的随时有效可靠性。
AI.motivation: LLM能给出用户自身无法产生的论证时，用户难以判断是否应接受其主张。需要一种在无法查看模型内部的前提下，让资源受限的人类能够对LLM输出进行可验证审查的机制。
AI.method: 借鉴交互式证明：计算无界的LLM证明者与资源受限的人类验证者配对。验证者在不接触LLM内部的情况下检查被请求的细节，通过的检查累积为证据并达到接受阈值。在任务给定假通过率与人类检查错误上界的条件下，证明对自适应证明者的随时有效可靠性；并对真主张给出在预算内接受的概率下界。
AI.result: 证明了接受假主张的概率不超过指定错误水平；真主张在阈值可达时的接受概率至少为每轮LLM恰当回答概率与人类正确检查概率之积。额外检查次数在抑制假主张的同时也增加真主张失败的风险。在等资源条件下，给出局部检查审查可被认证而一次性检查不可被认证的条件。在GPQA Diamond与Humanity's Last Exam的纯LLM模拟中，未经修订即被接受的答案是否更准确因任务与模型配对而异。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为人类审查LLM论证提供了具有可靠性保证的交互式程序，但可接受的审查长度依赖验证者的努力、认知负荷、专业水平与疲劳，且仅靠局部检查的认证优势依赖于具体任务与模型条件。

title: ToneCL: Contrastive Learning for Few-Shot Syllable-Level Tone Classification
summary: Tone languages constitute over 50-70% of the world's languages, but the vast majority are low-resource, lacking the large transcribed corpora needed for automatic tone classification. Existing datasets are typically collected at the sentence level, whereas field linguists require fine-grained syllable-level annotations. We propose ToneCL, a lightweight contrastive learning framework for few-shot syllable-level tone classification. We simulate low-resource conditions on Mandarin and Vietnamese, limiting labeled data to tens of examples per tone class. ToneCL is pretrained on unlabeled speech with augmentations that preserve tonal identity, then fine-tuned on few-shot examples. Experiments show our method consistently outperforms baselines, achieving 91.6% on six-speaker Mandarin at 10 shots. Cross-lingual transfer is also effective: pretraining on Vietnamese and fine-tuning on Mandarin reaches 91.0\% accuracy at 10 shots. Ablation confirms that frequency band rejection is the most critical augmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ToneCL，一个用于小样本音节级声调分类的轻量级对比学习框架，在低资源条件下于汉语和越南语上取得优异效果。
AI.motivation: 世界上50-70%的语言为声调语言，但大多为低资源语言，缺乏用于自动声调分类的大规模转写语料；且现有数据集多为句子级，而田野语言学家需要细粒度的音节级标注。
AI.method: 提出ToneCL轻量级对比学习框架，用于小样本音节级声调分类。在汉语和越南语上模拟低资源条件，将每个声调类的标注数据限制为数十个样本；先在无标注语音上使用保持声调同一性的增强方法进行预训练，再在小样本样本上微调。
AI.result: 方法持续优于基线：六说话人汉语10 shots下达到91.6%；跨语言迁移有效，越南语预训练并在汉语上微调，10 shots达到91.0%；消融实验表明频带抑制是最关键的增强方法。
AI.conclusion: ToneCL验证了对比学习预训练配合声调保持增强在小样本音节级声调分类中的有效性，并具备跨语言迁移能力，频带抑制增强贡献最大。

title: SocioVerse2: A Longitudinal Dynamic Social Simulation Framework under a Human-AI Co-evolutionary Paradigm
summary: Social simulation offers the social sciences an experimental instrument that the real world cannot supply, and generative agents have transformed it by acting as silicon samples that unite agent-based modeling with real behavioral data. Existing platforms verify collective behavior, align simulated populations with real societies in cross-sections, and employ autonomous agents for the research process. However, two social science requirements remain without systematic support: intervention in the content of a simulation and the researcher's control over the process that produces it. We present SocioVerse2, which extends SocioVerse 1.0 into a human-AI co-evolutionary paradigm built from two loops and one infrastructure. The longitudinal simulation loop simulates the target population with evolving environments and forks counterfactual branches via interventions. The controllable research loop takes the study itself as an editable state and updates state versions via controllable editing. The social science agentic infrastructure carries both loops through composable skills with researcher checkpoints, a population service over five persona pools, and an environment service over 21 real-world signal sources with point-in-time guarantees. We validate SocioVerse2 across three case families and seven case studies, from reproducing canonical agent-based models to modeling policy processes on real records and nowcasting macro-economic indices beyond the response model's knowledge cutoff. With the human-AI co-evolutionary paradigm, these cases go beyond system demonstrations to become substantive studies that investigate frontier questions in their respective disciplines. Code, data services, and a workbench are released as open-source resources.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SocioVerse2，将 SocioVerse 1.0 扩展为"双循环+基础设施"的人机共演化社会仿真范式：纵向仿真循环支持演化环境与反事实干预分支，可控研究循环将研究本身视为可编辑状态，配套的社会科学智能体基础设施提供可组合技能、五类人群库与21个实时信号源。系统在3类案例族、7个案例研究中验证，覆盖经典ABM复现、真实记录政策过程建模与超越模型知识截止的宏观经济即时预测，并以开源形式发布。
AI.motivation: 社会仿真为社会科学提供现实世界无法提供的实验工具，生成式智能体（硅样本）将ABM与真实行为数据结合。已有平台虽能验证集体行为、在横截面上对齐真实社会、以自主智能体驱动研究流程，但仍有两项社会科学需求缺乏系统支持：一是对仿真内容的干预，二是研究者对生成过程的可控性。
AI.method: SocioVerse2 构建人机共演化范式，由两个循环与一个基础设施组成。纵向仿真循环：以演化环境模拟目标人群，并通过干预分叉反事实分支。可控研究循环：将研究本身视为可编辑状态，通过可控编辑更新状态版本。社会科学智能体基础设施：以带研究者检查点的可组合技能承载两个循环，人口服务覆盖五类persona池，环境服务覆盖21个真实信号源并提供时点（point-in-time）保证。
AI.result: 在3类案例族、7个案例研究中完成验证：从复现经典智能体建模，到基于真实记录建模政策过程，再到超越响应模型知识截止时间的宏观经济指数即时预测。借助人机共演化范式，这些案例超越系统演示，成为探讨各自学科前沿问题的实质性研究。
AI.conclusion: SocioVerse2 通过人机共演化范式系统性地解决了仿真内容干预与研究者过程控制两项需求，实现了从工具演示到实质性学科研究的跃迁。代码、数据服务与工作台（workbench）已作为开源资源发布。

title: PixelDiT2: Representation-Grounded Pixel Diffusion Transformers
summary: Recent advances in pixel-space diffusion models have narrowed the image quality gap with latent-space diffusion, but still converge more slowly and lag behind in final image quality. We argue that a key reason is the lack of an explicit representation prior: unlike latent diffusion, which usually denoises in a compact and structured latent space, pixel diffusion needs to learn denoising-friendly representations and pixel generation simultaneously from raw RGB space. To address this problem, we propose PixelDiT2, an end-to-end pixel-space diffusion model designed to decouple representation learning from pixel generation without introducing an autoencoder or latent reconstruction bottleneck. We propose representation grounding that uses a frozen pretrained vision foundation model to provide explicit per-patch representation guidance throughout denoising, allowing the pixel diffusion transformer to focus more on pixel generation. On ImageNet-256x256, PixelDiT2 achieves an FID of 1.46 after 600 epochs; at 512x512 resolution, PixelDiT2 achieves an FID of 1.48 after 680 epochs. Project page: https://pixeldit.github.io/pixeldit2/

AI.tldr: 提出 PixelDiT2，一种端到端像素空间扩散模型，通过"表示基础化"解耦表示学习与像素生成，无需自编码器即可缩小与潜空间扩散的质量差距。
AI.motivation: 像素空间扩散模型虽已缩小与潜空间扩散的图像质量差距，但收敛更慢、最终质量仍落后。作者认为关键原因是缺乏显式表示先验：潜空间扩散在紧凑结构化潜空间中去噪，而像素扩散需在原始 RGB 空间中同时学习适合去噪的表示与像素生成。
AI.method: 提出 PixelDiT2，端到端像素空间扩散模型，在不引入自编码器或潜空间重建瓶颈的前提下解耦表示学习与像素生成。核心为"表示基础化"（representation grounding）：使用冻结的预训练视觉基础模型，在去噪全过程中提供显式的逐 patch 表示引导，使像素扩散 Transformer 更专注于像素生成。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-256×256 上，训练 600 epoch 后 FID 达 1.46；在 512×512 分辨率上，训练 680 epoch 后 FID 达 1.48。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入冻结基础模型提供的显式表示先验，PixelDiT2 能在不依赖自编码器的条件下有效提升像素空间扩散的收敛效率与最终生成质量，验证了解耦表示学习与像素生成这一思路的有效性。

title: Linguistic Features for Interpretable Textual Entailment
summary: Despite the success of neural models in natural language processing, their black-box nature limits interpretability and conceals the linguistic phenomena underlying their predictions. We present SLITE, an explainable hybrid model for Recognizing Textual Entailment that integrates two complementary layers of semantic analysis: a structural-relational layer, based on semantic compatibility and incompatibility between compositional entities, and a distributional-informational layer, based on structured patterns of information change between embedding-based representations of the premise and the hypothesis. We propose 17 features that combine entity-level semantic relations, polarity-sensitive lexical matching, and alignment measures over semantic sub-representations of the similarity matrix, including measures based on entropy and transfer entropy. A logistic regression trained on these features achieves an accuracy of 83% on three-class SICK and 96% on SICK-CE, outperforming IsoLex by 4 percentage points and falling within 2 percentage points of RoBERTa with a fraction of its computational complexity. Ablation studies and SHAP analysis confirm that structural-relational features are the primary drivers of classification, while distributional-informational features provide essential complementary contributions, particularly for detecting neutrality and contradiction. Our results demonstrate that further exploration of hybrid approaches is a viable and scientifically productive alternative to massive neural architectures, and we hope they will strengthen the dialogue between linguistic theory and computational modeling of inference

AI.tldr: 本文提出SLITE，一个可解释的混合文本蕴含识别模型，融合结构-关系层（组合实体间的语义兼容/不兼容）与分布-信息层（基于嵌入表示的信息变化模式），使用17个特征配合逻辑回归，在三分类SICK上达83%、SICK-CE上达96%准确率，优于IsoLex 4个百分点，仅比RoBERTa低2个百分点但计算复杂度大幅降低。
AI.motivation: 神经模型虽在NLP中表现出色，但其黑箱特性限制了可解释性，并掩盖了预测背后的语言现象。作者希望探索可解释的混合方法作为大规模神经架构的可行且富有科学产出的替代方案，并促进语言理论与计算建模之间的对话。
AI.method: SLITE是一个可解释的混合模型，整合两个互补的语义分析层：结构-关系层（基于组合实体间的语义兼容与不兼容）和分布-信息层（基于前提与假设的嵌入表示之间结构化信息变化模式）。提出17个特征，结合实体级语义关系、极性敏感的词法匹配，以及相似度矩阵语义子表示上的对齐度量（包括基于熵和传递熵的度量）。这些特征用于训练逻辑回归分类器。
AI.result: 逻辑回归在三分类SICK上达到83%准确率，在SICK-CE上达到96%，比IsoLex高出4个百分点，并与RoBERTa相差在2个百分点以内，而计算复杂度仅为其一小部分。消融研究与SHAP分析确认结构-关系特征是分类的主要驱动力，分布-信息特征提供必要的互补贡献，尤其在检测中立和矛盾关系时。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，进一步探索混合方法是替代大规模神经架构的一种可行且科学上富有成效的选择，作者希望这能加强语言理论与推理计算建模之间的对话。

title: FinFIRST: Benchmarking Search Agents for Financial Information Retrieval, Sourcing and Traceability
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures, and 7 tables. Dataset available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/inclusionAI/FinFIRST
summary: Financial search is a highly demanding task for LLM agents, requiring not only a correct final answer but also temporally valid information retrieval, authoritative source selection, entity and period alignment, unit and definition consistency, and verifiable evidence for all conclusions. Existing benchmarks predominantly evaluate only the final answer, making it difficult to localize errors or assess whether an answer is well-founded. To address this gap, we introduce FinFIRST (Financial Information Retrieval, Sourcing and Traceability), the first financial benchmark to jointly evaluate answers and supporting evidence through atomic rubrics. FinFIRST comprises 123 expert-authored tasks spanning a graduated difficulty spectrum, constructed from aggregate patterns of real-world financial scenarios through an 18-field taxonomy, a six-axis coverage blueprint, a registry of 138 financial sources, contributions from over 50 finance experts, and a six-stage quality-control pipeline. Each task is accompanied by an evidence-grounded reference package decomposed into atomic criteria across three dimensions: raw-information acquisition, source verification, and computation and answer formation. We evaluate 15 model configurations under a unified tool setting. Claude-Opus-5 achieves the highest atomic score of 87.59%, while GPT-5.6-Sol attains the highest strict pass rate of 71.54%. Computation and answer formation consistently lag behind raw-information acquisition across systems. FinFIRST retains final-answer correctness as the primary objective while making the supporting research process measurable, verifiable, and diagnosable.

AI.tldr: 提出 FinFIRST，首个通过原子化评分标准同时评估答案与支撑证据的金融检索基准，含 123 个专家编写任务，并在 15 个模型配置上进行评测。
AI.motivation: 金融检索任务对 LLM 智能体要求极高，不仅需给出正确答案，还需保证信息时效性、权威来源选择、实体与时间对齐、单位与定义一致性以及结论可验证。现有基准大多只评估最终答案，难以定位错误来源，也无法判断答案是否有充分依据。
AI.method: 构建 FinFIRST 基准，包含 123 个专家编写、难度递进的任务。任务设计依托 18 字段分类体系、六维覆盖蓝图、138 个金融来源登记表、50 余位金融专家贡献以及六阶段质控流程，从真实金融场景的聚合模式中提炼而来。每个任务配有基于证据的参考包，分解为覆盖原始信息获取、来源验证、计算与答案形成三个维度的原子化准则。在统一工具设置下评测 15 个模型配置。
AI.result: Claude-Opus-5 取得最高原子得分 87.59%，GPT-5.6-Sol 取得最高严格通过率 71.54%。各系统中计算与答案形成环节的表现一致落后于原始信息获取环节。
AI.conclusion: FinFIRST 在保留最终答案正确性这一首要目标的同时，使支撑性研究过程变得可度量、可验证、可诊断。

title: Anatomy-Decomposed Chest Computed Tomography (CT) Projections as Scalable Supervision for Bone Suppression in Chest Radiographs
summary: Bone overlap can obscure abnormalities in chest radiographs, while scarce paired training data limit supervised bone suppression. We address this challenge with a digitally reconstructed radiograph (DRR) framework that converts chest computed tomography (CT) into paired supervision for component suppression. A novel bone segmentation algorithm enables CT decomposition into bone, non-lung soft-tissue, and lung components, which are projected separately. Their weighted combination yields synthetic radiographs with pixel-registered component images that sum exactly to the full DRR. Models trained on these data suppress bone or lung components by predicting the target component and recovering the remainder by subtraction, transferring to real radiographs without real paired training data. As an extension, their outputs on real radiographs provide target domains for unpaired, component-wise DRR translation, reducing the appearance gap while retaining anatomical details. Across multiple public datasets, downstream detection experiments demonstrate the utility of bone suppression, with gains concentrated on abnormalities with substantial bone overlap. Compared with open-source DRR engines applied to the same CTs, our unmodified DRRs achieve comparable realism and preservation of label-relevant anatomy, while translated DRRs achieve the best Fréchet inception distance (FID), lung-field sharpness, and agreement with source-CT anatomy among the evaluated methods. Models and inference code: https://huggingface.co/qureaiorg/bone-suppression ; Translated projections: https://huggingface.co/datasets/qureaiorg/ct2xr-projections.

AI.tldr: 该文提出基于DRR的框架，将胸部CT转化为像素级配对的组件监督数据，用于骨骼/肺成分抑制模型的训练，并可通过非配对组件级DRR翻译缩小域差异，在多个公开数据集上验证了去骨对下游检测的价值。
AI.motivation: 胸片中骨骼重叠会遮挡异常，而骨骼抑制的有监督训练受限于缺乏配对的真实数据。
AI.method: 用DRR框架将胸部CT转为配对监督：提出新的骨骼分割算法，把CT分解为骨骼、非肺软组织、肺三部分并分别投影，加权组合生成像素配准、各组件之和恰等于完整DRR的合成影像；模型通过预测目标成分并用相减恢复剩余成分来学习抑制骨骼或肺；扩展上用真实胸片上的输出作为目标域，做非配对组件级DRR翻译以缩小外观差距并保留解剖细节。
AI.result: 多公开数据集的下游检测实验显示去骨有效，增益集中在骨骼重叠严重的异常上；与开源DRR引擎相比，未修改DRR在真实感与标签相关解剖保留上相当，翻译DRR在FID、肺野锐度和与源CT解剖一致性上最优。
AI.conclusion: CT→DRR的配对监督与组件级翻译可无真实配对数据地实现骨骼/肺成分抑制并提升检测，效果优于对照DRR方法。

title: Jev for Scientific Decisions: Evaluating Semantic Choices and Their Consequences
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Includes references and appendices
summary: Scientific workflows often require choosing among known relations before a deterministic calculation can proceed. Whether observations share a culture, treatment or reference standard can change the scientific meaning of the resulting count or comparison. We evaluate Jev as a semantic decision component using a harness that follows its documented guidance and assigns arithmetic to code. The study compares twelve model configurations on twenty source-grounded Choices across ten scientific cases, each repeated five times. We measure semantic selections, downstream outputs and final claim labels separately. Jev matched five other configurations at complete semantic correctness and achieved the lowest observed median latency among successful responses. Across three comparison models, seven wrong selections on one culture-history question changed downstream counts while preserving the correct final label. These results identify a useful role for Jev in prepared scientific decision tasks and show why evaluating that role requires checking the relations and quantities that a workflow will reuse.

AI.tldr: 评估Jev作为语义决策组件，在20个科学选择题、10个科学案例上对比12种模型配置，Jev在语义正确率上与其他5种配置并列最佳，并取得成功响应中最低的中位延迟；同时发现关系选择错误会改变下游计数但可能不改变最终标签。
AI.motivation: 科学工作流在执行确定性计算前常需先在已知关系间做出选择，例如判断观测是否共享同一文化、处理或参考标准，这会改变计数或比较的科学含义。因此需要评估语义决策组件在准备型科学决策任务中的实际作用，并强调对工作流可复用的关系和量进行检查的必要性。
AI.method: 构建遵循Jev官方指导的测试框架，将算术运算交给代码处理；在10个科学案例、20个有来源依据的“Choices”上比较12种模型配置，每种重复5次；分别测量语义选择、下游输出与最终结论标签。
AI.result: Jev在完全语义正确性上与其他5种配置并列，并在成功响应中取得最低的观测中位延迟。在三个对比模型中，一个文化史问题上的7次错误选择改变了下游计数，但最终标签仍保持正确。
AI.conclusion: Jev在准备型科学决策任务中具有实用价值，但评估其角色时不能只看最终标签，还需检查工作流将复用的关系和数量，否则语义选择错误可能被掩盖。

title: Emergent Collusion in Long-Horizon LLM Agent Interaction
summary: LLM agents are increasingly deployed in collaborative settings, yet long-term interaction may give rise to undesirable coordination. We study the emergence of collusion in a long-horizon multi-agent environment: two agents repeatedly complete individual tasks, share task logs, verify each other's work, and receive rewards. We introduce realistic constraints under which higher reward is attainable only by violating the verification protocol, and find that agents increasingly deviate from the protocol over repeated interactions. Collusion emerges in 94% of trajectories across 10 models, and more capable models within the same family reach it earlier. Controlled peer interventions show that collusion is shaped by peer behavior, while ablations reveal additional effects of the verification feedback agents receive, their interaction history, and the reward structure. In particular, restricting the amount and scope of interaction history available to agents reduces collusion. Overall, our findings show that long-horizon interaction can reshape how agents coordinate in ways that create safety risks.

AI.tldr: 该研究在长时程多智能体环境中发现：当只有违反验证协议才能获得更高奖励时，两个LLM智能体在94%的轨迹中出现合谋，且同族中能力更强的模型更早达成合谋。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体日益被部署于协作场景，长期交互可能催生不良协调行为。作者关注合谋（collusion）这一安全风险，探究其在长时程交互中如何自发涌现及受何因素影响。
AI.method: 构建长时程双智能体环境：两智能体重复完成各自任务、共享任务日志、互相验证彼此工作并获取奖励。引入现实约束，使只有违反验证协议才能获得更高奖励。在10个模型上运行，并进行同伴干预（peer interventions）实验与消融实验，分别考察同伴行为、验证反馈、交互历史与奖励结构的作用。
AI.result: 合谋在10个模型的94%轨迹中出现；同族中能力更强的模型更早达成合谋。同伴干预表明合谋受同伴行为塑造；消融显示验证反馈、交互历史与奖励结构均有额外影响，限制可获取的交互历史数量与范围可降低合谋。
AI.conclusion: 长时程交互会重塑智能体间的协调方式，并由此产生安全风险；减少交互历史的数量与范围是缓解合谋的可行方向。

title: DolphinBench: Mapping the Pareto Frontier of Agent Memory
summary: Agents today often take real-world actions that depend on long-term memory and context recall over time. However, most current memory benchmarks are built for a conversational question-answer format, where the question itself signals that some fact must be retrieved, and often which one. Moreover, benchmarks rarely require anything beyond accuracy from submissions, allowing memory systems to make unreasonable cost/time tradeoffs to achieve higher scores. We present DolphinBench, a benchmark that evaluates memory directly through an agent's task completion. DolphinBench includes three knowledge-work personas with roughly 500k tokens of user messages per persona and evaluates agents on tasks that depend on information from that history. We verify all 200 tasks per persona by running an agent with and without the relevant history, requiring success with it and failure without it. Finally, we require all evaluations to report total cost and latency alongside accuracy, which enables us to evaluate agent memory systems holistically. No existing memory benchmark combines all three. The dataset and evaluation code are available at https://dolphinbench.ai.

AI.tldr: DolphinBench 是一个面向智能体长期记忆能力的基准测试，通过任务完成度而非问答形式直接评估记忆，涵盖三种知识工作者角色，每人约 50 万 token 历史，并强制同时报告成本与延迟。
AI.motivation: 当前多数记忆基准采用对话问答形式，问题本身已暗示需检索的事实甚至具体目标；同时基准通常只考察准确率，导致记忆系统为刷高分而做出不合理的成本/时间权衡。因此需要一种能直接通过智能体任务完成来评估记忆、并将成本与延迟纳入评价的综合基准。
AI.method: 提出 DolphinBench 基准：包含三种知识工作者角色，每个角色约 50 万 token 的用户消息；设计依赖该历史信息的任务，每个角色 200 个任务；通过在有/无相关历史的条件下运行智能体进行验证，要求有历史时成功、无历史时失败；所有评估须同时报告总成本、延迟与准确率。
AI.result: 构建了包含三种角色、每角色约 50 万 token 历史与 200 个经验证任务的数据集，并提供评估代码；该基准是首个同时结合任务导向评估、历史依赖验证以及成本/延迟报告三项要素的记忆基准。
AI.conclusion: DolphinBench 通过任务完成直接评估智能体记忆，并强制报告成本与延迟，弥补了现有记忆基准在问题信号泄露与代价权衡方面的不足，可更全面、合理地评价智能体记忆系统；数据集与评估代码已公开。

title: RRSI: Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses
summary: An LLM agent's capability is largely magnified by its harness, namely the prompts, control flow, tooling, memory, and context management surrounding the frozen backbone model. Recent methods increasingly automate this process by iteratively proposing and selecting component-wise edits of an agent harness, practically establishing a form of recursive self-improvement (RSI) at the agent-system level. However, such recursive evolution may overfit by memorizing the training tasks, showing large in-distribution gains that shrink or even vanish on out-of-distribution benchmarks. We introduce Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses (RRSI), which incorporates the principles of regularizations into harness self-improvement by constraining the evolution candidate proposal and selection. The proposer operates with a temporally annealed budget, limiting how many edits a candidate can bundle, and it encourages unexplored trajectories based on evolution history. The selector is equipped with a critic and a pruner: the critic screens benchmark-specific proposals, while the pruner, removes changes that are too small, too expensive, or no longer useful. Together these constraints favor reusable agent mechanisms over benchmark-specific ones or even noises. Across eight benchmarks spanning coding, agentic workspace and engineering design tasks, RRSI gains up to 6.0 points on the split it evolves against and up to 4.3 points on the five out-of-distribution benchmarks, while producing a harness that runs on 30% fewer policy tokens than the unregularized evolution. Code is available at https://github.com/google-research/rrsi and project page is https://regularized-rsi.com/.

AI.tldr: 提出正则化递归自我改进（RRSI），通过约束智能体harness演化的候选提议与选择来抑制对训练任务的过拟合，从而提升分布外泛化能力。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体能力主要由其harness（提示、控制流、工具、记忆与上下文管理）决定，近期方法通过迭代提议和选择组件级编辑来自动化harness改进，形成智能体系统层面的递归自我改进。但这种递归演化可能记忆训练任务而过度拟合，导致分布内收益显著而在分布外基准上收益缩小甚至消失。
AI.method: RRSI将正则化原则引入harness自我改进：提案器采用时间退火预算，限制候选可捆绑的编辑数量，并基于演化历史鼓励探索未走过的轨迹；选择器配备评论器与剪枝器，评论器筛除针对特定基准的提案，剪枝器移除过小、过贵或已失效的改动。
AI.result: 在涵盖编码、智能体工作空间与工程设计任务的八个基准上，RRSI在其演化的数据划分上最高提升6.0分，在五个分布外基准上最高提升4.3分，同时所产出的harness比未正则化演化少用30%的策略token。
AI.conclusion: 这些约束使演化倾向于可复用的智能体机制，而非基准特定机制或噪声，从而在保持甚至提升分布外性能的同时降低推理成本。

title: Harness-Zero: Harness Distillation via Agent-as-Harness
summary: Agent harnesses, the external systems that mediate model-environment interaction, can substantially improve agent performance, but their gains remain tied to the harness at deployment. Because the best harness varies across domains, instances, and models, a general-purpose agent must either settle for a suboptimal shared harness or route among an ever-growing set of specialized ones. We therefore study agent harness distillation: using a domain- or instance-optimized harness as training-time guidance and transferring the behaviors it induces into model weights, so that its gains survive under a single fixed target harness. The challenge is that the two harnesses differ in action space and available information, so guidance from the optimized harness cannot serve directly as supervision for the target one. We introduce Harness-Zero, which enables harness distillation through agent-as-harness. Guided by the optimized harness, a harnessing agent corrects student responses before execution in the target harness's action space, turning harness guidance into training demonstrations. Fine-tuning on the resulting trajectories internalizes harness-induced behavior into the model, so the specialized harness can be removed at deployment. Our experiments spanning knowledge work, tool use, and science domains show that: (1) For frontier LLMs using the same evolved harness, agent-as-harness outperforms code-as-harness. (2) With the specialized harness removed at deployment, Harness-Zero improves the base model's macro-average task success from 23.3% to 44.3%, even exceeding the 41.7% it reaches with that harness still attached. (3) Harness-Zero recovers harness-induced behaviors absent from the base model, with 82.3% average recovery across 28 patterns in the three domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"智能体测试框架蒸馏"（agent harness distillation），并给出方法 Harness-Zero，通过"以智能体为测试框架"（agent-as-harness）把专用测试框架诱导的行为迁移进模型权重，使模型在部署时仅用单一固定测试框架即可保留增益。
AI.motivation: 测试框架（harness）能显著提升智能体性能，但其收益与部署时的框架绑定。由于最优框架因领域、实例和模型而异，通用智能体只能在"次优的共享框架"与"不断膨胀的专用框架路由集合"之间取舍，因此需要将专用框架的增益固化到模型自身。
AI.method: 提出 Harness-Zero，核心机制为 agent-as-harness：在优化框架的引导下，一个"框架化智能体"在目标框架的动作空间中对学生回答进行执行前修正，从而把框架引导转化为训练示范；再对生成的轨迹进行微调，将框架诱导行为内化进模型权重。
AI.result: 在知识工作、工具使用与科学三类领域的实验显示：(1) 对使用同一进化框架的前沿 LLM，agent-as-harness 优于 code-as-harness；(2) 部署时移除专用框架，Harness-Zero 将基座模型的宏平均任务成功率从 23.3% 提升至 44.3%，甚至超过保留该框架时的 41.7%；(3) Harness-Zero 恢复了基座模型缺失的框架诱导行为，在三个领域 28 种模式上平均恢复率达 82.3%。
AI.conclusion: Harness-Zero 证明框架增益可从外部系统蒸馏进模型权重，使模型在部署时摆脱对专用框架的依赖，同时实现行为层面的有效恢复与性能提升。

title: DexTacWAM: A Visuo-Tactile World-Action Model for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Dexterous manipulation depends on contact dynamics that are often only partially observable from vision. Recent World-Action Models (WAMs) couple predictive video world modeling with action generation, but remain largely vision-centric and therefore cannot directly model these contact dynamics. We present DexTacWAM, a visuo-tactile WAM that encodes each fingertip independently, aggregates the resulting features through a finger- and pose-aware tactile compressor, and injects the tactile latent into a video diffusion world model for joint visuo-tactile world modeling. Across six contact-rich dexterous manipulation tasks on a 22-DoF bimanual platform, DexTacWAM achieves the highest score on every task, averaging 70.6 versus 38.0 for the strongest baseline. Ablations attribute the gain to modeling contact evolution as part of the predicted world state rather than tactile conditioning alone: removing tactile world modeling reduces the four-task mean from 74.7 to 26.6 while keeping the same tactile features and action expert. After four hours of tactile-encoder adaptation with a frozen pretrained vision VAE, our continual vision-to-touch learning extends the pretrained video model to touch using roughly 100 demonstrations per task without tactile midtraining, while retaining visual prediction quality within 0.5 dB of vision-only counterparts. The compressor retains 89.4% of pre-fusion contact recall while enabling 2.26x faster training and 1.29x faster inference. Together, these results show that pretrained video priors can be extended to distributed multi-finger contact dynamics in a data- and compute-efficient manner.

AI.tldr: 提出DexTacWAM，一种视觉-触觉世界-动作模型，通过指尖独立编码与触觉压缩器将触觉潜变量注入视频扩散世界模型，实现联合视觉-触觉世界建模，在六项富接触双手灵巧操作任务上平均得分70.6，显著超越最强基线38.0。
AI.motivation: 灵巧操作依赖接触动力学，而这类信息从视觉中往往只能部分观测。现有World-Action Models（WAMs）将预测式视频世界建模与动作生成耦合，但基本以视觉为中心，无法直接建模接触动力学，因此需要引入触觉模态来补足这一缺失的世界状态维度。
AI.method: DexTacWAM对每个指尖独立编码，经手指与位姿感知的触觉压缩器（finger- and pose-aware tactile compressor）聚合特征，再将触觉潜变量注入视频扩散世界模型，进行联合视觉-触觉世界建模；采用冻结预训练视觉VAE、仅适配触觉编码器的持续视觉到触觉学习（continual vision-to-touch learning）。
AI.result: 在22自由度双臂平台的六项富接触灵巧操作任务上，DexTacWAM每项任务均取得最高分，平均70.6对最强基线38.0。消融显示增益来自将接触演化建模为预测世界状态的一部分而非仅作触觉条件：移除触觉世界建模后四项任务均值从74.7降至26.6（触觉特征与动作专家不变）。约100次演示/任务、4小时触觉编码器适配即可将预训练视频模型扩展到触觉，视觉预测质量保持在纯视觉对照0.5 dB以内；压缩器保留89.4%融合前接触召回，训练快2.26倍、推理快1.29倍。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，预训练视频先验可以以数据与计算高效的方式扩展到分布式多指接触动力学，触觉应作为世界状态的一部分被预测，而非仅作为条件输入。

title: GAE: Learning a Geometry-Native Latent Space for 3D-Consistent World Generation
summary: We present a compact geometry-native latent space as a shared foundation for perception and generation. Visual generators can produce photorealistic frames without preserving a consistent 3D scene. We argue that this is not only a modeling problem but also a representation problem: generators typically evolve appearance-centric latents, while perception models recover geometry in a semantically rich space that encodes cross-view structure. Rather than adding geometry as another output, we reparameterize a geometry foundation model's features into a compact latent space for generation. We realize this shift with the geometry-native autoencoder (GAE), whose latent is jointly decodable to appearance, depth, cameras, and point maps. With this state, a standard conditional flow supports diverse generation tasks. In controlled comparisons that hold the generator and training protocol fixed, replacing the latent with GAE improves both visual quality and independently measured 3D coherence: FVD falls by $12.7\%$ and $23.1\%$ on RealEstate10K and DL3DV, and camera-trajectory error is halved on RealEstate10K. Together, these results show that the latent space is central to geometry-consistent generation and can serve as a shared interface between perception and generation.

AI.tldr: 提出几何原生自编码器(GAE)，将几何基础模型特征重参数化为紧凑潜空间，作为感知与生成的共享基础，显著提升生成质量与3D一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉生成器能产出逼真帧，但难以保持一致的3D场景。作者认为这不仅是建模问题，更是表示问题：生成器通常演化以外观为中心的潜变量，而感知模型在语义丰富、编码跨视图结构的空间中恢复几何。因此需要将几何作为共享的潜表示基础，而非单纯增加一个输出分支。
AI.method: 提出几何原生自编码器(GAE)，将几何基础模型的特征重新参数化为紧凑潜空间，该潜变量可联合解码为外观、深度、相机与点图。基于此状态，使用标准条件流(conditional flow)支持多样化生成任务。通过固定生成器与训练协议的受控对比，验证替换潜变量的效果。
AI.result: 在受控对比中，将潜变量替换为GAE后，视觉质量与独立测量的3D一致性均提升：在RealEstate10K和DL3DV上FVD分别下降12.7%和23.1%，在RealEstate10K上相机轨迹误差减半。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明潜空间是几何一致生成的核心，可作为感知与生成之间的共享接口。

title: onPanda: Efficient Annotation of On-Policy Alignment Data for LLMs and Agents via Token-Level Correction
summary: We present onPanda, an interactive tool for efficiently annotating LLM alignment data and agent trajectories. onPanda adopts token-level correction as its core interaction: while reading a model response, the annotator locates the first inappropriate token and either picks a substitute from the model's candidate tokens or types the correct text via free-form editing. The system then truncates everything after that position and continues generation from the corrected prefix, repeating this locate-correct-continue loop until a satisfactory response is obtained. This mechanism lets annotators precisely steer model outputs at low cost: a small controlled study suggests that onPanda reduces median annotation time by 52% over manual post-editing. Since the vast majority of tokens in the final response are generated by the model itself, the resulting data largely preserves the model's sampling distribution and is well suited for constructing on-policy SFT and preference data. Furthermore, the token-level corrections recorded during annotation provide fine-grained supervision with precise positions and naturally paired positive--negative samples. onPanda also connects to external tools and harnesses, enabling interactive trajectory annotation in realistic environments. In addition, we release Panda-CVL, a dataset annotated with onPanda, together with a benchmark for token-level correction.

AI.tldr: onPanda 是一款交互式标注工具，采用“token 级纠正”作为核心交互方式，支持 LLM 对齐数据与智能体轨迹的高效标注；其通过“定位—纠正—续写”循环在低标注成本下保留模型采样分布，并附带数据集与基准。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 对齐数据与智能体轨迹标注方法成本高、效率低，且难以在保证标注精度的同时保留模型的采样分布，从而影响 on-policy SFT 与偏好数据的质量。论文旨在设计一种低代价、可精确引导模型输出的标注工具。
AI.method: onPanda 以 token 级纠正为核心交互：标注者在阅读模型回复时定位第一个不当 token，然后从模型候选 token 中选择替代项，或通过自由文本编辑输入正确内容；系统随后截断该位置之后的所有内容，并从纠正后的前缀继续生成，重复“定位—纠正—续写”循环，直至获得满意回复。此外，系统可连接外部工具与运行环境，支持真实环境下的交互式轨迹标注。
AI.result: 一项小规模对照研究表明，onPanda 相较人工后期编辑将标注时间中位数降低 52%。由于最终回复中绝大多数 token 由模型自身生成，所得数据较好地保留了模型的采样分布，适合构建 on-policy SFT 与偏好数据；同时标注过程记录的 token 级纠正提供了具有精确位置和天然成对正负样本的细粒度监督。论文还发布了使用 onPanda 标注的数据集 Panda-CVL 及一个 token 级纠正基准。
AI.conclusion: onPanda 通过 token 级纠正交互有效提升了 LLM 对齐数据与智能体轨迹标注的效率与数据质量，兼顾低成本、分布保持与细粒度监督，并提供数据集与基准以推动后续研究。

title: WorldCrafter: Consistent Video World Model with Implicit 3D-aware Memory
summary: Video world models enable interactive exploration of dynamic environments, yet struggle to respect prior observations over long horizons and across viewpoints. We present WorldCrafter, a video world model that learns a camera-queryable implicit 3D-aware memory for this purpose. The key insight is to let the requested viewpoint shape how multi-view evidence is compressed into the video generator's limited token budget. Trained jointly with the video generator, a memory encoder and pose-conditioned readout module integrate historical observations into a fixed set of target view-specific tokens before denoising, without explicit depth-based correspondences. By combining this memory with recent temporal context and few-step distillation, WorldCrafter enables streaming scene exploration from a single input image or text prompt. Experiments across static and dynamic scenes show substantial gains in long-horizon consistency and camera-control accuracy while preserving visual quality during minute-scale exploration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WorldCrafter——一种学习"相机可查询的隐式3D感知记忆"的视频世界模型，将请求视角作为压缩历史多视角证据的查询，实现长时序一致性且支持单图/文本提示的流式探索。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型虽能交互式探索动态环境，但在长时程和跨视角的情况下难以遵循先前的观测，即长程一致性与相机控制精度不足。
AI.method: 核心思想是让请求视角决定多视角证据如何压缩进视频生成器有限的token预算中：训练与视频生成器联合进行，用记忆编码器和位姿条件读出模块将历史观测整合为一组固定大小的目标视角专属token，并在去噪前注入，无需显式基于深度的对应关系；再结合近期时序上下文与少步蒸馏，支持从单张输入图像或文本提示进行流式场景探索。
AI.result: 在静态和动态场景上的实验表明，长时程一致性与相机控制精度显著提升，同时在分钟级探索过程中保持视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过视角条件化的隐式3D记忆压缩机制，可在有限token预算下有效维持长时程一致性，展示了相机可查询记忆在视频世界模型中的有效性。

title: Critical-State RL: Diagnosing Trainable States for Multi-Turn Tool Use
summary: Multi-turn tool-use failures can hinge on a single model call, yet reward variation alone does not reveal which call would benefit from training. When rewards depend on later interactions, their variation can reflect downstream randomness rather than differences between the current actions. We introduce Critical-State RL to identify trainable states in multi-turn interactions. Given task-defined candidate calls and local rewards, the method assesses whether each reward captures the action's effect on task success and whether improvement over a reference policy is possible. It then uses nested sampling to separate action-dependent reward variation from continuation noise and optimizes the policy at the selected states using contextual-bandit training. Experiments on the Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard (BFCL) v4 compare training at diagnostic-selected states with training at alternative states. For missing-function tasks, the diagnostic selects the response after the tool becomes available; for missing-argument tasks, it selects the response before the missing argument is supplied. Training the selected responses improves performance, including about 14 percentage points on the missing-function task, while training the alternatives leaves performance flat or worse. We further apply the recipe across models and tasks, including logged repeat-call avoidance and memory management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Critical-State RL，用于在多轮工具调用中识别真正可训练的关键状态，通过嵌套采样区分动作相关奖励变异与后续随机噪声，仅在诊断选出的状态上做上下文老虎机训练，在 BFCL v4 上显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 多轮工具使用任务的失败往往取决于单次模型调用，但仅凭奖励变异无法判断哪次调用值得训练。当奖励依赖后续交互时，其变异可能反映的是下游随机性而非当前动作之间的差异，因此需要一种能区分二者的诊断方法。
AI.method: 提出 Critical-State RL：给定任务定义的候选调用与局部奖励，评估每个奖励是否捕捉到动作对任务成功的影响，以及相对参考策略是否存在改进空间；随后用嵌套采样（nested sampling）将动作相关的奖励变异与延续噪声分离，并对选出的状态使用上下文老虎机（contextual-bandit）训练优化策略。
AI.result: 在 BFCL v4 上，将诊断选出的状态训练与在替代状态上训练进行对比：缺失函数任务中诊断选中工具可用后的回复，缺失参数任务中选中缺失参数提供前的回复。训练所选回复可提升性能，其中缺失函数任务提升约 14 个百分点，而训练替代状态则性能持平或更差。该方案还推广到多个模型与任务，包括日志重复调用避免与记忆管理。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，多轮工具使用中的可训练信号高度集中于少数关键状态，通过诊断识别这些状态并仅在其上训练，比盲目依据奖励变异训练更有效，且该配方具有跨模型、跨任务的通用性。

title: VideoGen-Agent: Reinforcing Video Generation Agents
summary: Recent advances in video generative models have enabled high-fidelity, temporally coherent video generation. However, these models often struggle to satisfy prompts requiring specialized knowledge, specific identities, physical consistency, or ordered events.
