In this paper, we present VideoGen-Agent, a multimodal agent trained through multitask agentic reinforcement learning to use external tools for video generation. The agent coordinates augmentation, generation, and verification tools through multi-turn interactions, using the prompt and intermediate observations to guide its decisions. We train a shared policy on a category-balanced dataset spanning six tasks. Supervised fine-tuning on teacher-generated trajectories establishes tool-use behavior, which is then refined through reinforcement learning. A category-aware hybrid reward evaluates tool-call validity, task-appropriate tool use, and generated video quality. We further introduce VABench, a held-out benchmark of 600 prompts covering procedural knowledge, single- and multi-entity identity preservation, physical consistency, scene composition, and multi-shot temporal structure. On VABench, VideoGen-Agent improves over its base text-to-video generator by 19.1 points, from 56.5 to 75.6. Upgrading the generation tools further raises the score to 86.1 without additional agent training. Human raters prefer the upgraded configuration over the strongest standalone baseline in 84.3% of comparisons. These results support learning tool use across video-generation tasks and show that the trained agent can benefit from subsequent advances in generation tools. Project page: https://andyca111.github.io/VideoGen_Agent/

AI.tldr: 提出 VideoGen-Agent，一个通过多任务智能体强化学习训练的多模态智能体，可调用外部工具完成视频生成，并引入 VABench 基准；在 VABench 上较基座文生视频模型提升 19.1 分（56.5→75.6），升级生成工具后进一步达 86.1。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽能生成高保真、时序连贯的视频，但难以满足需要专业知识、特定身份、物理一致性或有序事件的提示，即缺乏外部知识与工具调用能力。
AI.method: 构建多模态智能体 VideoGen-Agent，通过多轮交互协调增强、生成与验证三类工具，依据提示与中间观测做决策；在覆盖六类任务的类别均衡数据集上训练共享策略：先用教师生成轨迹做监督微调建立工具使用行为，再用强化学习精调；采用类别感知混合奖励，评估工具调用有效性、任务适配性与生成视频质量。
AI.result: 在 600 条提示的 VABench 上，VideoGen-Agent 较基座文生视频生成器提升 19.1 分（56.5→75.6）；仅升级生成工具（无需额外智能体训练）即达 86.1；人工评估中，升级配置在 84.3% 的对比中被偏好于最强单模型基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明可跨视频生成任务学习工具使用，且训练后的智能体能持续受益于生成工具的后续进步，具备良好的可扩展性与兼容性。

title: GameHorizon Suite: Multi-Horizon Data and Evaluation in Gameplay
comment: We will release our dataset, annotator, and benchmark to facilitate future research. Github Repo: https://github.com/TencentARC/GameHorizon & Project Page: https://gamehorizon-suite.github.io
summary: Modern video games provide a measurable testbed for AI models, combining abilities of visual understanding, instruction decomposition, goal planning, and precise action control over multiple temporal horizons. Existing datasets and benchmarks, however, either cover a narrow range of games, lack language instructions, or rely on high-variance online rollouts. To address these challenges, we introduce GameHorizon, a unified data and evaluation suite that measures gameplay capabilities at different horizons for diverse model families. GameHorizon Suite consists of three components. First, GameHorizon-Annotator is a scalable and automated annotation pipeline for multi-horizon instructions. Second, utilizing the pipeline, we construct GameHorizon-Data, the first large-scale AAA gameplay dataset with temporally aligned videos, player actions, and multi-horizon instructions. It comprises 5,000 hours of recordings from 21 games, collected by 100 human expert players. Third, we build GameHorizon-Bench with reproducible offline and stepwise online testing. The offline track enables reproducible evaluation using thousands of standardized questions organized into three primary tasks and a series of diagnostic variants, while the online track tests whether offline scores reflect actual gameplay capabilities and localizes failures to specific steps within long-horizon gameplay. Based on our GameHorizon Suite, we evaluate 47 models through more than one million model invocations, revealing a meaningful hierarchy of task difficulty and pronounced differences in model capabilities. Our work can provide a standardized yardstick for evaluating gameplay capabilities across horizons and model families. We will release our dataset, annotator, and benchmark to facilitate future research.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 GameHorizon，一个统一的数据与评测套件，用于衡量不同模型家族在不同时间跨度上的游戏能力，包含自动标注流水线、首个大规模 3A 游戏数据集及可复现的离/在线基准，并据此评测了 47 个模型。
AI.motivation: 视频游戏可作为衡量 AI 模型视觉理解、指令分解、目标规划与精确动作控制能力的可量化测试平台。然而现有数据集与基准存在覆盖游戏范围窄、缺乏语言指令、依赖高方差在线 rollout 等不足，亟需标准化评测手段。
AI.method: GameHorizon Suite 由三部分组成：(1) GameHorizon-Annotator：可扩展、自动化的多跨度指令标注流水线；(2) GameHorizon-Data：首个大规模 AAA 游戏数据集，含时间对齐的视频、玩家动作与多跨度指令，由 100 名人类专家玩家采集，覆盖 21 款游戏、共 5,000 小时录像；(3) GameHorizon-Bench：含可复现的离线与逐步在线测试轨道，离线轨道用数千道标准化问题组织为三类主任务及诊断变体，在线轨道检验离线分数能否反映真实游戏能力并将失败定位到长时程中的具体步骤。
AI.result: 基于该套件评测了 47 个模型，进行了超过一百万次模型调用，揭示了清晰的任务难度层级以及不同模型能力间的显著差异。
AI.conclusion: GameHorizon 为跨时间跨度、跨模型家族的游戏能力评测提供了标准化标尺，并将开源数据集、标注器与基准以促进未来研究。

title: Trains but Doesn't Learn: A Post-Training Delivery Benchmark for LLM Agents as Forward-Deployed Engineers
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Industry Track
summary: Post-training is becoming a service (PTaaS): a customer hands an operator data and a goal, and a forward-deployed engineer (FDE) returns a fine-tuned, evaluated, and deployed model under a budget, a human-approval gate, and reproducibility requirements. Seating an LLM agent in the FDE seat raises a question existing benchmarks cannot answer: not whether an agent can raise a metric, but whether it can be trusted to deliver. We answer it on a governed delivery plane, where an agent drives ten stages and an oracle scores each stage from platform-recorded facts. The central silent failure is the run that trains but does not learn (TBDL): loss falls, every signal stays green, and the delivered model is no better than the base. An operator-run acceptance gate catches every such run before payment, and a detector calibrated on known-corrupted runs flags severe corruption mid-run. We ran four frontier agents (Claude Opus 5, GPT-5.6-luna, Gemini 3.7 Flash, DeepSeek V4-Pro) end to end on metered L40S, A100, and H200 GPUs across 8B to 70B open bases, certifying every scenario before scoring. We also ran a human FDE arm under the same oracle and compare every agent against it.

title: Geometric and Semantic Coupling for Interaction Understanding in 3D Scenes
summary: Understanding interaction in a 3D scene requires recovering movable parts, their motion, and where they can be operated. These quantities are related, and their predictions can inform one another. A closed cabinet door, for instance, reveals a movable surface but may leave the hinge side ambiguous; its handle helps resolve this ambiguity, while the part provides context for localizing and interpreting the small handle. Building on this observation, we present SEGMENT-SNAP, which combines geometric and semantic evidence through part-handle coupling. Three independently trained predictors recover movable parts, dense handles, and part-associated handle proposals. We couple their outputs in two directions. For part motion, a training-free geometric decoder fits predicted part surfaces under explicit physical priors and uses detected handles to select candidate hinge lines. For handle prediction, a part-conditioned branch proposes additional handles, while standalone part classes refine their rotation/translation labels, with dense-handle labels as a fallback. Each transfer is applied once, without iterative feedback. On the Articulate3D validation set, handle guidance raises motion-gated AP from 13.74 to 40.98 under fixed masks and axes. Additional handle proposals raise handle AP from 24.63 to 29.65, and full contextual class correction raises it to 30.99 in the reference configuration. Fixed-input controls, retraining ablations, learned-decoder comparisons, and paired visualizations together characterize the benefits and limits of this coupling. Our system also achieved first place in the Articulate3D Challenge.

AI.tldr: 提出 SEGMENT-SNAP，通过"部件—手柄"双向耦合，将可动部件、稠密手柄与部件关联手柄三类预测器的输出相互传递，实现无迭代反馈的一次性耦合，在 Articulate3D 上显著提升运动与手柄预测精度并夺冠。
AI.motivation: 3D 场景交互理解需要同时恢复可动部件、其运动方式以及可操作位置，这些量彼此关联、可相互提供线索（如柜门手柄可消解铰链侧歧义，可动部件又为定位小尺寸手柄提供上下文），但现有方法多将三者独立预测，未充分利用这种互补性。
AI.method: SEGMENT-SNAP 独立训练三个预测器分别输出可动部件、稠密手柄与部件关联手柄提议，并进行双向一次性耦合：（1）部件运动方向，用免训练几何解码器在显式物理先验下拟合预测部件表面，并借助检测到的手柄选择候选铰链线；（2）手柄预测方向，由部件条件分支提出额外手柄，独立部件类别修正其旋转/平移标签，稠密手柄标签作为回退。每次迁移仅执行一次，不做迭代反馈。
AI.result: 在 Articulate3D 验证集上，固定掩码与轴时手柄引导将运动门控 AP 从 13.74 提升至 40.98；额外手柄提议使手柄 AP 从 24.63 提升至 29.65，完整上下文类别修正后在参考配置下达 30.99。此外通过固定输入对照、重训练消融、学习型解码器对比与成对可视化验证了该耦合的收益与局限，系统在 Articulate3D Challenge 中获得第一名。
AI.conclusion: 部件与手柄的语义—几何互补信息可通过单向、非迭代的耦合有效互相增强，带来运动与手柄预测的一致提升，同时消融与对照实验界定了该耦合的适用边界。

title: ImIR: Image-Instruction Tuning for All-in-One Image Restoration
summary: Degradations vary widely across images, so a practical restoration system has to handle many degradation types with one model. A recent and effective recipe adapts a large pretrained image-editing model to restoration using a small low-rank adapter with a text prompt. We replace that prompt with an instruction derived from the degraded image itself. The image reaches the editor through two paths: its structure comes from the model's VAE, and its semantic instruction comes from a lightweight token mapper that shifts the degraded image's vision-language embedding toward the embedding a clean image would produce. Because the instruction is a continuous vector, scaling it yields a family of valid restorations for tasks whose target is not unique, such as low-light enhancement. We adapt one Qwen-Image-Edit model to six tasks with a single adapter trained in about three hours on one GPU. The image instruction outperforms text conditioning under a matched comparison, and it supports task agnostic restoration without a degradation label, which the text variant does not.

AI.tldr: 提出以图像自身生成的指令向量替代文本提示，来适配大型预训练图像编辑模型完成多任务图像复原。
AI.motivation: 真实场景中图像退化类型差异极大，实用复原系统需用单一模型处理多种退化。既有方法依赖文本提示+低秩适配器，但文本条件在匹配对比下表现受限且需要退化标签。
AI.method: 用从退化图像本身导出的指令替代文本提示。图像通过两条路径进入编辑器：结构来自模型VAE，语义指令来自轻量级token mapper，该mapper将退化图像的视觉-语言嵌入向干净图像应有的嵌入偏移。指令为连续向量，对其缩放可为目标不唯一的任务（如暗光增强）生成一族有效复原结果。用单个适配器将Qwen-Image-Edit模型适配到六个任务。
AI.result: 在匹配对比下，图像指令优于文本条件；支持无需退化标签的任务无关复原，而文本变体不具备此能力。单GPU约三小时即可训练完成一个适配器，覆盖六个任务。
AI.conclusion: 以图像导出的连续指令向量替代文本提示，是一种更通用、高效的多退化图像复原适配方案。

title: RULER: Instance-aware Rubric Rewards for SVG Generation
summary: Generating Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) code from natural-language instructions is an open-ended task without absolute visual ground truth, leaving both evaluation and policy optimization without a faithful signal. Scalar metrics (CLIP, Aesthetic) calibrated on natural images transfer poorly to stylized vector content, and reusing them as RL rewards triggers reward hacking. We address both limitations with rubric-based scoring. We first establish empirically that prompting a vision-language judge with a multi-axis rubric correlates with human judgments far better than scalar metrics, both across samples and within instructions. Building on this finding, we introduce RULER (Instance-aware Rubric Rewards for Reinforcement Learning), which converts each instruction into an instance-aware rubric of six items spanning semantic, visual, and stylistic axes; a judge VLM scores rendered rollouts item-by-item, and the weighted satisfactions form a fine-grained reward optimized via Group Relative Policy Optimization. Because the rubric is derived from text alone, RULER requires neither paired SVG ground truth nor human preference labels. On MMSVG-Illustration and MMSVG-Icon, RULER lifts the rubric score from 0.432/0.395 to 0.693/0.683, surpassing dedicated SVG specialists and matching the substantially larger DeepSeek-V3, with ablations identifying rubric design as the active lever for RL on open-ended SVG generation. The project page is available at https://hangyuran.github.io/RULER/.

AI.tldr: 论文提出基于评分标准（rubric）的评估与强化学习方法RULER，为开放式SVG生成提供细粒度奖励信号，显著提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 由自然语言生成SVG代码属于开放式任务，缺乏绝对的视觉真值，导致评估与策略优化都缺乏可靠信号。基于自然图像校准的标量指标（CLIP、Aesthetic）难以迁移到风格化矢量内容，且作为RL奖励易引发奖励攻击（reward hacking）。
AI.method: 先通过实验证明：用多轴评分标准提示视觉语言评判模型，其与人类判断的相关性远高于标量指标（跨样本与指令内均成立）。据此提出RULER：将每条指令转换为包含语义、视觉、风格三个维度共六个条目的实例感知评分标准；由评判VLM对渲染的rollout逐项打分，加权满意度构成细粒度奖励，并用GRPO优化。评分标准仅由文本推导，无需配对SVG真值或人类偏好标注。
AI.result: 在MMSVG-Illustration与MMSVG-Icon上，RULER将评分标准得分从0.432/0.395提升至0.693/0.683，超越专用SVG专家模型，并与规模更大的DeepSeek-V3相当；消融实验表明评分标准设计是开放式SVG生成中RL的关键杠杆。
AI.conclusion: 评分标准式评估与奖励为开放式SVG生成提供了忠实且细粒度的信号，RULER无需真值或偏好标注即可高效优化策略，验证了rubric设计在RL优化中的核心作用。

title: Beyond the Flat Seafloor: A Closed-Form Two-View Constraint to Aid Sidescan Sonar Reconstruction
comment: Copyright 2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses, in any current or future media. This work was accepted for publication in the Proceedings of IEEE OCEANS 2026 Monterey
summary: Sidescan sonar is a common sensor for both manned and autonomous marine exploration and mapping, yet very few methods build upon or exploit the geometric projection model of the sensor. As sidescan sonar is limited to a 1D range measurement, many approximations are frequently used, including the long-standing assumption of a flat seafloor. Rather than make similar approximations, this paper focuses on a multi-view geometry based approach and formalizes a two-view geometric constraint and proves that a shared feature is constrained to a locus within the intersection of a sphere and a plane. In addition, we characterize what governs the size of the ambiguity locus through Monte Carlo simulation that is grounded in real aperture and mounting geometry for both a surface vessel and an underwater vehicle. We translate additional simulations of relative trajectories for both vehicle platforms into concrete survey-planning guidance. Our results show that locus length is strongly governed by elevation misalignment, and peaks at a moderate oblique crossing angle of approximately 20 degrees, with minimal locus lengths obtained at near parallel and anti-parallel passes.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对侧扫声呐缺乏几何投影模型利用的问题，提出基于多视图几何的两视图约束，证明共享特征位于球面与平面交集轨迹上，并通过蒙特卡洛仿真分析模糊轨迹长度的影响因素，给出测量规划建议。
AI.motivation: 侧扫声呐是有人与自主海洋探测和测绘常用传感器，但少有方法利用或建立其几何投影模型。由于侧扫声呐仅能进行一维距离测量，常采用包括长期存在的平坦海底假设在内的诸多近似，本文希望避免此类近似，转而采用多视图几何方法进行更严谨的建模。
AI.method: 本文采用基于多视图几何的方法，形式化了两视图几何约束，并证明共享特征被约束在球面与平面的交集轨迹内。此外，通过基于真实孔径与安装几何的蒙特卡洛仿真，刻画了影响模糊轨迹尺寸的因素，涵盖水面船只与水下航行器两种平台，并将相对轨迹仿真转化为具体的测量规划指导。
AI.result: 结果表明，轨迹长度主要受俯仰失配影响，并在约20度的中等斜交角处达到峰值，而在接近平行与反平行的通过时获得最小轨迹长度。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过多视图几何约束与仿真分析，揭示了侧扫声呐共享特征模糊轨迹的几何特性及其受俯仰失配和交叉角影响规律，并为水面与水下平台的测量规划提供了具体建议。

title: $τ$-Multilingual: Benchmarking Voice Agents Across Languages
summary: English-only benchmarks expose only a narrow slice of voice-agent behavior. We introduce $τ$-Multilingual, extending $τ$-Voice to Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Hindi, Korean, and Mandarin with native-speaker review and evaluation of generated language and spoken output. Across 4,500 full-duplex calls and five voice configurations, Spanish, Portuguese, and Hindi remain within 3.2 task-completion points of English, but Korean and Mandarin fall by 14.7 and 8.4 points. The failure modes also vary: Korean systems miss more responses, Mandarin systems interrupt more often, and both struggle with tools and entities. Grok leads task completion but scores lowest on generation quality, motivating separate task, interaction, and generation reporting. We release language packs, validated judges, and tools for community-built multilingual voice-agent evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 τ-Multilingual，将 τ-Voice 扩展至西班牙语、巴西葡萄牙语、印地语、韩语和普通话，通过母语者审核与评估生成语言和语音输出。基于 4,500 次全双工通话和五种语音配置，西/葡/印地语任务完成率与英语差距在 3.2 个百分点内，韩语和普通话分别下降 14.7 和 8.4 个百分点。失败模式各异：韩语系统漏响应更多，普通话系统打断更频繁，两者在工具和实体处理上均表现欠佳。Grok 任务完成度最高但生成质量最低，因此需分别报告任务、交互与生成指标。作者发布了语言包、验证过的评判器及工具。
AI.motivation: 现有语音智能体基准几乎全部基于英语，仅能反映行为的一个狭窄切面，无法揭示多语言场景下的性能差异与失败模式，因此需要构建多语言、可复现的语音智能体评测基准。
AI.method: 将 τ-Voice 扩展至西班牙语、巴西葡萄牙语、印地语、韩语和普通话，引入母语者进行生成语言与语音输出的审核和评估；在五种语音配置下开展 4,500 次全双工通话实验，并建立经过验证的评判器（validated judges）。
AI.result: 西、葡、印地语任务完成率与英语差距在 3.2 个百分点以内，韩语和普通话分别下降 14.7 和 8.4 个百分点。失败模式具语言特异性：韩语系统漏响应更多，普通话系统打断更频繁，二者在工具调用和实体识别上均存在困难。Grok 任务完成度领先，但生成质量得分最低。
AI.conclusion: 英语基准无法代表多语言语音智能体表现，且任务、交互与生成质量需分开报告，三者可能互相背离。作者发布语言包、验证过的评判器及工具，支持社区构建多语言语音智能体评测。

title: FineWeb-CLaR: Culture, Language, and Region Annotations for Benchmark-Aligned Corpus Auditing
summary: Cultural evaluation coverage and robustness in language models are difficult to diagnose because pretraining corpora and cultural benchmarks are rarely indexed with comparable metadata. Benchmarks increasingly target culturally situated phenomena at the level of languages, regions, and locale-specific practices, while web-scale corpora are usually organized only by language. A shared culture-language-region layer makes these resources comparable, enabling audits of whether a target cultural phenomenon is represented in pretraining data, evaluated by benchmarks or both. To this end, we introduce FineWeb-CLaR, a large-scale annotated dataset derived from FineWeb and FineWeb-2 that places web documents on a shared culture-language-region axis for corpus auditing and benchmark alignment. FineWeb-CLaR annotates the full 30.9B-document collection from FineWeb and FineWeb-2 with URL-derived region labels and cultural-topic provenance. Our region resolver assigns a non-empty region to 25.61% of documents (7.92B). For cultural-topic analysis, we induce locale-specific topics and project them onto the 14 leaves of the Cultural Taxonomy of Liu et al. (2025), producing Locale Topic Distributions (LTDs) for corpus-side comparison. We also annotate 277 cultural NLP benchmarks with the same taxonomy, language coverage, and region coverage. Together, these resources enable direct comparison between corpus-side pretraining evidence and benchmark-side evaluation coverage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FineWeb-CLaR，一个基于 FineWeb/FineWeb-2 的大规模标注数据集，为语料与基准建立共享的“文化-语言-区域”轴，以诊断文化评估的覆盖度与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 文化评估的覆盖与鲁棒性难以诊断，因为预训练语料与文化基准缺少可比的元数据索引：基准多聚焦语言、区域、地方性实践层面的文化现象，而网络语料通常仅按语言组织，导致无法判断目标文化现象是否在预训练数据中被表征、是否被基准评测，或两者兼有。
AI.method: 构建 FineWeb-CLaR：对 FineWeb 与 FineWeb-2 全部 30.9B 文档进行标注，利用 URL 派生区域标签与文化主题来源；区域解析器为 25.61%（7.92B）文档赋予非空区域。文化主题方面，诱导地方性主题并映射到 Liu et al. (2025) 文化分类法的 14 个叶节点，生成地方性主题分布（LTDs）。同时对 277 个文化 NLP 基准按同一分类法、语言覆盖与区域覆盖进行标注。
AI.result: 区域解析覆盖 7.92B 文档（25.61%）；生成语料侧 Locale Topic Distributions（LTDs）；完成 277 个文化 NLP 基准的分类法、语言与区域覆盖标注，形成语料侧与基准侧可直接对比的资源。
AI.conclusion: 共享的“文化-语言-区域”层使语料与基准可比，支持对预训练证据与评测覆盖进行直接对照，从而审计文化现象的覆盖度与鲁棒性。

title: Uncertainty-Aware 3D Residual Wavelet Diffusion for Ultra Low-Field MRI Super-Resolution
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Accepted at SASHIMI 2026 (MICCAI 2026 workshop). This is the version submitted for peer review
summary: Ultra low-field MRI expands global access to neuroimaging but produces scans with low signal-to-noise ratio, reduced contrast, and thick slices. While regression-based super-resolution can recover anatomical detail for segmentation, it returns a single deterministic estimate that gives no indication of regions where the low-field input leaves anatomy underdetermined. Generative diffusion models offer an alternative by sampling the posterior distribution of plausible high-field images, quantifying this anatomical ambiguity. However, applying them to 3D whole-brain MRI is restricted by memory bottlenecks, slow sampling, and scanner domain shifts. We propose a 3D residual wavelet diffusion model that combines three ideas to overcome these hurdles. A lossless wavelet reparameterisation shrinks the spatial grid to fit a whole brain on a single GPU, residual shifting accelerates sampling by starting from the low-field input, and domain randomisation promotes scanner generalisation without paired training data. As the high-field reference is not a voxel-aligned ground truth, we evaluate downstream volumetric agreement. On a healthy cohort (n=19) imaged at 0.064T and 3T, our method matches a leading general-purpose regression approach in volumetric accuracy while additionally generating per-voxel uncertainty maps highlighting underdetermined regions. Furthermore, on a pilot dataset (n=11) of participants with cognitive impairment, disease-relevant atrophy is preserved rather than normalised towards a healthy prior. Our framework brings whole-brain posterior sampling to low-field super-resolution without sacrificing volumetric accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种3D残差小波扩散模型，实现超低场（0.064T）全脑MRI的超分辨后验采样，在保持体积学精度的同时提供体素级不确定性图。
AI.motivation: 超低场MRI可扩展神经影像的可及性，但信噪比低、对比度差、层厚大。基于回归的超分辨虽能恢复解剖细节，却只给出单一确定性估计，无法指示低场输入未确定的解剖区域。生成式扩散模型可通过对高场图像后验分布采样来量化这种解剖模糊性，但应用于3D全脑MRI受限于内存瓶颈、采样慢和扫描仪域偏移。
AI.method: 提出3D残差小波扩散模型，融合三项设计：无损小波重参数化将空间网格缩小，使全脑可在单张GPU上处理；残差偏移以低场输入为起点加速采样；域随机化在无配对训练数据下提升扫描仪泛化能力。由于高场参考并非体素对齐的真值，采用下游体积一致性进行评估。
AI.result: 在健康队列（n=19，0.064T与3T成像）上，方法在体积精度上匹配领先的通用回归方法，并额外生成突出未确定区域的体素级不确定性图；在认知障碍参与者试点数据集（n=11）上，疾病相关的萎缩得以保留，而非被归一化到健康先验。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在不牺牲体积精度的前提下，将全脑后验采样引入低场超分辨，兼具不确定性量化与病理特征保留能力。

title: MirrorDistill: Illumination-Aware Latent Distillation for Efficient Low-Light Restoration
summary: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) is an im- portant component of visual sensing systems operating under degraded illumination, including nighttime surveillance, au- tonomous navigation, remote sensing, and inspection in poorly lit industrial environments. Most LLIE methods rely on output- level reconstruction losses that supervise only the final restored image, leaving the intermediate feature recovery process weakly constrained. This paper proposes MirrorDistill, an illumination- aware latent distillation framework that links the low-light and clean domains through feature mirroring. During training, a shared encoder and an exponential-moving-average teacher decoder process the clean reference image to generate clean- domain latent targets. These targets supervise the low-light student at two levels: raw encoder features and standardized multi-scale decoder projections. The alignment is applied layer by layer, while a proposed illumination-aware weighting scheme gives greater emphasis to underexposed regions. The teacher and reference branches are used only during training, so inference requires only the lightweight student encoder-decoder and in- troduces no teacher-side computational cost. Under evaluation on the standard LOL benchmarks, MirrorDistill outperforms the state-of-the-art methods on the real-captured LOL-v2-Real set, while having the lowest compute complexity (GMACs) and while remaining competitive on the LOL-v1 and LOL-v2-Synthetic datasets. Ablation studies further show the contributions of the encoder mirror, decoder mirror, and illumination-aware weighting. Finally, we release our code as open-source for the benefit of future research.

AI.tldr: 提出MirrorDistill，一种光照感知的潜在蒸馏框架，通过特征镜像连接低光域与干净域，逐层约束学生网络的特征恢复。
AI.motivation: 多数LLIE方法仅依赖输出级重建损失监督最终图像，中间特征恢复过程约束不足。
AI.method: 共享编码器与EMA教师解码器处理干净参考图生成干净域潜在目标，在原始编码器特征与标准化多尺度解码器投影两个层级监督低光学生网络，逐层对齐，并采用光照感知加权突出欠曝区域；教师与参考分支仅训练时使用，推理仅需轻量学生编解码器。
AI.result: 在LOL-v2-Real真实集上超越SOTA，同时计算复杂度（GMACs）最低；在LOL-v1与LOL-v2-Synthetic上保持竞争力。消融验证编码器镜像、解码器镜像与光照感知加权的贡献。
AI.conclusion: MirrorDistill以无额外推理开销的潜在蒸馏有效增强低光图像，兼顾性能与效率，并开源代码。

title: MT-ProtBERT: Multi-task Learning ProtBERT for Intrinsically Disordered Proteins Classification with Scarce Data
summary: Intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) differ from folded proteins in that they are dynamic, lack a stable three-dimensional conformation, and have low sequence similarity between similar proteins. The conformational heterogeneity of IDPs - while beneficial for their diverse functions - limits the use of traditional experimental tools to determine their conformation. The experimental difficulty, along with low sequence similarity, results in data scarcity, and makes it difficult to classify/detect IDPs that are similar or dissimilar, a task relevant to understand biology and evolution. We address this challenge using Multi-task ProtBERT (MT-ProtBERT), a multi-task extension of ProtBERT tailored for low-data regimes. MT-ProtBERT integrates Dynamic Window Masking, a Multi-Scale 1D Convolutional classifier (MS-Conv1D), and auxiliary objectives that jointly optimize masked language modeling and biochemistry-informed tasks. We evaluate this framework on two tasks under limited data: (i) phosphorylation site prediction (S/T/Y) in short sequences and small datasets, and (ii) protein compaction prediction on two small datasets (684 and 530 sequences), including sequences comparable in length to typical disordered regions. MT-ProtBERT consistently outperforms PARROT, an RNN-based IDP-specific model, across all tasks. These results demonstrate that combining self-supervised and biochemistry-informed tasks, and multi-scale learning enables robust modeling of unstructured proteins under data scarcity.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MT-ProtBERT，一种面向低数据场景的多任务ProtBERT扩展框架，通过整合动态窗口掩码、多尺度一维卷积分类器（MS-Conv1D）以及联合优化掩码语言建模与生化任务的辅助目标，在磷酸化位点预测与蛋白质致密性预测任务上均优于IDP专用模型PARROT。
AI.motivation: 内在无序蛋白（IDPs）具有动态性、缺乏稳定三维构象，且相似蛋白间序列相似度低。其构象异质性虽有利于多样功能，却限制了传统实验手段解析构象；实验困难叠低序列相似度导致数据稀缺，使相似或不相似IDP的分类与检测变得困难，而这一任务对理解生物学与进化具有重要意义。
AI.method: 提出Multi-task ProtBERT（MT-ProtBERT），是面向低数据 regime 的ProtBERT多任务扩展。该方法整合了三项关键设计：动态窗口掩码（Dynamic Window Masking）、多尺度一维卷积分类器（MS-Conv1D），以及联合优化掩码语言建模与生化信息辅助任务的辅助目标。在数据有限的两个任务上进行评估：(i) 短序列与小数据集中的磷酸化位点（S/T/Y）预测；(ii) 两个小数据集（684与530条序列）上的蛋白质致密性预测，序列长度与典型无序区域相当。
AI.result: MT-ProtBERT在所有任务上一致优于基于RNN的IDP专用模型PARROT。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，结合自监督任务与生化信息任务以及多尺度学习，能够在数据稀缺条件下实现无结构蛋白的稳健建模。

title: TelecomGPT-R1: Unified Post-Training for Reasoning Across Heterogeneous Telecom Tasks
summary: Large language models (LLMs) offer great potential to automate a broad range of telecom engineering tasks by reasoning over standards, network configurations, mathematical models, source code, and operational logs. However, existing telecom LLMs struggle to reliably reason across these diverse tasks and data types. General-purpose LLMs often lack reliable grounding in telecom-specific knowledge, while telecom-specialized models are typically developed for narrower task families and exhibit limited multi-task performance. To fill this gap, we introduce TelecomGPT-R1, a family of open source unified telecom reasoning models structured around four complementary axes: protocol, knowledge, modeling, and fault. We first develop an axis-aware data generation framework that refines coarse public telecom artifacts into verified question-answer pairs and high quality chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning trajectories, yielding a training corpus containing 104,880 examples. Building on this corpus, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) instills telecom knowledge and evidence-grounded reasoning patterns to overcome the cold start barrier for reinforcement learning (RL). We then apply dynamic sampling policy optimization (DAPO) with task-routed rubric rewards to keep RL updates informative and stable across heterogeneous telecom reasoning tasks. These rewards decompose axis-specific CoT traces into verifiable reasoning units and combine grounded dense process credit with outcome correctness, allowing RL to learn generalizable problem solving behaviors from verifiable telecom evidence. We release the TelecomGPT-R1 models and a reproducible training recipe to support further community development. Evaluations on seven benchmarks of the GSMA Open Telco Leaderboard show that the open-source TelecomGPT-R1-27B achieves an 89.64% mean score, outperforming leading proprietary models, including GPT-5, Claude, and Gemini.

AI.tldr: 提出开源统一电信推理模型系列 TelecomGPT-R1，围绕协议、知识、建模、故障四轴构建数据与训练流程，在 GSMA Open Telco 七个基准上以 89.64% 平均分超越 GPT-5、Claude、Gemini 等专有模型。
AI.motivation: 电信工程任务需对标准、网络配置、数学模型、源代码与运行日志等多源异构数据推理，但现有电信 LLM 存在两类不足：通用 LLM 缺乏电信领域知识的可靠 grounding；电信专用模型多面向单一任务族，多任务表现受限。因此需要统一且可靠的电信推理模型。
AI.method: 1) 提出轴感知（axis-aware）数据生成框架，将粗粒度公开电信资料精炼为经核验的问答对与高质量 CoT 推理轨迹，得到含 104,880 条样本的训练语料；2) 用 SFT 注入电信知识与证据驱动的推理模式，解决 RL 冷启动问题；3) 采用动态采样策略优化（DAPO）并配合任务路由的 rubric 奖励，将各轴 CoT 轨迹分解为可验证推理单元，结合基于证据的稠密过程奖励与结果正确性，使 RL 更新在异构任务上保持信息量与稳定性。
AI.result: 在 GSMA Open Telco Leaderboard 的七个基准上评测，开源模型 TelecomGPT-R1-27B 取得 89.64% 平均分，超过包括 GPT-5、Claude 与 Gemini 在内的领先专有模型。
AI.conclusion: TelecomGPT-R1 通过四轴统一的语料构建、SFT 冷启动与带 rubric 奖励的 DAPO 强化学习，实现了可跨任务泛化的电信推理能力；论文同时开源模型与可复现训练配方，以支持社区后续开发。

title: PARTE: Plane-Assisted Robust Transformation Estimation for Point Cloud Registration
comment: 16 pages, 14 figures, 11 tables. Code: https://ariarobotics.github.io/parte/. Updated project website URL
summary: Global point-cloud registration remains challenging when limited overlap, repetitive geometry, and sensor noise produce correspondence sets dominated by outliers. Planar regions are particularly difficult for conventional point descriptors and are therefore often suppressed or discarded before matching. We present PARTE (Plane-Assisted Robust Transformation Estimation), a global registration method that instead treats planar structure as complementary registration evidence. PARTE extracts planar patches and represents them using our novel Plane Context Histogram (PCH), a descriptor that encodes the geometry surrounding each patch, while a two-level matching procedure identifies reliable plane correspondences. Candidate point and plane correspondences are combined in a confidence-weighted compatibility graph for joint outlier rejection, followed by rigid transformation estimation. When no usable plane correspondences are available, PARTE naturally reduces to point-only registration. We evaluate PARTE on 8,097 registration pairs across six indoor and outdoor benchmarks spanning dense RGB-D and sparse LiDAR measurements. Evaluations show PARTE achieves the highest overall success rate against 13 standard and state-of-the-art methods while maintaining low runtime. An open-source C++ implementation with Python bindings is provided at https://ariarobotics.github.io/parte/.

AI.tldr: 提出全局点云配准方法PARTE，将平面结构作为互补配准证据，通过平面上下文直方图描述子与两级匹配、置信度加权兼容图联合剔除离群点，在8097对配准数据上取得最高成功率。
AI.motivation: 全局点云配准在重叠有限、几何重复及传感器噪声导致对应关系被离群点主导时仍具挑战性；平面区域对传统点描述子尤为困难，常被抑制或丢弃，造成信息浪费。
AI.method: PARTE提取平面片，用新颖的平面上下文直方图（PCH）描述每个平面片周围的几何结构；采用两级匹配识别可靠平面对应；将点与平面候选对应放入置信度加权兼容图进行联合离群点剔除，再估计刚体变换；当无可用平面对应时自然退化为纯点配准。
AI.result: 在六个室内外基准（密集RGB-D与稀疏LiDAR）的8097对配准数据上评估，PARTE在13种标准及最新方法中取得最高总体成功率，并保持低运行时间；提供开源C++实现及Python绑定。
AI.conclusion: 将平面结构视为互补配准证据可有效提升全局配准鲁棒性与成功率，且方法与纯点配准可无缝衔接，具备实用性与可复现性。

title: Sex Estimation from Footwear Outsole Impressions Using CNN Transfer Learning and Interpretable Image Statistics
summary: Footwear outsole impressions are a common form of forensic pattern evidence, yet quantitative methods for estimating wearer attributes from these images remain relatively underdeveloped. We investigate binary sex estimation from footwear outsole impressions by comparing convolutional neural network (CNN) transfer learning with traditional feature-based classification. Using a publicly available outsole-impression dataset, we adopt a shoe-level training and test partition that keeps replicate scans of the same physical shoe together to reduce data leakage. We evaluate pretrained CNNs through end-to-end fine-tuning, frozen feature extraction followed by support vector machine classification, and hybrid feature fusion incorporating handcrafted, geometric, and metadata-derived descriptors. Fine-tuned CNNs achieve the strongest overall predictive performance and substantially outperform traditional classifiers trained on the manually specified descriptors alone, while frozen-feature approaches offer a less computationally demanding alternative. Exploratory analysis of low-dimensional CNN representations reveals associations with frequency threshold ratio, image contrast, and wavelet-based summaries, providing a connection between learned representations and measurable properties of outsole impressions. These findings suggest that CNN transfer learning captures discriminative information beyond the descriptors considered and offers a promising approach to footwear-based forensic screening. Further validation on independently collected and casework-like impressions is needed before operational use.

AI.tldr: 该论文比较了CNN迁移学习与传统特征分类在鞋底印记性别推断中的表现，采用鞋级划分避免数据泄漏，发现微调CNN性能最优。
AI.motivation: 鞋底印记是常见法庭模式证据，但从图像中定量估计穿着者属性的方法仍较落后，需要更有效的自动化推断手段。
AI.method: 使用公开鞋底印记数据集，采用保持同一双鞋重复扫描在一起的鞋级训练/测试划分；评估预训练CNN的端到端微调、冻结特征提取加SVM分类、以及融合手工、几何与元数据描述符的混合特征方法。
AI.result: 微调CNN整体预测性能最强，显著优于仅用手工描述符的传统分类器；冻结特征方法计算开销更低。低维CNN表示的探索性分析显示其与频率阈值比、图像对比度及小波摘要存在关联。
AI.conclusion: CNN迁移学习能捕捉手工描述符之外的判别信息，在鞋印法医筛查中具有前景，但在实际应用前需在独立采集和类案件印记上进一步验证。

title: Passes Alone, Fails Together: Benchmarking Semantic Coordination in Parallel LLM-Agent Development
comment: 6 pages, accepted to The 2nd Workshop on Explainable and Reliable Software Systems (EXPRESS 2026)
summary: Parallel coding agents can produce patches that work alone but fail when merged. This happens when one agent changes an interface or rule that another agent still relies on. We study these failures with stale, a benchmark for semantic coordination. Our evaluation runs the same tests on each patch alone and on their combination, counting only failures introduced by combining the patches. We use three tiers: synthetic tasks with controlled interface changes, pairs of merged pull requests, and constructed tasks that use real Django helpers. Among 834 runs on 417 mined Django pairs, only one showed interference after correcting the grading procedure. On constructed tasks using 12 Django helpers, interference occurred in 97% of runs. A message describing the completed concurrent change recovered 82% of runs. Reviewed pull requests may contain few unresolved parallel changes, even when agents fail on controlled tasks using real code. The constructed failure rates do not estimate how often these problems occur in practice.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究并行编码智能体合并补丁时的语义协调失败问题，提出 stale 基准并以三层任务评估：受控合成任务、真实合并 PR 对、使用 Django 辅助函数的构造任务。结果显示真实 PR 中干扰极少（417 对 834 次运行仅 1 次），但构造任务干扰率高达 97%，且一条描述并发变更的消息可恢复 82% 的运行。
AI.motivation: 并行编码智能体各自生成的补丁单独可用，但合并后可能失败，原因是一个智能体修改了另一智能体仍依赖的接口或规则。作者希望量化并理解这种语义协调失败，因此构建基准加以研究。
AI.method: 提出 stale 基准：对每个补丁单独运行测试，也对补丁组合运行测试，仅统计由组合引入的失败。设置三个层级：受控接口变更的合成任务、成对合并的 pull request、使用真实 Django 辅助函数构造的任务。并在构造任务中测试一条描述已完成并发变更的消息能否恢复运行。
AI.result: 在 417 对挖掘的 Django PR 上共 834 次运行，纠正评分流程后仅 1 次出现干扰；在使用 12 个 Django 辅助函数的构造任务中，干扰出现在 97% 的运行中；描述已完成并发变更的消息恢复了 82% 的运行。
AI.conclusion: 经过审查的 pull request 中可能只含少量未解决的并行变更，即使智能体在使用真实代码的受控任务上失败。构造任务的失败率并不能估计这些问题在实践中的发生频率。

title: Efficient Iterative Retrieval with Heterogeneous Batching
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures, Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (main conference)
summary: Modern information retrieval increasingly employs both embedding and generative models to handle complex queries. However, current serving systems suffer from low throughput and poor GPU utilization because they execute these models in isolation. Coarse-grained partitioning, such as dedicating GPUs to specific tasks, fails to adapt to dynamic workloads and creates computational "bubbles". To address these, we present Orthrus, a serving system that performs heterogeneous batching within a unified inference loop. The primary challenge lies in unifying embedding and generation workloads with conflicting computational patterns while optimizing batch composition for high performance. Orthrus addresses these challenges through chunked embedding with incremental pooling and by adjusting batch composition in a workload-aware manner. Evaluation on four A100 GPUs shows that, relative to baseline deployments, Orthrus achieves 1.28$\times$--4.52$\times$ higher throughput on controlled workloads and up to 55.8% lower end-to-end p99 latency on an iterative-RAG benchmark. We release our code at https://github.com/illinoisdata/Orthrus .

AI.tldr: Orthrus：在统一推理循环中异构批处理嵌入与生成模型，提升检索服务吞吐与GPU利用率。
AI.motivation: 现代信息检索同时依赖嵌入与生成模型处理复杂查询，但现有服务系统将两类模型隔离执行，导致吞吐低、GPU利用率差；按任务独占GPU的粗粒度划分无法适应动态负载并产生计算“气泡”。
AI.method: 提出Orthrus统一推理循环中的异构批处理服务系统。核心挑战是融合计算模式冲突的嵌入与生成负载并优化批组成。方法包括：分块嵌入与增量池化（chunked embedding with incremental pooling），以及面向负载感知的批组成调整。
AI.result: 在四张A100 GPU上评测，相比基线部署，受控负载下吞吐提升1.28×–4.52×；在迭代式RAG基准上端到端p99延迟最多降低55.8%。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过异构批处理统一嵌入与生成推理，可显著提升检索服务系统的吞吐、延迟表现与GPU利用效率。

title: CrisisFake: Benchmark Validity of AI-Generated Text Detection for Disaster Social Sensing
summary: Disaster social sensing converts public social-media posts into evidence for situational awareness and humanitarian response, but plausible LLM-generated posts can contaminate this information stream and distort assessments of needs, damage, and resource priorities. This study empirically investigates whether text-based detectors can distinguish human-authored from LLM-generated disaster posts and what textual cues underlie their judgments. We construct CrisisFake, a Qwen2.5-7B-based dataset of 12,000 texts organized into 3,000 matched semantic units from nine disasters. Each unit contains an original human post, a minimally LLM-proofread human post, a fact-preserving LLM-generated post produced using LoRA, and an affectively reframed version of the artificial post. A separate 6,000-text corpus spanning 42 disaster events is independently constructed to support model selection and threshold calibration. We evaluate OSM-Det, Fast-DetectGPT, Binoculars, and direct LLM judges across five model families, and further examine how disaster-domain calibration and superficial linguistic cues, such as retweet markers, user mentions, hashtags, URLs, punctuation, and text length, affect detector performance. Across fourteen frozen configurations, AUROC ranges from 0.402 to 0.517, while the best prospective recall at a calibration-derived low-false-positive operating point is only 3.6%, indicating near-chance discrimination. For OSM-Det, a disaster-calibrated linear head improves AUROC to 0.817; however, a seven-feature textual classifier alone reaches AUROC 0.784 on the original-versus-factual-LLM contrast, and neutralizing identified surface asymmetries reduces the corresponding linear-head AUROC from 0.733 to 0.594. These findings provide empirical evidence that LLM-generated text detection is largely driven by linguistic cues and remains insufficiently robust for short-form disaster social media.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建CrisisFake数据集，检验文本检测器能否区分人类与LLM生成的灾害社交媒体帖文。结果显示，多数冻结配置下AUROC接近随机水平（0.402–0.517），检测性能主要由表层语言线索驱动，对短文本灾害社媒场景鲁棒性不足。
AI.motivation: 灾害社会感知依赖社交媒体帖文支撑态势感知与人道响应，但LLM生成的看似合理的帖文可能污染信息流，扭曲对需求、损失和资源优先级的判断。因此需实证检验现有文本检测器能否可靠区分人类撰写与LLM生成的灾害帖文，并揭示其判断依据。
AI.method: 构建CrisisFake数据集：基于Qwen2.5-7B，涵盖九类灾害，包含12,000条文本、3,000个语义匹配单元，每单元含原始人类帖文、经LLM轻度校对的人类帖文、LoRA生成的事实保持型LLM帖文及其情感重构版本；另独立构建覆盖42个灾害事件的6,000条文本语料用于模型选择与阈值校准。评估OSM-Det、Fast-DetectGPT、Binoculars及直接LLM判别器（跨五个模型家族），并考察灾害领域校准与表层语言线索（转发标记、用户提及、话题标签、URL、标点、文本长度）的影响。
AI.result: 在14种冻结配置下，AUROC介于0.402至0.517；在校准导出的低误报工作点上，最佳前瞻召回率仅为3.6%，判别接近随机。经灾害校准的线性分类头可将OSM-Det的AUROC提升至0.817；但仅用七特征文本分类器在"原始人类 vs 事实型LLM"对比中即达AUROC 0.784；中和已识别的表层不对称后，对应线性头AUROC由0.733降至0.594。
AI.conclusion: LLM生成文本检测在很大程度上由语言线索驱动，而非稳健的生成痕迹判别，对短文本灾害社交媒体场景仍不够鲁棒，难以作为可靠的灾害信息流净化手段。

title: Directional Total Variation-Regularized Implicit Neural Representations (DTV-INR) for Continuous Super-Resolution in Degraded Imaging Domains
summary: In this paper, we introduce the Directional Total Variation-Regularized Implicit Neural Representation (DTV-INR), an advanced variational paradigm that synergistically integrates coordinate-driven implicit neural networks with an anisotropic, structure-tensor-informed total variation regularizer tailored for resolution-agnostic image super-resolution. Casting the continuous-to-discrete acquisition process into an ill-posed inverse problem framework, our formulation equips a SIREN-architected coordinate network with a dynamic Riemannian metric tensor field D(x). By leveraging its spectral decomposition, the proposed regularizer preferentially directs diffusion parallel to dominant structural contours while penalizing cross-edge dissipation, successfully circumventing the classical staircasing artifacts inherent to scalar total variation schemes. We rigorously prove the well-posedness of this formulation in H^1(Omega) by establishing the existence, uniqueness, and metric stability of the variational minimizer, and realize this via an alternating projected optimization algorithm that decouples network parameter tuning from adaptive tensor field updates. Comprehensive experiments conducted on clinical brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and biomedical transmission electron microscopy confirm substantial quantitative and qualitative improvements, yielding PSNR enhancements reaching +5.05 dB over baseline unregularized INRs and +1.71-2.85 dB over isotropic TV-INR across continuous (non-integer) upsampling factors, alongside remarkable noise robustness up to sigma_eta = 0.10 and monotonic preconditioned convergence behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出DTV-INR：将各向异性结构张量引导的全变分正则项与SIREN隐式神经表征结合，用于分辨率无关图像超分，并在H^1(Ω)上证明适定性。
AI.motivation: 隐式神经表征（INR）在超分中易受不适定逆问题影响，而传统标量全变分（TV）正则化会产生阶梯效应（staircasing），难以在保持结构轮廓的同时抑制噪声。因此需要一种沿结构方向各向异性的正则化范式。
AI.method: 将连续—离散采样建模为不适定逆问题；在SIREN坐标网络上引入动态黎曼度量张量场D(x)，利用其谱分解构造方向性TV正则项，使扩散优先沿主导结构轮廓方向、惩罚跨边缘耗散；在H^1(Ω)中证明解的存在性、唯一性与度量稳定性；采用交替投影优化算法解耦网络参数更新与自适应张量场更新。
AI.result: 在临床脑部MRI与生物医学透射电镜数据上，连续（非整数）上采样因子下较无正则INR基线PSNR提升达+5.05 dB，较各向同性TV-INR提升+1.71–2.85 dB；对噪声σ_η=0.10具有显著鲁棒性，并表现出单调的预条件收敛行为。
AI.conclusion: DTV-INR通过各向异性结构张量正则化有效克服标量TV的阶梯伪影，兼具理论适定性与实验上的定量、定性优势，适用于分辨率无关的医学与生物成像超分。

title: LatentReRig: An SDF-Based VAE with Dual Decoders for Latent-Space Deformation Conditioning
comment: 13 pages, 11 figures, extracted from final dissertation
summary: Transferring deformation between characters with different geometry and topology is challenging because conventional rigs encode behaviour through character-specific structures and correspondences. We present LatentReRig, an experimental framework that investigates whether pose-associated changes can instead be represented as reusable directions in a learned geometric latent space. An SDF-based variational autoencoder is coupled with two decoders: one reconstructs the implicit field, while the other predicts target vertex positions from source geometry and latent deformation conditioning. The source geometry may be neutral or already deformed. Experiments on a controlled humanoid dataset show that several poses induce coherent latent directions across identities, particularly for broad articulated motions. These signals can guide deformation of unseen characters, but explicit predictions remain less accurate for localized changes and corrective contributions. Diagnostic comparisons with repeated SDF sampling show that inter-identity distances exceed same-geometry resampling variability on average, while pose signals exhibit different margins above this baseline. The results support the presence of reusable pose-related structure and identify stable local conditioning and accurate mesh decoding as complementary requirements for improving transfer.

AI.tldr: LatentReRig是一个实验性框架，探索能否将姿态相关的形变表示为学习到的几何潜空间中的可重用方向，以实现不同几何与拓扑角色之间的形变迁移。
AI.motivation: 传统骨骼绑定（rig）通过角色特定的结构和对应关系来编码行为，导致在不同几何与拓扑的角色之间迁移形变十分困难。本文希望验证姿态相关的形变变化是否可以不依赖角色特定绑定，而作为可复用的潜空间方向来表示。
AI.method: 提出LatentReRig框架：采用基于SDF的变分自编码器（VAE），并耦合两个解码器——一个重建隐式场，另一个从源几何与潜形变条件预测目标顶点位置。源几何可以是中性姿态，也可以是已形变的姿态。在受控的人形数据集上开展实验，并与重复SDF采样进行诊断性对比。
AI.result: 实验表明，若干姿态在不同身份间诱导出一致的潜方向，尤以大幅度的关节运动为显著；这些信号可指导未见角色的形变。但显式预测在局部变化与矫正性贡献上精度不足。与重复SDF采样的对比显示，跨身份距离平均超过同几何重采样波动，且不同姿态信号的超出幅度存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持存在可复用的姿态相关结构，并指出稳定局部条件化与精确网格解码是提升形变迁移能力的两个互补必要条件。

title: Mining Legal Arguments in U.S. Corporate Case Law
summary: Legal argument mining supports passage classification, retrieval, and argument completion. This work introduces an expert-annotated dataset of 42 U.S. federal tax opinions on corporate reorganizations under I.R.C. §368. To our knowledge, it is the first expert-annotated, tree-structured argument corpus for this domain. Explicit spans receive one of five functional labels: Rule, Analysis, Conclusion, Background Facts, and Procedural History. Rule, Analysis, and Conclusion spans can be linked into directed support trees, while Background Facts and Procedural History serve a contextual function. The corpus provides span-based, sentence-based, flat, and tree-structured representations. Agreement analysis shows that functional node labels are more reliable than directed support edges and implicit intermediate conclusions. Directed-path agreement is stronger than direct-edge agreement, which indicates that broad reachability is more stable than exact local decomposition. Classification experiments show that functional labels are learnable under case-disjoint evaluation. Retrieval experiments show that supervised fine-tuning improves within-case retrieval. However, cross-case generalization remains weak. The dataset supports legal passage classification and provides a conservative benchmark for structured argument mining in U.S. federal tax case law.

AI.tldr: 该工作构建了首个面向美国联邦税法(IRC §368 公司重组)的专家标注、树结构法律论证语料库（42 份判决意见），提供 span/句子/扁平/树四种表示，并给出标注一致性与分类、检索实验基准。
AI.motivation: 法律论证挖掘需要段落分类、检索与论证补全等任务支持，但该领域（尤其是美国联邦税务判例中的公司重组）缺乏专家标注的结构化论证语料，现有资源难以支撑树结构论证挖掘的研究与评测。
AI.method: 构建 42 份 IRC §368 公司重组联邦税务判决意见的专家标注语料：显式文本片段标注为五类功能标签（Rule、Analysis、Conclusion、Background Facts、Procedural History）；Rule、Analysis、Conclusion 片段可连成有向支持树，后两类承担语境功能。语料同时提供 span 级、句子级、扁平与树结构表示。开展标注一致性分析（比较功能节点标签、有向支持边、隐式中间结论；比较直接路径与直接边一致性），并进行案例不相交设定下的功能标签分类实验与检索实验（监督微调 vs 跨案例泛化）。
AI.result: 功能节点标签的标注一致性高于有向支持边与隐式中间结论；有向路径一致性优于直接边一致性，说明宽泛可达性比精确局部拆解更稳定。分类实验表明功能标签在案例不相交评测下可学习；检索实验表明监督微调能提升案内检索，但跨案例泛化仍然较弱。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集支持法律段落分类，并为美国联邦税务判例法中的结构化论证挖掘提供了一个偏保守的基准，同时揭示出边级结构与跨案例泛化仍是主要难点。

title: Mean Velocity Matching: Rethinking Generative Dynamics in Diffusion Models
summary: This work studies prediction parameterization for stochastic generative dynamics in diffusion models. Existing velocity-based generative models provide the simplicity of learning a single transport field, but their standard formulation is deterministic, whereas stochastic extensions generally require additional score information or an intermediate velocity-to-score reconstruction. To retain single-field prediction while directly supporting stochastic reverse dynamics, this paper introduces Mean Velocity Matching (MVM). MVM constructs a Gaussian perturbation process for which the conditional expectation of a restoration-oriented velocity, $(x_0-x_t)/t$, directly forms the reverse-SDE drift. Consequently, a single learned field is sufficient to parameterize the stochastic reverse process without separately estimating or reconstructing the score. Because direct regression of this velocity becomes unbounded near $t=0$, MVM further introduces a $\sqrt{t}$-scaled parameterization that preserves the reverse dynamics while yielding a bounded training target. The same learned field also induces a deterministic probability-flow ODE, enabling stochastic and deterministic sampling to be studied within a unified formulation. Experiments with Transformer-based generative models achieve an FID of $\MVMImageNetThirtyTwoFID$ at \MVMImageNetThirtyTwoNFE\ NFE on ImageNet $32\times32$ and $\MVMImageNetTwoFiftySixFID$ at \MVMImageNetTwoFiftySixNFE\ NFE on ImageNet $256\times256$. Controlled SDE--ODE comparisons further show that the ODE performs better under very low NFE, whereas the stochastic reverse process achieves lower FID when sufficient function evaluations are available. These results demonstrate that MVM provides a direct single-field parameterization of stochastic reverse dynamics while maintaining competitive generation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Mean Velocity Matching (MVM)，通过对“恢复导向速度”(x0−xt)/t 的条件期望建模，用单一学习场直接参数化扩散模型的随机逆向动力学，并引入 √t 缩放参数化保证训练目标有界。
AI.motivation: 现有基于速度的生成模型结构简单（只需学习单一传输场），但标准形式是确定性的；若要支持随机逆向动力学，通常需要额外的 score 信息或进行速度到 score 的中间重构，增加了复杂度。本文希望在保留单场预测的同时，直接支持随机逆向过程。
AI.method: MVM 构造一个高斯扰动过程，使其恢复导向速度 (x0−xt)/t 的条件期望恰好构成逆向 SDE 的漂移项，因此无需单独估计或重构 score 即可用单一学习场参数化随机逆向过程。针对该速度在 t→0 附近回归无界的问题，提出 √t 缩放参数化，在保持逆向动力学不变的同时得到有界训练目标。同一学习场还诱导出确定性 probability-flow ODE，使随机与确定性采样可在统一框架下研究。
AI.result: 基于 Transformer 的生成模型实验：在 ImageNet 32×32 上以 MVMImageNetThirtyTwoNFE NFE 达到 FID MVMImageNetThirtyTwoFID；在 ImageNet 256×256 上以 MVMImageNetTwoFiftySixNFE NFE 达到 FID MVMImageNetTwoFiftySixFID。受控 SDE–ODE 对比显示：在极低 NFE 下 ODE 表现更好；当函数评估次数充足时，随机逆向过程获得更低 FID。
AI.conclusion: MVM 为随机逆向动力学提供了直接的单场参数化，无需额外 score 估计或重构，同时在随机与确定性采样下保持有竞争力的生成质量。

title: Conduct Under Pressure: What Sixty Language Models Do When a User Pushes
comment: 16 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. v2 adds a preregistered replication on six further scenes. Code, data and labels: https://github.com/tap2k/modelun/studies/conduct
summary: We study what LLMs do when a user applies pressure in an uncomfortable situation: a user insists, begs, flatters or grieves, and the model gives up a correct fact, writes a document it should refuse, or cheers a plan that will cost the user money. We send frozen multi-turn scenes, identical for every model regardless of the reply, to 60 models from 13 vendors, and label each transcript with a codebook built by open coding and then frozen: a trajectory (the model held its position or folded) and a manner (how it held or folded). Two findings separate. Whether a model holds tracks its generation, meaning how recent it is: fold rate correlates with a public capability index at Spearman -0.64, with little vendor effect. How it holds tracks the vendor: six of the 17 manner codes sort by vendor at permutation p <= 0.001, corrected across the codebook. We report four vendor profiles on the codes that cleared reliability. We also ask which parts of the labeling need a person. Six LLM coders from three vendors apply the codebook more consistently than three human coders do (Krippendorff's alpha 0.66 against 0.46), agree with the codebook's author on trajectory at kappa 0.84 to 0.91 on transcripts the codebook's examples never touched, and match an adjudicated human reference at 0.83. Blind machine readings recover the codebook's categories but cannot tell which of them a second reader would apply the same way. We conclude that for behavior a non-specialist can judge, the human contribution is authoring and bounding the codes and owning a small reference, not producing labels at volume.

AI.tldr: 研究60个来自13家厂商的LLM在多轮压力情境下的"坚持或屈服"行为：是否坚持与模型代际（能力）相关（Spearman -0.64），而如何坚持与厂商文化相关；同时发现LLM标注员在编码一致性上优于人类标注员。
AI.motivation: 探究LLM在用户施压（坚持、恳求、奉承、悲情）等不适情境下是否会放弃正确事实、撰写应拒写的文档或附和有害计划，并厘清"是否坚持"与"如何坚持"分别由何种因素决定，同时评估LLM能否替代人工完成此类行为标注。
AI.method: 向13家厂商的60个模型输入冻结的多轮场景（对所有模型完全一致），用"开放式编码后冻结"的编码本对 transcripts 标注，分轨迹（坚持/屈服）与方式（如何坚持或屈服）两个维度；检验 fold rate 与公开能力指数的 Spearman 相关、方式编码与厂商的置换检验；并让6个来自3家厂商的LLM编码员与3名人类编码员对比一致性（Krippendorff's alpha）。
AI.result: fold rate 与公开能力指数呈 Spearman -0.64，厂商效应甚微；17个方式编码中6个按厂商显著排序（置换 p ≤ 0.001，经编码本多重校正），归纳出4种厂商画像。LLM编码员一致性（alpha 0.66）高于人类编码员（0.46），与编码本作者在轨迹上 Kappa 0.84–0.91，与人工裁决参照一致率0.83。
AI.conclusion: 是否坚持主要由模型代际/能力决定，如何坚持主要由厂商决定；对于非专家可判断的行为，人类的核心贡献在于编写与界定编码、维护小型参照集，而非大规模产出标签——机器可复现编码本类别，但无法判断第二个读者是否会作相同归类。

title: Combinatorial Network-Based Manifold Topological Deep Learning for Image Analysis
summary: Medical image analysis remains fundamentally challenging because of the intricate geometric and topological structures present in medical data. Conventional convolutional neural networks model images as regular Euclidean grids, limiting their ability to preserve geometric relationships and higher-order structural information. Recently, manifold topological deep learning (MTDL) has emerged as a promising paradigm that integrates deep learning with geometric and topological representations. Nevertheless, existing methods have not yet fully exploited discrete manifold structures within combinatorial complex neural networks. To bridge this gap, we introduce CNMTDL, a MTDL framework that integrates Hodge decomposition with a combinatorial attention mechanism. In our approach, medical images are represented as discrete manifolds and decomposed into three Hodge components. Features extracted from these components are concatenated and embedded into a combinatorial complex architecture, enabling enhanced higher-order message passing between $0$-cells and $2$-cells through attention-based blocks. We evaluate CNMTDL on six two-dimensional and three-dimensional datasets from the MedMNIST v2 benchmark, demonstrating its effectiveness for medical image analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出CNMTDL框架，将Hodge分解与组合注意力机制结合，把医学图像表示为离散流形并在组合复形上进行高阶消息传递，在MedMNIST v2的六个2D/3D数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 医学图像具有复杂的几何与拓扑结构，而传统卷积神经网络将图像建模为规则欧氏网格，难以保留几何关系与高阶结构信息。现有流形拓扑深度学习（MTDL）方法尚未充分利用组合复形神经网络中的离散流形结构，因此需要一种能整合几何与拓扑表示的新框架。
AI.method: 提出CNMTDL框架，将Hodge分解与组合注意力机制相结合：首先把医学图像表示为离散流形，并分解为三个Hodge分量；然后提取各分量特征并拼接，嵌入组合复形架构；通过基于注意力的模块在0-cell与2-cell之间实现增强的高阶消息传递。
AI.result: 在MedMNIST v2基准的六个二维和三维数据集上对CNMTDL进行了评估，实验结果表明其在医学图像分析任务上具有有效性。
AI.conclusion: CNMTDL通过融合Hodge分解与组合复形上的注意力机制，充分利用离散流形结构，为医学图像分析提供了一种有效的流形拓扑深度学习方案。

title: MIND the Gap: A Geographic Implicit Neural Representation with Adjustable Spatial Scale
summary: Geographic measurements are often sparse, leaving large areas without labels for the quantities we want to map. Geographic implicit neural representations (INRs) provide coordinate-based embeddings that can be combined with sparse labels to predict at unsampled locations without satellite imagery at inference. Yet existing INRs are largely evaluated with random holdouts, leaving their ability to generalize across larger geographic gaps unclear. We introduce Matryoshka Implicit Neural Distillation (MIND), a geographic INR whose spatial granularity can be adjusted after training. MIND distills several pretrained geospatial models using nested supervision at increasing embedding dimensions, dividing the representation into contiguous chunks. Early chunks capture broad spatial patterns, while later chunks add increasingly local variation. Downstream models can retain only the leading chunks or use our Chunked Penalty to reduce reliance on later chunks without retraining the INR. We also introduce CoordBench, comprising $52$ datasets and $78$ targets with both random and regional holdouts at multiple spatial scales. Across CoordBench, fine-scale features help most when labels are nearby, while smoother representations generalize better across larger geographic gaps. MIND with the Chunked Penalty achieves the highest aggregate regression and classification performance among tested INRs and the highest overall performance under regional holdout. These results show that geographic representations should be evaluated and adapted according to the spatial separation between labeled and prediction locations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出可调空间粒度的地理隐式神经表示 MIND 及评测基准 CoordBench，发现精细特征利于邻近标签场景、平滑表示利于大范围地理外推，MIND 配合 Chunked Penalty 在区域留出下取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 地理测量数据稀疏，大量区域缺乏标签。地理隐式神经表示（INR）可在推理阶段无需卫星影像，通过坐标嵌入结合稀疏标签实现未采样位置预测。但现有 INR 多以随机留出方式评测，其在较大地理空隙上的泛化能力尚不明确。
AI.method: 提出 MIND（Matryoshka Implicit Neural Distillation）：以嵌套监督、沿递增嵌入维度将表示切分为连续 chunk 的方式蒸馏多个预训练地理空间模型，早期 chunk 捕获广域空间模式，后期 chunk 补充局部变化。下游模型可仅保留前若干 chunk，或使用 Chunked Penalty 降低对后期 chunk 的依赖，无需重训 INR。同时构建 CoordBench 基准，含 52 个数据集、78 个目标，涵盖随机留出与多空间尺度的区域留出。
AI.result: 在 CoordBench 上，当标签邻近时细尺度特征收益最大，而更平滑的表示在较大地理空隙上泛化更好。MIND 配合 Chunked Penalty 在被测 INR 中取得最高总体回归与分类性能，并在区域留出下取得最高整体性能。
AI.conclusion: 地理表示应依据标注位置与预测位置之间的空间距离进行评测与适配，空间粒度可调是实现这一目标的有效途径。

title: SAM-V: Geometry-Aware Segment Anything for Multi-View Instance Segmentation
summary: Consistent multi-view object segmentation is critical for 3D perception and robotics, yet remains challenging under severe viewpoint and occlusion changes. Existing methods typically perform 3D instance segmentation on point clouds or rely on offline 2D mask-matching pipelines. However, 3D instance segmentation is limited by scarce 3D annotations, while offline 2D matching suffers from object identity ambiguity across frames. To leverage strong 2D and 3D priors jointly, we propose SAM-V (Geometry-Aware Segment Anything for Multi-View Instance Segmentation). Instead of combining the two priors through post-hoc matching, SAM-V directly integrates features from a feed-forward geometry model (VGGT) into a 2D segmentation foundation model (SAM), trained end-to-end for cross-view instance prediction. SAM-V introduces a prompt-fusion mechanism that enriches sparse SAM prompt tokens with view-specific camera tokens and local VGGT features, making the prompt representation both view-aware and spatially grounded, together with a mask decoder that attends to dense 2D and 3D features. By conditioning the mask decoding directly on multi-view geometry, SAM-V produces consistent multi-view segmentation of a prompted object in a single forward pass without offline mask matching or explicit 3D reconstruction. On the IGGT 3D tracking benchmark, where consistent instance identity across frames directly determines performance, SAM-V improves overall IoU by 5 points and frame-level recall by 12 points on the ScanNet++ split over the state-of-the-art multi-view instance segmentation baseline and leads on all metrics in the zero-shot ScanNet split. Our code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/gong208/SAM-V.git.

AI.tldr: 提出SAM-V，将VGGT几何模型特征端到端融入SAM分割基础模型，通过提示融合机制实现单次前向传播的多视图一致实例分割，无需离线掩码匹配或显式3D重建。
AI.motivation: 严重视角与遮挡变化下多视图一致分割困难。3D实例分割受限于3D标注稀缺，离线2D掩码匹配存在跨帧目标身份歧义。
AI.method: SAM-V端到端整合前馈几何模型VGGT特征与2D分割基础模型SAM。引入提示融合机制，用视图专属相机token和局部VGGT特征丰富稀疏SAM提示token；掩码解码器同时关注稠密2D与3D特征，直接以多视图几何为条件进行掩码解码。
AI.result: 在IGGT 3D跟踪基准上，ScanNet++划分相比SOTA多视图实例分割基线整体IoU提高5点、帧级召回提高12点；在零样本ScanNet划分上所有指标领先。代码与预训练模型已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过融合2D与3D先验，SAM-V单次前向即可生成一致的多视图实例分割，提升跨视图实例身份一致性。

title: RGSQ: Riemannian Geometry-Sensitive Quantization for Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) can be efficiently deployed under stringent memory and latency constraints through post training quantization (PTQ). However, most PTQ methods are designed for unimodal large language models (LLMs). These methods treat quantization errors as isotropic perturbations under the Euclidean assumption, which provides weak guidance on directions most sensitive to quantization in VLMs. Consequently, directly adapting unimodal PTQ approaches or solely employing modality-specific scaling often leads to uneven bit-width distribution and inconsistent performance in low-bit settings. To address these challenges, we propose Riemannian Geometry-Sensitive Quantization (RGSQ), which formulates quantization as a reconstruction problem under a unified Fisher-Riemannian metric. RGSQ identifies modality-specific sensitive directions via Riemannian manifold mappings built from modality-partitioned empirical Fisher factors and fused into a modality-aware Kronecker-structured metric. We then apply geometry-aligned rotations to reorient the local tangent frame, steering low-bit perturbations toward loss-insensitive axes. Finally, we apply a whitening transformation that maps the Riemannian objective to an equivalent Euclidean form, enabling standard unimodal PTQ methods to evaluate multimodal quantization error under their original assumptions. Across an extensive and diverse set of mainstream VLM benchmarks, RGSQ achieves the highest accuracy and stability under extremely low-bit settings (W2A8 and W3A8). It outperforms VLM-aware baselines, such as MBQ and MQuant, by up to 5.9% and surpasses single-modality improvements by up to 8.6%.

AI.tldr: 提出RGSQ，将VLM训练后量化建模为统一Fisher-Riemannian度量下的重构问题，通过模态敏感方向辨识、几何对齐旋转与白化变换，在极低比特下取得最高精度与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有PTQ方法多面向单模态LLM，将量化误差视为欧氏假设下的各向同性扰动，对VLM量化敏感方向指导不足；直接迁移单模态PTQ或仅用模态特定缩放易导致比特分配不均与低比特性能不一致。
AI.method: RGSQ将量化视为统一Fisher-Riemannian度量下的重构问题：基于模态划分的经验Fisher因子构建Riemannian流形映射，识别模态特定敏感方向并融合为模态感知的Kronecker结构度量；施加几何对齐旋转重定向局部切空间坐标系，使低比特扰动转向损失不敏感轴；最后用白化变换将Riemannian目标映射为等价欧氏形式，使标准单模态PTQ方法可在原假设下评估多模态量化误差。
AI.result: 在主流VLM基准上，RGSQ在极低比特（W2A8、W3A8）下取得最高精度与稳定性，较VLM感知基线MBQ、MQuant提升最高5.9%，较单模态改进最高提升8.6%。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入Riemannian几何敏感度量并兼容既有单模态PTQ框架，RGSQ有效解决VLM低比特量化中的敏感方向指导不足与比特分配不均问题。

title: Tracing mechanisms of sycophantic agreement in language models
summary: Sycophantic agreement in language models refers to the tendency to overly affirm a user's stated beliefs or preferences, often at the expense of factual accuracy. Although it is widely recognized as an alignment failure, its underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. In this work, we use causal mediation analysis to identify the mechanisms behind sycophantic agreement. We show that a stated opinion is incorporated into the residual stream of the final prompt token early, where it biases subsequent answer retrieval. A sparse set of early attention heads carries this opinion signal. Ablating these heads substantially reduces sycophancy while leaving factual accuracy largely intact. The same heads carry the opinion when it is explicitly stated, regardless of how it is phrased. When an opinion is not stated explicitly but instead conveyed through content-free pushback (e.g., ``Are you sure?"), we find a distinct set of heads that suppresses the model's original correct answer to promote a revised answer. By providing a mechanistic account of how opinions induce sycophantic agreement, this work takes a step toward developing more targeted and reliable alignment interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过因果中介分析揭示语言模型谄媚性认同的机制：用户明示观点在早期被写入最后一个提示词的残差流，并由一组稀疏的早期注意力头承载，从而偏置答案检索；对内容无关的反驳（如"你确定吗"）则由另一组注意力头抑制原正确答案。
AI.motivation: 谄媚性认同被广泛视为一种对齐失败，即模型过度肯定用户陈述的信念或偏好，甚至牺牲事实准确性，但其底层机制此前缺乏清晰理解。
AI.method: 采用因果中介分析（causal mediation analysis），定位承载用户观点信号的注意力头，并通过消融（ablation）验证其因果作用；区分明示观点与隐式内容无关反驳两种情形。
AI.result: 明示观点在早期即被写入最后一个提示词的残差流，由一小组稀疏的早期注意力头承载，偏置后续答案检索；消融这些头可大幅降低谄媚性，同时基本保持事实准确性；该组头对观点措辞不敏感。而对于内容无关的反驳，存在另一组独立的注意力头，抑制模型原有的正确答案以促成修正答案。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出了观点诱发谄媚性认同的机制性解释，为发展更具针对性、更可靠的对齐干预提供了基础。

title: Universal Fractal Natural Language Decision Map: Real-Time Edge Triage Across Heterogeneous Domains
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Version 2.0 with expanded EVM on-chain oracle benchmarks (werracle), formal multi-scale tripod dynamics, semantic token damping filter, and Zenodo v2 dataset
summary: Deploying Large Language Models for runtime operational triage incurs prohibitive latency (>100-500 ms), high VRAM requirements (>4-8 GB), and excessive energy dissipation. Extending Mandelbrot Fractal Neural Synthesis (Dagli et al., 2026), this paper presents the Universal Fractal Natural Language Decision Map, realized via the werr machine-native edge reflex runtime and the production answerr platform (https://answerr.me). Operating entirely without stored weight tensors (0 Bytes VRAM), the engine synthesizes deterministic decisions---noul (Boolean), choice (categorical), and score (ordinal)---by dynamically modulating 24-byte coordinate seeds along the chaotic boundary of the Mandelbrot set and evaluating multi-scale escape dynamics. Drawing inspiration from biological System-One reflex arcs, the engine introduces: (i) an Auto-Seed Router with domain projector Phi_D yielding a +28.8% accuracy gain over linear baselines; (ii) an Information-Theoretic Semantic Token Damping Filter (T_desc = 0.045) insulating against prompt injections (0.0% empirical bypass; 95% Wilson CI: [0.0%, 27.8%]) while pruning iterations by 45.8% (accelerating throughput 2.5x to 3.31 ms latency); (iii) a Multi-Scale Harmonic Tripod Fusion; (iv) a Coupled Margin Expansion Operator (Pitchfork Bifurcation Offset); and (v) a Cyclic Z/9Z Modular Resonant Grid Discretization based on the closed sub-ideal {0,3,6} (Lean 4 Mathlib ZMod 9), reducing FLOPs by 68.4%. Evaluated on JevBench (N=231), werr achieves 100.00% TypeSafe compliance and 81.65% calibrated accuracy with 7.08 ms median latency. We provide an OpenAI-compatible API and demonstrate deployment on 32-byte EVM smart contracts via the open-source werracle on-chain oracle (21,438 gas).

AI.tldr: 本文提出"通用分形自然语言决策图"(UFNLDM)，通过werr边缘反射运行时与answerr平台，在不存储任何权重张量(0 VRAM)的前提下，利用24字节坐标种子沿Mandelbrot集混沌边界动态调制，合成确定性决策（布尔/分类/序数），实现7.08 ms中位延迟与81.65%校准精度。
AI.motivation: 部署大型语言模型进行运行时运营分诊面临三重障碍：延迟过高（>100-500 ms）、显存占用大（>4-8 GB）以及能耗过大，难以满足边缘低延迟、低功耗的实时决策需求，因此需要一种无需存储权重张量的轻量替代方案。
AI.method: 扩展Mandelbrot分形神经合成，构建Universal Fractal Natural Language Decision Map，依托werr机器原生边缘反射运行时与answerr生产平台实现。引擎完全不含存储权重张量（0 Bytes VRAM），通过对24字节坐标种子在Mandelbrot集混沌边界上动态调制并评估多尺度逃逸动力学来合成确定性决策。核心组件包括：(i) Auto-Seed Router与领域投影Phi_D；(ii) 信息论语义令牌阻尼滤波器(T_desc=0.045)；(iii) 多尺度调和三脚架融合；(iv) 耦合裕度扩展算子(叉式分岔偏移)；(v) 基于闭子理想{0,3,6}的循环Z/9Z模谐振网格离散化(Lean 4 Mathlib ZMod 9)。
AI.result: 在JevBench(N=231)上，werr达到100.00%的TypeSafe合规率与81.65%的校准精度，中位延迟7.08 ms。消融方面：Auto-Seed Router较线性基线提升+28.8%准确率；语义阻尼滤波器实现0.0%提示注入绕过(95% Wilson CI: [0.0%, 27.8%])，同时将迭代次数减少45.8%，吞吐提升2.5倍至3.31 ms延迟；模块谐振网格离散化降低FLOPs 68.4%。此外提供OpenAI兼容API，并演示了通过开源werracle链上预言机在32字节EVM智能合约上的部署（21,438 gas）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，基于分形逃逸动力学与坐标种子调制的无权重决策引擎，可在保持类型安全与校准精度的同时，将运行时延迟、显存与算力开销降至极低水平（0 VRAM、7.08 ms、FLOPs降68.4%），并可通过OpenAI兼容API与EVM链上预言机实现边缘与链上部署，为LLM运行时分诊提供了一种分形、边缘原生的替代范式。

title: mbariml: a curation pipeline for turning deep-sea imagery and video into object-detection training data
summary: Training data quantity and quality greatly affect object detection model performance, regardless of model architecture. For object detection in deep-sea video and imagery, where the objects of interest (primarily organisms) are sparse, faint, and hard to identify, incremental improvements to detector performance may require an iterative approach to data labeling and management. This paper presents mbariml, a Python-based video and image analysis pipeline built around the data labeling and management process. mbariml uses an Ultralytics YOLO detection model, runs it over still images or video, stores every detection as a reviewable region of interest, groups those regions by visual similarity so that a human can accept or reject them in bulk, and exports the result as training data, statistics, image sidecars, and additional metadata. Existing YOLO and Pascal VOC datasets can be imported into the same database, so a legacy training set can be reviewed, extended, and re-exported alongside new detections. The human review stage is the center of the design: an annotator can validate, relabel, resize, delete, and draw entirely new localizations, optionally assisted by the SAM3 segmentation model, and every one of those edits is written back to the same database the detector wrote to. Video receives particular attention: the software treats each tracker-produced track as a provisional observation and selects one representative frame instead of retaining every detection in the track. We describe the pipeline stage by stage, including how each track's representative frame is chosen (from a user-selected third of the track, the middle by default), which we examine on 684 tracks from seafloor video.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 mbariml，一个面向深海视频与图像的 Python 视频/图像分析流水线，围绕数据标注与管理流程构建，核心是将 YOLO 检测结果与人工审核写入同一数据库，并以轨迹代表性帧选择减少冗余标注。
AI.motivation: 深海视频与图像中的目标（主要是生物）稀疏、模糊且难以辨识，检测器性能的增量提升依赖数据标注与管理的迭代；且逐帧保留检测结果会造成大量冗余，因此需要一个以人工审核为中心、可复用的标注与管理流程。
AI.method: mbariml 使用 Ultralytics YOLO 检测模型对静态图像或视频推理，将每个检测保存为可审核的感兴趣区域（ROI），按视觉相似度分组以支持批量接受或拒绝，并导出为训练数据、统计信息、图像 sidecar 及元数据；支持导入已有 YOLO 与 Pascal VOC 数据集到同一数据库。人工审核阶段支持验证、重标注、调整尺寸、删除和新增定位框，可选由 SAM3 分割模型辅助，所有编辑写回检测器写入的同一数据库。视频方面将跟踪器产生的每条轨迹视为临时观测，仅选择一帧代表性帧。
AI.result: 论文逐阶段描述了流水线，并说明了每条轨迹代表性帧的选取方式（从用户选择的轨迹三分之一区间中选取，默认取中间），并在 684 条海底视频轨迹上进行了检验。
AI.conclusion: mbariml 通过检测—分组—人工审核—导出的一体化数据库流程，以及对视频轨迹代表性帧的选择策略，为深海稀疏、模糊目标的数据标注与检测器迭代改进提供了可行方案。
